verses.translation: Let him fully consider the future and the immediate results of all undertakings, and the good and bad sides of all past (actions).
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: आयत्यां गुणदोषज्ञस्तदात्वे क्षिप्रनिश्चयः । अतीते कार्यशेषज्ञः शत्रुभिर्नाभिभूयते
verses.transliteration: AyatyAM guNadoShaj~nastadAtve kShipranishchayaH | atIte kAryasheShaj~naH shatrubhirnAbhibhUyate
verses.translation: He who knows the good and the evil (which will result from his acts) in the future, is quick in forming resolutions for the present, and understands the consequences of past (actions), will not be conquered.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: दण्डः शास्ति प्रजाः सर्वा दण्ड एवाभिरक्षति । दण्डः सुप्तेषु जागर्ति दण्डं धर्मं विदुर्बुधाः
verses.transliteration: daNDaH shAsti prajAH sarvA daNDa evAbhirakShati | daNDaH supteShu jAgarti daNDaM dharmaM vidurbudhAH
verses.translation: Punishment alone governs all created beings, punishment alone protects them, punishment watches over them while they sleep; the wise declare punishment (to be identical with) the law.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: यथैनं नाभिसंदध्युर्मित्रोदासीनशत्रवः । तथा सर्वं संविदध्यादेष सामासिको नयः
verses.transliteration: yathainaM nAbhisa.ndadhyurmitrodAsInashatravaH | tathA sarvaM sa.nvidadhyAdeSha sAmAsiko nayaH
verses.translation: Let him arrange everything in such a manner that no ally, no neutral or foe may injure him; that is the sum of political wisdom.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: तदा तु यानमातिष्ठेदरिराष्ट्रं प्रति प्रभुः । तदानेन विधानेन यायादरिपुरं शनैः
verses.transliteration: tadA tu yAnamAtiShThedarirAShTraM prati prabhuH | tadAnena vidhAnena yAyAdaripuraM shanaiH
verses.translation: But if the king undertakes an expedition against a hostile kingdom, then let him gradually advance, in the following manner, against his foe's capital.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: मार्गशीर्षे शुभे मासि यायाद्यात्रां महीपतिः । फाल्गुनं वाथ चैत्रं वा मासौ प्रति यथाबलम्
verses.transliteration: mArgashIrShe shubhe mAsi yAyAdyAtrAM mahIpatiH | phAlgunaM vAtha chaitraM vA mAsau prati yathAbalam
verses.translation: Let the king undertake his march in the fine month Margasirsha, or towards the months of Phalguna and Kaitra, according to the (condition of his) army.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: अन्येष्वपि तु कालेषु यदा पश्येद्ध्रुवं जयम् । तदा यायाद्विगृह्यैव व्यसने चोत्थिते रिपोः
verses.transliteration: anyeShvapi tu kAleShu yadA pashyeddhruvaM jayam | tadA yAyAdvigR^ihyaiva vyasane chotthite ripoH
verses.translation: Even at other times, when he has a certain prospect of victory, or when a disaster has befallen his foe, he may advance to attack him.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा विधानं मूले तु यात्रिकं च यथाविधि । उपगृह्यास्पदं चैव चारान् सम्यग्विधाय च
verses.transliteration: kR^itvA vidhAnaM mUle tu yAtrikaM cha yathAvidhi | upagR^ihyAspadaM chaiva chArAn samyagvidhAya cha
verses.translation: But having duly arranged (all affairs) in his original (kingdom) and what relates to the expedition, having secured a basis (for his operations) and having duly dispatched his spies;
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: संशोध्य त्रिविधं मार्गं षड्विधं च बलं स्वकम् । साम्परायिककल्पेन यायादरिपुरं प्रति
verses.transliteration: sa.nshodhya trividhaM mArgaM ShaDvidhaM cha balaM svakam | sAmparAyikakalpena yAyAdaripuraM prati
verses.translation: Having cleared the three kinds of roads, and (having made) his sixfold army (efficient), let him leisurely proceed in the manner prescribed for warfare against the enemy's capital.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: शत्रुसेविनि मित्रे च गूढे युक्ततरो भवेत् । गतप्रत्यागते चैव स हि कष्टतरो रिपुः
verses.transliteration: shatrusevini mitre cha gUDhe yuktataro bhavet | gatapratyAgate chaiva sa hi kaShTataro ripuH
verses.translation: Let him be very much on his guard against a friend who secretly serves the enemy and against (deserters) who return (from the enemy's camp); for such (men are) the most dangerous foes.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: दण्डव्यूहेन तन् मार्गं यायात्तु शकटेन वा । वराहमकराभ्यां वा सूच्या वा गरुडेन वा
verses.transliteration: daNDavyUhena tan mArgaM yAyAttu shakaTena vA | varAhamakarAbhyAM vA sUchyA vA garuDena vA
verses.translation: Let him march on his road, arraying (his troops) like a staff (i.e. in an oblong), or like a waggon (i.e. in a wedge), or like a boar (i.e. in a rhombus), or like a Makara (i.e. in two triangles, with the apices joined), or like a pin (i.e. in a long line), or like a Garuda (i.e. in a rhomboid with far-extended wings).
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: यतश्च भयमाशङ्केत्ततो विस्तारयेद्बलम् । पद्मेन चैव व्यूहेन निविशेत सदा स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: yatashcha bhayamAsha~Nkettato vistArayedbalam | padmena chaiva vyUhena nivisheta sadA svayam
verses.translation: From whatever (side) he apprehends danger, in that (direction) let him extend his troops, and let him always himself encamp in an array, shaped like a lotus.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: सेनापतिबलाध्यक्षौ सर्वदिक्षु निवेशयेत् । यतश्च भयमाशङ्केत्प्राचीं तां कल्पयेद्दिशम्
verses.transliteration: senApatibalAdhyakShau sarvadikShu niveshayet | yatashcha bhayamAsha~NketprAchIM tAM kalpayeddisham
verses.translation: Let him allot to the commander-in-chief, to the (subordinate) general, (and to the superior officers) places in all directions, and let him turn his front in that direction whence he fears danger.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: समीक्ष्य स धृतः सम्यक्सर्वा रञ्जयति प्रजाः । असमीक्ष्य प्रणीतस्तु विनाशयति सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: samIkShya sa dhR^itaH samyaksarvA ra~njayati prajAH | asamIkShya praNItastu vinAshayati sarvataH
verses.translation: If (punishment) is properly inflicted after (due) consideration, it makes all people happy; but inflicted without consideration, it destroys everything.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: गुल्मांश्च स्थापयेदाप्तान् कृतसंज्ञान् समन्ततः । स्थाने युद्धे च कुशलानभीरूनविकारिणः
verses.transliteration: gulmA.nshcha sthApayedAptAn kR^itasa.nj~nAn samantataH | sthAne yuddhe cha kushalAnabhIrUnavikAriNaH
verses.translation: On all sides let him place troops of soldiers, on whom he can rely, with whom signals have been arranged, who are expert both in sustaining a charge and in charging, fearless and loyal.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: संहतान् योधयेदल्पान् कामं विस्तारयेद्बहून् । सूच्या वज्रेण चैवैतान् व्यूहेन व्यूह्य योधयेत्
verses.transliteration: sa.nhatAn yodhayedalpAn kAmaM vistArayedbahUn | sUchyA vajreNa chaivaitAn vyUhena vyUhya yodhayet
verses.translation: Let him make a small number of soldiers fight in close order, at his pleasure let him extend a large number in loose ranks; or let him make them fight, arranging (a small number) in the needle-array, (and a large number) in the thunderbolt-array.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: स्यन्दनाश्वैः समे युध्येदनूपेनोद्विपैस्तथा । वृक्षगुल्मावृते चापैरसिचर्मायुधैः स्थले
verses.transliteration: syandanAshvaiH same yudhyedanUpenodvipaistathA | vR^ikShagulmAvR^ite chApairasicharmAyudhaiH sthale
verses.translation: On even ground let him fight with chariots and horses, in water-bound places with boats and elephants, on (ground) covered with trees and shrubs with bows, on hilly ground with swords, targets, (and other) weapons.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: कुरुक्षेत्रांश्च मत्स्यांश्च पञ्चालांशूरसेनजान् । कौरक्षेत्रांश्च दीर्घांल्लघूंश्चैव नरानग्रानीकेषु योजयेत्
verses.transliteration: kurukShetrA.nshcha matsyA.nshcha pa~nchAlA.nshUrasenajAn | kaurakShetrA.nshcha dIrghA.nllaghU.nshchaiva narAnagrAnIkeShu yojayet
verses.translation: (Men born in) Kurukshetra, Matsyas, Pankalas, and those born in Surasena, let him cause to fight in the van of the battle, as well as (others who are) tall and light.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: प्रहर्षयेद्बलं व्यूह्य तांश्च सम्यक्परीक्षयेत् । भृशं परीक्षयेत्) चेष्टाश्चैव विजानीयादरीन् योधयतामपि
verses.transliteration: praharShayedbalaM vyUhya tA.nshcha samyakparIkShayet | bhR^ishaM parIkShayet) cheShTAshchaiva vijAnIyAdarIn yodhayatAmapi
verses.translation: After arranging his troops, he should encourage them (by an address) and carefully inspect them; he should also mark the behaviour (of the soldiers) when they engage the enemy.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: उपरुध्यारिमासीत राष्ट्रं चास्योपपीडयेत् । दूषयेच्चास्य सततं यवसान्नोदकैन्धनम्
verses.transliteration: uparudhyArimAsIta rAShTraM chAsyopapIDayet | dUShayechchAsya satataM yavasAnnodakaindhanam
verses.translation: When he has shut up his foe (in a town), let him sit encamped, harass his kingdom, and continually spoil his grass, food, fuel, and water.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: भिन्द्याच्चैव तडागानि प्राकारपरिखास्तथा । समवस्कन्दयेच्चैनं रात्रौ वित्रासयेत्तथा
verses.transliteration: bhindyAchchaiva taDAgAni prAkAraparikhAstathA | samavaskandayechchainaM rAtrau vitrAsayettathA
verses.translation: Likewise let him destroy the tanks, ramparts, and ditches, and let him assail the (foe unawares) and alarm him at night.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: उपजप्यानुपजपेद्बुध्येतैव च तत्कृतम् । युक्ते च दैवे युध्येत जयप्रेप्सुरपेतभीः
verses.transliteration: upajapyAnupajapedbudhyetaiva cha tatkR^itam | yukte cha daive yudhyeta jayaprepsurapetabhIH
verses.translation: Let him instigate to rebellion those who are open to such instigations, let him be informed of his (foe's) doings, and, when fate is propitious, let him fight without fear, trying to conquer.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: साम्ना दानेन भेदेन समस्तैरथ वा पृथक् । विजेतुं प्रयतेतारीन्न युद्धेन कदा चन
verses.transliteration: sAmnA dAnena bhedena samastairatha vA pR^ithak | vijetuM prayatetArInna yuddhena kadA chana
verses.translation: He should (however) try to conquer his foes by conciliation, by (well-applied) gifts, and by creating dissension, used either separately or conjointly, never by fighting, (if it can be avoided.)
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: अरिं अनित्यो विजयो यस्माद्दृश्यते युध्यमानयोः । पराजयश्च सङ्ग्रामे तस्माद्युद्धं विवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: ariM anityo vijayo yasmAddR^ishyate yudhyamAnayoH | parAjayashcha sa~NgrAme tasmAdyuddhaM vivarjayet
verses.translation: For when two (princes) fight, victory and defeat in the battle are, as experience teaches, uncertain; let him therefore avoid an engagement.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मं प्राप्तेन संस्कारं क्षत्रियेण यथाविधि । सर्वस्यास्य यथान्यायं कर्तव्यं परिरक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: brAhmaM prAptena sa.nskAraM kShatriyeNa yathAvidhi | sarvasyAsya yathAnyAyaM kartavyaM parirakShaNam
verses.translation: A Kshatriya, who has received according to the rule the sacrament prescribed by the Veda, must duly protect this whole (world).
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: यदि न प्रणयेद्राजा दण्डं दण्ड्येष्वतन्द्रितः । शूले मत्स्यानिवापक्ष्यन् दुर्बलान् बलवत्तराः
verses.transliteration: yadi na praNayedrAjA daNDaM daNDyeShvatandritaH | shUle matsyAnivApakShyan durbalAn balavattarAH
verses.translation: If the king did not, without tiring, inflict punishment on those worthy to be punished, the stronger would roast the weaker, like fish on a spit;
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: त्रयाणामप्युपायानां पूर्वोक्तानामसम्भवे । तथा युध्येत सम्पन्नो विजयेत रिपून् यथा
verses.transliteration: trayANAmapyupAyAnAM pUrvoktAnAmasambhave | tathA yudhyeta sampanno vijayeta ripUn yathA
verses.translation: (But) if even those three before-mentioned expedients fail, then let him, duly exerting himself, fight in such a manner that he may completely conquer his enemies.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: जित्वा सम्पूजयेद्देवान् ब्राह्मणांश्चैव धार्मिकान् । प्रदद्यात्परिहारार्थं ख्यापयेदभयानि च
verses.transliteration: jitvA sampUjayeddevAn brAhmaNA.nshchaiva dhArmikAn | pradadyAtparihArArthaM khyApayedabhayAni cha
verses.translation: When he has gained victory, let him duly worship the gods and honour righteous Brahmanas, let him grant exemptions, and let him cause promises of safety to be proclaimed.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां तु विदित्वैषां समासेन चिकीर्षितम् । स्थापयेत्तत्र तद्वंश्यं कुर्याच्च समयक्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: sarveShAM tu viditvaiShAM samAsena chikIrShitam | sthApayettatra tadva.nshyaM kuryAchcha samayakriyAm
verses.translation: But having fully ascertained the wishes of all the (conquered), let him place there a relative of the (vanquished ruler on the throne), and let him impose his conditions.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: प्रमाणानि च कुर्वीत तेषां धर्मान् यथोदितान् । रत्नैश्च पूजयेदेनं प्रधानपुरुषैः सह
verses.transliteration: pramANAni cha kurvIta teShAM dharmAn yathoditAn | ratnaishcha pUjayedenaM pradhAnapuruShaiH saha
verses.translation: Let him make authoritative the lawful (customs) of the (inhabitants), just as they are stated (to be), and let him honour the (new king) and his chief servants with precious gifts.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: आदानमप्रियकरं दानं च प्रियकारकम् । अभीप्सितानामर्थानां काले युक्तं प्रशस्यते
verses.transliteration: AdAnamapriyakaraM dAnaM cha priyakArakam | abhIpsitAnAmarthAnAM kAle yuktaM prashasyate
verses.translation: The seizure of desirable property which causes displeasure, and its distribution which causes pleasure, are both recommendable, (if they are) resorted to at the proper time.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: कालयुक्तं सर्वं कर्मैदमायत्तं विधाने दैवमानुषे । तयोर्दैवमचिन्त्यं तु मानुषे विद्यते क्रिया
verses.transliteration: kAlayuktaM sarvaM karmaidamAyattaM vidhAne daivamAnuShe | tayordaivamachintyaM tu mAnuShe vidyate kriyA
verses.translation: All undertakings (in) this (world) depend both on the ordering of fate and on human exertion; but among these two (the ways of) fate are unfathomable; in the case of man's work action is possible.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: दैवेन विधिना युक्तं मानुष्यं यत्प्रवर्तते । परिक्लेशेन महता तदर्थस्य समाधकम्
verses.transliteration: in MedhAtithi's commentary## daivena vidhinA yuktaM mAnuShyaM yatpravartate | parikleshena mahatA tadarthasya samAdhakam || 7\.207 sa.nyuktasyApi daivena puruShakAreNa varjitam | vinA puruShakAreNa phalaM kShetraM prayachChati || 7\.208 chandrArkAdyA grahA vAyuragnirApastathaiva cha | iha daivena sAdhyante pauruSheNa prayatnataH || 7\.209) saha vA.api vrajedyuktaH sa.ndhiM kR^itvA prayatnataH | mitraM hiraNyaM bhUmiM vA sampashya.nstrividhaM phalam
verses.translation: Or (the king, bent on conquest), considering a friend, gold, and land (to be) the triple result (of an expedition), may, using diligent care, make peace with (his foe) and return (to his realm).
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: पार्ष्णिग्राहं च सम्प्रेक्ष्य तथाक्रन्दं च मण्डले । मित्रादथाप्यमित्राद्वा यात्राफलमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: pArShNigrAhaM cha samprekShya tathAkrandaM cha maNDale | mitrAdathApyamitrAdvA yAtrAphalamavApnuyAt
verses.translation: Having paid due attention to any king in the circle (of neighbouring states) who might attack him in the rear, and to his supporter who opposes the latter, let (the conqueror) secure the fruit of the expedition from (the prince whom he attacks), whether (he may have become) friendly or (remained) hostile.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यभूमिसम्प्राप्त्या पार्थिवो न तथैधते । यथा मित्रं ध्रुवं लब्ध्वा कृशमप्यायतिक्षमम्
verses.transliteration: hiraNyabhUmisamprAptyA pArthivo na tathaidhate | yathA mitraM dhruvaM labdhvA kR^ishamapyAyatikShamam
verses.translation: By gaining gold and land a king grows not so much in strength as by obtaining a firm friend, (who), though weak, (may become) powerful in the future.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: धर्मज्ञं च कृतज्ञं च तुष्टप्रकृतिमेव च । अनुरक्तं स्थिरारम्भं लघुमित्रं प्रशस्यते
verses.transliteration: dharmaj~naM cha kR^itaj~naM cha tuShTaprakR^itimeva cha | anuraktaM sthirArambhaM laghumitraM prashasyate
verses.translation: A weak friend (even) is greatly commended, who is righteous (and) grateful, whose people are contented, who is attached and persevering in his undertakings.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: अद्यात्काकः पुरोडाशं श्वा च लिह्याद्धविस्तथा । श्वाऽवलिह्याद्द् स्वाम्यं च न स्यात्कस्मिंश्चित्प्रवर्तेताधरोत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: adyAtkAkaH puroDAshaM shvA cha lihyAddhavistathA | shvA.avalihyAdd svAmyaM cha na syAtkasmi.nshchitpravartetAdharottaram
verses.translation: The crow would eat the sacrificial cake and the dog would lick the sacrificial viands, and ownership would not remain with any one, the lower ones would (usurp the place of) the higher ones.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: प्राज्ञं कुलीनं शूरं च दक्षं दातारमेव च । कृतज्ञं धृतिमन्तं च कष्टमाहुररिं बुधाः
verses.transliteration: prAj~naM kulInaM shUraM cha dakShaM dAtArameva cha | kR^itaj~naM dhR^itimantaM cha kaShTamAhurariM budhAH
verses.translation: The wise declare him (to be) a most dangerous foe, who is wise, of noble race, brave, clever, liberal, grateful, and firm.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: आर्यता पुरुषज्ञानं शौर्यं करुणवेदिता । स्थौललक्ष्यं च सततमुदासीनगुणौदयः
verses.transliteration: AryatA puruShaj~nAnaM shauryaM karuNaveditA | sthaulalakShyaM cha satatamudAsInaguNaudayaH
verses.translation: Behaviour worthy of an Aryan, knowledge of men, bravery, a compassionate disposition, and great liberality are the virtues of a neutral (who may be courted).
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: क्षेम्यां सस्यप्रदां नित्यं पशुवृद्धिकरीमपि । परित्यजेन्नृपो भूमिमात्मार्थमविचारयन्
verses.transliteration: kShemyAM sasyapradAM nityaM pashuvR^iddhikarImapi | parityajennR^ipo bhUmimAtmArthamavichArayan
verses.translation: Let the king, without hesitation, quit for his own sake even a country (which is) salubrious, fertile, and causing an increase of cattle.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: आपदर्थं धनं रक्षेद्दारान् रक्षेद्धनैरपि । आपदर्थे आत्मानं सततं रक्षेद्दारैरपि धनैरपि
verses.transliteration: ApadarthaM dhanaM rakSheddArAn rakSheddhanairapi | Apadarthe AtmAnaM satataM rakSheddArairapi dhanairapi
verses.translation: For times of need let him preserve his wealth; at the expense of his wealth let him preserve his wife; let him at all events preserve himself even by (giving up) his wife and his wealth.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: सह सर्वाः समुत्पन्नाः प्रसमीक्ष्यापदो भृशम् । संयुक्तांश्च वियुक्तांश्च सर्वोपायान् सृजेद्बुधः
verses.transliteration: saha sarvAH samutpannAH prasamIkShyApado bhR^isham | sa.nyuktA.nshcha viyuktA.nshcha sarvopAyAn sR^ijedbudhaH
verses.translation: A wise (king), seeing that all kinds of misfortunes violently assail him at the same time, should try all (the four) expedients, be it together or separately, (in order to save himself.)
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: उपेतारमुपेयं च सर्वोपायांश्च कृत्स्नशः । एतत्त्रयं समाश्रित्य प्रयतेतार्थसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: upetAramupeyaM cha sarvopAyA.nshcha kR^itsnashaH | etattrayaM samAshritya prayatetArthasiddhaye
verses.translation: On the person who employs the expedients, on the business to be accomplished, and on all the expedients collectively, on these three let him ponder and strive to accomplish his ends.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: एवं सर्वमिदं राजा सह सम्मन्त्र्य मन्त्रिभिः । व्यायम्याप्लुत्य मध्याह्ने भोक्तुमन्तःपुरं विशेत्
verses.transliteration: evaM sarvamidaM rAjA saha sammantrya mantribhiH | vyAyamyAplutya madhyAhne bhoktumantaHpuraM vishet
verses.translation: Having thus consulted with his ministers on all these (matters), having taken exercise, and having bathed afterwards, the king may enter the harem at midday in order to dine.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: तत्रात्मभूतैः कालज्ञैरहार्यैः परिचारकैः । सुपरीक्षितमन्नाद्यमद्यान् मन्त्रैर्विषापहैः
verses.transliteration: tatrAtmabhUtaiH kAlaj~nairahAryaiH parichArakaiH | suparIkShitamannAdyamadyAn mantrairviShApahaiH
verses.translation: There he may eat food, (which has been prepared) by faithful, incorruptible (servants) who know the (proper) time (for dining), which has been well examined (and hallowed) by sacred texts that destroy poison.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: विषघ्नैरगदैश्चास्य सर्वद्रव्याणि योजयेत् । विषघ्नैरुदकैश्चास्य सर्वद्रव्याणि शोधयेत् विषघ्नानि च रत्नानि नियतो धारयेत्सदा
verses.transliteration: viShaghnairagadaishchAsya sarvadravyANi yojayet | viShaghnairudakaishchAsya sarvadravyANi shodhayet viShaghnAni cha ratnAni niyato dhArayetsadA
verses.translation: Let him mix all his food with medicines (that are) antidotes against poison, and let him always be careful to wear gems which destroy poison.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: परीक्षिताः स्त्रियश्चैनं व्यजनोदकधूपनैः । वेषाभरणसंशुद्धाः स्पृशेयुः सुसमाहिताः
verses.transliteration: parIkShitAH striyashchainaM vyajanodakadhUpanaiH | veShAbharaNasa.nshuddhAH spR^isheyuH susamAhitAH
verses.translation: Well-tried females whose toilet and ornaments have been examined, shall attentively serve him with fans, water, and perfumes.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: सर्वो दण्डजितो लोको दुर्लभो हि शुचिर्नरः । दण्डस्य हि भयात्सर्वं जगद्भोगाय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: sarvo daNDajito loko durlabho hi shuchirnaraH | daNDasya hi bhayAtsarvaM jagadbhogAya kalpate
verses.translation: The whole world is kept in order by punishment, for a guiltless man is hard to find; through fear of punishment the whole world yields the enjoyments (which it owes).
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: एवं प्रयत्नं कुर्वीत यानशय्याऽऽसनाशने । स्नाने प्रसाधने चैव सर्वालङ्कारकेषु च
verses.transliteration: evaM prayatnaM kurvIta yAnashayyA.a.asanAshane | snAne prasAdhane chaiva sarvAla~NkArakeShu cha
verses.translation: In like manner let him be careful about his carriages, bed, seat, bath, toilet, and all his ornaments.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: भुक्तवान् विहरेच्चैव स्त्रीभिरन्तःपुरे सह । विहृत्य तु यथाकालं पुनः कार्याणि चिन्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: bhuktavAn viharechchaiva strIbhirantaHpure saha | vihR^itya tu yathAkAlaM punaH kAryANi chintayet
verses.translation: When he has dined, he may divert himself with his wives in the harem; but when he has diverted himself, he must, in due time, again think of the affairs of state.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: अलङ्कृतश्च सम्पश्येदायुधीयं पुनर्जनम् । वाहनानि च सर्वाणि शस्त्राण्याभरणानि च
verses.transliteration: ala~NkR^itashcha sampashyedAyudhIyaM punarjanam | vAhanAni cha sarvANi shastrANyAbharaNAni cha
verses.translation: Adorned (with his robes of state), let him again inspect his fighting men, all his chariots and beasts of burden, the weapons and accoutrements.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: संध्यां चोपास्य शृणुयादन्तर्वेश्मनि शस्त्रभृत् । रहस्याख्यायिनां चैव प्रणिधीनां च चेष्टितम्
verses.transliteration: sa.ndhyAM chopAsya shR^iNuyAdantarveshmani shastrabhR^it | rahasyAkhyAyinAM chaiva praNidhInAM cha cheShTitam
verses.translation: Having performed his twilight-devotions, let him, well armed, hear in an inner apartment the doings of those who make secret reports and of his spies.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा कक्षान्तरं त्वन्यत्समनुज्ञाप्य तं जनम् । प्रविशेद्भोजनार्थं च स्त्रीवृतोऽन्तःपुरं पुनः
verses.transliteration: gatvA kakShAntaraM tvanyatsamanuj~nApya taM janam | pravishedbhojanArthaM cha strIvR^ito.antaHpuraM punaH
verses.translation: But going to another secret apartment and dismissing those people, he may enter the harem, surrounded by female (servants), in order to dine again.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: एतद्विधानमातिष्ठेदरोगः पृथिवीपतिः । अस्वस्थः सर्वमेतत्तु भृत्येषु विनियोजयेत्
verses.transliteration: etadvidhAnamAtiShThedarogaH pR^ithivIpatiH | asvasthaH sarvametattu bhR^ityeShu viniyojayet
verses.translation: A king who is in good health must observe these rules; but, if he is indisposed, he may entrust all this (business) to his servants.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: देवदानवगन्धर्वा रक्षांसि पतगोरगाः । तेऽपि भोगाय कल्पन्ते दण्डेनैव निपीडिताः
verses.transliteration: devadAnavagandharvA rakShA.nsi patagoragAH | te.api bhogAya kalpante daNDenaiva nipIDitAH
verses.translation: The gods, the Danavas, the Gandharvas, the Rakshasas, the bird and snake deities even give the enjoyments (due from them) only, if they are tormented by (the fear of) punishment.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: दुष्येयुः सर्ववर्णाश्च भिद्येरन् सर्वसेतवः । सर्वलोकप्रकोपश्च भवेद्दण्डस्य विभ्रमात्
verses.transliteration: duShyeyuH sarvavarNAshcha bhidyeran sarvasetavaH | sarvalokaprakopashcha bhaveddaNDasya vibhramAt
verses.translation: All castes (varna) would be corrupted (by intermixture), all barriers would be broken through, and all men would rage (against each other) in consequence of mistakes with respect to punishment.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: यत्र श्यामो लोहिताक्षो दण्डश्चरति पापहा । प्रजास्तत्र न मुह्यन्ति नेता चेत्साधु पश्यति
verses.transliteration: yatra shyAmo lohitAkSho daNDashcharati pApahA | prajAstatra na muhyanti netA chetsAdhu pashyati
verses.translation: But where Punishment with a black hue and red eyes stalks about, destroying sinners, there the subjects are not disturbed, provided that he who inflicts it discerns well.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: तत्र भुक्त्वा पुनः किं चित्तूर्यघोषैः प्रहर्षितः । संविशेत्तं यथाकालमुत्तिष्ठेच्च गतक्लमः
verses.transliteration: tatra bhuktvA punaH kiM chittUryaghoShaiH praharShitaH | sa.nvishettaM yathAkAlamuttiShThechcha gataklamaH
verses.translation: Having eaten there something for the second time, and having been recreated by the sound of music, let him go to rest and rise at the proper time free from fatigue.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: तस्याहुः सम्प्रणेतारं राजानं सत्यवादिनम् । समीक्ष्यकारिणं प्राज्ञं धर्मकामार्थकोविदम्
verses.transliteration: tasyAhuH sampraNetAraM rAjAnaM satyavAdinam | samIkShyakAriNaM prAj~naM dharmakAmArthakovidam
verses.translation: They declare that king to be a just inflicter of punishment, who is truthful, who acts after due consideration, who is wise, and who knows (the respective value of) virtue, pleasure, and wealth.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: तं राजा प्रणयन् सम्यक्त्रिवर्गेणाभिवर्धते । कामात्मा विषमः क्षुद्रो दण्डेनैव निहन्यते
verses.transliteration: taM rAjA praNayan samyaktrivargeNAbhivardhate | kAmAtmA viShamaH kShudro daNDenaiva nihanyate
verses.translation: A king who properly inflicts (punishment), prospers with respect to (those) three (means of happiness); but he who is voluptuous, partial, and deceitful will be destroyed, even through the (unjust) punishment (which he inflicts).
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: कामान्धो दण्डो हि सुमहत्तेजो दुर्धरश्चाकृतात्मभिः । धर्माद्विचलितं हन्ति नृपमेव सबान्धवम्
verses.transliteration: kAmAndho daNDo hi sumahattejo durdharashchAkR^itAtmabhiH | dharmAdvichalitaM hanti nR^ipameva sabAndhavam
verses.translation: Punishment (possesses) a very bright lustre, and is hard to be administered by men with unimproved minds; it strikes down the king who swerves from his duty, together with his relatives.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: ततो दुर्गं च राष्ट्रं च लोकं च सचराचरम् । अन्तरिक्षगतांश्चैव मुनीन् देवांश्च पीडयेत्
verses.transliteration: tato durgaM cha rAShTraM cha lokaM cha sacharAcharam | antarikShagatA.nshchaiva munIn devA.nshcha pIDayet
verses.translation: Next it will afflict his castles, his territories, the whole world together with the movable and immovable (creation), likewise the sages and the gods, who (on the failure of offerings) ascend to the sky.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: अराजके हि लोकेऽस्मिन् सर्वतो विद्रुतो भयात् । रक्षार्थमस्य सर्वस्य राजानमसृजत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: arAjake hi loke.asmin sarvato vidruto bhayAt | rakShArthamasya sarvasya rAjAnamasR^ijatprabhuH
verses.translation: For, when these creatures, being without a king, through fear dispersed in all directions, the Lord created a king for the protection of this whole (creation),
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: सोऽसहायेन मूढेन लुब्धेनाकृतबुद्धिना । न शक्यो न्यायतो नेतुं सक्तेन विषयेषु च
verses.transliteration: so.asahAyena mUDhena lubdhenAkR^itabuddhinA | na shakyo nyAyato netuM saktena viShayeShu cha
verses.translation: (Punishment) cannot be inflicted justly by one who has no assistant, (nor) by a fool, (nor) by a covetous man, (nor) by one whose mind is unimproved, (nor) by one addicted to sensual pleasures.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: शुचिना सत्यसंधेन यथाशास्त्रानुसारिणा । प्रणेतुं शक्यते दण्डः सुसहायेन धीमता
verses.transliteration: shuchinA satyasa.ndhena yathAshAstrAnusAriNA | praNetuM shakyate daNDaH susahAyena dhImatA
verses.translation: By him who is pure (and) faithful to his promise, who acts according to the Institutes (of the sacred law), who has good assistants and is wise, punishment can be (justly) inflicted.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: स्वराष्ट्रे न्यायवृत्तः स्याद्भृशदण्डश्च शत्रुषु । सुहृत्स्वजिह्मः स्निग्धेषु ब्राह्मणेषु क्षमान्वितः
verses.transliteration: svarAShTre nyAyavR^ittaH syAdbhR^ishadaNDashcha shatruShu | suhR^itsvajihmaH snigdheShu brAhmaNeShu kShamAnvitaH
verses.translation: Let him act with justice in his own domain, with rigour chastise his enemies, behave without duplicity towards his friends, and be lenient towards Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: एवंवृत्तस्य नृपतेः शिलोञ्छेनापि जीवतः । विस्तीर्यते यशो लोके तैलबिन्दुरिवाम्भसि
verses.transliteration: eva.nvR^ittasya nR^ipateH shilo~nChenApi jIvataH | vistIryate yasho loke tailabindurivAmbhasi
verses.translation: The fame of a king who behaves thus, even though he subsist by gleaning, is spread in the world, like a drop of oil on water.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: अतस्तु विपरीतस्य नृपतेरजितात्मनः । सङ्क्षिप्यते यशो लोके घृतबिन्दुरिवाम्भसि
verses.transliteration: atastu viparItasya nR^ipaterajitAtmanaH | sa~NkShipyate yasho loke ghR^itabindurivAmbhasi
verses.translation: But the fame of a king who acts in a contrary manner and who does not subdue himself, diminishes in extent among men like a drop of clarified butter in water.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: स्वे स्वे धर्मे निविष्टानां सर्वेषामनुपूर्वशः । वर्णानामाश्रमाणां च राजा सृष्टोऽभिरक्षिता
verses.transliteration: sve sve dharme niviShTAnAM sarveShAmanupUrvashaH | varNAnAmAshramANAM cha rAjA sR^iShTo.abhirakShitA
verses.translation: The king has been created (to be) the protector of the castes (varna) and orders, who, all according to their rank, discharge their several duties.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: तेन यद्यत्सभृत्येन कर्तव्यं रक्षता प्रजाः । तत्तद्वोऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि यथावदनुपूर्वशः
verses.transliteration: tena yadyatsabhR^ityena kartavyaM rakShatA prajAH | tattadvo.ahaM pravakShyAmi yathAvadanupUrvashaH
verses.translation: Whatever must be done by him and by his servants for the protection of his people, that I will fully declare to you in due order.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणान् पर्युपासीत प्रातरुत्थाय पार्थिवः । त्रैविद्यवृद्धान् विदुषस्तिष्ठेत्तेषां च शासने
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNAn paryupAsIta prAtarutthAya pArthivaH | traividyavR^iddhAn viduShastiShThetteShAM cha shAsane
verses.translation: Let the king, after rising early in the morning, worship Brahmanas who are well versed in the threefold sacred science and learned (in polity), and follow their advice.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: वृद्धांश्च नित्यं सेवेत विप्रान् वेदविदः शुचीन् । वृद्धसेवी हि सततं रक्षोभिरपि पूज्यते
verses.transliteration: vR^iddhA.nshcha nityaM seveta viprAn vedavidaH shuchIn | vR^iddhasevI hi satataM rakShobhirapi pUjyate
verses.translation: Let him daily worship aged Brahmanas who know the Veda and are pure; for he who always worships aged men, is honoured even by Rakshasas.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: तेभ्योऽधिगच्छेद्विनयं विनीतात्माऽपि नित्यशः । विनीतात्मा हि नृपतिर्न विनश्यति कर्हि चित्
verses.transliteration: tebhyo.adhigachChedvinayaM vinItAtmA.api nityashaH | vinItAtmA hi nR^ipatirna vinashyati karhi chit
verses.translation: Let him, though he may already be modest, constantly learn modesty from them; for a king who is modest never perishes.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रानिलयमार्काणामग्नेश्च वरुणस्य च । चन्द्रवित्तेशयोश्चैव मात्रा निर्हृत्य शाश्वतीः
verses.transliteration: indrAnilayamArkANAmagneshcha varuNasya cha | chandravitteshayoshchaiva mAtrA nirhR^itya shAshvatIH
verses.translation: Taking (for that purpose) eternal particles of Indra, of the Wind, of Yama, of the Sun, of Fire, of Varuna, of the Moon, and of the Lord of wealth (Kubera).
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: बहवोऽविनयात्नष्टा राजानः सपरिच्छदाः । सपरिग्रहाः वनस्था अपि राज्यानि विनयात्प्रतिपेदिरे
verses.transliteration: bahavo.avinayAtnaShTA rAjAnaH saparichChadAH | saparigrahAH vanasthA api rAjyAni vinayAtpratipedire
verses.translation: Through a want of modesty many kings have perished, together with their belongings; through modesty even hermits in the forest have gained kingdoms.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: वेनो विनष्टोऽविनयात्नहुषश्चैव पार्थिवः । सुदाः पैजवनश्चैव सुमुखो निमिरेव च
verses.transliteration: veno vinaShTo.avinayAtnahuShashchaiva pArthivaH | sudAH paijavanashchaiva sumukho nimireva cha
verses.translation: Through a want of humility Vena perished, likewise king Nahusha, Sudas, the son of Pigavana, Sumukha, and Nemi.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: पृथुस्तु विनयाद्राज्यं प्राप्तवान् मनुरेव च । कुबेरश्च धनैश्वर्यं ब्राह्मण्यं चैव गाधिजः
verses.transliteration: pR^ithustu vinayAdrAjyaM prAptavAn manureva cha | kuberashcha dhanaishvaryaM brAhmaNyaM chaiva gAdhijaH
verses.translation: But by humility Prithu and Manu gained sovereignty, Kubera the position of the Lord of wealth, and the son of Gadhi the rank of a Brahmana.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: त्रैविद्येभ्यस्त्रयीं विद्यां दण्डनीतिं च शाश्वतीम् । त्रयीं विद्यात् आन्वीक्षिकीं चात्मविद्यां वार्तारम्भांश्च लोकतः
verses.transliteration: traividyebhyastrayIM vidyAM daNDanItiM cha shAshvatIm | trayIM vidyAt AnvIkShikIM chAtmavidyAM vArtArambhA.nshcha lokataH
verses.translation: From those versed in the three Vedas let him learn the threefold (sacred science), the primeval science of government, the science of dialectics, and the knowledge of the (supreme) Soul; from the people (the theory of) the (various) trades and professions.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणां जये योगं समातिष्ठेद्दिवानिशम् । जितैन्द्रियो हि शक्नोति वशे स्थापयितुं प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: indriyANAM jaye yogaM samAtiShTheddivAnisham | jitaindriyo hi shaknoti vashe sthApayituM prajAH
verses.translation: Day and night he must strenuously exert himself to conquer his senses; for he (alone) who has conquered his own senses, can keep his subjects in obedience.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: दश कामसमुत्थानि तथाऽष्टौ क्रोधजानि च । व्यसनानि दुर्ऽन्तानि प्रयत्नेन विवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: dasha kAmasamutthAni tathA.aShTau krodhajAni cha | vyasanAni dur.antAni prayatnena vivarjayet
verses.translation: Let him carefully shun the ten vices, springing from love of pleasure, and the eight, proceeding from wrath, which (all) end in misery.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: कामजेषु प्रसक्तो हि व्यसनेषु महीपतिः । वियुज्यतेऽर्थधर्माभ्यां क्रोधजेष्वात्मनैव तु
verses.transliteration: kAmajeShu prasakto hi vyasaneShu mahIpatiH | viyujyate.arthadharmAbhyAM krodhajeShvAtmanaiva tu
verses.translation: For a king who is attached to the vices springing from love of pleasure, loses his wealth and his virtue, but (he who is given) to those arising from anger, (loses) even his life.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: मृगयाऽक्षो दिवास्वप्नः परिवादः स्त्रियो मदः । तौर्यत्रिकं वृथाट्या च कामजो दशको गणः
verses.transliteration: mR^igayA.akSho divAsvapnaH parivAdaH striyo madaH | tauryatrikaM vR^ithATyA cha kAmajo dashako gaNaH
verses.translation: Hunting, gambling, sleeping by day, censoriousness, (excess with) women, drunkenness, (an inordinate love for) dancing, singing, and music, and useless travel are the tenfold set (of vices) springing from love of pleasure.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: पैशुन्यं साहसं द्रोह ईर्ष्याऽसूयाऽर्थदूषणम् । वाग्दण्डजं च पारुष्यं क्रोधजोऽपि गणोऽष्टकः
verses.transliteration: paishunyaM sAhasaM droha IrShyA.asUyA.arthadUShaNam | vAgdaNDajaM cha pAruShyaM krodhajo.api gaNo.aShTakaH
verses.translation: Tale-bearing, violence, treachery, envy, slandering, (unjust) seizure of property, reviling, and assault are the eightfold set (of vices) produced by wrath.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: द्वयोरप्येतयोर्मूलं यं सर्वे कवयो विदुः । तं यत्नेन जयेत्लोभं तज्जावेतावुभौ गणौ
verses.transliteration: dvayorapyetayormUlaM yaM sarve kavayo viduH | taM yatnena jayetlobhaM tajjAvetAvubhau gaNau
verses.translation: That greediness which all wise men declare to be the root even of both these (sets), let him carefully conquer; both sets (of vices) are produced by that.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: यस्मादेषां सुरेन्द्राणां मात्राभ्यो निर्मितो नृपः । तस्मादभिभवत्येष सर्वभूतानि तेजसा
verses.transliteration: yasmAdeShAM surendrANAM mAtrAbhyo nirmito nR^ipaH | tasmAdabhibhavatyeSha sarvabhUtAni tejasA
verses.translation: Because a king has been formed of particles of those lords of the gods, he therefore surpasses all created beings in lustre;
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: पानमक्षाः स्त्रियश्चैव मृगया च यथाक्रमम् । एतत्कष्टतमं विद्यात्चतुष्कं कामजे गणे
verses.transliteration: pAnamakShAH striyashchaiva mR^igayA cha yathAkramam | etatkaShTatamaM vidyAtchatuShkaM kAmaje gaNe
verses.translation: Drinking, dice, women, and hunting, these four (which have been enumerated) in succession, he must know to be the most pernicious in the set that springs from love of pleasure.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: दण्डस्य पातनं चैव वाक्पारुष्यार्थदूषणे । क्रोधजेऽपि गणे विद्यात्कष्टमेतत्त्रिकं सदा
verses.transliteration: daNDasya pAtanaM chaiva vAkpAruShyArthadUShaNe | krodhaje.api gaNe vidyAtkaShTametattrikaM sadA
verses.translation: Doing bodily injury, reviling, and the seizure of property, these three he must know to be the most pernicious in the set produced by wrath.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: सप्तकस्यास्य वर्गस्य सर्वत्रैवानुषङ्गिणः । पूर्वं पूर्वं गुरुतरं विद्याद्व्यसनमात्मवान्
verses.transliteration: saptakasyAsya vargasya sarvatraivAnuSha~NgiNaH | pUrvaM pUrvaM gurutaraM vidyAdvyasanamAtmavAn
verses.translation: A self-controlled (king) should know that in this set of seven, which prevails everywhere, each earlier-named vice is more abominable (than those named later).
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: व्यसनस्य च मृत्योश्च व्यसनं कष्टमुच्यते । व्यसन्यधोऽधो व्रजति स्वर्यात्यव्यसनी मृतः
verses.transliteration: vyasanasya cha mR^ityoshcha vyasanaM kaShTamuchyate | vyasanyadho.adho vrajati svaryAtyavyasanI mR^itaH
verses.translation: (On a comparison) between vice and death, vice is declared to be more pernicious; a vicious man sinks to the nethermost (hell), he who dies, free from vice, ascends to heaven.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: मौलान् शास्त्रविदः शूरान् लब्धलक्षान् कुलोद्भवान् । कुलोद्गतान् सचिवान् सप्त चाष्टौ वा प्रकुर्वीत परीक्षितान्
verses.transliteration: maulAn shAstravidaH shUrAn labdhalakShAn kulodbhavAn | kulodgatAn sachivAn sapta chAShTau vA prakurvIta parIkShitAn
verses.translation: Let him appoint seven or eight ministers whose ancestors have been royal servants, who are versed in the sciences, heroes skilled in the use of weapons and descended from (noble) families and who have been tried.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: कुर्वीत सुपरीक्षितान् अपि यत्सुकरं कर्म तदप्येकेन दुष्करम् । विशेषतोऽसहायेन किं तु राज्यं महोदयम्
verses.transliteration: kurvIta suparIkShitAn api yatsukaraM karma tadapyekena duShkaram | visheShato.asahAyena kiM tu rAjyaM mahodayam
verses.translation: Even an undertaking easy (in itself) is (sometimes) hard to be accomplished by a single man; how much (harder is it for a king), especially (if he has) no assistant, (to govern) a kingdom which yields great revenues.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: किं नु तैः सार्धं चिन्तयेन्नित्यं सामान्यं संधिविग्रहम् । स्थानं समुदयं गुप्तिं लब्धप्रशमनानि च
verses.transliteration: kiM nu taiH sArdhaM chintayennityaM sAmAnyaM sa.ndhivigraham | sthAnaM samudayaM guptiM labdhaprashamanAni cha
verses.translation: Let him daily consider with them the ordinary (business, referring to) peace and war, (the four subjects called) sthana, the revenue, the (manner of) protecting (himself and his kingdom), and the sanctification of his gains (by pious gifts).
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: तेषां स्वं स्वमभिप्रायमुपलभ्य पृथक्पृथक् । समस्तानां च कार्येषु विदध्याद्धितमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: teShAM svaM svamabhiprAyamupalabhya pR^ithakpR^ithak | samastAnAM cha kAryeShu vidadhyAddhitamAtmanaH
verses.translation: Having (first) ascertained the opinion of each (minister) separately and (then the views) of all together, let him do what is (most) beneficial for him in his affairs.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां तु विशिष्टेन ब्राह्मणेन विपश्चिता । मन्त्रयेत्परमं मन्त्रं राजा षाड्गुण्यसंयुतम्
verses.transliteration: sarveShAM tu vishiShTena brAhmaNena vipashchitA | mantrayetparamaM mantraM rAjA ShADguNyasa.nyutam
verses.translation: But with the most distinguished among them all, a learned Brahmana, let the king deliberate on the most important affairs which relate to the six measures of royal policy.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: नित्यं तस्मिन् समाश्वस्तः सर्वकार्याणि निःक्षिपेत् । निक्षिपेत् तेन सार्धं विनिश्चित्य ततः कर्म समारभेत्
verses.transliteration: nityaM tasmin samAshvastaH sarvakAryANi niHkShipet | nikShipet tena sArdhaM vinishchitya tataH karma samArabhet
verses.translation: Let him, full of confidence, always entrust to that (official) all business; having taken his final resolution with him, let him afterwards begin to act.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: तपत्यादित्यवच्चैष चक्षूंषि च मनांसि च । न चैनं भुवि शक्नोति कश्चिदप्यभिवीक्षितुम्
verses.transliteration: tapatyAdityavachchaiSha chakShU.nShi cha manA.nsi cha | na chainaM bhuvi shaknoti kashchidapyabhivIkShitum
verses.translation: And, like the sun, he burns eyes and hearts; nor can anybody on earth even gaze on him.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: अन्यानपि प्रकुर्वीत शुचीन् प्राज्ञानवस्थितान् । सम्यगर्थसमाहर्तॄनमात्यान् सुपरीक्षितान्
verses.transliteration: anyAnapi prakurvIta shuchIn prAj~nAnavasthitAn | samyagarthasamAhartR^InamAtyAn suparIkShitAn
verses.translation: He must also appoint other officials, (men) of integrity, (who are) wise, firm, well able to collect money, and well tried.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: निर्वर्तेतास्य यावद्भिरितिकर्तव्यता नृभिः । तावतोऽतन्द्रितान् दक्षान् प्रकुर्वीत विचक्षणान्
verses.transliteration: nirvartetAsya yAvadbhiritikartavyatA nR^ibhiH | tAvato.atandritAn dakShAn prakurvIta vichakShaNAn
verses.translation: As many persons as the due performance of his business requires, so many skilful and clever (men), free from sloth, let him appoint.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: तेषामर्थे नियुञ्जीत शूरान् दक्षान् कुलोद्गतान् । शुचीनाकरकर्मान्ते भीरूनन्तर्निवेशने
verses.transliteration: teShAmarthe niyu~njIta shUrAn dakShAn kulodgatAn | shuchInAkarakarmAnte bhIrUnantarniveshane
verses.translation: Among them let him employ the brave, the skilful, the high-born, and the honest in (offices for the collection of) revenue, (e.g.) in mines, manufactures, and storehouses, (but) the timid in the interior of his palace.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: दूतं चैव प्रकुर्वीत सर्वशास्त्रविशारदम् । इङ्गिताकारचेष्टज्ञं शुचिं दक्षं कुलोद्गतम्
verses.transliteration: dUtaM chaiva prakurvIta sarvashAstravishAradam | i~NgitAkAracheShTaj~naM shuchiM dakShaM kulodgatam
verses.translation: Let him also appoint an ambassador who is versed in all sciences, who understands hints, expressions of the face and gestures, who is honest, skilful, and of (noble) family.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: अनुरक्तः शुचिर्दक्षः स्मृतिमान् देशकालवित् । वपुष्मान् वीतभीर्वाग्मी दूतो राज्ञः प्रशस्यते
verses.transliteration: anuraktaH shuchirdakShaH smR^itimAn deshakAlavit | vapuShmAn vItabhIrvAgmI dUto rAj~naH prashasyate
verses.translation: (Such) an ambassador is commended to a king (who is) loyal, honest, skilful, possessing a good memory, who knows the (proper) place and time (for action, who is) handsome, fearless, and eloquent.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: अमात्ये दण्ड आयत्तो दण्डे वैनयिकी क्रिया । नृपतौ कोशराष्ट्रे च दूते संधिविपर्ययौ
verses.transliteration: amAtye daNDa Ayatto daNDe vainayikI kriyA | nR^ipatau kosharAShTre cha dUte sa.ndhiviparyayau
verses.translation: The army depends on the official (placed in charge of it), the due control (of the subjects) on the army, the treasury and the (government of) the realm on the king, peace and its opposite (war) on the ambassador.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: दूत एव हि संधत्ते भिनत्त्येव च संहतान् । दूतस्तत्कुरुते कर्म भिद्यन्ते येन मानवः
verses.transliteration: dUta eva hi sa.ndhatte bhinattyeva cha sa.nhatAn | dUtastatkurute karma bhidyante yena mAnavaH
verses.translation: For the ambassador alone makes (kings') allies and separates allies; the ambassador transacts that business by which (kings) are disunited or not.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: स विद्यादस्य कृत्येषु निर्गूढेङ्गितचेष्टितैः । आकारमिङ्गितं चेष्टां भृत्येषु च चिकीर्षितम्
verses.transliteration: sa vidyAdasya kR^ityeShu nirgUDhe~NgitacheShTitaiH | AkArami~NgitaM cheShTAM bhR^ityeShu cha chikIrShitam
verses.translation: With respect to the affairs let the (ambassador) explore the expression of the countenance, the gestures and actions of the (foreign king) through the gestures and actions of his confidential (advisers), and (discover) his designs among his servants.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: बुद्ध्वा च सर्वं तत्त्वेन परराजचिकीर्षितम् । तथा प्रयत्नमातिष्ठेद्यथाऽत्मानं न पीडयेत्
verses.transliteration: buddhvA cha sarvaM tattvena pararAjachikIrShitam | tathA prayatnamAtiShThedyathA.atmAnaM na pIDayet
verses.translation: Having learnt exactly (from his ambassador) the designs of the foreign king, let (the king) take such measures that he does not bring evil on himself.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: जाङ्गलं सस्यसम्पन्नमार्यप्रायमनाविलम् । रम्यमानतसामन्तं स्वाजीव्यं देशमावसेत्
verses.transliteration: jA~NgalaM sasyasampannamAryaprAyamanAvilam | ramyamAnatasAmantaM svAjIvyaM deshamAvaset
verses.translation: Let him settle in a country which is open and has a dry climate, where grain is abundant, which is chiefly (inhabited) by Aryans, not subject to epidemic diseases (or similar troubles), and pleasant, where the vassals are obedient and his own (people easily) find their livelihood.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: सोऽग्निर्भवति वायुश्च सोऽर्कः सोमः स धर्मराट् । स कुबेरः स वरुणः स महेन्द्रः प्रभावतः
verses.transliteration: so.agnirbhavati vAyushcha so.arkaH somaH sa dharmarAT | sa kuberaH sa varuNaH sa mahendraH prabhAvataH
verses.translation: Through his (supernatural) power he is Fire and Wind, he Sun and Moon, he the Lord of justice (Yama), he Kubera, he Varuna, he great Indra.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: धन्वदुर्गं महीदुर्गमब्दुर्गं वार्क्षमेव वा । नृदुर्गं गिरिदुर्गं वा समाश्रित्य वसेत्पुरम्
verses.transliteration: dhanvadurgaM mahIdurgamabdurgaM vArkShameva vA | nR^idurgaM giridurgaM vA samAshritya vasetpuram
verses.translation: Let him build (there) a town, making for his safety a fortress, protected by a desert, or a fortress built of (stone and) earth, or one protected by water or trees, or one (formed by an encampment of armed) men or a hill-fort.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेण तु प्रयत्नेन गिरिदुर्गं समाश्रयेत् । एषां हि बाहुगुण्येन गिरिदुर्गं विशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: sarveNa tu prayatnena giridurgaM samAshrayet | eShAM hi bAhuguNyena giridurgaM vishiShyate
verses.translation: Let him make every effort to secure a hill-fort, for amongst all those (fortresses mentioned) a hill-fort is distinguished by many superior qualities.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: त्रीण्याद्यान्याश्रितास्त्वेषां मृगगर्ताश्रयाप्चराः । त्रीण्युत्तराणि क्रमशः प्लवङ्गमनरामराः
verses.transliteration: trINyAdyAnyAshritAstveShAM mR^igagartAshrayApcharAH | trINyuttarANi kramashaH plava~NgamanarAmarAH
verses.translation: The first three of those (various kinds of fortresses) are inhabited by wild beasts, animals living in holes and aquatic animals, the last three by monkeys, men, and gods respectively.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: यथा दुर्गाश्रितानेतान्नोपहिंसन्ति शत्रवः । तथाऽरयो न हिंसन्ति नृपं दुर्गसमाश्रितम्
verses.transliteration: yathA durgAshritAnetAnnopahi.nsanti shatravaH | tathA.arayo na hi.nsanti nR^ipaM durgasamAshritam
verses.translation: As enemies do not hurt these (beings, when they are) sheltered by (their) fortresses, even so foes (can) not injure a king who has taken refuge in his fort.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: एकः शतं योधयति प्राकारस्थो धनुर्धरः । शतं दशसहस्राणि तस्माद्दुर्गं विधीयते
verses.transliteration: ekaH shataM yodhayati prAkArastho dhanurdharaH | shataM dashasahasrANi tasmAddurgaM vidhIyate
verses.translation: One bowman, placed on a rampart, is a match in battle for one hundred (foes), one hundred for ten thousand; hence it is prescribed (in the Sastras that a king will posses) a fortress.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: तत्स्यादायुधसम्पन्नं धनधान्येन वाहनैः । ब्राह्मणैः शिल्पिभिर्यन्त्रैर्यवसेनोदकेन च
verses.transliteration: tatsyAdAyudhasampannaM dhanadhAnyena vAhanaiH | brAhmaNaiH shilpibhiryantrairyavasenodakena cha
verses.translation: Let that (fort) be well supplied with weapons, money, grain and beasts of burden, with Brahmanas, with artisans, with engines, with fodder, and with water.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: तस्य मध्ये सुपर्याप्तं कारयेद्गृहमात्मनः । गुप्तं सर्वऋतुकं शुभ्रं जलवृक्षसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: tasya madhye suparyAptaM kArayedgR^ihamAtmanaH | guptaM sarvaR^itukaM shubhraM jalavR^ikShasamanvitam
verses.translation: Let him cause to be built for himself, in the centre of it, a spacious palace, (well) protected, habitable in every season, resplendent (with whitewash), supplied with water and trees.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: तदध्यास्योद्वहेद्भार्यां सवर्णां लक्षणान्विताम् । कुले महति सम्भूतां हृद्यां रूपगुणान्विताम्
verses.transliteration: tadadhyAsyodvahedbhAryAM savarNAM lakShaNAnvitAm | kule mahati sambhUtAM hR^idyAM rUpaguNAnvitAm
verses.translation: Inhabiting that, let him wed a consort of equal caste (varna), who possesses auspicious marks (on her body), and is born in a great family, who is charming and possesses beauty and excellent qualities.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: पुरोहितं च कुर्वीत वृणुयादेव चर्त्विजः । तेऽस्य गृह्याणि कर्माणि कुर्युर्वैतानिकानि च
verses.transliteration: purohitaM cha kurvIta vR^iNuyAdeva chartvijaH | te.asya gR^ihyANi karmANi kuryurvaitAnikAni cha
verses.translation: Let him appoint a domestic priest (purohita) and choose officiating priests (ritvig); they shall perform his domestic rites and the (sacrifices) for which three fires are required.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: यजेत राजा क्रतुभिर्विविधैराप्तदक्षिणैः । धर्मार्थं चैव विप्रेभ्यो दद्याद्भोगान् धनानि च
verses.transliteration: yajeta rAjA kratubhirvividhairAptadakShiNaiH | dharmArthaM chaiva viprebhyo dadyAdbhogAn dhanAni cha
verses.translation: A king shall offer various (Srauta) sacrifices at which liberal fees (are distributed), and in order to acquire merit, he shall give to Brahmanas enjoyments and wealth.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: स चैन्द्रः स्वप्रभावतः बालोऽपि नावमान्तव्यो मनुष्य इति भूमिपः । महती देवता ह्येषा नररूपेण तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: sa chaindraH svaprabhAvataH bAlo.api nAvamAntavyo manuShya iti bhUmipaH | mahatI devatA hyeShA nararUpeNa tiShThati
verses.translation: Even an infant king must not be despised, (from an idea) that he is a (mere) mortal; for he is a great deity in human form.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: सांवत्सरिकमाप्तैश्च राष्ट्रादाहारयेद्बलिम् । स्याच्चाम्नायपरो लोके वर्तेत पितृवत्नृषु
verses.transliteration: sA.nvatsarikamAptaishcha rAShTrAdAhArayedbalim | syAchchAmnAyaparo loke varteta pitR^ivatnR^iShu
verses.translation: Let him cause the annual revenue in his kingdom to be collected by trusty (officials), let him obey the sacred law in (his transactions with) the people, and behave like a father towards all men.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: अध्यक्षान् विविधान् कुर्यात्तत्र तत्र विपश्चितः । तेऽस्य सर्वाण्यवेक्षेरन्नृणां कार्याणि कुर्वताम्
verses.transliteration: adhyakShAn vividhAn kuryAttatra tatra vipashchitaH | te.asya sarvANyavekSherannR^iNAM kAryANi kurvatAm
verses.translation: For the various (branches of business) let him appoint intelligent supervisors; they shall inspect all (the acts) of those men who transact his business.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: आवृत्तानां गुरुकुलाद्विप्राणां पूजको भवेत् । नृपाणामक्षयो ह्येष निधिर्ब्राह्मोऽभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: AvR^ittAnAM gurukulAdviprANAM pUjako bhavet | nR^ipANAmakShayo hyeSha nidhirbrAhmo.abhidhIyate
verses.translation: Let him honour those Brahmanas who have returned from their teacher's house (after studying the Veda); for that (money which is given) to Brahmanas is declared to be an imperishable treasure for kings.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: न तं स्तेना न चामित्रा हरन्ति न च नश्यति । तस्माद्राज्ञा निधातव्यो ब्राह्मणेष्वक्षयो निधिः
verses.transliteration: na taM stenA na chAmitrA haranti na cha nashyati | tasmAdrAj~nA nidhAtavyo brAhmaNeShvakShayo nidhiH
verses.translation: Neither thieves nor foes can take it, nor can it be lost; hence an imperishable store must be deposited by kings with Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: न स्कन्दते न व्यथते न विनश्यति कर्हि चित् । न स्कन्दति न च्यवते वरिष्ठमग्निहोत्रेभ्यो ब्राह्मणस्य मुखे हुतम्
verses.transliteration: na skandate na vyathate na vinashyati karhi chit | na skandati na chyavate variShThamagnihotrebhyo brAhmaNasya mukhe hutam
verses.translation: The offering made through the mouth of a Brahmana, which is neither spilt, nor falls (on the ground), nor ever perishes, is far more excellent than Agnihotras.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: सममब्राह्मणे दानं द्विगुणं ब्राह्मणब्रुवे । प्राधीते शतसाहस्रमनन्तं वेदपारगे
verses.transliteration: samamabrAhmaNe dAnaM dviguNaM brAhmaNabruve | prAdhIte shatasAhasramanantaM vedapArage
verses.translation: A gift to one who is not a Brahmana (yields) the ordinary (reward; a gift) to one who calls himself a Brahmana, a double (reward); a gift to a well-read Brahmana, a hundred-thousandfold (reward); (a gift) to one who knows the Veda and the Angas (Vedaparaga, a reward) without end.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: आचार्ये शतसाहस्रं सहस्रगुणमाचार्ये पात्रस्य हि विशेषेण श्रद्दधानतयैव च । अल्पं वा बहु वा प्रेत्य दानस्य फलमश्नुते
verses.transliteration: AchArye shatasAhasraM sahasraguNamAchArye pAtrasya hi visheSheNa shraddadhAnatayaiva cha | alpaM vA bahu vA pretya dAnasya phalamashnute
verses.translation: For according to the particular qualities of the recipient and according to the faith (of the giver) a small or a great reward will be obtained for a gift in the next world.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: देशकालविधानेन द्रव्यं श्रद्धासमन्वितम् । पात्रे प्रदीयते यत्तु तद्धर्मस्य प्रसाधनम् ॥ ७.८७
verses.transliteration: (deshakAlavidhAnena dravyaM shraddhAsamanvitam | pAtre pradIyate yattu taddharmasya prasAdhanam || 7\.87) Jha's edition does not count it in his numbering of the text.)## samottamAdhamai rAjA tvAhUtaH pAlayan prajAH | na nivarteta sa~NgrAmAtkShAtraM dharmamanusmaran
verses.translation: A king who, while he protects his people, is defied by (foes), be they equal in strength, or stronger, or weaker, must not shrink from battle, remembering the duty of Kshatriyas.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: सङ्ग्रामेष्वनिवर्तित्वं प्रजानां चैव पालनम् । शुश्रूषा ब्राह्मणानां च राज्ञां श्रेयस्करं परम्
verses.transliteration: sa~NgrAmeShvanivartitvaM prajAnAM chaiva pAlanam | shushrUShA brAhmaNAnAM cha rAj~nAM shreyaskaraM param
verses.translation: Not to turn back in battle, to protect the people, to honour the Brahmanas, is the best means for a king to secure happiness.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: आहवेषु मिथोऽन्योन्यं जिघांसन्तो महीक्षितः । युध्यमानाः परं शक्त्या स्वर्गं यान्त्यपराङ्मुखाः
verses.transliteration: AhaveShu mitho.anyonyaM jighA.nsanto mahIkShitaH | yudhyamAnAH paraM shaktyA svargaM yAntyaparA~NmukhAH
verses.translation: Those kings who, seeking to slay each other in battle, fight with the utmost exertion and do not turn back, go to heaven.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: एकमेव दहत्यग्निर्नरं दुरुपसर्पिणम् । कुलं दहति राजाऽग्निः सपशुद्रव्यसञ्चयम्
verses.transliteration: ekameva dahatyagnirnaraM durupasarpiNam | kulaM dahati rAjA.agniH sapashudravyasa~nchayam
verses.translation: Fire burns one man only, if he carelessly approaches it, the fire of a king's (anger) consumes the (whole) family, together with its cattle and its hoard of property.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: न कूटैरायुधैर्हन्याद्युध्यमानो रणे रिपून् । न कर्णिभिर्नापि दिग्धैर्नाग्निज्वलिततेजनैः
verses.transliteration: na kUTairAyudhairhanyAdyudhyamAno raNe ripUn | na karNibhirnApi digdhairnAgnijvalitatejanaiH
verses.translation: When he fights with his foes in battle, let him not strike with weapons concealed (in wood), nor with (such as are) barbed, poisoned, or the points of which are blazing with fire.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: न च हन्यात्स्थलारूढं न क्लीबं न कृताञ्जलिम् । न मुक्तकेशं नासीनं न तवास्मीति वादिनम्
verses.transliteration: na cha hanyAtsthalArUDhaM na klIbaM na kR^itA~njalim | na muktakeshaM nAsInaM na tavAsmIti vAdinam
verses.translation: Let him not strike one who (in flight) has climbed on an eminence, nor a eunuch, nor one who joins the palms of his hands (in supplication), nor one who (flees) with flying hair, nor one who sits down, nor one who says 'I am thine;'
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: न सुप्तं न विसंनाहं न नग्नं न निरायुधम् । नायुध्यमानं पश्यन्तं न परेण समागतम्
verses.transliteration: na suptaM na visa.nnAhaM na nagnaM na nirAyudham | nAyudhyamAnaM pashyantaM na pareNa samAgatam
verses.translation: Nor one who sleeps, nor one who has lost his coat of mail, nor one who is naked, nor one who is disarmed, nor one who looks on without taking part in the fight, nor one who is fighting with another (foe);
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: नायुधव्यसनप्राप्तं नार्तं नातिपरिक्षतम् । न भीतं न परावृत्तं सतां धर्ममनुस्मरन्
verses.transliteration: nAyudhavyasanaprAptaM nArtaM nAtiparikShatam | na bhItaM na parAvR^ittaM satAM dharmamanusmaran
verses.translation: Nor one whose weapons are broken, nor one afflicted (with sorrow), nor one who has been grievously wounded, nor one who is in fear, nor one who has turned to flight; (but in all these cases let him) remember the duty (of honourable warriors).
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु भीतः परावृत्तः सङ्ग्रामे हन्यते परैः । भर्तुर्यद्दुष्कृतं किं चित्तत्सर्वं प्रतिपद्यते
verses.transliteration: yastu bhItaH parAvR^ittaH sa~NgrAme hanyate paraiH | bharturyadduShkR^itaM kiM chittatsarvaM pratipadyate
verses.translation: But the (Kshatriya) who is slain in battle, while he turns back in fear, takes upon himself all the sin of his master, whatever (it may be);
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: यत्चास्य सुकृतं किं चिदमुत्रार्थमुपार्जितम् । भर्ता तत्सर्वमादत्ते परावृत्तहतस्य तु
verses.transliteration: yatchAsya sukR^itaM kiM chidamutrArthamupArjitam | bhartA tatsarvamAdatte parAvR^ittahatasya tu
verses.translation: And whatever merit (a man) who is slain in flight may have gained for the next (world), all that his master takes.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: रथाश्वं हस्तिनं छत्रं धनं धान्यं पशून् स्त्रियः । सर्वद्रव्याणि कुप्यं च यो यज्जयति तस्य तत्
verses.transliteration: rathAshvaM hastinaM ChatraM dhanaM dhAnyaM pashUn striyaH | sarvadravyANi kupyaM cha yo yajjayati tasya tat
verses.translation: Chariots and horses, elephants, parasols, money, grain, cattle, women, all sorts of (marketable) goods and valueless metals belong to him who takes them (singly) conquering (the possessor).
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञश्च दद्युरुद्धारमित्येषा वैदिकी श्रुतिः । राज्ञा च सर्वयोधेभ्यो दातव्यमपृथग्जितम्
verses.transliteration: rAj~nashcha dadyuruddhAramityeShA vaidikI shrutiH | rAj~nA cha sarvayodhebhyo dAtavyamapR^ithagjitam
verses.translation: A text of the Veda (declares) that (the soldiers) shall present a choice portion (of the booty) to the king; what has not been taken singly, must be distributed by the king among all the soldiers.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: एषोऽनुपस्कृतः प्रोक्तो योधधर्मः सनातनः । अस्माद्धर्मान्न च्यवेत क्षत्रियो घ्नन् रणे रिपून्
verses.transliteration: eSho.anupaskR^itaH prokto yodhadharmaH sanAtanaH | asmAddharmAnna chyaveta kShatriyo ghnan raNe ripUn
verses.translation: Thus has been declared the blameless, primeval law for warriors; from this law a Kshatriya must not depart, when he strikes his foes in battle.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: अलब्धं चैव लिप्सेत लब्धं रक्षेत्प्रयत्नतः । रक्षितं वर्धयेच्चैव वृद्धं पात्रेषु निक्षिपेत्
verses.transliteration: alabdhaM chaiva lipseta labdhaM rakShetprayatnataH | rakShitaM vardhayechchaiva vR^iddhaM pAtreShu nikShipet
verses.translation: Let him strive to gain what he has not yet gained; what he has gained let him carefully preserve; let him augment what he preserves, and what he has augmented let him bestow on worthy men.
verses.hindi: -बादी और 'प्रतिचादियों के विचाराथे नम्नता से राजससा ठे .:  रेश करे । वहाँ जाकर, दाहना हाथ उठांकर, बैठकर या खड़ेहों...

verses.sanskrit: व्यवहारान् दिदृक्षुस्तु ब्राह्मणैः सह पार्थिवः । मन्त्रज्ञैर्मन्त्रिभिश्चैव विनीतः प्रविशेत्सभाम्
verses.transliteration: vyavahArAn didR^ikShustu brAhmaNaiH saha pArthivaH | mantraj~nairmantribhishchaiva vinItaH pravishetsabhAm
verses.translation: A king, desirous of investigating law cases, must enter his court of justice, preserving a dignified demeanour, together with Brahmanas and with experienced councillors.
verses.hindi: इन विष में झगडा करनेबाला का फेसला राजा को सच्मतन- धसे के अनुसार करना चाहिए। जव आप कारणवश न काम देख के साथ ससा से देडकर या खड़े ही राजा के खास कामों को देखे । जिल देश में घेदविशारद दीन ब्राह्मण राजसभा में निरयन

verses.sanskrit: सोऽस्य कार्याणि सम्पश्येत्सभ्यैरेव त्रिभिर्वृतः । सभामेव प्रविश्याग्र्यामासीनः स्थित एव वा
verses.transliteration: so.asya kAryANi sampashyetsabhyaireva tribhirvR^itaH | sabhAmeva pravishyAgryAmAsInaH sthita eva vA
verses.translation: That (man) shall enter that most excellent court, accompanied by three assessors, and fully consider (all) causes (brought) before the (king), either sitting down or standing.
verses.hindi: इषलं लं विदुहैवास्तस्साडम न लोपयेत् ॥.१६॥ धर्मे का लोप कर्देने से वह उस पुरुष को यष्ट करदेता है और थमे की रक्षा करने से वह सी रक्षा करता है । इसलिए धमे का राश न करना -चादिए जिसमें नष्ट चर्म इसारा नाश न करे।

verses.sanskrit: अप्सु भूमिवदित्याहुः स्त्रीणां भोगे च मैथुने । अब्जेषु चैव रत्नेषु सर्वेष्वश्ममयेषु च
verses.transliteration: apsu bhUmivadityAhuH strINAM bhoge cha maithune | abjeShu chaiva ratneShu sarveShvashmamayeShu cha
verses.translation: 'They declare (false evidence) concerning water, concerning the carnal enjoyment of women, and concerning all gems, produced in water, or consisting of stones (to be) equally (wicked) as a lie concerning land.
verses.hindi: ल्याॉय करते समय उसका एक चौथाई अधर्म अन्याय करने वाले को, एक चौथाई भूँठे गचाइ को, एक चौथाई सभासद् और एक चौथाई राजा को अधर्म लगता है । जिस समा में अन्यायी - पुरुष की ठीक ठीक निन्दा कीजाती .है, चहां राजा और सभा-

verses.sanskrit: एतान् दोषानवेक्ष्य त्वं सर्वाननृतभाषणे । यथाश्रुतं यथादृष्टं सर्वमेवाञ्जसा वद
verses.transliteration: etAn doShAnavekShya tvaM sarvAnanR^itabhAShaNe | yathAshrutaM yathAdR^iShTaM sarvamevA~njasA vada
verses.translation: 'Marking well all the evils (which are produced) by perjury, declare thou openly everything as (thou hast) heard or seen (it).'
verses.hindi: अर्थानथावुभो बुद्ध्वा घमोधरसो च केवलो ।

verses.sanskrit: गोरक्षकान् वाणिजिकांस्तथा कारुकुशीलवान् । वाणिजकांस्तथा प्रेष्यान् वार्धुषिकांश्चैव विप्रान् शूद्रवदाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: gorakShakAn vANijikA.nstathA kArukushIlavAn | vANijakA.nstathA preShyAn vArdhuShikA.nshchaiva viprAn shUdravadAcharet
