verses.sanskrit: पाणिग्रहणिका मन्त्रा नियतं दारलक्षणम् । तेषां निष्ठा तु विज्ञेया विद्वद्भिः सप्तमे पदे
verses.transliteration: pANigrahaNikA mantrA niyataM dAralakShaNam | teShAM niShThA tu vij~neyA vidvadbhiH saptame pade
verses.translation: The nuptial texts are a certain proof (that a maiden has been made a lawful) wife; but the learned should know that they (and the marriage ceremony are complete with the seventh step (of the bride around the sacred fire).
verses.hindi: घश्या और शूद्रा से व्यभिचार करे तो पाँच सौ पण दरड करे। और चःएडालो-भागनसे गमंत करने पर हज़ार पण दण्ड करे॥ ३८३-३८४

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन् यस्मिन् कृते कार्ये यस्येहानुशयो भवेत् । तमनेन विधानेन धर्म्ये पथि निवेशयेत्
verses.transliteration: yasmin yasmin kR^ite kArye yasyehAnushayo bhavet | tamanena vidhAnena dharmye pathi niveshayet
verses.translation: If anybody in this (world) repent of any completed transaction, (the king) shall keep him on the road of rectitude in accordance with the rules given above.
verses.hindi: घतेपां निमहो राज्ञः पञ्चानां विषये स्वके ।

verses.sanskrit: पशुषु स्वामिनां चैव पालानां च व्यतिक्रमे । विवादं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि यथावद्धर्मतत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: pashuShu svAminAM chaiva pAlAnAM cha vyatikrame | vivAdaM sampravakShyAmi yathAvaddharmatattvataH
verses.translation: I will fully declare in accordance with the true law (the rules concerning) the disputes, (arising) from the transgressions of owners of cattle and of herdsmen.
verses.hindi: “जिस राजा के नगर में न चोर है, न व्यभिचारी हैं, न कुवाच्य कहनेवाले हैं, न लुटेरे हैं, और न मारपीट करनेवाले हैँ घह . करने से राजा का राज्य और यश फैलता है । जो यजमान अपने यजमान को छोड़ दे उन दोनों पर राजा सौ सो पण दरड करे

verses.sanskrit: धर्मासनमधिष्ठाय संवीताङ्गः समाहितः । प्रणम्य लोकपालेभ्यः कार्यदर्शनमारभेत्
verses.transliteration: dharmAsanamadhiShThAya sa.nvItA~NgaH samAhitaH | praNamya lokapAlebhyaH kAryadarshanamArabhet
verses.translation: Having occupied the seat of justice, having covered his body, and having worshipped the guardian deities of the world, let him, with a collected mind, begin the trial of causes.
verses.hindi: , किन्तु अपने समासदों के साथ इनकी यथोचित पूजा करके आर बीस बाह्णा,के भोजन का प्रवन्ध हो तव पड़ोसी और आने जनेवाले हिती को न जिमाबे तो उस पुरुष पर एक सापक दरड रे । किसी ये में वेद ब्राह्मण पी

verses.sanskrit: दिवा वक्तव्यता पाले रात्रौ स्वामिनि तद्गृहे । योगक्षेमेऽन्यथा चेत्तु पालो वक्तव्यतामियात्
verses.transliteration: divA vaktavyatA pAle rAtrau svAmini tadgR^ihe | yogakSheme.anyathA chettu pAlo vaktavyatAmiyAt
verses.translation: During the day the responsibility for the safety (of the cattle rests) on the herdsman, during the night on the owner, (provided they are) in his house; (if it be) otherwise, the herdsman will be responsible (for them also during the night).
verses.hindi: धोधी सेमर के चिकने पाट पर धीरे धीरे कपड़े 'घोवे, कपड़ों को चदले, नहँ और न वहुत दिनो तक पड़ा रक्खे। जुलाहा द्श' पल दूत लेकर मांडी के संवच से ग्यारह पल कपड़ा देवे । यदि 'लिळाफ़ करे तो उल पर राजा वारह पण् दण्ड दिलावे । जो पुरुप

verses.sanskrit: गोपः क्षीरभृतो यस्तु स दुह्याद्दशतो वराम् । गोस्वाम्यनुमते भृत्यः सा स्यात्पालेऽभृते भृतिः

verses.translation: A hired herdsman who is paid with milk, may milk with the consent of the owner the best (cow) out of ten; such shall be his hire if no (other) wages (are paid).
verses.hindi: राजा अपने देश के जिन प्रसिद्ध चस्तुओं को परदेश मे व्यापारार्थ ज्ञाने से रोके उनको लोभबश कोई लेजाय तो राजा उसका सर्वस्व छीन लेय! चुगीधर से डिपानेवाला, असमय में ख़रीद-बेच करनेवाला, गिनती-तोल में मूठ घोलनेवाला वस्तु

verses.sanskrit: नष्टं विनष्टं कृमिभिः श्वहतं विषमे मृतम् । हीनं पुरुषकारेण प्रदद्यात्पाल एव तु
verses.transliteration: naShTaM vinaShTaM kR^imibhiH shvahataM viShame mR^itam | hInaM puruShakAreNa pradadyAtpAla eva tu
verses.translation: The herdsman alone shall make good (the loss of a beast) strayed, destroyed by worms, killed by dogs or (by falling) into a pit, if he did not duly exert himself (to prevent it).
verses.hindi: दीघाध्वानि यथादेशं यथाकालं तरो भवेत् ।

verses.sanskrit: विघुष्य तु हृतं चौरैर्न पालो दातुमर्हति । यदि देशे च काले च स्वामिनः स्वस्य शंसति
verses.transliteration: vighuShya tu hR^itaM chaurairna pAlo dAtumarhati | yadi deshe cha kAle cha svAminaH svasya sha.nsati
verses.translation: But for (an animal) stolen by thieves, though he raised an alarm, the herdsman shall not pay, provided he gives notice to his master at the proper place and time.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णौ चर्म च वालांश्च बस्तिं स्नायुं च रोचनाम् । पशुषु स्वामिनां दद्यान् मृतेष्वङ्कानि दर्शयेत्
verses.transliteration: karNau charma cha vAlA.nshcha bastiM snAyuM cha rochanAm | pashuShu svAminAM dadyAn mR^iteShva~NkAni darshayet
verses.translation: If cattle die, let him carry to his master their ears, skin, tails, bladders, tendons, and the yellow concrete bile, and let him point out their particular. marks.
verses.hindi: दाशापराधतस्तोये हैविके नास्ति नियहः

verses.sanskrit: अङ्कांश्च दर्शयेत्) अजाविके तु संरुद्धे वृकैः पाले त्वनायति । यां प्रसह्य वृको हन्यात्पाले तत्किल्बिषं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: a~NkA.nshcha darshayet) ajAvike tu sa.nruddhe vR^ikaiH pAle tvanAyati | yAM prasahya vR^iko hanyAtpAle tatkilbiShaM bhavet
verses.translation: But if goats or sheep are surrounded by wolves and the herdsman does not hasten (to their assistance), lie shall be responsible for any (animal) which a wolf may attack and kill.
verses.hindi: दो महीना से अधिक की गसिणी, वानप्रस्थ, संन्यासी और फे दोप से जो कुछ दानि हो, बद मल्लाह लोग इकट्ठा होकर अपने भाग में से देवें ! यह नौका से नदी पार होने का निय और जल में मल्लाहों के व्यवहार का निर्णय कहा है. । यादे कोई हैवी चि-

verses.sanskrit: तासां चेदवरुद्धानां चरन्तीनां मिथो वने । यामुत्प्लुत्य वृको हन्यान्न पालस्तत्र किल्बिषी
verses.transliteration: tAsAM chedavaruddhAnAM charantInAM mitho vane | yAmutplutya vR^iko hanyAnna pAlastatra kilbiShI
verses.translation: But if they, kept in (proper) order, graze together in the forest, and a wolf, suddenly jumping on one of them, kills it, the herdsman shall bear in that case no responsibility.
verses.hindi: कराचे। आर शूद्रा स धजाका खचा कराने आयका स रहित करावे तो उसपर राजा छ सौ पण दरड करे  खरीदे वः. विना के लिएही पेदो किया है। स्वामी से छुड़ाया हुआ भी यद्र दास कर्म को नहीं छोड़ सकता क्याकि वह उसका स्वाभाविक थमे

verses.sanskrit: धनुःशतं परीहारो ग्रामस्य स्यात्समन्ततः । शम्यापातास्त्रयो वाऽपि त्रिगुणो नगरस्य तु
verses.transliteration: dhanuHshataM parIhAro grAmasya syAtsamantataH | shamyApAtAstrayo vA.api triguNo nagarasya tu
verses.translation: On all sides of a village a space, one hundred dhanus or three samya-throws (in breadth), shall be reserved (for pasture), and thrice (that space) round a town.
verses.hindi: युद सें जीतकर लाया हुआ, सक्त दास, दासीपुत खरीदा हुआ, किसी का दिया हत्या, परपरा से मात और द्रड-शुद्धि के लिए जिसने दासपना किया हो, ये खात प्रकार के दाख होते हैं । भायो, पुत्र और दाल इन तीनों को मेठुते विव कहा है, ये जो

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापरिवृतं धान्यं विहिंस्युः पशवो यदि । न तत्र प्रणयेद्दण्डं नृपतिः पशुरक्षिणाम्
verses.transliteration: tatrAparivR^itaM dhAnyaM vihi.nsyuH pashavo yadi | na tatra praNayeddaNDaM nR^ipatiH pashurakShiNAm
verses.translation: If the cattle do damage to unfenced crops on that (common), the king shall in that case not punish the herdsmen.
verses.hindi: वे अपने कर्म से इरकर ससार को उपद्र्यों से दुखी करेगे। राजा प्रतिदिन आरम्भ किये कार्यों का, सवारियों का, नियत आय-यय, खान और धन-भएडार का अवलोकन करे । इसप्रकार राजा इन सव व्यवहारा का निर्णय करताइआ सब पापों का

verses.sanskrit: वृतिं तत्र प्रकुर्वीत यामुष्त्रो न विलोकयेत् । छिद्रं च वारयेत्सर्वं श्वसूकरमुखानुगम्
verses.transliteration: vR^itiM tatra prakurvIta yAmuShtro na vilokayet | ChidraM cha vArayetsarvaM shvasUkaramukhAnugam
verses.translation: (The owner of the field) shall make there a hedge over which a camel cannot look, and stop every gap through which a dog or a boar can thrust his head.
verses.hindi: पिता रक्षति कोमारे भता रक्षति योवने। .

verses.sanskrit: अर्थानर्थावुभौ बुद्ध्वा धर्माधर्मौ च केवलौ । वर्णक्रमेण सर्वाणि पश्येत्कार्याणि कार्यिणाम्
verses.transliteration: arthAnarthAvubhau buddhvA dharmAdharmau cha kevalau | varNakrameNa sarvANi pashyetkAryANi kAryiNAm
verses.translation: Knowing what is expedient or inexpedient, what is pure justice or injustice, let him examine the causes of suitors according to the order of the castes (varna).
verses.hindi: दयोहि कुलयोः शोकमावहेयुरंरंक्षिताः ॥ इ ॥ .

verses.sanskrit: पथि क्षेत्रे परिवृते ग्रामान्तीयेऽथ वा पुनः । सपालः शतदण्डार्हो विपालान् वारयेत्पशून्
verses.transliteration: pathi kShetre parivR^ite grAmAntIye.atha vA punaH | sapAlaH shatadaNDArho vipAlAn vArayetpashUn
verses.translation: (If cattle do mischief) in an enclosed field near a highway or near a village, the herdsman shall be fined one hundred (panas);
verses.hindi: अपने हनातन धमे में स्थित पुरुष और स्त्रियो के संयोग और ' ' वियोग समय के धर्म कहे जाते हैः--   पुरुष को अपनी खियों को कभी स्वतन्त्र न होने देना चाहिए । नाच गान म आसक्क खियों को अपने वशमें रखना चाहिए । वॉर

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रेष्वन्येषु तु पशुः सपादं पणमर्हति । सर्वत्र तु सदो देयः क्षेत्रिकस्यैति धारणा
verses.transliteration: kShetreShvanyeShu tu pashuH sapAdaM paNamarhati | sarvatra tu sado deyaH kShetrikasyaiti dhAraNA
verses.translation: (For damage) in other fields (each head of) cattle shall (pay a fine of one (pana) and a quarter, and in all (cases the value of) the crop (destroyed) shall be made good to the owner of the field; that is the settled rule.
verses.hindi: खियों की रक्षा करने से पुरुष अपनी संतान को घर्णसङ्कर 'दोने से घचाता है, अपने चरित्र को निर्दोष रखता है, अपने कुल की मर्यादा बढ़ाता है, अपनी और अपने धर्म कौ रक्षा करता , लेता है। अपनी खो में फिर जन्मता है इसीसे खरी जाया कद"

verses.sanskrit: अनिर्दशाहां गां सूतां वृषान् देवपशूंस्तथा । सपालान् वा विपालान् वा न दण्ड्यान् मनुरब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: anirdashAhAM gAM sUtAM vR^iShAn devapashU.nstathA | sapAlAn vA vipAlAn vA na daNDyAn manurabravIt
verses.translation: But Manu has declared that no fine shall be paid for (damage done by) a cow within ten days after her calving, by bulls and by cattle sacred to the gods, whether they are attended by a herdsman or not.
verses.hindi: अरक्षिता रहे रुद्धाः पुरुषेरातकारिभिः,। व

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रियस्यात्यये दण्डो भागाद्दशगुणो भवेत् । क्षेत्रिकस्यात्यये ततोऽर्धदण्डो भृत्यानामज्ञानात्क्षेत्रिकस्य तु
verses.transliteration: kShetriyasyAtyaye daNDo bhAgAddashaguNo bhavet | kShetrikasyAtyaye tato.ardhadaNDo bhR^ityAnAmaj~nAnAtkShetrikasya tu
verses.translation: If (the crops are destroyed by) the husbandman's (own) fault, the fine shall amount to ten times as much as (the king's) share; but the fine (shall be) only half that amount if (the fault lay) with the servants and the farmer had no knowledge of it.
verses.hindi: घन-सँग्रह, “खर्च, सक्काई, पतिसेवा;  अमै, रसोई आर घरके साल स खरा का लगाव । खश्वास पात्र मङुष्या स चरस रखवास त कराने से रक्षित नहीं होती किन्तु जो अपनी रक्षा पदी कर. चेही खरक्षित होसकती है. मच्चपान, डुजनसर) पति से वियोग, ..

verses.sanskrit: एतद्विधानमातिष्ठेद्धार्मिकः पृथिवीपतिः । स्वामिनां च पशूनां च पालानां च व्यतिक्रमे
verses.transliteration: etadvidhAnamAtiShTheddhArmikaH pR^ithivIpatiH | svAminAM cha pashUnAM cha pAlAnAM cha vyatikrame
verses.translation: To these rules a righteous king shall keep in (all cases of) transgressions by masters, their cattle, and herdsmen.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सीमां प्रति समुत्पन्ने विवादे ग्रामयोर्द्वयोः । ज्येष्ठे मासि नयेत्सीमां सुप्रकाशेषु सेतुषु
verses.transliteration: sImAM prati samutpanne vivAde grAmayordvayoH | jyeShThe mAsi nayetsImAM suprakAsheShu setuShu
verses.translation: If a dispute has arisen between two villages concerning a boundary, the king shall settle the limits in the month of Gyaishtha, when the landmarks are most distinctly visible.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सीमावृक्षांश्च कुर्वीत न्यग्रोधाश्वत्थकिंशुकान् । शाल्मलीन् सालतालांश्च क्षीरिणश्चैव पादपान्
verses.transliteration: sImAvR^ikShA.nshcha kurvIta nyagrodhAshvatthaki.nshukAn | shAlmalIn sAlatAlA.nshcha kShIriNashchaiva pAdapAn
verses.translation: Let him mark the boundaries (by) trees, (e.g.) Nyagrodhas, Asvatthas, Kimsukas, cotton-trees, Salas, Palmyra palms, and trees with milky juice,
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: गुल्मान् वेणूंश्च विविधान् शमीवल्लीस्थलानि च । शरान् कुब्जकगुल्मांश्च तथा सीमा न नश्यति
verses.transliteration: gulmAn veNU.nshcha vividhAn shamIvallIsthalAni cha | sharAn kubjakagulmA.nshcha tathA sImA na nashyati
verses.translation: By clustering shrubs, bamboos of different kinds, Samis, creepers and raised mounds, reeds, thickets of Kubgaka; thus the boundary will not be forgotten.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: तडागान्युदपानानि वाप्यः प्रस्रवणानि च । सीमासंधिषु कार्याणि देवतायतनानि च
verses.transliteration: taDAgAnyudapAnAni vApyaH prasravaNAni cha | sImAsa.ndhiShu kAryANi devatAyatanAni cha
verses.translation: Tanks, wells, cisterns, and fountains should be built where boundaries meet, as well as temples,
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: उपछन्नानि चान्यानि सीमालिङ्गानि कारयेत् । सीमाज्ञाने नृणां वीक्ष्य नित्यं लोके विपर्ययम्
verses.transliteration: upaChannAni chAnyAni sImAli~NgAni kArayet | sImAj~nAne nR^iNAM vIkShya nityaM loke viparyayam
verses.translation: And as he will see that through men's ignorance of the boundaries trespasses constantly occur in the world, let him cause to be made other hidden marks for boundaries,
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: बाह्यैर्विभावयेत्लिङ्गैर्भावमन्तर्गतं नृणाम् । स्वरवर्णैङ्गिताकारैश्चक्षुषा चेष्टितेन च
verses.transliteration: bAhyairvibhAvayetli~NgairbhAvamantargataM nR^iNAm | svaravarNai~NgitAkAraishchakShuShA cheShTitena cha
verses.translation: By external signs let him discover the internal disposition of men, by their voice, their colour, their motions, their aspect, their eyes, and their gestures.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अश्मनोऽस्थीनि गोवालांस्तुषान् भस्म कपालिकाः । करीषमिष्टकाऽङ्गारांश्छर्करा वालुकास्तथा
verses.transliteration: ashmano.asthIni govAlA.nstuShAn bhasma kapAlikAH | karIShamiShTakA.a~NgArA.nshCharkarA vAlukAstathA
verses.translation: Stones, bones, cow's hair, chaff, ashes, potsherds, dry cowdung, bricks, cinders, pebbles, and sand,
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यानि चैवम्प्रकाराणि कालाद्भूमिर्न भक्षयेत् । तानि संधिषु सीमायामप्रकाशानि कारयेत्
verses.transliteration: yAni chaivamprakArANi kAlAdbhUmirna bhakShayet | tAni sa.ndhiShu sImAyAmaprakAshAni kArayet
verses.translation: And whatever other things of a similar kind the earth does not corrode even after a long time, those he should cause to be buried where one boundary joins (the other).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सीमाया एतैर्लिङ्गैर्नयेत्सीमां राजा विवदमानयोः । पूर्वभुक्त्या च सततमुदकस्यागमेन च
verses.transliteration: sImAyA etairli~NgairnayetsImAM rAjA vivadamAnayoH | pUrvabhuktyA cha satatamudakasyAgamena cha
verses.translation: By these signs, by long continued possession, and by constantly flowing streams of water the king shall ascertain the boundary (of the land) of two disputing parties.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यदि स्ंशय एव स्यात्लिङ्गानामपि दर्शने । साक्षिप्रत्यय एव स्यात्सीमावादविनिर्णयः
verses.transliteration: yadi s.nshaya eva syAtli~NgAnAmapi darshane | sAkShipratyaya eva syAtsImAvAdavinirNayaH
verses.translation: If there be a doubt even on inspection of the marks, the settlement of a dispute regarding boundaries shall depend on witnesses.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सीमावादविनिश्चयः ग्रामीयककुलानां च समक्षं सीम्नि साक्षिणः । ग्रामेयक प्रष्टव्याः सीमलिङ्गानि तयोश्चैव विवादिनोः
verses.transliteration: sImAvAdavinishchayaH grAmIyakakulAnAM cha samakShaM sImni sAkShiNaH | grAmeyaka praShTavyAH sImali~NgAni tayoshchaiva vivAdinoH
verses.translation: The witnesses, (giving evidence) regarding a boundary, shall be examined concerning the landmarks in the presence of the crowd of the villagers and also of the two litigants.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सीमालिङ्गानि ते पृष्तास्तु यथा ब्रूयुः समस्ताः सीम्नि निश्चयम् । निबध्नीयात्तथा सीमां सर्वांस्तांश्चैव नामतः
verses.transliteration: sImAli~NgAni te pR^iShtAstu yathA brUyuH samastAH sImni nishchayam | nibadhnIyAttathA sImAM sarvA.nstA.nshchaiva nAmataH
verses.translation: As they, being questioned, unanimously decide, even so he shall record the boundary (in writing), together with their names.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: शिरोभिस्ते गृहीत्वोर्वीं स्रग्विणो रक्तवाससः । सुकृतैः शापिताः स्वैः स्वैर्नयेयुस्ते समञ्जसम्
verses.transliteration: shirobhiste gR^ihItvorvIM sragviNo raktavAsasaH | sukR^itaiH shApitAH svaiH svairnayeyuste sama~njasam
verses.translation: Let them, putting earth on their heads, wearing chaplets (of red flowers) and red dresses, being sworn each by (the rewards for) his meritorious deeds, settle (the boundary) in accordance with the truth.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यथोक्तेन नयन्तस्ते पूयन्ते सत्यसाक्षिणः । विपरीतं नयन्तस्तु दाप्याः स्युर्द्विशतं दमम्
verses.transliteration: yathoktena nayantaste pUyante satyasAkShiNaH | viparItaM nayantastu dApyAH syurdvishataM damam
verses.translation: If they determine (the boundary) in the manner stated, they are guiltless (being) veracious witnesses; but if they determine it unjustly, they shall be compelled to pay a fine of two hundred (panas).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: साक्ष्यभावे तु चत्वारो ग्रामाः सामन्तवासिनः । ग्रामसीमान्तवासिनः सीमाविनिर्णयं कुर्युः प्रयता राजसंनिधौ
verses.transliteration: sAkShyabhAve tu chatvAro grAmAH sAmantavAsinaH | grAmasImAntavAsinaH sImAvinirNayaM kuryuH prayatA rAjasa.nnidhau
verses.translation: On failure of witnesses (from the two villages, men of) the four neighbouring villages, who are pure, shall make (as witnesses) a decision concerning the boundary in the presence of the king.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सामन्तानामभावे तु मौलानां सीम्नि साक्षिणाम् । इमानप्यनुयुञ्जीत पुरुषान् वनगोचरान्
verses.transliteration: sAmantAnAmabhAve tu maulAnAM sImni sAkShiNAm | imAnapyanuyu~njIta puruShAn vanagocharAn
verses.translation: On failure of neighbours (who are) original inhabitants (of the country and can be) witnesses with respect to the boundary, (the king) may hear the evidence even of the following inhabitants of the forest.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: आकारैरिङ्गितैर्गत्या चेष्टया भाषितेन च । नेत्रवक्त्रविकारैश्च गृह्यतेऽन्तर्गतं मनः
verses.transliteration: AkArairi~NgitairgatyA cheShTayA bhAShitena cha | netravaktravikAraishcha gR^ihyate.antargataM manaH
verses.translation: The internal (working of the) mind is perceived through the aspect, the motions, the gait, the gestures, the speech, and the changes in the eye and of the face.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: व्याधांशाकुनिकान् गोपान् कैवर्तान् मूलखानकान् । व्यालग्राहानुञ्छवृत्तीनन्यांश्च वनचारिणः
verses.transliteration: vyAdhA.nshAkunikAn gopAn kaivartAn mUlakhAnakAn | vyAlagrAhAnu~nChavR^ittInanyA.nshcha vanachAriNaH
verses.translation: (Viz.) hunters, fowlers, herdsmen, fishermen, root-diggers, snake-catchers, gleaners, and other foresters.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: ते पृष्टास्तु यथा ब्रूयुः सीमासंधिषु लक्षणम् । तत्तथा स्थापयेद्राजा धर्मेण ग्रामयोर्द्वयोः
verses.transliteration: te pR^iShTAstu yathA brUyuH sImAsa.ndhiShu lakShaNam | tattathA sthApayedrAjA dharmeNa grAmayordvayoH
verses.translation: As they, being examined, declare the marks for the meeting of the boundaries (to be), even so the king shall justly cause them to be fixed between the two villages.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रकूपतडागानामारामस्य गृहस्य च । सामन्तप्रत्ययो ज्ञेयः सीमासेतुविनिर्णयः
verses.transliteration: kShetrakUpataDAgAnAmArAmasya gR^ihasya cha | sAmantapratyayo j~neyaH sImAsetuvinirNayaH
verses.translation: The decision concerning the boundary-marks of fields, wells, tanks, of gardens and houses depends upon (the evidence of) the neighbours.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सामन्ताश्चेत्मृषा ब्रूयुः सेतौ विवादतां नृणाम् । सर्वे पृथक्पृथग्दण्ड्या राज्ञा मध्यमसाहसम्
verses.transliteration: sAmantAshchetmR^iShA brUyuH setau vivAdatAM nR^iNAm | sarve pR^ithakpR^ithagdaNDyA rAj~nA madhyamasAhasam
verses.translation: Should the neighbours give false evidence, when men dispute about a boundary-mark, the king shall make each of them pay the middlemost amercement as a fine.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: गृहं तडागमारामं क्षेत्रं वा भीषया हरन् । शतानि पञ्च दण्ड्यः स्यादज्ञानाद्द्विशतो दमः
verses.transliteration: gR^ihaM taDAgamArAmaM kShetraM vA bhIShayA haran | shatAni pa~ncha daNDyaH syAdaj~nAnAddvishato damaH
verses.translation: He who by intimidation possesses himself of a house, a tank, a garden, or a field, shall be fined five hundred (panas); (if he trespassed) through ignorance, the fine (shall be) two hundred (panas).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सीमायामविषह्यायां स्वयं राजैव धर्मवित् । प्रदिशेद्भूमिमेकेषामुपकारादिति स्थितिः
verses.transliteration: sImAyAmaviShahyAyAM svayaM rAjaiva dharmavit | pradishedbhUmimekeShAmupakArAditi sthitiH
verses.translation: If the boundary cannot be ascertained (by any evidence), let a righteous king with (the intention of) benefiting them (all), himself assign (his) land (to each); that is the settled rule.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: एषोऽखिलेनाभिहितो धर्मः सीमाविनिर्णये । अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि वाक्पारुष्यविनिर्णयम्
verses.transliteration: eSho.akhilenAbhihito dharmaH sImAvinirNaye | ata UrdhvaM pravakShyAmi vAkpAruShyavinirNayam
verses.translation: Thus the law for deciding boundary (disputes) has been fully declared, I will next propound the (manner of) deciding (cases of) defamation.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: शतं ब्राह्मणमाक्रुश्य क्षत्रियो दण्डमर्हति । वैश्योऽप्यर्धशतं द्वे वा शूद्रस्तु वधमर्हति
verses.transliteration: shataM brAhmaNamAkrushya kShatriyo daNDamarhati | vaishyo.apyardhashataM dve vA shUdrastu vadhamarhati
verses.translation: A Kshatriya, having defamed a Brahmana, shall be fined one hundred (panas); a Vaisya one hundred and fifty or two hundred; a Sudra shall suffer corporal punishment.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाशद्ब्राह्मणो दण्ड्यः क्षत्रियस्याभिशंसने । वैश्ये स्यादर्धपञ्चाशत्शूद्रे द्वादशको दमः
verses.transliteration: pa~nchAshadbrAhmaNo daNDyaH kShatriyasyAbhisha.nsane | vaishye syAdardhapa~nchAshatshUdre dvAdashako damaH
verses.translation: A Brahmana shall be fined fifty (panas) for defaming a Kshatriya; in (the case of) a Vaisya the fine shall be twenty-five (panas); in (the case of) a Sudra twelve.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: समवर्णे द्विजातीनां द्वादशैव व्यतिक्रमे । वादेष्ववचनीयेषु तदेव द्विगुणं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: samavarNe dvijAtInAM dvAdashaiva vyatikrame | vAdeShvavachanIyeShu tadeva dviguNaM bhavet
verses.translation: For offences of twice-born men against those of equal caste (varna, the fine shall be) also twelve (panas); for speeches which ought not to be uttered, that (and every fine shall be) double.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: एकजातिर्द्विजातींस्तु वाचा दारुणया क्षिपन् । जिह्वायाः प्राप्नुयाच्छेदं जघन्यप्रभवो हि सः
verses.transliteration: ekajAtirdvijAtI.nstu vAchA dAruNayA kShipan | jihvAyAH prApnuyAchChedaM jaghanyaprabhavo hi saH
verses.translation: A once-born man (a Sudra), who insults a twice-born man with gross invective, shall have his tongue cut out; for he is of low origin.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: नामजातिग्रहं त्वेषामभिद्रोहेण कुर्वतः । निक्षेप्योऽयोमयः शङ्कुर्ज्वलन्नास्ये दशाङ्गुलः
verses.transliteration: nAmajAtigrahaM tveShAmabhidroheNa kurvataH | nikShepyo.ayomayaH sha~NkurjvalannAsye dashA~NgulaH
verses.translation: If he mentions the names and castes (gati) of the (twice-born) with contumely, an iron nail, ten fingers long, shall be thrust red-hot into his mouth.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: धर्मोपदेशं दर्पेण विप्राणामस्य कुर्वतः । तप्तमासेचयेत्तैलं वक्त्रे श्रोत्रे च पार्थिवः
verses.transliteration: dharmopadeshaM darpeNa viprANAmasya kurvataH | taptamAsechayettailaM vaktre shrotre cha pArthivaH
verses.translation: If he arrogantly teaches Brahmanas their duty, the king shall cause hot oil to be poured into his mouth and into his ears.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: श्रौत्रे श्रुतं देशं च जातिं च कर्म शरीरमेव च । वितथेन ब्रुवन् दर्पाद्दाप्यः स्याद्द्विशतं दमम्
verses.transliteration: shrautre shrutaM deshaM cha jAtiM cha karma sharIrameva cha | vitathena bruvan darpAddApyaH syAddvishataM damam
verses.translation: He who through arrogance makes false statements regarding the learning (of a caste-fellow), his country, his caste (gati), or the rites by which his body was sanctified, shall be compelled to pay a fine of two hundred (panas).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: काणं वाऽप्यथ वा खञ्जमन्यं वाऽपि तथाविधम् । तथ्येनापि ब्रुवन् दाप्यो दण्डं कार्षापणावरम्
verses.transliteration: kANaM vA.apyatha vA kha~njamanyaM vA.api tathAvidham | tathyenApi bruvan dApyo daNDaM kArShApaNAvaram
verses.translation: He who even in accordance with the true facts (contemptuously) calls another man one-eyed, lame, or the like (names), shall be fined at least one karshapana.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: मातरं पितरं जायां भ्रातरं तनयं गुरुम् । आक्षारयंशतं दाप्यः पन्थानं चाददद्गुरोः
verses.transliteration: mAtaraM pitaraM jAyAM bhrAtaraM tanayaM gurum | AkShAraya.nshataM dApyaH panthAnaM chAdadadguroH
verses.translation: He who defames his mother, his father, his wife, his brother, his son, or his teacher, and he who gives not the way to his preceptor, shall be compelled to pay one hundred (panas).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियाभ्यां तु दण्डः कार्यो विजानता । ब्राह्मणे साहसः पूर्वः क्षत्रिये त्वेव मध्यमः
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNakShatriyAbhyAM tu daNDaH kAryo vijAnatA | brAhmaNe sAhasaH pUrvaH kShatriye tveva madhyamaH
verses.translation: (For mutual abuse) by a Brahmana and a Kshatriya a fine must be imposed by a discerning (king), on the Brahmana the lowest amercement, but on the Kshatriya the middlemost.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: विट् शूद्रयोरेवमेव स्वजातिं प्रति तत्त्वतः । छेदवर्जं प्रणयनं दण्डस्यैति विनिश्चयः
verses.transliteration: viT shUdrayorevameva svajAtiM prati tattvataH | ChedavarjaM praNayanaM daNDasyaiti vinishchayaH
verses.translation: A Vaisya and a Sudra must be punished exactly in the same manner according to their respective castes, but the tongue (of the Sudra) shall not be cut out; that is the decision.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: एष दण्डविधिः प्रोक्तो वाक्पारुष्यस्य तत्त्वतः । अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि दण्डपारुष्यनिर्णयम्
verses.transliteration: eSha daNDavidhiH prokto vAkpAruShyasya tattvataH | ata UrdhvaM pravakShyAmi daNDapAruShyanirNayam
verses.translation: Thus the rules for punishments (applicable to cases) of defamation have been truly declared; I will next propound the decision (of cases) of assault.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: येन केन चिदङ्गेन हिंस्याच्चेत्श्रेष्ठमन्त्यजः । छेत्तव्यं तद्तदेवास्य तन् मनोरनुशासनम्
verses.transliteration: yena kena chida~Ngena hi.nsyAchchetshreShThamantyajaH | ChettavyaM tadtadevAsya tan manoranushAsanam
verses.translation: With whatever limb a man of a low caste does hurt to (a man of the three) highest (castes), even that limb shall be cut off; that is the teaching of Manu.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: बालदायादिकं रिक्थं तावद्राजाऽनुपालयेत् । यावत्स स्यात्समावृत्तो यावत्चातीतशैशवः ॥ यावद्वाऽतीतशैशवः ८.२७॥ वशाऽपुत्रासु चैवं स्याद्रक्षणं निष्कुलासु च । पतिव्रतासु च स्त्रीषु विधवास्वातुरासु च
verses.transliteration: bAladAyAdikaM rikthaM tAvadrAjA.anupAlayet | yAvatsa syAtsamAvR^itto yAvatchAtItashaishavaH || yAvadvA.atItashaishavaH 8\.27|| vashA.aputrAsu chaivaM syAdrakShaNaM niShkulAsu cha | pativratAsu cha strIShu vidhavAsvAturAsu cha
verses.translation: In like manner care must be taken of barren women, of those who have no sons, of those whose family is extinct, of wives and widows faithful to their lords, and of women afflicted with diseases.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: पाणिमुद्यम्य दण्डं वा पाणिच्छेदनमर्हति । पादेन प्रहरन् कोपात्पादच्छेदनमर्हति
verses.transliteration: pANimudyamya daNDaM vA pANichChedanamarhati | pAdena praharan kopAtpAdachChedanamarhati
verses.translation: He who raises his hand or a stick, shall have his hand cut off; he who in anger kicks with his foot, shall have his foot cut off.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सहासनमभिप्रेप्सुरुत्कृष्टस्यापकृष्टजः । कट्यां कृताङ्को निर्वास्यः स्फिचं वाऽस्यावकर्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: sahAsanamabhiprepsurutkR^iShTasyApakR^iShTajaH | kaTyAM kR^itA~Nko nirvAsyaH sphichaM vA.asyAvakartayet
verses.translation: A low-caste man who tries to place himself on the same seat with a man of a high caste, shall be branded on his hip and be banished, or (the king) shall cause his buttock to be gashed.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अवनिष्ठीवतो दर्पाद्द्वावोष्ठौ छेदयेन्नृपः । अवमूत्रयतो मेढ्रमवशर्धयतो गुदम्
verses.transliteration: avaniShThIvato darpAddvAvoShThau ChedayennR^ipaH | avamUtrayato meDhramavashardhayato gudam
verses.translation: If out of arrogance he spits (on a superior), the king shall cause both his lips to be cut off; if he urines (on him), the penis; if he breaks wind (against him), the anus.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: केशेषु गृह्णतो हस्तौ छेदयेदविचारयन् । पादयोर्दाढिकायां च ग्रीवायां वृषणेषु च
verses.transliteration: kesheShu gR^ihNato hastau ChedayedavichArayan | pAdayordADhikAyAM cha grIvAyAM vR^iShaNeShu cha
verses.translation: If he lays hold of the hair (of a superior), let the (king) unhesitatingly cut off his hands, likewise (if he takes him) by the feet, the beard, the neck, or the scrotum.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: त्वग्भेदकः शतं दण्ड्यो लोहितस्य च दर्शकः । मांसभेत्ता तु षण्निष्कान् प्रवास्यस्त्वस्थिभेदकः
verses.transliteration: tvagbhedakaH shataM daNDyo lohitasya cha darshakaH | mA.nsabhettA tu ShaNniShkAn pravAsyastvasthibhedakaH
verses.translation: He who breaks the skin (of an equal) or fetches blood (from him) shall be fined one hundred (panas), he who cuts a muscle six nishkas, he who breaks a bone shall be banished.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: वनस्पतीनां सर्वेषामुपभोगो यथा यथा । यथा तथा दमः कार्यो हिंसायामिति धारणा
verses.transliteration: vanaspatInAM sarveShAmupabhogo yathA yathA | yathA tathA damaH kAryo hi.nsAyAmiti dhAraNA
verses.translation: According to the usefulness of the several (kinds of) trees a fine must be inflicted for injuring them; that is the settled rule.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: मनुष्याणां पशूनां च दुःखाय प्रहृते सति । यथा यथा महद्दुःखं दण्डं कुर्यात्तथा तथा
verses.transliteration: manuShyANAM pashUnAM cha duHkhAya prahR^ite sati | yathA yathA mahadduHkhaM daNDaM kuryAttathA tathA
verses.translation: If a blow is struck against men or animals in order to (give them) pain, (the judge) shall inflict a fine in proportion to the amount of pain (caused).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गावपीडनायां च व्रणशोणितयोस्तथा । प्राणशोनितयोः समुत्थानव्ययं दाप्यः सर्वदण्डमथापि वा
verses.transliteration: a~NgAvapIDanAyAM cha vraNashoNitayostathA | prANashonitayoH samutthAnavyayaM dApyaH sarvadaNDamathApi vA
verses.translation: If a limb is injured, a wound (is caused), or blood (flows, the assailant) shall be made to pay (to the sufferer) the expenses of the cure, or the whole (both the usual amercement and the expenses of the cure as a) fine (to the king).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: द्रव्याणि हिंस्याद्यो यस्य ज्ञानतोऽज्ञानतोऽपि वा । स तस्योत्पादयेत्तुष्टिं राज्ञे दद्याच्च तत्समम्
verses.transliteration: dravyANi hi.nsyAdyo yasya j~nAnato.aj~nAnato.api vA | sa tasyotpAdayettuShTiM rAj~ne dadyAchcha tatsamam
verses.translation: He who damages the goods of another, be it intentionally or unintentionally, shall give satisfaction to the (owner) and pay to the king a fine equal to the (damage).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: चर्मचार्मिकभाण्डेषु काष्ठलोष्टमयेषु । मूल्यात्पञ्चगुणो दण्डः पुष्पमूलफलेषु च
verses.transliteration: charmachArmikabhANDeShu kAShThaloShTamayeShu | mUlyAtpa~nchaguNo daNDaH puShpamUlaphaleShu cha
verses.translation: In the case of (damage done to) leather, or to utensils of leather, of wood, or of clay, the fine (shall be) five times their value; likewise in the case of (damage to) flowers, roots, and fruit.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: जीवन्तीनां तु तासां ये तधरेयुः स्वबान्धवाः । तांशिष्यात्चौरदण्डेन धार्मिकः पृथिवीपतिः
verses.transliteration: jIvantInAM tu tAsAM ye tadhareyuH svabAndhavAH | tA.nshiShyAtchauradaNDena dhArmikaH pR^ithivIpatiH
verses.translation: A righteous king must punish like thieves those relatives who appropriate the property of such females during their lifetime.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यानस्य चैव यातुश्च यानस्वामिन एव च । दशातिवर्तनान्याहुः शेषे दण्डो विधीयते
verses.transliteration: yAnasya chaiva yAtushcha yAnasvAmina eva cha | dashAtivartanAnyAhuH sheShe daNDo vidhIyate
verses.translation: They declare with respect to a carriage, its driver and its owner, (that there are) ten cases in which no punishment (for damage done) can be inflicted; in other cases a fine is prescribed.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: छिन्ननास्ये भग्नयुगे तिर्यक्प्रतिमुखागते । अक्षभङ्गे च यानस्य चक्रभङ्गे तथैव च
verses.transliteration: ChinnanAsye bhagnayuge tiryakpratimukhAgate | akShabha~Nge cha yAnasya chakrabha~Nge tathaiva cha
verses.translation: When the nose-string is snapped, when the yoke is broken, when the carriage turns sideways or back, when the axle or a wheel is broken,
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: छेदने चैव यन्त्राणां योक्त्ररश्म्योस्तथैव च । आक्रन्दे चाप्यपैहीति न दण्डं मनुरब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: Chedane chaiva yantrANAM yoktrarashmyostathaiva cha | Akrande chApyapaihIti na daNDaM manurabravIt
verses.translation: When the leather-thongs, the rope around the neck or the bridle are broken, and when (the driver) has loudly called out, 'Make way,' Manu has declared (that in all these cases) no punishment (shall be inflicted).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यत्रापवर्तते युग्यं वैगुण्यात्प्राजकस्य तु । तत्र स्वामी भवेद्दण्ड्यो हिंसायां द्विशतं दमम्
verses.transliteration: yatrApavartate yugyaM vaiguNyAtprAjakasya tu | tatra svAmI bhaveddaNDyo hi.nsAyAM dvishataM damam
verses.translation: But if the cart turns off (the road) through the driver's want of skill, the owner shall be fined, if damage (is done), two hundred (panas).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: प्राजकश्चेद्भवेदाप्तः प्राजको दण्डमर्हति । युग्यस्थाः प्राजकेऽनाप्ते सर्वे दण्ड्याः शतं शतम्
verses.transliteration: prAjakashchedbhavedAptaH prAjako daNDamarhati | yugyasthAH prAjake.anApte sarve daNDyAH shataM shatam
verses.translation: If the driver is skilful (but negligent), he alone shall be fined; if the driver is unskilful, the occupants of the carriage (also) shall be each fined one hundred (panas).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: स चेत्तु पथि संरुद्धः पशुभिर्वा रथेन वा । प्रमापयेत्प्राणभृतस्तत्र दण्डोऽविचारितः
verses.transliteration: sa chettu pathi sa.nruddhaH pashubhirvA rathena vA | pramApayetprANabhR^itastatra daNDo.avichAritaH
verses.translation: But if he is stopped on his way by cattle or by (another) carriage, and he causes the death of any living being, a fine shall without doubt be imposed.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: मनुष्यमारणे क्षिप्रं चौरवत्किल्बिषं भवेत् । प्राणभृत्सु महत्स्वर्धं गोगजोष्ट्रहयादिषु
verses.transliteration: manuShyamAraNe kShipraM chauravatkilbiShaM bhavet | prANabhR^itsu mahatsvardhaM gogajoShTrahayAdiShu
verses.translation: If a man is killed, his guilt will be at once the same as (that of) a thief; for large animals such as cows, elephants, camels or horses, half of that.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: क्षुद्रकाणां पशूनां तु हिंसायां द्विशतो दमः । पञ्चाशत्तु भवेद्दण्डः शुभेषु मृगपक्षिषु
verses.transliteration: kShudrakANAM pashUnAM tu hi.nsAyAM dvishato damaH | pa~nchAshattu bhaveddaNDaH shubheShu mR^igapakShiShu
verses.translation: For injuring small cattle the fine (shall be) two hundred (panas); the fine for beautiful wild quadrupeds and birds shall amount to fifty (panas).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: गर्धभाजाविकानां तु दण्डः स्यात्पञ्चमाषिकः । पाञ्चमाषिकः माषिकस्तु भवेद्दण्डः श्वसूकरनिपातने
verses.transliteration: gardhabhAjAvikAnAM tu daNDaH syAtpa~nchamAShikaH | pA~nchamAShikaH mAShikastu bhaveddaNDaH shvasUkaranipAtane
verses.translation: For donkeys, sheep, and goats the fine shall be five mashas; but the punishment for killing a dog or a pig shall be one masha.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: भार्या पुत्रश्च दासश्च प्रेष्यो भ्रात्रा च सौदरः । प्राप्तापराधास्ताड्याः स्यू रज्ज्वा वेणुदलेन वा
verses.transliteration: bhAryA putrashcha dAsashcha preShyo bhrAtrA cha saudaraH | prAptAparAdhAstADyAH syU rajjvA veNudalena vA
verses.translation: A wife, a son, a slave, a pupil, and a (younger) brother of the full blood, who have committed faults, may be beaten with a rope or a split bamboo,
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यहं देशदृष्टैश्च शास्त्रदृष्टैश्च हेतुभिः । अष्टादशसु मार्गेषु निबद्धानि पृथक्पृथक्
verses.transliteration: pratyahaM deshadR^iShTaishcha shAstradR^iShTaishcha hetubhiH | aShTAdashasu mArgeShu nibaddhAni pR^ithakpR^ithak
verses.translation: Daily (deciding) one after another (all cases) which fall under the eighteen titles (of the law) according to principles drawn from local usages. and from the Institutes of the sacred law.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: प्रणष्टस्वामिकं रिक्थं राजा त्र्यब्दं निधापयेत् । अर्वाक्त्र्यब्दाद्धरेत्स्वामी परेण नृपतिर्हरेत्
verses.transliteration: praNaShTasvAmikaM rikthaM rAjA tryabdaM nidhApayet | arvAktryabdAddharetsvAmI pareNa nR^ipatirharet
verses.translation: Property, the owner of which has disappeared, the king shall cause to be kept as a deposit during three years; within the period of three years the owner may claim it, after (that term) the king may take it.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: पृष्ठतस्तु शरीरस्य नोत्तमाङ्गे कथं चन । अतोऽन्यथा तु प्रहरन् प्राप्तः स्याच्चौरकिल्बिषम्
verses.transliteration: pR^iShThatastu sharIrasya nottamA~Nge kathaM chana | ato.anyathA tu praharan prAptaH syAchchaurakilbiSham
verses.translation: But on the back part of the body (only), never on a noble part; he who strikes them otherwise will incur the same guilt as a thief.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: एषोऽखिलेनाभिहितो दण्डपारुष्यनिर्णयः । स्तेनस्यातः प्रवक्ष्यामि विधिं दण्डविनिर्णये
verses.transliteration: eSho.akhilenAbhihito daNDapAruShyanirNayaH | stenasyAtaH pravakShyAmi vidhiM daNDavinirNaye
verses.translation: Thus the whole law of assault (and hurt) has been declared completely; I will now explain the rules for the decision (in cases) of theft.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: परमं यत्नमातिष्ठेत्स्तेनानां निग्रहे नृपः । स्तेनानां निग्रहादस्य यशो राष्ट्रं च वर्धते
verses.transliteration: paramaM yatnamAtiShThetstenAnAM nigrahe nR^ipaH | stenAnAM nigrahAdasya yasho rAShTraM cha vardhate
verses.translation: Let the king exert himself to the utmost to punish thieves; for, if he punishes thieves, his fame grows and his kingdom prospers.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अभयस्य हि यो दाता स पूज्यः सततं नृपः । सत्त्रं हि वर्धते तस्य सदैवाभयदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: abhayasya hi yo dAtA sa pUjyaH satataM nR^ipaH | sattraM hi vardhate tasya sadaivAbhayadakShiNam
verses.translation: That king, indeed, is ever worthy of honour who ensures the safety (of his subjects); for the sacrificial session (sattra, which he, as it were, performs thereby) ever grows in length, the safety (of his subjects representing) the sacrificial fee.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतो धर्मषड्भागो राज्ञो भवति रक्षतः । अधर्मादपि षड्भागो भवत्यस्य ह्यरक्षतः
verses.transliteration: sarvato dharmaShaDbhAgo rAj~no bhavati rakShataH | adharmAdapi ShaDbhAgo bhavatyasya hyarakShataH
verses.translation: A king who (duly) protects (his subjects) receives from each and all the sixth part of their spiritual merit; if he does not protect them, the sixth part of their demerit also (will fall on him).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यदधीते यद्यजते यद्ददाति यदर्चति । तस्य षड्भागभाग्राजा सम्यग्भवति रक्षणात्
verses.transliteration: yadadhIte yadyajate yaddadAti yadarchati | tasya ShaDbhAgabhAgrAjA samyagbhavati rakShaNAt
verses.translation: Whatever (merit a man gains by) reading the Veda, by sacrificing, by charitable gifts, (or by) worshipping (Gurus and gods), the king obtains a sixth part of that in consequence of his duly protecting (his kingdom).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: रक्षन् धर्मेण भूतानि राजा वध्यांश्च घातयन् । यजतेऽहरहर्यज्ञैः सहस्रशतदक्षिणैः
verses.transliteration: rakShan dharmeNa bhUtAni rAjA vadhyA.nshcha ghAtayan | yajate.aharaharyaj~naiH sahasrashatadakShiNaiH
verses.translation: A king who protects the created beings in accordance with the sacred law and smites those worthy of corporal punishment, daily offers (as it were) sacrifices at which hundred thousands (are given as) fees.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: योऽरक्षन् बलिमादत्ते करं शुल्कं च पार्थिवः । प्रतिभागं च दण्डं च स सद्यो नरकं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: yo.arakShan balimAdatte karaM shulkaM cha pArthivaH | pratibhAgaM cha daNDaM cha sa sadyo narakaM vrajet
verses.translation: A king who does not afford protection, (yet) takes his share in kind, his taxes, tolls and duties, daily presents and fines, will (after death) soon sink into hell.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अरक्षितारं राजानं बलिषड्भागहारिणम् । अरक्षितारमत्तारं तमाहुः सर्वलोकस्य समग्रमलहारकम्
verses.transliteration: arakShitAraM rAjAnaM baliShaDbhAgahAriNam | arakShitAramattAraM tamAhuH sarvalokasya samagramalahArakam
verses.translation: They declare that a king who affords no protection, (yet) receives the sixth part of the produce, takes upon himself all the foulness of his whole people.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अनपेक्षितमर्यादं नास्तिकं विप्रलुम्पकम् । अनवेक्षितमर्यादं अरक्षितारमत्तारं नृपं विद्यादधोगतिम्
verses.transliteration: anapekShitamaryAdaM nAstikaM vipralumpakam | anavekShitamaryAdaM arakShitAramattAraM nR^ipaM vidyAdadhogatim
verses.translation: Know that a king who heeds not the rules (of the law), who is an atheist, and rapacious, who does not protect (his subjects, but) devours them, will sink low (after death).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: ममैदमिति यो ब्रूयात्सोऽनुयोज्यो यथाविधि । संवाद्य रूपसङ्ख्यादीन् स्वामी तद्द्रव्यमर्हति
verses.transliteration: mamaidamiti yo brUyAtso.anuyojyo yathAvidhi | sa.nvAdya rUpasa~NkhyAdIn svAmI taddravyamarhati
verses.translation: He who says, 'This belongs to me,' must be examined according to the rule; if he accurately describes the shape, and the number (of the articles found) and so forth, (he is) the owner, (and) ought (to receive) that property.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अधार्मिकं त्रिभिर्न्यायैर्निगृह्णीयात्प्रयत्नतः । निरोधनेन बन्धेन विविधेन वधेन च
verses.transliteration: adhArmikaM tribhirnyAyairnigR^ihNIyAtprayatnataH | nirodhanena bandhena vividhena vadhena cha
verses.translation: Let him carefully restrain the wicked by three methods,- by imprisonment by putting them in fetters, and by various (kinds of) corporal punishments.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: निग्रहेण हि पापानां साधूनां सङ्ग्रहेण च । द्विजातय इवैज्याभिः पूयन्ते सततं नृपाः
verses.transliteration: nigraheNa hi pApAnAM sAdhUnAM sa~NgraheNa cha | dvijAtaya ivaijyAbhiH pUyante satataM nR^ipAH
verses.translation: For by punishing the wicked and by favouring the virtuous, kings are constantly sanctified, just as twice-born men by sacrifices.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: क्षन्तव्यं प्रभुणा नित्यं क्षिपतां कार्यिणां नृणाम् । बालवृद्धातुराणां च कुर्वता हितमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: kShantavyaM prabhuNA nityaM kShipatAM kAryiNAM nR^iNAm | bAlavR^iddhAturANAM cha kurvatA hitamAtmanaH
verses.translation: A king who desires his own welfare must always forgive litigants, infants, aged and sick men, who inveigh against him.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यः क्षिप्तो मर्षयत्यार्तैस्तेन स्वर्गे महीयते । यस्त्वैश्वर्यान्न क्षमते नरकं तेन गच्छति
verses.transliteration: yaH kShipto marShayatyArtaistena svarge mahIyate | yastvaishvaryAnna kShamate narakaM tena gachChati
verses.translation: He who, being abused by men in pain, pardons (them), will in reward of that (act) be exalted in heaven; but he who, (proud) of his kingly state, forgives them not, will for that (reason) sink into hell.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: राजा स्तेनेन गन्तव्यो मुक्तकेशेन धावता । धीमता आचक्षाणेन तत्स्तेयमेवङ्कर्माऽस्मि शाधि माम्
verses.transliteration: rAjA stenena gantavyo muktakeshena dhAvatA | dhImatA AchakShANena tatsteyameva~NkarmA.asmi shAdhi mAm
verses.translation: A thief shall, running, approach the king, with flying hair, confessing that theft (and saying), 'Thus have I done, punish me;'
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: स्कन्धेनादाय मुसलं लगुडं वाऽपि खादिरम् । मुशलं शक्तिं चोभयतस्तीक्ष्णामायसं दण्डमेव वा
verses.transliteration: skandhenAdAya musalaM laguDaM vA.api khAdiram | mushalaM shaktiM chobhayatastIkShNAmAyasaM daNDameva vA
verses.translation: (And he must) carry on his shoulder a pestle, or a club of Khadira wood, or a spear sharp at both ends, or an iron staff.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: शासनाद्वा विमोक्षाद्वा स्तेनः स्तेयाद्विमुच्यते । अशासित्वा तु तं राजा स्तेनस्याप्नोति किल्बिषम्
verses.transliteration: shAsanAdvA vimokShAdvA stenaH steyAdvimuchyate | ashAsitvA tu taM rAjA stenasyApnoti kilbiSham
verses.translation: Whether he be punished or pardoned, the thief is freed from the (guilt of) theft; but the king, if he punishes not, takes upon himself the guilt of the thief.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अन्नादे भ्रूणहा मार्ष्टि पत्यौ भार्याऽपचारिणी । गुरौ शिष्यश्च याज्यश्च स्तेनो राजनि किल्बिषम्
verses.transliteration: annAde bhrUNahA mArShTi patyau bhAryA.apachAriNI | gurau shiShyashcha yAjyashcha steno rAjani kilbiSham
verses.translation: The killer of a learned Brahmana throws his guilt on him who eats his food, an adulterous wife on her (negligent) husband, a (sinning) pupil or sacrificer on (their negligent) teacher (or priest), a thief on the king (who pardons him).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: राजभिः कृतदण्डास्तु कृत्वा पापानि मानवाः । राजभिर्धृतदण्डास्तु निर्मलाः स्वर्गमायान्ति सन्तः सुकृतिनो यथा
verses.transliteration: rAjabhiH kR^itadaNDAstu kR^itvA pApAni mAnavAH | rAjabhirdhR^itadaNDAstu nirmalAH svargamAyAnti santaH sukR^itino yathA
verses.translation: But men who have committed crimes and have been punished by the king, go to heaven, being pure like those who performed meritorious deeds.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु रज्जुं घटं कूपाद्धरेद्भिन्द्याच्च यः प्रपाम् । स दण्डं प्राप्नुयान् माषं तच्च तस्मिन् समाहरेत्
verses.transliteration: yastu rajjuM ghaTaM kUpAddharedbhindyAchcha yaH prapAm | sa daNDaM prApnuyAn mAShaM tachcha tasmin samAharet
verses.translation: He who steals the rope or the water-pot from a well, or damages a hut where water is distributed, shall pay one masha as a fine and restore the (article abstracted or damaged) in its (proper place).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अवेदयानो नष्टस्य देशं कालं च तत्त्वतः । वर्णं रूपं प्रमाणं च तत्समं दण्डमर्हति
verses.transliteration: avedayAno naShTasya deshaM kAlaM cha tattvataH | varNaM rUpaM pramANaM cha tatsamaM daNDamarhati
verses.translation: But if he does not really know the time and the place (where it was) lost, its colour, shape, and size, he is worthy of a fine equal (in value) to the (object claimed).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: धान्यं दशभ्यः कुम्भेभ्यो हरतोऽभ्यधिकं वधः । शेषेऽप्येकादशगुणं दाप्यस्तस्य च तद्धनम्
verses.transliteration: dhAnyaM dashabhyaH kumbhebhyo harato.abhyadhikaM vadhaH | sheShe.apyekAdashaguNaM dApyastasya cha taddhanam
verses.translation: On him who steals more than ten kumbhas of grain corporal punishment (shall be inflicted); in other cases he shall be fined eleven times as much, and shall pay to the (owner the value of his) property.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: तथा धरिममेयानां शतादभ्यधिके वधः । सुवर्णरजतादीनामुत्तमानां च वाससाम्
verses.transliteration: tathA dharimameyAnAM shatAdabhyadhike vadhaH | suvarNarajatAdInAmuttamAnAM cha vAsasAm
verses.translation: So shall corporal punishment be inflicted for stealing more than a hundred (palas) of articles sold by the weight, (i.e.) of gold, silver, and so forth, and of most excellent clothes.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाशतस्त्वभ्यधिके हस्तच्छेदनमिष्यते । शेषे त्वेकादशगुणं मूल्याद्दण्डं प्रकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: pa~nchAshatastvabhyadhike hastachChedanamiShyate | sheShe tvekAdashaguNaM mUlyAddaNDaM prakalpayet
verses.translation: For (stealing) more than fifty (palas) it is enacted that the hands (of the offender) shall be cut off; but in other cases, let him inflict a fine of eleven times the value.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषाणां कुलीनानां नारीणां च विशेषतः । मुख्यानां चैव रत्नानां हरणे वधमर्हति
verses.transliteration: puruShANAM kulInAnAM nArINAM cha visheShataH | mukhyAnAM chaiva ratnAnAM haraNe vadhamarhati
verses.translation: For stealing men of noble family and especially women and the most precious gems, (the offender) deserves corporal (or capital) punishment.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: महापशूनां हरणे शस्त्राणामौषधस्य च । कालमासाद्य कार्यं च दण्डं राजा प्रकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: mahApashUnAM haraNe shastrANAmauShadhasya cha | kAlamAsAdya kAryaM cha daNDaM rAjA prakalpayet
verses.translation: For stealing large animals, weapons, or medicines, let the king fix a punishment, after considering the time and the purpose (for which they were destined).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: गोषु ब्राह्मणसंस्थासु छुरिकायाश्च भेदने । खरिकायाश्च पशूनां हरणे चैव सद्यः कार्योऽर्धपादिकः
verses.transliteration: goShu brAhmaNasa.nsthAsu ChurikAyAshcha bhedane | kharikAyAshcha pashUnAM haraNe chaiva sadyaH kAryo.ardhapAdikaH
verses.translation: For (stealing) cows belonging to Brahmanas, piercing (the nostrils of) a barren cow, and for stealing (other) cattle (belonging to Brahmanas, the offender) shall forthwith lose half his feet.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सूत्रकार्पासकिण्वानां गोमयस्य गुडस्य च । दध्नः क्षीरस्य तक्रस्य पानीयस्य तृणस्य च
verses.transliteration: sUtrakArpAsakiNvAnAM gomayasya guDasya cha | dadhnaH kShIrasya takrasya pAnIyasya tR^iNasya cha
verses.translation: (For stealing) thread, cotton, drugs causing fermentation, cowdung, molasses, sour milk, sweet milk, butter-milk, water, or grass,
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: वेणुवैदलभाण्डानां लवणानां तथैव च । मृण्मयानां च हरणे मृदो भस्मन एव च
verses.transliteration: veNuvaidalabhANDAnAM lavaNAnAM tathaiva cha | mR^iNmayAnAM cha haraNe mR^ido bhasmana eva cha
verses.translation: Vessels made of bamboo or other cane, salt of various kinds, earthen (vessels), earth and ashes,
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्यानां पक्षिणां चैव तैलस्य च घृतस्य च । मांसस्य मधुनश्चैव यच्चान्यत्पशुसम्भवम्
verses.transliteration: matsyAnAM pakShiNAM chaiva tailasya cha ghR^itasya cha | mA.nsasya madhunashchaiva yachchAnyatpashusambhavam
verses.translation: Fish, birds, oil, clarified butter, meat, honey, and other things that come from beasts,
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अन्येषां चैवमादीनां मद्यानामोदनस्य च । चैवमादीनामद्यानाम् पक्वान्नानां च सर्वेषां तन्मुल्याद्द्विगुणो दमः
verses.transliteration: anyeShAM chaivamAdInAM madyAnAmodanasya cha | chaivamAdInAmadyAnAm pakvAnnAnAM cha sarveShAM tanmulyAddviguNo damaH
verses.translation: Or other things of a similar kind, spirituous liquor, boiled rice, and every kind of cooked food, the fine (shall be) twice the value (of the stolen article).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: आददीताथ षड्भागं प्रनष्टाधिगतान्नृपः । दशमं द्वादशं वाऽपि सतां धर्ममनुस्मरन्
verses.transliteration: AdadItAtha ShaDbhAgaM pranaShTAdhigatAnnR^ipaH | dashamaM dvAdashaM vA.api satAM dharmamanusmaran
verses.translation: Now the king, remembering the duty of good men, may take one-sixth part of property lost and afterwards found, or one-tenth, or at least one-twelfth.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पेषु हरिते धान्ये गुल्मवल्लीनगेषु च । अन्येष्वपरिपूतेषु दण्डः स्यात्पञ्चकृष्णलः
verses.transliteration: puShpeShu harite dhAnye gulmavallInageShu cha | anyeShvaparipUteShu daNDaH syAtpa~nchakR^iShNalaH
verses.translation: For flowers, green corn, shrubs, creepers, trees, and other unhusked (grain) the fine (shall be) five krishnalas.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: परिपूतेषु धान्येषु शाकमूलफलेषु च । निरन्वये शतं दण्डः सान्वयेऽर्धशतं दमः
verses.transliteration: paripUteShu dhAnyeShu shAkamUlaphaleShu cha | niranvaye shataM daNDaH sAnvaye.ardhashataM damaH
verses.translation: For husked grain, vegetables, roots, and fruit the fine (shall be) one hundred (panas) if there is no connexion (between the owner and the thief), fifty (panas) if such a connexion exists.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: स्यात्साहसं त्वन्वयवत्प्रसभं कर्म यत्कृतम् । निरन्वयं भवेत्स्तेयं हृत्वाऽपव्ययते च यत्
verses.transliteration: syAtsAhasaM tvanvayavatprasabhaM karma yatkR^itam | niranvayaM bhavetsteyaM hR^itvA.apavyayate cha yat
verses.translation: An offence (of this description), which is committed in the presence (of the owner) and with violence, will be robbery; if (it is committed) in his absence, it will be theft; likewise if (the possession of) anything is denied after it has been taken.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्वेतान्युपकॢप्तानि द्रव्याणि स्तेनयेन्नरः । तमाद्यं दण्डयेद्राजा यश्चाग्निं चोरयेद्गृहात्
verses.transliteration: yastvetAnyupakL^iptAni dravyANi stenayennaraH | tamAdyaM daNDayedrAjA yashchAgniM chorayedgR^ihAt
verses.translation: On that man who may steal (any of) the above-mentioned articles, when they are prepared for (use), let the king inflict the first (or lowest) amercement; likewise on him who may steal (a sacred) fire out of the room (in which it is kept).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: तं शतं येन येन यथाङ्गेन स्तेनो नृषु विचेष्टते । तत्तदेव हरेत्तस्य प्रत्यादेशाय पार्थिवः
verses.transliteration: taM shataM yena yena yathA~Ngena steno nR^iShu vicheShTate | tattadeva harettasya pratyAdeshAya pArthivaH
verses.translation: With whatever limb a thief in any way commits (an offence) against men, even of that (the king) shall deprive him in order to prevent (a repetition of the crime).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: पिताऽचार्यः सुहृत्माता भार्या पुत्रः पुरोहितः । नादण्ड्यो नाम राज्ञोऽस्ति यः स्वधर्मे न तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: pitA.achAryaH suhR^itmAtA bhAryA putraH purohitaH | nAdaNDyo nAma rAj~no.asti yaH svadharme na tiShThati
verses.translation: Neither a father, nor a teacher, nor a friend, nor a mother, nor a wife, nor a son, nor a domestic priest must be left unpunished by a king, if they do not keep within their duty.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: कार्षापणं भवेद्दण्ड्यो यत्रान्यः प्राकृतो जनः । तत्र राजा भवेद्दण्ड्यः सहस्रमिति धारणा
verses.transliteration: kArShApaNaM bhaveddaNDyo yatrAnyaH prAkR^ito janaH | tatra rAjA bhaveddaNDyaH sahasramiti dhAraNA
verses.translation: Where another common man would be fined one karshapana, the king shall be fined one thousand; that is the settled rule.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अष्टापाद्यं तु शूद्रस्य स्तेये भवति किल्बिषम् । षोडशैव तु वैश्यस्य द्वात्रिंशत्क्षत्रियस्य च
verses.transliteration: aShTApAdyaM tu shUdrasya steye bhavati kilbiSham | ShoDashaiva tu vaishyasya dvAtri.nshatkShatriyasya cha
verses.translation: In (a case of) theft the guilt of a Sudra shall be eightfold, that of a Vaisya sixteenfold, that of a Kshatriya two-and-thirtyfold,
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणस्य चतुःषष्टिः पूर्णं वाऽपि शतं भवेत् । द्विगुणा वा चतुःषष्टिस्तद्दोषगुणविद्धि सः
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNasya chatuHShaShTiH pUrNaM vA.api shataM bhavet | dviguNA vA chatuHShaShTistaddoShaguNaviddhi saH
verses.translation: That of a Brahmana sixty-fourfold, or quite a hundredfold, or (even) twice four-and-sixtyfold; (each of them) knowing the nature of the offence.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: वानस्पत्यं मूलफलं दार्वग्न्यर्थं तथैव च । तृणं च गोभ्यो ग्रासार्थमस्तेयं मनुरब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: vAnaspatyaM mUlaphalaM dArvagnyarthaM tathaiva cha | tR^iNaM cha gobhyo grAsArthamasteyaM manurabravIt
verses.translation: (The taking of) roots and of fruit from trees, of wood for a (sacrificial) fire, and of grass for feeding cows, Manu has declared (to be) no theft.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: प्रणष्टाधिगतं द्रव्यं तिष्ठेद्युक्तैरधिष्ठितम् । यांस्तत्र चौरान् गृह्णीयात्तान् राजैभेन घातयेत्
verses.transliteration: praNaShTAdhigataM dravyaM tiShThedyuktairadhiShThitam | yA.nstatra chaurAn gR^ihNIyAttAn rAjaibhena ghAtayet
verses.translation: Property lost and afterwards found (by the king's servants) shall remain in the keeping of (special) officials; those whom the king may convict of stealing it, he shall cause to be slain by an elephant.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: योऽदत्तादायिनो हस्तात्लिप्सेत ब्राह्मणो धनम् । याजनाध्यापनेनापि यथा स्तेनस्तथैव सः
verses.transliteration: yo.adattAdAyino hastAtlipseta brAhmaNo dhanam | yAjanAdhyApanenApi yathA stenastathaiva saH
verses.translation: A Brahmana, seeking to obtain property from a man who took what was not given to him, either by sacrificing for him or by teaching him, is even like a thief.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: द्विजोऽध्वगः क्षीणवृत्तिर्द्वाविक्षू द्वे च मूलके । आददानः परक्षेत्रात्न दण्डं दातुमर्हति
verses.transliteration: dvijo.adhvagaH kShINavR^ittirdvAvikShU dve cha mUlake | AdadAnaH parakShetrAtna daNDaM dAtumarhati
verses.translation: A twice-born man, who is travelling and whose provisions are exhausted, shall not be fined, if he takes two stalks of sugar-cane or two (esculent) roots from the field of another man.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: असंदितानां संदाता संदितानां च मोक्षकः । दासाश्वरथहर्ता च प्राप्तः स्याच्चोरकिल्बिषम्
verses.transliteration: asa.nditAnAM sa.ndAtA sa.nditAnAM cha mokShakaH | dAsAshvarathahartA cha prAptaH syAchchorakilbiSham
verses.translation: He who ties up unbound or sets free tied up (cattle of other men), he who takes a slave, a horse, or a carriage will have incurred the guilt of a thief.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अनेन विधिना राजा कुर्वाणः स्तेननिग्रहम् । यशोऽस्मिन् प्राप्नुयात्लोके प्रेत्य चानुत्तमं सुखम्
verses.transliteration: anena vidhinA rAjA kurvANaH stenanigraham | yasho.asmin prApnuyAtloke pretya chAnuttamaM sukham
verses.translation: A king who punishes thieves according to these rules, will gain fame in this world and after death unsurpassable bliss.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: ऐन्द्रं स्थानमभिप्रेप्सुर्यशश्चाक्षयमव्ययम् । नोपेक्षेत क्षणमपि राजा साहसिकं नरम्
verses.transliteration: aindraM sthAnamabhiprepsuryashashchAkShayamavyayam | nopekSheta kShaNamapi rAjA sAhasikaM naram
verses.translation: A king who desires to gain the throne of Indra and imperishable eternal fame, shall not, even for a moment, neglect (to punish) the man who commits violence.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: वाग्दुष्टात्तस्कराच्चैव दण्डेनैव च हिंसतः । साहसस्य नरः कर्ता विज्ञेयः पापकृत्तमः
verses.transliteration: vAgduShTAttaskarAchchaiva daNDenaiva cha hi.nsataH | sAhasasya naraH kartA vij~neyaH pApakR^ittamaH
verses.translation: He who commits violence must be considered as the worst offender, (more wicked) than a defamer, than a thief, and than he who injures (another) with a staff.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: साहसे वर्तमानं तु यो मर्षयति पार्थिवः । स विनाशं व्रजत्याशु विद्वेषं चाधिगच्छति
verses.transliteration: sAhase vartamAnaM tu yo marShayati pArthivaH | sa vinAshaM vrajatyAshu vidveShaM chAdhigachChati
verses.translation: But that king who pardons the perpetrator of violence quickly perishes and incurs hatred.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: न मित्रकारणाद्राजा विपुलाद्वा धनागमात् । समुत्सृजेत्साहसिकान् सर्वभूतभयावहान्
verses.transliteration: na mitrakAraNAdrAjA vipulAdvA dhanAgamAt | samutsR^ijetsAhasikAn sarvabhUtabhayAvahAn
verses.translation: Neither for friendship's sake, nor for the sake of great lucre, must a king let go perpetrators of violence, who cause terror to all creatures.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: शस्त्रं द्विजातिभिर्ग्राह्यं धर्मो यत्रोपरुध्यते । द्विजातीनां च वर्णानां विप्लवे कालकारिते
verses.transliteration: shastraM dvijAtibhirgrAhyaM dharmo yatroparudhyate | dvijAtInAM cha varNAnAM viplave kAlakArite
verses.translation: Twice-born men may take up arms when (they are) hindered (in the fulfilment of their duties, when destruction (threatens) the twice-born castes (varna) in (evil) times,
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: आत्मनश्च परित्राणे दक्षिणानां च सङ्गरे । स्त्रीविप्राभ्युपपत्तौ च घ्नन् धर्मेण न दुष्यति
verses.transliteration: Atmanashcha paritrANe dakShiNAnAM cha sa~Ngare | strIviprAbhyupapattau cha ghnan dharmeNa na duShyati
verses.translation: In their own defence, in a strife for the fees of officiating priests, and in order to protect women and Brahmanas; he who (under such circumstances) kills in the cause of right, commits no sin.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: ममायमिति यो ब्रूयान्निधिं सत्येन मानवः । तस्याददीत षड्भागं राजा द्वादशमेव वा
verses.transliteration: mamAyamiti yo brUyAnnidhiM satyena mAnavaH | tasyAdadIta ShaDbhAgaM rAjA dvAdashameva vA
verses.translation: From that man who shall truly say with respect to treasure-trove, 'This belongs to me,' the king may take one-sixth or one-twelfth part.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: गुरुं वा बालवृद्धौ वा ब्राह्मणं वा बहुश्रुतम् । आततायिनमायान्तं हन्यादेवाविचारयन्
verses.transliteration: guruM vA bAlavR^iddhau vA brAhmaNaM vA bahushrutam | AtatAyinamAyAntaM hanyAdevAvichArayan
verses.translation: One may slay without hesitation an assassin who approaches (with murderous intent), whether (he be one's) teacher, a child or an aged man, or a Brahmana deeply versed in the Vedas.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: नाततायिवधे दोषो हन्तुर्भवति कश्चन । प्रकाशं वाऽप्रकाशं वा मन्युस्तं मन्युमृच्छति
verses.transliteration: nAtatAyivadhe doSho hanturbhavati kashchana | prakAshaM vA.aprakAshaM vA manyustaM manyumR^ichChati
verses.translation: By killing an assassin the slayer incurs no guilt, whether (he does it) publicly or secretly; in that case fury recoils upon fury.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: परदाराभिमर्शेषु प्रवृत्तान्नॄन् महीपतिः । उद्वेजनकरैर्दण्डैश्छिन्नयित्वा प्रवासयेत्
verses.transliteration: paradArAbhimarsheShu pravR^ittAnnR^In mahIpatiH | udvejanakarairdaNDaishChinnayitvA pravAsayet
verses.translation: Men who commit adultery with the wives of others, the king shall cause to be marked by punishments which cause terror, and afterwards banish.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: चिह्नयित्वा) तत्समुत्थो हि लोकस्य जायते वर्णसङ्करः । येन मूलहरोऽधर्मः सर्वनाशाय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: chihnayitvA) tatsamuttho hi lokasya jAyate varNasa~NkaraH | yena mUlaharo.adharmaH sarvanAshAya kalpate
verses.translation: For by (adultery) is caused a mixture of the castes (varna) among men; thence (follows) sin, which cuts up even the roots and causes the destruction of everything.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: परस्य पत्न्या पुरुषः सम्भाषां योजयन् रहः । पूर्वमाक्षारितो दोषैः प्राप्नुयात्पूर्वसाहसम्
verses.transliteration: parasya patnyA puruShaH sambhAShAM yojayan rahaH | pUrvamAkShArito doShaiH prApnuyAtpUrvasAhasam
verses.translation: A man formerly accused of (such) offences, who secretly converses with another man's wife, shall pay the first (or lowest) amercement.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्वनाक्षारितः पूर्वमभिभाषेत कारणात् । न दोषं प्राप्नुयात्किं चिन्न हि तस्य व्यतिक्रमः
verses.transliteration: yastvanAkShAritaH pUrvamabhibhASheta kAraNAt | na doShaM prApnuyAtkiM chinna hi tasya vyatikramaH
verses.translation: But a man, not before accused, who (thus) speaks with (a woman) for some (reasonable) cause, shall not incur any guilt, since in him there is no transgression.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: परस्त्रियं योऽभिवदेत्तीर्थेऽरण्ये वनेऽपि वा । नदीनां वाऽपि सम्भेदे स सङ्ग्रहणमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: parastriyaM yo.abhivadettIrthe.araNye vane.api vA | nadInAM vA.api sambhede sa sa~NgrahaNamApnuyAt
verses.translation: He who addresses the wife of another man at a Tirtha, outside the village, in a forest, or at the confluence of rivers, suffer (the punishment for) adulterous acts (samgrahana).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: उपचारक्रिया केलिः स्पर्शो भूषणवाससाम् । उपकारक्रिया सह खट्वाऽसनं चैव सर्वं सङ्ग्रहणं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: upachArakriyA keliH sparsho bhUShaNavAsasAm | upakArakriyA saha khaTvA.asanaM chaiva sarvaM sa~NgrahaNaM smR^itam
verses.translation: Offering presents (to a woman), romping (with her), touching her ornaments and dress, sitting with her on a bed, all (these acts) are considered adulterous acts (samgrahana).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रियं स्पृशेददेशे यः स्पृष्टो वा मर्षयेत्तया । परस्परस्यानुमते सर्वं सङ्ग्रहणं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: striyaM spR^ishedadeshe yaH spR^iShTo vA marShayettayA | parasparasyAnumate sarvaM sa~NgrahaNaM smR^itam
verses.translation: If one touches a woman in a place (which ought) not (to be touched) or allows (oneself to be touched in such a spot), all (such acts done) with mutual consent are declared (to be) adulterous (samgrahana).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अब्राह्मणः सङ्ग्रहणे प्राणान्तं दण्डमर्हति । चतुर्णामपि वर्णानां दारा रक्ष्यतमाः सदा
verses.transliteration: abrAhmaNaH sa~NgrahaNe prANAntaM daNDamarhati | chaturNAmapi varNAnAM dArA rakShyatamAH sadA
verses.translation: A man who is not a Brahmana ought to suffer death for adultery (samgrahana); for the wives of all the four castes even must always be carefully guarded.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अनृतं तु वदन् दण्ड्यः स्ववित्तस्यांशमष्टमम् । तस्यैव वा निधानस्य सङ्ख्ययाऽल्पीयसीं कलाम्
verses.transliteration: anR^itaM tu vadan daNDyaH svavittasyA.nshamaShTamam | tasyaiva vA nidhAnasya sa~NkhyayA.alpIyasIM kalAm
verses.translation: But he who falsely says (so), shall be fined in one-eighth of his property, or, a calculation of (the value of) the treasure having been made, in some smaller portion (of that).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: भिक्षुका बन्दिनश्चैव दीक्षिताः कारवस्तथा । सम्भाषणं सह स्त्रीभिः कुर्युरप्रतिवारिताः
verses.transliteration: bhikShukA bandinashchaiva dIkShitAH kAravastathA | sambhAShaNaM saha strIbhiH kuryuraprativAritAH
verses.translation: Mendicants, bards, men who have performed the initiatory ceremony of a Vedic sacrifice, and artisans are not prohibited from speaking to married women.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: न सम्भाषां परस्त्रीभिः प्रतिषिद्धः समाचरेत् । निषिद्धो भाषमाणस्तु सुवर्णं दण्डमर्हति
verses.transliteration: na sambhAShAM parastrIbhiH pratiShiddhaH samAcharet | niShiddho bhAShamANastu suvarNaM daNDamarhati
verses.translation: Let no man converse with the wives of others after he has been forbidden (to do so); but he who converses (with them), in spite of a prohibition, shall be fined one suvarna.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: नैष चारणदारेषु विधिर्नात्मोपजीविषु । सज्जयन्ति हि ते नारीर्निगूढाश्चारयन्ति च
verses.transliteration: naiSha chAraNadAreShu vidhirnAtmopajIviShu | sajjayanti hi te nArIrnigUDhAshchArayanti cha
verses.translation: This rule does not apply to the wives of actors and singers, nor (of) those who live on (the intrigues of) their own (wives); for such men send their wives (to others) or, concealing themselves, allow them to hold criminal intercourse.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: किं चिदेव तु दाप्यः स्यात्सम्भाषां ताभिराचरन् । प्रैष्यासु चैकभक्तासु रहः प्रव्रजितासु च
verses.transliteration: kiM chideva tu dApyaH syAtsambhAShAM tAbhirAcharan | praiShyAsu chaikabhaktAsu rahaH pravrajitAsu cha
verses.translation: Yet he who secretly converses with such women, or with female slaves kept by one (master), and with female ascetics, shall be compelled to pay a small fine.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: प्रेष्यासु योऽकामां दूषयेत्कन्यां स सद्यो वधमर्हति । सकामां दूषयंस्तुल्यो न वधं प्राप्नुयान्नरः
verses.transliteration: preShyAsu yo.akAmAM dUShayetkanyAM sa sadyo vadhamarhati | sakAmAM dUShaya.nstulyo na vadhaM prApnuyAnnaraH
verses.translation: He who violates an unwilling maiden shall instantly suffer corporal punishment; but a man who enjoys a willing maiden shall not suffer corporal punishment, if (his caste be) the same (as hers).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: कन्यां भजन्तीमुत्कृष्टं न किं चिदपि दापयेत् । जघन्यं सेवमानां तु संयतां वासयेद्गृहे
verses.transliteration: kanyAM bhajantImutkR^iShTaM na kiM chidapi dApayet | jaghanyaM sevamAnAM tu sa.nyatAM vAsayedgR^ihe
verses.translation: From a maiden who makes advances to a (man of) high (caste), he shall not take any fine; but her, who courts a (man of) low (caste), let him force to live confined in her house.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमां सेवमानस्तु जघन्यो वधमर्हति । शुल्कं दद्यात्सेवमानः समामिच्छेत्पिता यदि
verses.transliteration: uttamAM sevamAnastu jaghanyo vadhamarhati | shulkaM dadyAtsevamAnaH samAmichChetpitA yadi
verses.translation: A (man of) low (caste) who makes love to a maiden (of) the highest (caste) shall suffer corporal punishment; he who addresses a maiden (on) equal (caste) shall pay the nuptial fee, if her father desires it.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अभिषह्य तु यः कन्यां कुर्याद्दर्पेण मानवः । तस्याशु कर्त्ये अङ्गुल्यौ दण्डं चार्हति षट्शतम्
verses.transliteration: abhiShahya tu yaH kanyAM kuryAddarpeNa mAnavaH | tasyAshu kartye a~Ngulyau daNDaM chArhati ShaTshatam
