verses.translation: But if any man through insolence forcibly contaminates a maiden, two of his fingers shall be instantly cut off, and he shall pay a fine of six hundred (panas).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: कर्त्या अङ्गुल्यो सकामां दूषयंस्तुल्यो नाङ्गुलिछेदमाप्नुयात् । द्विशतं तु दमं दाप्यः प्रसङ्गविनिवृत्तये
verses.transliteration: kartyA a~Ngulyo sakAmAM dUShaya.nstulyo nA~NguliChedamApnuyAt | dvishataM tu damaM dApyaH prasa~NgavinivR^ittaye
verses.translation: A man (of) equal (caste) who defiles a willing maiden shall not suffer the amputation of his fingers, but shall pay a fine of two hundred (panas) in order to deter him from a repetition (of the offence).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: कन्यैव कन्यां या कुर्यात्तस्याः स्याद्द्विशतो दमः । शुल्कं च द्विगुणं दद्यात्शिफाश्चैवाप्नुयाद्दश
verses.transliteration: kanyaiva kanyAM yA kuryAttasyAH syAddvishato damaH | shulkaM cha dviguNaM dadyAtshiphAshchaivApnuyAddasha
verses.translation: A damsel who pollutes (another) damsel must be fined two hundred (panas), pay the double of her (nuptial) fee, and receive ten (lashes with a) rod.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: या तु कन्यां प्रकुर्यात्स्त्री सा सद्यो मौण्ड्यमर्हति । अङ्गुल्योरेव वा छेदं खरेणोद्वहनं तथा
verses.transliteration: yA tu kanyAM prakuryAtstrI sA sadyo mauNDyamarhati | a~Ngulyoreva vA ChedaM khareNodvahanaM tathA
verses.translation: But a woman who pollutes a damsel shall instantly have (her head) shaved or two fingers cut off, and be made to ride (through the town) on a donkey.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: भर्तारं लङ्घयेद्या तु स्त्री ज्ञातिगुणदर्पिता । तां श्वभिः खादयेद्राजा संस्थाने बहुसंस्थिते
verses.transliteration: bhartAraM la~NghayedyA tu strI j~nAtiguNadarpitA | tAM shvabhiH khAdayedrAjA sa.nsthAne bahusa.nsthite
verses.translation: If a wife, proud of the greatness of her relatives or (her own) excellence, violates the duty which she owes to her lord, the king shall cause her to be devoured by dogs in a place frequented by many.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: पुमांसं दाहयेत्पापं शयने तप्त आयसे । अभ्यादध्युश्च काष्ठानि तत्र दह्येत पापकृत्
verses.transliteration: pumA.nsaM dAhayetpApaM shayane tapta Ayase | abhyAdadhyushcha kAShThAni tatra dahyeta pApakR^it
verses.translation: Let him cause the male offender to be burnt on a red-hot iron bed; they shall put logs under it, (until) the sinner is burned (to death).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सराभिशस्तस्य दुष्टस्य द्विगुणो दमः । संवत्सरेऽभिशस्तस्य व्रात्यया सह संवासे चाण्डाल्या तावदेव तु
verses.transliteration: sa.nvatsarAbhishastasya duShTasya dviguNo damaH | sa.nvatsare.abhishastasya vrAtyayA saha sa.nvAse chANDAlyA tAvadeva tu
verses.translation: On a man (once) convicted, who is (again) accused within a year, a double fine (must be inflicted); even thus (must the fine be doubled) for (repeated) intercourse with a Vratya and a Kandali.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: शूद्रो गुप्तमगुप्तं वा द्वैजातं वर्णमावसन् । अगुप्तमङ्गसर्वस्वैर्गुप्तं सर्वेण हीयते
verses.transliteration: shUdro guptamaguptaM vA dvaijAtaM varNamAvasan | aguptama~NgasarvasvairguptaM sarveNa hIyate
verses.translation: A Sudra who has intercourse with a woman of a twice-born caste (varna), guarded or unguarded, (shall be punished in the following manner): if she was unguarded, he loses the part (offending) and all his property; if she was guarded, everything (even his life).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गसर्वस्वी वैश्यः सर्वस्वदण्डः स्यात्संवत्सरनिरोधतः । सहस्रं क्षत्रियो दण्ड्यो मौण्ड्यं मूत्रेण चार्हति
verses.transliteration: a~NgasarvasvI vaishyaH sarvasvadaNDaH syAtsa.nvatsaranirodhataH | sahasraM kShatriyo daNDyo mauNDyaM mUtreNa chArhati
verses.translation: (For intercourse with a guarded Brahmana a Vaisya shall forfeit all his property after imprisonment for a year; a Kshatriya shall be fined one thousand (panas) and be shaved with the urine (of an ass).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणीं यद्यगुप्तां तु गच्छेतां वैश्यपार्थिवौ । वैश्यं पञ्चशतं कुर्यात्क्षत्रियं तु सहस्रिणम्
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNIM yadyaguptAM tu gachChetAM vaishyapArthivau | vaishyaM pa~nchashataM kuryAtkShatriyaM tu sahasriNam
verses.translation: If a Vaisya or a Kshatriya has connexion with an unguarded Brahmana, let him fine the Vaisya five hundred (panas) and the Kshatriya one thousand.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: उभावपि तु तावेव ब्राह्मण्या गुप्तया सह । विप्लुतौ शूद्रवद्दण्ड्यौ दग्धव्यौ वा कटाग्निना
verses.transliteration: ubhAvapi tu tAveva brAhmaNyA guptayA saha | viplutau shUdravaddaNDyau dagdhavyau vA kaTAgninA
verses.translation: But even these two, if they offend with a Brahmani (not only) guarded (but the wife of an eminent man), shall be punished like a Sudra or be burnt in a fire of dry grass.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रं ब्राह्मणो दण्ड्यो गुप्तां विप्रां बलाद्व्रजन् । शतानि पञ्च दण्ड्यः स्यादिच्छन्त्या सह सङ्गतः
verses.transliteration: sahasraM brAhmaNo daNDyo guptAM viprAM balAdvrajan | shatAni pa~ncha daNDyaH syAdichChantyA saha sa~NgataH
verses.translation: A Brahmana who carnally knows a guarded Brahmani against her will, shall be fined one thousand (panas); but he shall be made to pay five hundred, if he had connexion with a willing one.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: मौण्ड्यं प्राणान्तिकं दण्डो ब्राह्मणस्य विधीयते । प्राणान्तको इतरेषां तु वर्णानां दण्डः प्राणान्तिको भवेत्
verses.transliteration: mauNDyaM prANAntikaM daNDo brAhmaNasya vidhIyate | prANAntako itareShAM tu varNAnAM daNDaH prANAntiko bhavet
verses.translation: Tonsure (of the head) is ordained for a Brahmana (instead of) capital punishment; but (men of) other castes shall suffer capital punishment.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: विद्वांस्तु ब्राह्मणो दृष्ट्वा पूर्वोपनिहितं निधिम् । अशेषतोऽप्याददीत सर्वस्याधिपतिर्हि सः
verses.transliteration: vidvA.nstu brAhmaNo dR^iShTvA pUrvopanihitaM nidhim | asheShato.apyAdadIta sarvasyAdhipatirhi saH
verses.translation: When the king finds treasure of old concealed in the ground let him give one half to Brahmanas and place the (other) half in his treasury.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यं तु पश्येन्निधिं राजा पुराणं निहितं क्षितौ । तस्माद्द्विजेभ्यो दत्त्वाऽर्धमर्धं कोशे प्रवेशयेत्
verses.transliteration: yaM tu pashyennidhiM rAjA purANaM nihitaM kShitau | tasmAddvijebhyo dattvA.ardhamardhaM koshe praveshayet
verses.translation: When the king finds treasure of old concealed in the ground let him give one half to Brahmanas and place the (other) half in his treasury.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: प्राणान्तको न जातु ब्राह्मणं हन्यात्सर्वपापेष्वपि स्थितम् । राष्ट्रादेनं बहिः कुर्यात्समग्रधनमक्षतम्
verses.transliteration: prANAntako na jAtu brAhmaNaM hanyAtsarvapApeShvapi sthitam | rAShTrAdenaM bahiH kuryAtsamagradhanamakShatam
verses.translation: Let him never slay a Brahmana, though he have committed all (possible) crimes; let him banish such an (offender), leaving all his property (to him) and (his body) unhurt.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: न ब्राह्मणवधाद्भूयानधर्मो विद्यते भुवि । तस्मादस्य वधं राजा मनसाऽपि न चिन्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: na brAhmaNavadhAdbhUyAnadharmo vidyate bhuvi | tasmAdasya vadhaM rAjA manasA.api na chintayet
verses.translation: No greater crime is known on earth than slaying a Brahmana; a king, therefore, must not even conceive in his mind the thought of killing a Brahmana.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यश्चेत्क्षत्रियां गुप्तां वैश्यां वा क्षत्रियो व्रजेत् । यो ब्राह्मण्यामगुप्तायां तावुभौ दण्डमर्हतः
verses.transliteration: vaishyashchetkShatriyAM guptAM vaishyAM vA kShatriyo vrajet | yo brAhmaNyAmaguptAyAM tAvubhau daNDamarhataH
verses.translation: If a Vaisya approaches a guarded female of the Kshatriya caste, or a Kshatriya a (guarded) Vaisya woman, they both deserve the same punishment as in the case of an unguarded Brahmana female.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रं ब्राह्मणो दण्डं दाप्यो गुप्ते तु ते व्रजन् । शूद्रायां क्षत्रियविशोः साहस्रो वै भवेद्दमः
verses.transliteration: sahasraM brAhmaNo daNDaM dApyo gupte tu te vrajan | shUdrAyAM kShatriyavishoH sAhasro vai bhaveddamaH
verses.translation: A Brahmana shall be compelled to pay a fine of one thousand (panas) if he has intercourse with guarded (females of) those two (castes); for (offending with) a (guarded) Sudra female a fine of one thousand (panas shall be inflicted) on a Kshatriya or a Vaisya.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: शूद्राया क्षत्रियायामगुप्तायां वैश्ये पञ्चशतं दमः । मूत्रेण मौण्ड्यमिच्छेत्तु क्षत्रियो दण्डमेव वा
verses.transliteration: shUdrAyA kShatriyAyAmaguptAyAM vaishye pa~nchashataM damaH | mUtreNa mauNDyamichChettu kShatriyo daNDameva vA
verses.translation: For (intercourse with) an unguarded Kshatriya a fine of five hundred (panas shall fall) on a Vaisya; but (for the same offence) a Kshatriya shall be shaved with the urine (of a donkey) or (pay) the same fine.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: ऋच्छेत्तु अगुप्ते क्षत्रियावैश्ये शूद्रां वा ब्राह्मणो व्रजन् । शतानि पञ्च दण्ड्यः स्यात्सहस्रं त्वन्त्यजस्त्रियम्
verses.transliteration: R^ichChettu agupte kShatriyAvaishye shUdrAM vA brAhmaNo vrajan | shatAni pa~ncha daNDyaH syAtsahasraM tvantyajastriyam
verses.translation: A Brahmana who approaches unguarded females (of the) Kshatriya or Vaisya (castes), or a Sudra female, shall be fined five hundred (panas); but (for intercourse with) a female (of the) lowest (castes), one thousand.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यस्य स्तेनः पुरे नास्ति नान्यस्त्रीगो न दुष्टवाक् । न साहसिकदण्डघ्नो स राजा शक्रलोकभाक्
verses.transliteration: yasya stenaH pure nAsti nAnyastrIgo na duShTavAk | na sAhasikadaNDaghno sa rAjA shakralokabhAk
verses.translation: That king in whose town lives no thief, no adulterer, no defamer, no man guilty of violence, and no committer of assaults, attains the world of Sakra (Indra).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: एतेषां निग्रहो राज्ञः पञ्चानां विषये स्वके । सांराज्यकृत्सजात्येषु लोके चैव यशस्करः
verses.transliteration: eteShAM nigraho rAj~naH pa~nchAnAM viShaye svake | sA.nrAjyakR^itsajAtyeShu loke chaiva yashaskaraH
verses.translation: The suppression of those five in his dominions secures to a king paramount sovereignty among his peers and fame in the world.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: ऋत्विजं यस्त्यजेद्याज्यो याज्यं चर्त्विक्त्यजेद्यदि । शक्तं कर्मण्यदुष्टं च तयोर्दण्डः शतं शतम्
verses.transliteration: R^itvijaM yastyajedyAjyo yAjyaM chartviktyajedyadi | shaktaM karmaNyaduShTaM cha tayordaNDaH shataM shatam
verses.translation: A sacrificer who forsakes an officiating priest, and an officiating priest who forsakes a sacrificer, (each being) able to perform his work and not contaminated (by grievous crimes), must each be fined one hundred (panas).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: न माता न पिता न स्त्री न पुत्रस्त्यागमर्हति । त्यजन्नपतितानेतान् राज्ञा दण्ड्यः शतानि षट्
verses.transliteration: na mAtA na pitA na strI na putrastyAgamarhati | tyajannapatitAnetAn rAj~nA daNDyaH shatAni ShaT
verses.translation: Neither a mother, nor a father, nor a wife, nor a son shall be cast off; he who casts them off, unless guilty of a crime causing loss of caste, shall be fined six hundred (panas).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: निधीनां तु पुराणानां धातूनामेव च क्षितौ । अर्धभाग्रक्षणाद्राजा भूमेरधिपतिर्हि सः
verses.transliteration: nidhInAM tu purANAnAM dhAtUnAmeva cha kShitau | ardhabhAgrakShaNAdrAjA bhUmeradhipatirhi saH
verses.translation: The king obtains one half of ancient hoards and metals (found) in the ground, by reason of (his giving) protection, (and) because he is the lord of the soil.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमेषु द्विजातीनां कार्ये विवदतां मिथः । न विब्रूयान्नृपो धर्मं चिकीर्षन् हितमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: AshrameShu dvijAtInAM kArye vivadatAM mithaH | na vibrUyAnnR^ipo dharmaM chikIrShan hitamAtmanaH
verses.translation: If twice-born men dispute among each other concerning the duty of the orders, a king who desires his own welfare should not (hastily) decide (what is) the law.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यथार्हमेतानभ्यर्च्य ब्राह्मणैः सह पार्थिवः । सान्त्वेन प्रशमय्यादौ स्वधर्मं प्रतिपादयेत्
verses.transliteration: yathArhametAnabhyarchya brAhmaNaiH saha pArthivaH | sAntvena prashamayyAdau svadharmaM pratipAdayet
verses.translation: Having shown them due honor, he should, with (the assistance of) Brahmanas, first soothe them by gentle (speech) and afterwards teach them their duty.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिवेश्यानुवेश्यौ च कल्याणे विंशतिद्विजे । अर्हावभोजयन् विप्रो दण्डमर्हति माषकम्
verses.transliteration: prativeshyAnuveshyau cha kalyANe vi.nshatidvije | arhAvabhojayan vipro daNDamarhati mAShakam
verses.translation: A Brahmana who does not invite his next neighbour and his neighbour next but one, (though) both (he) worthy (of the honour), to a festival at which twenty Brahmanas are entertained, is liable to a fine of one masha.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: श्रोत्रियः श्रोत्रियं साधुं भूतिकृत्येष्वभोजयन् । तदन्नं द्विगुणं दाप्यो हिरण्यं चैव माषकम्
verses.transliteration: shrotriyaH shrotriyaM sAdhuM bhUtikR^ityeShvabhojayan | tadannaM dviguNaM dApyo hiraNyaM chaiva mAShakam
verses.translation: A Srotriya who does not entertain a virtuous Srotriya at auspicious festive rites, shall be made to pay him twice (the value of) the meal and a masha of gold (as a fine to the king).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: हैरण्यं अन्धो जडः पीठसर्पी सप्तत्या स्थविरश्च यः । श्रोत्रियेषूपकुर्वंश्च न दाप्याः केन चित्करम्
verses.transliteration: hairaNyaM andho jaDaH pIThasarpI saptatyA sthavirashcha yaH | shrotriyeShUpakurva.nshcha na dApyAH kena chitkaram
verses.translation: A blind man, an idiot, (a cripple) who moves with the help of a board, a man full seventy years old, and he who confers benefits on Srotriyas, shall not be compelled by any (king) to pay a tax.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: श्रोत्रियं व्याधितार्तौ च बालवृद्धावकिञ्चनम् । महाकुलीनमार्यं च राजा सम्पूजयेत्सदा
verses.transliteration: shrotriyaM vyAdhitArtau cha bAlavR^iddhAvaki~nchanam | mahAkulInamAryaM cha rAjA sampUjayetsadA
verses.translation: Let the king always treat kindly a Srotriya, a sick or distressed man, an infant and an aged or indigent man, a man of high birth, and an honourable man (Arya).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: शाल्मलीफलके श्लक्ष्णे नेनिज्यान्नेजकः शनैः । न च वासांसि वासोभिर्निर्हरेन्न च वासयेत्
verses.transliteration: shAlmalIphalake shlakShNe nenijyAnnejakaH shanaiH | na cha vAsA.nsi vAsobhirnirharenna cha vAsayet
verses.translation: A washerman shall wash (the clothes of his employers) gently on a smooth board of Salmaliwood he shall not return the clothes (of one person) for those (of another), nor allow anybody (but the owner) to wear them.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: तन्तुवायो दशपलं दद्यादेकपलाधिकम् । अतोऽन्यथा वर्तमानो दाप्यो द्वादशकं दमम्
verses.transliteration: tantuvAyo dashapalaM dadyAdekapalAdhikam | ato.anyathA vartamAno dApyo dvAdashakaM damam
verses.translation: A weaver (who has received) ten palas (of thread), shall return (cloth weighing) one pala more; he who acts differently shall be compelled to pay a fine of twelve (panas).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: शुल्कस्थानेषु कुशलाः सर्वपण्यविचक्षणाः । कुर्युरर्घं यथापण्यं ततो विंशं नृपो हरेत्
verses.transliteration: shulkasthAneShu kushalAH sarvapaNyavichakShaNAH | kuryurarghaM yathApaNyaM tato vi.nshaM nR^ipo haret
verses.translation: Let the king take one-twentieth of that (amount) which men, well acquainted with the settlement of tolls and duties (and) skilful in (estimating the value of) all kinds of merchandise, may fix as the value for each saleable commodity.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञः प्रख्यातभाण्डानि प्रतिषिद्धानि यानि च । ताणि निर्हरतो लोभात्सर्वहारं हरेन्नृपः
verses.transliteration: rAj~naH prakhyAtabhANDAni pratiShiddhAni yAni cha | tANi nirharato lobhAtsarvahAraM harennR^ipaH
verses.translation: Let the king confiscate the whole property of (a trader) who out of greed exports goods of which the king has a monopoly or (the export of which is) forbidden.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: तेषामाद्यं ऋणादानं निक्षेपोऽस्वामिविक्रयः । सम्भूय च समुत्थानं दत्तस्यानपकर्म च
verses.transliteration: teShAmAdyaM R^iNAdAnaM nikShepo.asvAmivikrayaH | sambhUya cha samutthAnaM dattasyAnapakarma cha
verses.translation: Of those (titles) the first is the non-payment of debts, (then follow), (2) deposit and pledge, (3) sale without ownership, (4) concerns among partners, and (5) resumption of gifts,
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: दातव्यं सर्ववर्णेभ्यो राज्ञा चौरैर्हृतं धनम् । राजा तदुपयुञ्जानश्चौरस्याप्नोति किल्बिषम्
verses.transliteration: dAtavyaM sarvavarNebhyo rAj~nA chaurairhR^itaM dhanam | rAjA tadupayu~njAnashchaurasyApnoti kilbiSham
verses.translation: Property stolen by thieves must be restored by the king to (men of) all castes (varna); a king who uses such (property) for himself incurs the guilt of a thief.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: शुल्कस्थानं परिहरन्नकाले क्रयविक्रयी । मिथ्यावादी च सङ्ख्याने दाप्योऽष्टगुणमत्ययम्
verses.transliteration: shulkasthAnaM pariharannakAle krayavikrayI | mithyAvAdI cha sa~NkhyAne dApyo.aShTaguNamatyayam
verses.translation: He who avoids a custom-house (or a toll), he who buys or sells at an improper time, or he who makes a false statement in enumerating (his goods), shall be fined eight times (the amount of duty) which he tried to evade.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: आगमं निर्गमं स्थानं तथा वृद्धिक्षयावुभौ । विचार्य सर्वपण्यानां कारयेत्क्रयविक्रयौ
verses.transliteration: AgamaM nirgamaM sthAnaM tathA vR^iddhikShayAvubhau | vichArya sarvapaNyAnAM kArayetkrayavikrayau
verses.translation: Let (the king) fix (the rates for) the purchase and sale of all marketable goods, having (duly) considered whence they come, whither they go, how long they have been kept, the (probable) profit and the (probable) outlay.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चरात्रे पञ्चरात्रे पक्षे पक्षेऽथ वा गते । कुर्वीत चैषां प्रत्यक्षमर्घसंस्थापनं नृपः
verses.transliteration: pa~ncharAtre pa~ncharAtre pakShe pakShe.atha vA gate | kurvIta chaiShAM pratyakShamarghasa.nsthApanaM nR^ipaH
verses.translation: Once in five nights, or at the close of each fortnight, let the king publicly settle the prices for the (merchants).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: तुलामानं प्रतीमानं सर्वं च स्यात्सुलक्षितम् । षट्सु षट्सु च मासेषु पुनरेव परीक्षयेत्
verses.transliteration: tulAmAnaM pratImAnaM sarvaM cha syAtsulakShitam | ShaTsu ShaTsu cha mAseShu punareva parIkShayet
verses.translation: All weights and measures must be duly marked, and once in six months let him re-examine them.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: पणं यानं तरे दाप्यं पौरुषोऽर्धपणं तरे । पादं पशुश्च योषित्च पादार्धं रिक्तकः पुमान्
verses.transliteration: paNaM yAnaM tare dApyaM pauruSho.ardhapaNaM tare | pAdaM pashushcha yoShitcha pAdArdhaM riktakaH pumAn
verses.translation: At a ferry an (empty) cart shall be made to pay one pana, a man's (load) half a pana, an animal and a woman one quarter of a (pana), an unloaded man one-half of a quarter.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: पादे भाण्डपूर्णानि यानानि तार्यं दाप्यानि सारतः । रिक्तभाण्डानि यत्किं चित्पुमांसश्चपरिच्छदाः
verses.transliteration: pAde bhANDapUrNAni yAnAni tAryaM dApyAni sArataH | riktabhANDAni yatkiM chitpumA.nsashchaparichChadAH
verses.translation: Carts (laden) with vessels full (of merchandise) shall be made to pay toll at a ferry according to the value (of the goods), empty vessels and men without luggage some trifle.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घाध्वनि यथादेशं यथाकालं तरो भवेत् । नदीतीरेषु तद्विद्यात्समुद्रे नास्ति लक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: dIrghAdhvani yathAdeshaM yathAkAlaM taro bhavet | nadItIreShu tadvidyAtsamudre nAsti lakShaNam
verses.translation: For a long passage the boat-hire must be proportioned to the places and times; know that this (rule refers) to (passages along) the banks of rivers; at sea there is no settled (freight).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: गर्भिणी तु द्विमासादिस्तथा प्रव्रजितो मुनिः । ब्राह्मणा लिङ्गिनश्चैव न दाप्यास्तारिकं तरे
verses.transliteration: garbhiNI tu dvimAsAdistathA pravrajito muniH | brAhmaNA li~Nginashchaiva na dApyAstArikaM tare
verses.translation: But a woman who has been pregnant two months or more, an ascetic, a hermit in the forest, and Brahmanas who are students of the Veda, shall not be made to pay toll at a ferry.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यन्नावि किं चिद्दाशानां विशीर्येतापराधतः । तद्दाशैरेव दातव्यं समागम्य स्वतोऽंशतः
verses.transliteration: yannAvi kiM chiddAshAnAM vishIryetAparAdhataH | taddAshaireva dAtavyaM samAgamya svato.a.nshataH
verses.translation: Whatever may be damaged in a boat by the fault of the boatmen, that shall be made good by the boatmen collectively, (each paying) his share.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: एष नौयायिनामुक्तो व्यवहारस्य निर्णयः । दाशापराधतस्तोये दैविके नास्ति निग्रहः
verses.transliteration: eSha nauyAyinAmukto vyavahArasya nirNayaH | dAshAparAdhatastoye daivike nAsti nigrahaH
verses.translation: This decision in suits (brought) by passengers (holds good only) in case the boatmen are culpably negligent on the water; in the case of (an accident) caused by (the will of) the gods, no fine can be (inflicted on them).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: जातिजानपदान् धर्मान् श्रेणीधर्मांश्च धर्मवित् । समीक्ष्य कुलधर्मांश्च स्वधर्मं प्रतिपादयेत्
verses.transliteration: jAtijAnapadAn dharmAn shreNIdharmA.nshcha dharmavit | samIkShya kuladharmA.nshcha svadharmaM pratipAdayet
verses.translation: (A king) who knows the sacred law, must inquire into the laws of castes (gati), of districts, of guilds, and of families, and (thus) settle the peculiar law of each.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: वाणिज्यं कारयेद्वैश्यं कुसीदं कृषिमेव च । पशूनां रक्षणं चैव दास्यं शूद्रं द्विजन्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: vANijyaM kArayedvaishyaM kusIdaM kR^iShimeva cha | pashUnAM rakShaNaM chaiva dAsyaM shUdraM dvijanmanAm
verses.translation: (The king) should order a Vaisya to trade, to lend money, to cultivate the land, or to tend cattle, and a Sudra to serve the twice-born castes
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रियं चैव वैश्यं च ब्राह्मणो वृत्तिकर्शितौ । बिभृयादानृशंस्येन स्वानि कर्माणि कारयेत्
verses.transliteration: kShatriyaM chaiva vaishyaM cha brAhmaNo vR^ittikarshitau | bibhR^iyAdAnR^isha.nsyena svAni karmANi kArayet
verses.translation: (Some wealthy) Brahmana shall compassionately support both a Kshatriya and a Vaisya, if they are distressed for a livelihood, employing them on work (which is suitable for) their (castes).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: दास्यं तु कारयन्लोभाद्ब्राह्मणः संस्कृतान् द्विजान् । अनिच्छतः प्राभवत्याद्राज्ञा दण्ड्यः शतानि षट्
verses.transliteration: dAsyaM tu kArayanlobhAdbrAhmaNaH sa.nskR^itAn dvijAn | anichChataH prAbhavatyAdrAj~nA daNDyaH shatAni ShaT
verses.translation: But a Brahmana who, because he is powerful, out of greed makes initiated (men of the) twice-born (castes) against their will do the work of slaves, shall be fined by the king six hundred (panas).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: शूद्रं तु कारयेद्दास्यं क्रीतमक्रीतमेव वा । दास्यायैव हि सृष्टोऽसौ ब्राह्मणस्य स्वयम्भुवा
verses.transliteration: shUdraM tu kArayeddAsyaM krItamakrItameva vA | dAsyAyaiva hi sR^iShTo.asau brAhmaNasya svayambhuvA
verses.translation: But a Sudra, whether bought or unbought, he may compel to do servile work; for he was created by the Self-existent (Svayambhu) to be the slave of a Brahmana.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: न स्वामिना निसृष्टोऽपि शूद्रो दास्याद्विमुच्यते । निसर्गजं हि तत्तस्य कस्तस्मात्तदपोहति
verses.transliteration: na svAminA nisR^iShTo.api shUdro dAsyAdvimuchyate | nisargajaM hi tattasya kastasmAttadapohati
verses.translation: A Sudra, though emancipated by his master, is not released from servitude; since that is innate in him, who can set him free from it?
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: ध्वजाहृतो भक्तदासो गृहजः क्रीतदत्त्रिमौ । पैत्रिको दण्डदासश्च सप्तैते दासयोनयः
verses.transliteration: dhvajAhR^ito bhaktadAso gR^ihajaH krItadattrimau | paitriko daNDadAsashcha saptaite dAsayonayaH
verses.translation: There are slaves of seven kinds, (viz.) he who is made a captive under a standard, he who serves for his daily food, he who is born in the house, he who is bought and he who is given, he who is inherited from ancestors, and he who is enslaved by way of punishment.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: भार्या पुत्रश्च दासश्च त्रय एवाधनाः स्मृताः । यत्ते समधिगच्छन्ति यस्य ते तस्य तद्धनम्
verses.transliteration: bhAryA putrashcha dAsashcha traya evAdhanAH smR^itAH | yatte samadhigachChanti yasya te tasya taddhanam
verses.translation: A wife, a son, and a slave, these three are declared to have no property; the wealth which they earn is (acquired) for him to whom they belong.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: विस्रब्धं ब्राह्मणः शूद्राद्द्रव्योपादानमाचरेत् । न हि तस्यास्ति किं चित्स्वं भर्तृहार्यधनो हि सः
verses.transliteration: visrabdhaM brAhmaNaH shUdrAddravyopAdAnamAcharet | na hi tasyAsti kiM chitsvaM bhartR^ihAryadhano hi saH
verses.translation: A Brahmana may confidently seize the goods of (his) Sudra (slave); for, as that (slave) can have no property, his master may take his possessions.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यशूद्रौ प्रयत्नेन स्वानि कर्माणि कारयेत् । तौ हि च्युतौ स्वकर्मभ्यः क्षोभयेतामिदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: vaishyashUdrau prayatnena svAni karmANi kArayet | tau hi chyutau svakarmabhyaH kShobhayetAmidaM jagat
verses.translation: (The king) should carefully compel Vaisyas and Sudra to perform the work (prescribed) for them; for if these two (castes) swerved from their duties, they would throw this (whole) world into confusion.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अहन्यहन्यवेक्षेत कर्मान्तान् वाहनानि च । आयव्ययौ च नियतावाकरान् कोशमेव च
verses.transliteration: ahanyahanyavekSheta karmAntAn vAhanAni cha | Ayavyayau cha niyatAvAkarAn koshameva cha
verses.translation: Let him daily look after the completion of his undertakings, his beasts of burden, and carriages, (the collection of) his revenues and the disbursements, his mines and his treasury.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: स्वानि कर्माणि कुर्वाणा दूरे सन्तोऽपि मानवाः । प्रिया भवन्ति लोकस्य स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यवस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: svAni karmANi kurvANA dUre santo.api mAnavAH | priyA bhavanti lokasya sve sve karmaNyavasthitAH
verses.translation: For men who follow their particular occupations and abide by their particular duty, become dear to people, though they may live at a distance.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: एवं सर्वानिमान् राजा व्यवहारान् समापयन् । व्यपोह्य किल्बिषं सर्वं प्राप्नोति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: evaM sarvAnimAn rAjA vyavahArAn samApayan | vyapohya kilbiShaM sarvaM prApnoti paramAM gatim
verses.translation: A king who thus brings to a conclusion. all the legal business enumerated above, and removes all sin, reaches the highest state (of bliss).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: नोत्पादयेत्स्वयं कार्यं राजा नाप्यस्य पूरुषः । न च प्रापितमन्येन ग्रसेदर्थं कथं चन
verses.transliteration: notpAdayetsvayaM kAryaM rAjA nApyasya pUruShaH | na cha prApitamanyena grasedarthaM kathaM chana
verses.translation: Neither the king nor any servant of his shall themselves cause a lawsuit to be begun, or hush up one that has been brought (before them) by (some) other (man).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: ग्रसेतार्थं यथा नयत्यसृक्पातैर्मृगस्य मृगयुः पदम् । नयेत्तथाऽनुमानेन धर्मस्य नृपतिः पदम्
verses.transliteration: grasetArthaM yathA nayatyasR^ikpAtairmR^igasya mR^igayuH padam | nayettathA.anumAnena dharmasya nR^ipatiH padam
verses.translation: As a hunter traces the lair of a (wounded) deer by the drops of blood, even so the king shall discover on which side the right lies, by inferences (from the facts).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सत्यमर्थं च सम्पश्येदात्मानमथ साक्षिणः । साक्षिणम् देशं रूपं च कालं च व्यवहारविधौ स्थितः
verses.transliteration: satyamarthaM cha sampashyedAtmAnamatha sAkShiNaH | sAkShiNam deshaM rUpaM cha kAlaM cha vyavahAravidhau sthitaH
verses.translation: When engaged in judicial proceedings he must pay full attention to the truth, to the object (of the dispute), (and) to himself, next to the witnesses, to the place, to the time, and to the aspect.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सद्भिराचरितं यत्स्याद्धार्मिकैश्च द्विजातिभिः । तद्देशकुलजातीनामविरुद्धं प्रकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: sadbhirAcharitaM yatsyAddhArmikaishcha dvijAtibhiH | taddeshakulajAtInAmaviruddhaM prakalpayet
verses.translation: What may have been practised by the virtuous, by such twice-born men as are devoted to the law, that he shall establish as law, if it be not opposed to the (customs of) countries, families, and castes (gati).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अधमर्णार्थसिद्ध्यर्थमुत्तमर्णेन चोदितः । दापयेद्धनिकस्यार्थमधमर्णाद्विभावितम्
verses.transliteration: adhamarNArthasiddhyarthamuttamarNena choditaH | dApayeddhanikasyArthamadhamarNAdvibhAvitam
verses.translation: When a creditor sues (before the king) for the recovery of money from a debtor, let him make the debtor pay the sum which the creditor proves (to be due).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यैर्यैरुपायैरर्थं स्वं प्राप्नुयादुत्तमर्णिकः । तैर्तैरुपायैः सङ्गृह्य दापयेदधमर्णिकम्
verses.transliteration: yairyairupAyairarthaM svaM prApnuyAduttamarNikaH | tairtairupAyaiH sa~NgR^ihya dApayedadhamarNikam
verses.translation: By whatever means a creditor may be able to obtain possession of his property, even by those means may he force the debtor and make him pay.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: धर्मेण व्यवहारेण छलेनाचरितेन च । प्रयुक्तं साधयेदर्थं पञ्चमेन बलेन च
verses.transliteration: dharmeNa vyavahAreNa ChalenAcharitena cha | prayuktaM sAdhayedarthaM pa~nchamena balena cha
verses.translation: By moral suasion, by suit of law, by artful management, or by the customary proceeding, a creditor may recover property lent; and fifthly, by force.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: वेतनस्यैव चादानं संविदश्च व्यतिक्रमः । क्रयविक्रयानुशयो विवादः स्वामिपालयोः
verses.transliteration: vetanasyaiva chAdAnaM sa.nvidashcha vyatikramaH | krayavikrayAnushayo vivAdaH svAmipAlayoH
verses.translation: (6) Non-payment of wages, (7) non-performance of agreements, (8) rescission of sale and purchase, (9) disputes between the owner (of cattle) and his servants,
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यः स्वयं साधयेदर्थमुत्तमर्णोऽधमर्णिकात् । न स राज्ञाऽभियोक्तव्यः स्वकं संसाधयन् धनम्
verses.transliteration: yaH svayaM sAdhayedarthamuttamarNo.adhamarNikAt | na sa rAj~nA.abhiyoktavyaH svakaM sa.nsAdhayan dhanam
verses.translation: A creditor who himself recovers his property from his debtor, must not be blamed by the king for retaking what is his own.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अर्थेऽपव्ययमानं तु करणेन विभावितम् । दापयेद्धनिकस्यार्थं दण्डलेशं च शक्तितः
verses.transliteration: arthe.apavyayamAnaM tu karaNena vibhAvitam | dApayeddhanikasyArthaM daNDaleshaM cha shaktitaH
verses.translation: But him who denies a debt which is proved by good evidence, he shall order to pay that debt to the creditor and a small fine according to his circumstances.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अपह्नवेऽधमर्णस्य देहीत्युक्तस्य संसदि । अभियोक्ता दिशेद्देश्यं करणं वाऽन्यदुद्दिशेत्
verses.transliteration: apahnave.adhamarNasya dehItyuktasya sa.nsadi | abhiyoktA disheddeshyaM karaNaM vA.anyaduddishet
verses.translation: On the denial (of a debt) by a debtor who has been required in court to pay it, the complainant must call (a witness) who was present (when the loan was made), or adduce other evidence.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अदेश्यं यश्च दिशति निर्दिश्यापह्नुते च यः । यश्चाधरोत्तरानर्थान् विगीतान्नावबुध्यते
verses.transliteration: adeshyaM yashcha dishati nirdishyApahnute cha yaH | yashchAdharottarAnarthAn vigItAnnAvabudhyate
verses.translation: (The plaintiff) who calls a witness not present at the transaction, who retracts his statements, or does not perceive that his statements (are) confused or contradictory;
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अपदिश्यापदेश्यं च पुनर्यस्त्वपधावति । अपदिश्यापदेशं सम्यक्प्रणिहितं चार्थं पृष्टः सन्नाभिनन्दति
verses.transliteration: apadishyApadeshyaM cha punaryastvapadhAvati | apadishyApadeshaM samyakpraNihitaM chArthaM pR^iShTaH sannAbhinandati
verses.translation: Or who having stated what he means to prove afterwards varies (his case), or who being questioned on a fact duly stated by himself does not abide by it;
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: असम्भाष्ये साक्षिभिश्च देशे सम्भाषते मिथः । निरुच्यमानं प्रश्नं च नेच्छेद्यश्चापि निष्पतेत्
verses.transliteration: asambhAShye sAkShibhishcha deshe sambhAShate mithaH | niruchyamAnaM prashnaM cha nechChedyashchApi niShpatet
verses.translation: Or who converses with the witnesses in a place improper for such conversation; or who declines to answer a question, properly put, or leaves (the court);
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: ब्रूहीत्युक्तश्च न ब्रूयादुक्तं च न विभावयेत् । न च पूर्वापरं विद्यात्तस्मादर्थात्स हीयते
verses.transliteration: brUhItyuktashcha na brUyAduktaM cha na vibhAvayet | na cha pUrvAparaM vidyAttasmAdarthAtsa hIyate
verses.translation: Or who, being ordered to speak, does not answer, or does not prove what he has alleged; or who does not know what is the first (point), and what the second, fails in his suit.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: साक्षिणः सन्ति मेत्युक्त्वा दिशेत्युक्तो दिशेन्न यः । ज्ञातारः सन्ति मेत्युक्त्वा धर्मस्थः कारणैरेतैर्हीनं तमपि निर्दिशेत्
verses.transliteration: sAkShiNaH santi metyuktvA dishetyukto dishenna yaH | j~nAtAraH santi metyuktvA dharmasthaH kAraNairetairhInaM tamapi nirdishet
verses.translation: Him also who says 'I have witnesses,' and, being ordered to produce them, produces them not, the judge must on these (same) grounds declare to be non-suited.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: तमिति निर्दिशेत् अभियोक्ता न चेद्ब्रूयाद्बध्यो दण्ड्यश्च धर्मतः । बन्ध्यो दण्ड्यश्च न चेत्त्रिपक्षात्प्रब्रूयाद्धर्मं प्रति पराजितः
verses.transliteration: tamiti nirdishet abhiyoktA na chedbrUyAdbadhyo daNDyashcha dharmataH | bandhyo daNDyashcha na chettripakShAtprabrUyAddharmaM prati parAjitaH
verses.translation: If a plaintiff does not speak, he may be punished corporally or fined according to the law; if (a defendant) does not plead within three fortnights, he has lost his cause.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यो यावद्निह्नुवीतार्थं मिथ्या यावति वा वदेत् । तौ नृपेण ह्यधर्मज्ञौ दाप्यौ तद्द्विगुणं दमम्
verses.transliteration: yo yAvadnihnuvItArthaM mithyA yAvati vA vadet | tau nR^ipeNa hyadharmaj~nau dApyau taddviguNaM damam
verses.translation: In the double of that sum which (a defendant) falsely denies or on which (the plaintiff) falsely declares, shall those two (men) offending against justice be fined by the king.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सीमाविवादधर्मश्च पारुष्ये दण्डवाचिके । स्तेयं च साहसं चैव स्त्रीसङ्ग्रहणमेव च
verses.transliteration: sImAvivAdadharmashcha pAruShye daNDavAchike | steyaM cha sAhasaM chaiva strIsa~NgrahaNameva cha
verses.translation: (10) Disputes regarding boundaries, (11) assault and (12) defamation, (13) theft, (14) robbery and violence, (15) adultery,
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: पृष्टोऽपव्ययमानस्तु कृतावस्थो धनेषिणा । त्र्यवरैः साक्षिभिर्भाव्यो नृपब्राह्मणसंनिधौ
verses.transliteration: pR^iShTo.apavyayamAnastu kR^itAvastho dhaneShiNA | tryavaraiH sAkShibhirbhAvyo nR^ipabrAhmaNasa.nnidhau
verses.translation: (A defendant) who, being brought (into court) by the creditor, (and) being questioned, denies (the debt), shall be convicted (of his falsehood) by at least three witnesses (who must depose) in the presence of the Brahmana (appointed by) the king.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यादृशा धनिभिः कार्या व्यवहारेषु साक्षिणः । तादृशान् सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि यथा वाच्यं ऋतं च तैः
verses.transliteration: yAdR^ishA dhanibhiH kAryA vyavahAreShu sAkShiNaH | tAdR^ishAn sampravakShyAmi yathA vAchyaM R^itaM cha taiH
verses.translation: I will fully declare what kind of men may be made witnesses in suits by creditors, and in what manner those (witnesses) must give true (evidence).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: गृहिणः पुत्रिणो मौलाः क्षत्रविद्शूद्रयोनयः । अर्थ्युक्ताः साक्ष्यमर्हन्ति न ये के चिदनापदि
verses.transliteration: gR^ihiNaH putriNo maulAH kShatravidshUdrayonayaH | arthyuktAH sAkShyamarhanti na ye ke chidanApadi
verses.translation: Householders, men with male issue, and indigenous (inhabitants of the country, be they) Kshatriyas, Vaisyas, or Sudras, are competent, when called by a suitor, to give evidence, not any persons whatever (their condition may be) except in cases of urgency.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: आप्ताः सर्वेषु वर्णेषु कार्याः कार्येषु साक्षिणः । सर्वधर्मविदोऽलुब्धा विपरीतांस्तु वर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: AptAH sarveShu varNeShu kAryAH kAryeShu sAkShiNaH | sarvadharmavido.alubdhA viparItA.nstu varjayet
verses.translation: Trustworthy men of all the (four) castes (varna) may be made witnesses in lawsuits, (men) who know (their) whole duty, and are free from covetousness; but let him reject those (of an) opposite (character).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: नार्थसम्बन्धिनो नाप्ता न सहाया न वैरिणः । न दृष्टदोषाः कर्तव्या न व्याध्यार्ता न दूषिताः
verses.transliteration: nArthasambandhino nAptA na sahAyA na vairiNaH | na dR^iShTadoShAH kartavyA na vyAdhyArtA na dUShitAH
verses.translation: Those must not be made (witnesses) who have an interest in the suit, nor familiar (friends), companions, and enemies (of the parties), nor (men) formerly convicted (of perjury), nor (persons) suffering under (severe) illness, nor (those) tainted (by mortal sin).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: न साक्षी नृपतिः कार्यो न कारुककुशीलवौ । न श्रोत्रियो न लिङ्गस्थो न सङ्गेभ्यो विनिर्गतः
verses.transliteration: na sAkShI nR^ipatiH kAryo na kArukakushIlavau | na shrotriyo na li~Ngastho na sa~Ngebhyo vinirgataH
verses.translation: The king cannot be made a witness, nor mechanics and actors, nor a: Srotriya, nor a student of the Veda, nor (an ascetic) who has given up (all) connexion (with the world),
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: नाध्यधीनो न वक्तव्यो न दस्युर्न विकर्मकृत् । न वृद्धो न शिशुर्नैको नान्त्यो न विकलेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: nAdhyadhIno na vaktavyo na dasyurna vikarmakR^it | na vR^iddho na shishurnaiko nAntyo na vikalendriyaH
verses.translation: Nor one wholly dependent, nor one of bad fame, nor a Dasyu, nor one who follows forbidden occupations, nor an aged (man), nor an infant, nor one (man alone), nor a man of the lowest castes, nor one deficient in organs of sense,
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: नार्तो न मत्तो नोन्मत्तो न क्षुत्तृष्णोपपीडितः । न श्रमार्तो न कामार्तो न क्रुद्धो नापि तस्करः
verses.transliteration: nArto na matto nonmatto na kShuttR^iShNopapIDitaH | na shramArto na kAmArto na kruddho nApi taskaraH
verses.translation: Nor one extremely grieved, nor one intoxicated, nor a madman, nor one tormented by hunger or thirst, nor one oppressed by fatigue, nor one tormented by desire, nor a wrathful man, nor a thief.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीणां साक्ष्यं स्त्रियः कुर्युर्द्विजानां सदृशा द्विजाः । शूद्राश्च सन्तः शूद्राणां अन्त्यानामन्त्ययोनयः
verses.transliteration: strINAM sAkShyaM striyaH kuryurdvijAnAM sadR^ishA dvijAH | shUdrAshcha santaH shUdrANAM antyAnAmantyayonayaH
verses.translation: Women should give evidence for women, and for twice-born men twice-born men (of the) same (kind), virtuous Sudras for Sudras, and men of the lowest castes for the lowest.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अनुभावी तु यः कश्चित्कुर्यात्साक्ष्यं विवादिनाम् । अन्तर्वेश्मन्यरण्ये वा शरीरस्यापि चात्यये
verses.transliteration: anubhAvI tu yaH kashchitkuryAtsAkShyaM vivAdinAm | antarveshmanyaraNye vA sharIrasyApi chAtyaye
verses.translation: But any person whatsoever, who has personal knowledge (of an act committed) in the interior apartments (of a house), or in a forest, or of (a crime causing) loss of life, may give evidence between the parties.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीपुंधर्मो विभागश्च द्यूतमाह्वय एव च । पदान्यष्टादशैतानि व्यवहारस्थिताविह
verses.transliteration: strIpu.ndharmo vibhAgashcha dyUtamAhvaya eva cha | padAnyaShTAdashaitAni vyavahArasthitAviha
verses.translation: (16) Duties of man and wife, (17) partition (of inheritance), (18) gambling and betting; these are in this world the eighteen topics which give rise to lawsuits.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रियाऽप्यसम्भावे कार्यं बालेन स्थविरेण वा । शिष्येण बन्धुना वाऽपि दासेन भृतकेन वा
verses.transliteration: striyA.apyasambhAve kAryaM bAlena sthavireNa vA | shiShyeNa bandhunA vA.api dAsena bhR^itakena vA
verses.translation: On failure (of qualified witnesses, evidence) may given (in such cases) by a woman, by an infant, by an aged man, by a pupil, by a relative, by a slave, or by a hired servant.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: बालवृद्धातुराणां च साक्ष्येषु वदतां मृषा । जानीयादस्थिरां वाचमुत्सिक्तमनसां तथा
verses.transliteration: bAlavR^iddhAturANAM cha sAkShyeShu vadatAM mR^iShA | jAnIyAdasthirAM vAchamutsiktamanasAM tathA
verses.translation: But the (judge) should consider the evidence of infants, aged and diseased men, who (are apt to) speak untruly, as untrustworthy, likewise that of men with disordered minds.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: साहसेषु च सर्वेषु स्तेयसङ्ग्रहणेषु च । वाग्दण्डयोश्च पारुष्ये न परीक्षेत साक्षिणः
verses.transliteration: sAhaseShu cha sarveShu steyasa~NgrahaNeShu cha | vAgdaNDayoshcha pAruShye na parIkSheta sAkShiNaH
verses.translation: In all cases of violence, of theft and adultery, of defamation and assault, he must not examine the (competence of) witnesses (too strictly).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: बहुत्वं परिगृह्णीयात्साक्षिद्वैधे नराधिपः । समेषु तु गुणोत्कृष्टान् गुणिद्वैधे द्विजोत्तमान्
verses.transliteration: bahutvaM parigR^ihNIyAtsAkShidvaidhe narAdhipaH | sameShu tu guNotkR^iShTAn guNidvaidhe dvijottamAn
verses.translation: On a conflict of the witnesses the king shall accept (as true) the evidence of the) majority; if (the conflicting parties are) equal in number, (that of) those distinguished by good qualities; on a difference between (equally) distinguished (witnesses, that of) the best among the twice-born.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: समक्षदर्शनात्साक्ष्यं श्रवणाच्चैव सिध्यति । तत्र सत्यं ब्रुवन् साक्षी धर्मार्थाभ्यां न हीयते
verses.transliteration: samakShadarshanAtsAkShyaM shravaNAchchaiva sidhyati | tatra satyaM bruvan sAkShI dharmArthAbhyAM na hIyate
verses.translation: Evidence in accordance with what has actually been seen or heard, is admissible; a witness who speaks truth in those (cases), neither loses spiritual merit nor wealth.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: साक्षी दृष्टश्रुतादन्यद्विब्रुवन्नार्यसंसदि । अवाङ्नरकमभ्येति प्रेत्य स्वर्गाच्च हीयते
verses.transliteration: sAkShI dR^iShTashrutAdanyadvibruvannAryasa.nsadi | avA~Nnarakamabhyeti pretya svargAchcha hIyate
verses.translation: A witness who deposes in an assembly of honourable men (Arya) anything else but what he has seen or heard, falls after death headlong into hell and loses heaven.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यत्रानिबद्धोऽपीक्षेत शृणुयाद्वाऽपि किं चन । पृष्टस्तत्रापि तद्ब्रूयाद्यथादृष्टं यथाश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: yatrAnibaddho.apIkSheta shR^iNuyAdvA.api kiM chana | pR^iShTastatrApi tadbrUyAdyathAdR^iShTaM yathAshrutam
verses.translation: When a man (originally) not appointed to be a witness sees or hears anything and is (afterwards) examined regarding it, he must declare it (exactly) as he saw or heard it.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: एकोऽलुब्धस्तु साक्षी स्याद्बह्व्यः शुच्योऽपि न स्त्रियः । त्वसाक्षी स्त्रीबुद्धेरस्थिरत्वात्तु दोषैश्चान्येऽपि ये वृताः
verses.transliteration: eko.alubdhastu sAkShI syAdbahvyaH shuchyo.api na striyaH | tvasAkShI strIbuddherasthiratvAttu doShaishchAnye.api ye vR^itAH
verses.translation: One man who is free from covetousness may be (accepted as) witness; but not even many pure women, because the understanding of females is apt to waver, nor even many other men, who are tainted with sin.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: स्वभावेनैव यद्ब्रूयुस्तद्ग्राह्यं व्यावहारिकम् । अतो यदन्यद्विब्रूयुर्धर्मार्थं तदपार्थकम्
verses.transliteration: svabhAvenaiva yadbrUyustadgrAhyaM vyAvahArikam | ato yadanyadvibrUyurdharmArthaM tadapArthakam
verses.translation: What witnesses declare quite naturally, that must be received on trials; (depositions) differing from that, which they make improperly, are worthless for (the purposes of) justice.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सभान्तः साक्षिणः प्राप्तानर्थिप्रत्यर्थिसंनिधौ । प्राड्विवाकोऽनुयुञ्जीत विधिनाऽनेन सान्त्वयन्
verses.transliteration: sabhAntaH sAkShiNaH prAptAnarthipratyarthisa.nnidhau | prADvivAko.anuyu~njIta vidhinA.anena sAntvayan
verses.translation: The witnesses being assembled in the court in the presence of the plaintiff and of the defendant, let the judge examine them, kindly exhorting them in the following manner:
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: एषु स्थानेषु भूयिष्ठं विवादं चरतां नृणाम् । धर्मं शाश्वतमाश्रित्य कुर्यात्कार्यविनिर्णयम्
verses.transliteration: eShu sthAneShu bhUyiShThaM vivAdaM charatAM nR^iNAm | dharmaM shAshvatamAshritya kuryAtkAryavinirNayam
verses.translation: Depending on the eternal law, let him decide the suits of men who mostly contend on the titles just mentioned.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यद्द्वयोरनयोर्वेत्थ कार्येऽस्मिंश्चेष्टितं मिथः । तद्ब्रूत सर्वं सत्येन युष्माकं ह्यत्र साक्षिता
verses.transliteration: yaddvayoranayorvettha kArye.asmi.nshcheShTitaM mithaH | tadbrUta sarvaM satyena yuShmAkaM hyatra sAkShitA
verses.translation: 'What ye know to have been mutually transacted in this matter between the two men before us, declare all that in accordance with the truth; for ye are witnesses in this (cause).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सत्यं साक्ष्ये ब्रुवन् साक्षी लोकान् आप्नोत्यपुष्कलान् । आप्नोत्यनिन्दितान् इह चानुत्तमां कीर्तिं वागेषा ब्रह्मपूजिता
verses.transliteration: satyaM sAkShye bruvan sAkShI lokAn ApnotyapuShkalAn | ApnotyaninditAn iha chAnuttamAM kIrtiM vAgeShA brahmapUjitA
verses.translation: 'A witness who speaks the truth in his evidence, gains (after death) the most excellent regions (of bliss) and here (below) unsurpassable fame; such testimony is revered by Brahman (himself).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: साक्ष्येऽनृतं वदन् पाशैर्बध्यते वारुणैर्भृशम् । विवशः शतमाजातीस्तस्मात्साक्ष्यं वदेदृतम्
verses.transliteration: sAkShye.anR^itaM vadan pAshairbadhyate vAruNairbhR^isham | vivashaH shatamAjAtIstasmAtsAkShyaM vadedR^itam
verses.translation: 'He who gives false evidence is firmly bound by Varuna's fetters, helpless during one hundred existences; let (men therefore) give true evidence.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सत्येन पूयते साक्षी धर्मः सत्येन वर्धते । तस्मात्सत्यं हि वक्तव्यं सर्ववर्णेषु साक्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: satyena pUyate sAkShI dharmaH satyena vardhate | tasmAtsatyaM hi vaktavyaM sarvavarNeShu sAkShibhiH
verses.translation: 'By truthfulness a witness is purified, through truthfulness his merit grows, truth must, therefore, be spoken by witnesses of all castes (varna).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: आत्मैव ह्यात्मनः साक्षी गतिरात्मा तथाऽत्मनः । माऽवमंस्थाः स्वमात्मानं नृणां साक्षिणमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: Atmaiva hyAtmanaH sAkShI gatirAtmA tathA.atmanaH | mA.avama.nsthAH svamAtmAnaM nR^iNAM sAkShiNamuttamam
verses.translation: 'The Soul itself is the witness of the Soul, and the Soul is the refuge of the Soul; despise not thy own Soul, the supreme witness of men.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: मन्यन्ते वै पापकृतो न कश्चित्पश्यतीति नः । तांस्तु देवाः प्रपश्यन्ति स्वस्यैवान्तरपूरुषः
verses.transliteration: manyante vai pApakR^ito na kashchitpashyatIti naH | tA.nstu devAH prapashyanti svasyaivAntarapUruShaH
verses.translation: 'The wicked, indeed, say in their hearts, "Nobody sees us;" but the gods distinctly see them and the male within their own breasts.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: द्यौर्भूमिरापो हृदयं चन्द्रार्काग्नियमानिलाः । रात्रिः संध्ये च धर्मश्च वृत्तज्ञाः सर्वदेहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: dyaurbhUmirApo hR^idayaM chandrArkAgniyamAnilAH | rAtriH sa.ndhye cha dharmashcha vR^ittaj~nAH sarvadehinAm
verses.translation: 'The sky, the earth, the waters, (the male in) the heart, the moon, the sun, the fire, Yama and the wind, the night, the two twilights, and justice know the conduct of all corporeal beings.'
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: देवब्राह्मणसांनिध्ये साक्ष्यं पृच्छेदृतं द्विजान् । उदङ्मुखान् प्राङ्मुखान् वा पूर्वाह्णे वै शुचिः शुचीन्
verses.transliteration: devabrAhmaNasA.nnidhye sAkShyaM pR^ichChedR^itaM dvijAn | uda~NmukhAn prA~NmukhAn vA pUrvAhNe vai shuchiH shuchIn
verses.translation: The (judge), being purified, shall ask in the forenoon the twice-born (witnesses) who (also have been) purified, (and stand) facing the north or the east, to give true evidence in the presence of (images of) the gods and of Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: ब्रूहीति ब्राह्मणं पृच्छेत्सत्यं ब्रूहीति पार्थिवम् । गोबीजकाञ्चनैर्वैश्यं शूद्रं सर्वैस्तु पातकैः
verses.transliteration: brUhIti brAhmaNaM pR^ichChetsatyaM brUhIti pArthivam | gobIjakA~nchanairvaishyaM shUdraM sarvaistu pAtakaiH
verses.translation: Let him examine a Brahmana (beginning with) 'Speak,' a Kshatriya (beginning with) 'Speak the truth,' a Vaisya (admonishing him) by (mentioning) his kine, grain, and gold, a Sudra (threatening him) with (the guilt of) every crime that causes loss of caste;
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मघ्नो ये स्मृता लोका ये च स्त्रीबालघातिनः । मित्रद्रुहः कृतघ्नस्य ते ते स्युर्ब्रुवतो मृषा
verses.transliteration: brahmaghno ye smR^itA lokA ye cha strIbAlaghAtinaH | mitradruhaH kR^itaghnasya te te syurbruvato mR^iShA
verses.translation: (Saying), 'Whatever places (of torment) are assigned (by the sages) to the slayer of a Brahmana, to the murderer of women and children, to him who betrays a friend, and to an ungrateful man, those shall be thy (portion), if thou speakest falsely.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यदा स्वयं न कुर्यात्तु नृपतिः कार्यदर्शनम् । तदा नियुञ्ज्याद्विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं कार्यदर्शने
verses.transliteration: yadA svayaM na kuryAttu nR^ipatiH kAryadarshanam | tadA niyu~njyAdvidvA.nsaM brAhmaNaM kAryadarshane
verses.translation: But if the king does not personally investigate the suits, then let him appoint a learned Brahmana to try them.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: जन्मप्रभृति यत्किं चित्पुण्यं भद्र त्वया कृतम् । तत्ते सर्वं शुनो गच्छेद्यदि ब्रूयास्त्वमन्यथा
verses.transliteration: janmaprabhR^iti yatkiM chitpuNyaM bhadra tvayA kR^itam | tatte sarvaM shuno gachChedyadi brUyAstvamanyathA
verses.translation: '(The reward) of all meritorious deeds which thou, good man, hast done since thy birth, shall become the share of the dogs, if in thy speech thou departest from the truth.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: एकोऽहमस्मीत्यात्मानं यस्त्वं कल्याण मन्यसे । नित्यं स्थितस्ते हृद्येष पुण्यपापैक्षिता मुनिः
verses.transliteration: eko.ahamasmItyAtmAnaM yastvaM kalyANa manyase | nityaM sthitaste hR^idyeSha puNyapApaikShitA muniH
verses.translation: 'If thou thinkest, O friend of virtue, with respect to thyself, "I am alone," (know that) that sage who witnesses all virtuous acts and all crimes, ever resides in thy heart.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यमो वैवस्वतो देवो यस्तवैष हृदि स्थितः । तेन चेदविवादस्ते मा गङ्गां मा कुरून् गमः
verses.transliteration: yamo vaivasvato devo yastavaiSha hR^idi sthitaH | tena chedavivAdaste mA ga~NgAM mA kurUn gamaH
verses.translation: 'If thou art not at variance with that divine Yama, the son of Vivasvat, who dwells in thy heart, thou needest neither visit the Ganges nor the (land of the) Kurus.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: नग्नो मुण्डः कपालेन च भिक्षार्थी क्षुत्पिपासितः । कपाली अन्धः शत्रुकुलं गच्छेद्यः साक्ष्यमनृतं वदेत्
verses.transliteration: nagno muNDaH kapAlena cha bhikShArthI kShutpipAsitaH | kapAlI andhaH shatrukulaM gachChedyaH sAkShyamanR^itaM vadet
verses.translation: 'Naked and shorn, tormented with hunger and thirst, and deprived of sight, shall the man who gives false evidence, go with a potsherd to beg food at the door of his enemy.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अवाक्षिरास्तमस्यन्धे किल्बिषी नरकं व्रजेत् । यः प्रश्नं वितथं ब्रूयात्पृष्टः सन् धर्मनिश्चये
verses.transliteration: avAkShirAstamasyandhe kilbiShI narakaM vrajet | yaH prashnaM vitathaM brUyAtpR^iShTaH san dharmanishchaye
verses.translation: 'Headlong, in utter darkness shall the sinful man tumble into hell, who being interrogated in a judicial inquiry answers one question falsely.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अन्धो मत्स्यानिवाश्नाति स नरः कण्टकैः सह । यो भाषतेऽर्थवैकल्यमप्रत्यक्षं सभां गतः
verses.transliteration: andho matsyAnivAshnAti sa naraH kaNTakaiH saha | yo bhAShate.arthavaikalyamapratyakShaM sabhAM gataH
verses.translation: 'That man who in a court (of justice) gives an untrue account of a transaction (or asserts a fact) of which he was not an eye-witness, resembles a blind man who swallows fish with the bones.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यस्य विद्वान् हि वदतः क्षेत्रज्ञो नाभिशङ्कते । नातिशङ्कते तस्मान्न देवाः श्रेयांसं लोकेऽन्यं पुरुषं विदुः
verses.transliteration: yasya vidvAn hi vadataH kShetraj~no nAbhisha~Nkate | nAtisha~Nkate tasmAnna devAH shreyA.nsaM loke.anyaM puruShaM viduH
verses.translation: 'The gods are acquainted with no better man in this world than him, of whom his conscious Soul has no distrust, when he gives evidence.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यावतो बान्धवान् यस्मिन् हन्ति साक्ष्येऽनृतं वदन् । तावतः सङ्ख्यया तस्मिन् शृणु सौम्यानुपूर्वशः
verses.transliteration: yAvato bAndhavAn yasmin hanti sAkShye.anR^itaM vadan | tAvataH sa~NkhyayA tasmin shR^iNu saumyAnupUrvashaH
verses.translation: 'Learn now, O friend, from an enumeration in due order, how many relatives he destroys who gives false evidence in several particular cases.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: पञ्च पश्वनृते हन्ति दश हन्ति गवानृते । शतमश्वानृते हन्ति सहस्रं पुरुषानृते
verses.transliteration: pa~ncha pashvanR^ite hanti dasha hanti gavAnR^ite | shatamashvAnR^ite hanti sahasraM puruShAnR^ite
verses.translation: 'He kills five by false Testimony regarding (small) cattle, he kills ten by false testimony regarding kine, he kills a hundred by false evidence concerning horses, and a thousand by false evidence concerning men.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: हन्ति जातानजातांश्च हिरण्यार्थेऽनृतं वदन् । सर्वं भूमिअनृते हन्ति मा स्म भूमिअनृतं वदीः
verses.transliteration: hanti jAtAnajAtA.nshcha hiraNyArthe.anR^itaM vadan | sarvaM bhUmianR^ite hanti mA sma bhUmianR^itaM vadIH
verses.translation: 'By speaking falsely in a cause regarding gold, he kills the born and the unborn; by false evidence concerning land, he kills everything; beware, therefore, of false evidence concerning land.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषस्य स्त्रियाश्चैव धर्मे वर्त्मनि तिष्ठतोः । धर्म्ये संयोगे विप्रयोगे च धर्मान् वक्ष्यामि शाश्वतान्
verses.transliteration: puruShasya striyAshchaiva dharme vartmani tiShThatoH | dharmye sa.nyoge viprayoge cha dharmAn vakShyAmi shAshvatAn
verses.translation: I will now propound the eternal laws for a husband and his wife who keep to the path of duty, whether they be united or separated.
verses.hindi: श्रतियां पठित हैं । उनमें जो व्यभिचार के प्रायशचितभूत है उन को सुनो  कोई पुत्र माता का मानस व्यभिचार जाकर कहताहै जी मेरी माता अपतिवता हुई परपुदप को चाइनेबाली थी, उस दुष्टता का मेरा पिता शद्ध वार्यसे शोधन फरे-यद एक नमुना है!

verses.sanskrit: न कश्चिद्योषितः शक्तः प्रसह्य परिरक्षितुम् । एतैरुपाययोगैस्तु शक्यास्ताः परिरक्षितुम्
verses.transliteration: na kashchidyoShitaH shaktaH prasahya parirakShitum | etairupAyayogaistu shakyAstAH parirakShitum
verses.translation: No man can completely guard women by force; but they can be guarded by the employment of the (following) expedients:
verses.hindi: , अक्षमाला-- अधन जाति की खी वशिष्ठ को ,विवाहित होने से. - पूज्य इुर। य ऑर दूसरों भा खिया इस लोक मे अपने पतियों के. झुझों के कारण उन्नति को एहुँची हैँ । इस घकार ख्ी-पुरुषों का ' उत्तम लोकिक आचार कहा गया है। अव लोक, परलोक में सुख

verses.sanskrit: नानुशुश्रुम जात्वेतत्पूर्वेष्वपि हि जन्मसु । शुल्कसंज्ञेन मूल्येन छन्नं दुहितृविक्रयम्
verses.transliteration: nAnushushruma jAtvetatpUrveShvapi hi janmasu | shulkasa.nj~nena mUlyena ChannaM duhitR^ivikrayam
verses.translation: Nor, indeed, have we heard, even in former creations, of such (a thing as) the covert sale of a daughter for a fixed price, called a nuptial fee.
verses.hindi: सा भदेलोकानामोति स्विः साध्वीति चोच्यते

verses.sanskrit: अन्योन्यस्याव्यभिचारो भवेदामरणान्तिकः । एष धर्मः समासेन ज्ञेयः स्त्रीपुंसयोः परः
verses.transliteration: anyonyasyAvyabhichAro bhavedAmaraNAntikaH | eSha dharmaH samAsena j~neyaH strIpu.nsayoH paraH
verses.translation: 'Let mutual fidelity continue until death,' this may be considered as the summary of the highest law for husband and wife.
verses.hindi: व्यनिचाराचु भुः त्री लोके भाझोति निन्यतामं ।.  'कौस्प और घर की शोना हैं । सियो से और लक्ष्मी मै कोई भेद " नहीं हे! दोनों खमान हैं। सन्तान पैदा करवा, उनका पालन, अतिथि, मित्र आदि फा लोकिक आद्र-सोअन का निर्घाह जी

verses.sanskrit: तथा नित्यं यतेयातां स्त्रीपुंसौ तु कृतक्रियौ । यथा नाभिचरेतां तौ वियुक्तावितरेतरम्
verses.transliteration: tathA nityaM yateyAtAM strIpu.nsau tu kR^itakriyau | yathA nAbhicharetAM tau viyuktAvitaretaram
verses.translation: Let man and woman, united in marriage, constantly exert themselves, that (they may not be) disunited (and) may not violate their mutual fidelity.
verses.hindi: आहुरुत्पादकं केचिदपरे क्षेत्रिणं विदुः

verses.sanskrit: नातिचरेतां एष स्त्रीपुंसयोरुक्तो धर्मो वो रतिसंहितः । आपद्यपत्यप्राप्तिश्च दायधर्मं निबोधत
verses.transliteration: nAticharetAM eSha strIpu.nsayorukto dharmo vo ratisa.nhitaH | ApadyapatyaprAptishcha dAyadharmaM nibodhata
verses.translation: Thus has been declared to you the law for a husband and his wife, which is intimately connected with conjugal happiness, and the manner of raising offspring in times of calamity; learn (now the law concerning) the division of the inheritance.
verses.hindi: भमावप्येककेदारे कालोतानि कुषीबले

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वं पितुश्च मातुश्च समेत्य भ्रातरः समम् । भजेरन् पैतृकं रिक्थमनीशास्ते हि जीवतोः
verses.transliteration: UrdhvaM pitushcha mAtushcha sametya bhrAtaraH samam | bhajeran paitR^ikaM rikthamanIshAste hi jIvatoH
verses.translation: After the death of the father and of the mother, the brothers, being assembled, may divide among themselves in equal shares the paternal (and the maternal) estate; for, they have no power (over it) while the parents live.
verses.hindi: उस विश्‍वदितकारी, पवित्र विचार को खुनो-- से हुआ हो उसका माना जाता है । दूसरा मत है--जिसकी खी याज के रूप, रंग देखने में आते हैं समय पर जैसा वीज खेत में चोया जाता है, उसी भांति का गुण पैदा हुए में आता है। यह

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठ एव तु गृह्णीयात्पित्र्यं धनमशेषतः । शेषास्तमुपजीवेयुर्यथैव पितरं तथा
verses.transliteration: jyeShTha eva tu gR^ihNIyAtpitryaM dhanamasheShataH | sheShAstamupajIveyuryathaiva pitaraM tathA
verses.translation: (Or) the eldest alone may take the whole paternal estate, the others shall live under him just as (they lived) under their father.
verses.hindi: आथुष्कासेन वक्तव्यं न जातु परयोषिति

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठेन जातमात्रेण पुत्री भवति मानवः । पितॄणामनृणश्चैव स तस्मात्सर्वमर्हति
verses.transliteration: jyeShThena jAtamAtreNa putrI bhavati mAnavaH | pitR^INAmanR^iNashchaiva sa tasmAtsarvamarhati
verses.translation: Immediately on the birth of his first-born a man is (called) the father of a son and is freed from the debt to the manes; that (son), therefore, is worthy (to receive) the whole estate.
verses.hindi: अन्न गाथा वायुगीताः कीतेयन्ति पुराविदः अपने चीज के अचुसार हो उगते झैँ । वीज दूसरा, दक्ष दूसरा उगे यदद नहीं होता । जो वीज होता है, उसीका बरुक्ष पेदा होता है। मे चीज न योना चाहिए । प्राचीन इतिहास फे ज्ञाता ऋषि इस

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिनृणं संनयति येन चानन्त्यमश्नुते । स एव धर्मजः पुत्रः कामजानितरान् विदुः
verses.transliteration: yasminR^iNaM sa.nnayati yena chAnantyamashnute | sa eva dharmajaH putraH kAmajAnitarAn viduH
verses.translation: That son alone on whom he throws his debt and through whom he obtains immortality, is begotten for (the fulfilment of) the law; all the rest they consider the offspring of desire.
verses.hindi: एतावानेव पुरुषो यजायात्मा प्रजेति ह ।

verses.sanskrit: पितेव पालयेत्पूत्रान् ज्येष्ठो भ्रातॄन् यवीयसः । पुत्रवत्चापि वर्तेरन् ज्येष्ठे भ्रातरि धर्मतः
verses.transliteration: piteva pAlayetpUtrAn jyeShTho bhrAtR^In yavIyasaH | putravatchApi varteran jyeShThe bhrAtari dharmataH
verses.translation: As a father (supports) his sons, so let the eldest support his younger brothers, and let them also in accordance with the law behave towards their eldest brother as sons (behave towards their father).
verses.hindi: जैस दूसरे के वेछे सुग को फिर सारने से वाण निष्फल होती है, ऐसे परखी में चोया बीज शीघ्र निष्फल होता है। इस एथिवी को जो पहले राजा एथुकी भार्या थी, अब,भी लोग प्रथकी सार्या ही जानते हैं। जो दक्ष काटकर साफ़ करता है उसका खेत और

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठः कुलं वर्धयति विनाशयति वा पुनः । ज्येष्ठः पूज्यतमो लोके ज्येष्ठः सद्भिरगर्हितः
verses.transliteration: jyeShThaH kulaM vardhayati vinAshayati vA punaH | jyeShThaH pUjyatamo loke jyeShThaH sadbhiragarhitaH
verses.translation: The eldest (son) makes the family prosperous or, on the contrary, brings it to ruin; the eldest (is considered) among men most worthy of honour, the eldest is not treated with disrespect by the virtuous.
verses.hindi: यथा गोऽश्वोूवासीपु महिष्यजाविकासु च ।

verses.sanskrit: अर्थस्य सङ्ग्रहे चैनां व्यये चैव नियोजयेत् । शौचे धर्मेऽन्नपक्त्यां च पारिणाह्यस्य वेक्षणे
verses.transliteration: arthasya sa~Ngrahe chainAM vyaye chaiva niyojayet | shauche dharme.annapaktyAM cha pAriNAhyasya vekShaNe
verses.translation: Let the (husband) employ his (wife) in the collection and expenditure of his wealth, in keeping (everything) clean, in (the fulfilment of) religious duties, in the preparation of his food, and in looking after the household utensils.
verses.hindi: साइया का वर्वारा एक बार हा हावा हैँ  कन्यादान एक चार दाता हैं आर दान भा एकह बार कहन स दोजाता हना खत्जु- रप इन तीच वातो को प्कवार ही करते हैं! जले गो, घोड़ी, ऊटना, दाखा, संस, चकरा छार सड आदि मे सन्तान पदा करचे

verses.sanskrit: यो ज्येष्ठो ज्येष्ठवृत्तिः स्यान् मातैव स पितैव सः । अज्येष्ठवृत्तिर्यस्तु स्यात्स सम्पूज्यस्तु बन्धुवत्
verses.transliteration: yo jyeShTho jyeShThavR^ittiH syAn mAtaiva sa pitaiva saH | ajyeShThavR^ittiryastu syAtsa sampUjyastu bandhuvat
verses.translation: If the eldest brother behaves as an eldest brother (ought to do), he (must be treated) like a mother and like a father; but if he behaves in a manner unworthy of an eldest brother, he should yet be honoured like a kinsman.
verses.hindi: सेत और वीजवालों में कोई ठहराव न हो तव तक सन्तान प्रधान हैं क्षेम मजो सन्तान होगी, बंद हम दोनी की होगी“ ऐसा ठहराव हुआ हो तो सन्तान क्षेत्र और चीज दोनों की हौगी । जो वाज जल के बेग चा घायु खे गिरकर दूसरे के खेत

verses.sanskrit: एवं सह वसेयुर्वा पृथग्वा धर्मकाम्यया । पृथग्विवर्धते धर्मस्तस्माद्धर्म्या पृथक्क्रिया
verses.transliteration: evaM saha vaseyurvA pR^ithagvA dharmakAmyayA | pR^ithagvivardhate dharmastasmAddharmyA pR^ithakkriyA
verses.translation: Either let them thus live together, or apart, if (each) desires (to gain) spiritual merit; for (by their living) separate (their) merit increases, hence separation is meritorious.
verses.hindi: अतः परे शवक्ष्वासि योषितां धर्ममाषादि

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठस्य विंश उद्धारः सर्वद्रव्याच्च यद्वरम् । ततोऽर्धं मध्यमस्य स्यात्तुरीयं तु यवीयसः
verses.transliteration: jyeShThasya vi.nsha uddhAraH sarvadravyAchcha yadvaram | tato.ardhaM madhyamasya syAtturIyaM tu yavIyasaH
verses.translation: The additional share (deducted) for the eldest shall be one-twentieth (of the estate) and the best of all chattels, for the middlemost half of that, but for the youngest one-fourth.
verses.hindi: यह व्यवस्था गो, घोड़ी, दासी, ऊंदवी, यकरी, भेड़, पक्षी और भैस की संतति में जाननी चाहिए । इस प्रकार चीज़ और योनि झापद्धमे कहा जाता है। स्व्रियो का आपद्धम, नियोग ।

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठश्चैव कनिष्ठश्च संहरेतां यथोदितम् । येऽन्ये ज्येष्ठकनिष्ठाभ्यां तेषां स्यान् मध्यमं धनम्
verses.transliteration: jyeShThashchaiva kaniShThashcha sa.nharetAM yathoditam | ye.anye jyeShThakaniShThAbhyAM teShAM syAn madhyamaM dhanam
verses.translation: Both the eldest and the youngest shall take (their shares) according to (the rule just) stated (each of) those who are between the eldest and the youngest, shall have the share (prescribed for the) middlemost.
verses.hindi: वीनां संकरं चक्रे कामोपहतचेतनः

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां धनजातानामाददीताग्र्यमग्रजः । यच्च सातिशयं किं चिद्दशतश्चाप्नुयाद्वरम्
verses.transliteration: sarveShAM dhanajAtAnAmAdadItAgryamagrajaH | yachcha sAtishayaM kiM chiddashatashchApnuyAdvaram
verses.translation: Among the goods of every kind the eldest shall take the best (article), and (even a single chattel) which is particularly good, as well as the best of ten (animals).
verses.hindi: ततः प्रमृति यो मोहाखमीतपतिका श्रियस् ।

verses.sanskrit: उद्धारो न दशस्वस्ति सम्पन्नानां स्वकर्मसु । यत्किं चिदेव देयं तु ज्यायसे मानवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: uddhAro na dashasvasti sampannAnAM svakarmasu | yatkiM chideva deyaM tu jyAyase mAnavardhanam
verses.translation: But among (brothers) equally skilled in their occupations, there is no additional share, (consisting of the best animal) among ten; some trifle only shall be given to the eldest as a token of respect.
verses.hindi: यदि नियोग करनेवाले दोनों शाख्विधि को छोड़कर सन- माचा व्यवहार करें तो पतित होते हे। और पुत्रवधू एरुपल्ली क साथ गमन करनेवाले माने जते हें. । द्विजातिया को विधवा खी का नियोग दूसरे वर्णघाले से न करना चाहिए । अन्य जाति से नि-

verses.sanskrit: एवं समुद्धृतोद्धारे समानंशान् प्रकल्पयेत् । उद्धारेऽनुद्धृते त्वेषामियं स्यादंशकल्पना
verses.transliteration: evaM samuddhR^itoddhAre samAna.nshAn prakalpayet | uddhAre.anuddhR^ite tveShAmiyaM syAda.nshakalpanA
verses.translation: If additional shares are thus deducted, one must allot equal shares (out of the residue to each); but if no deduction is made, the allotment of the shares among them shall be (made) in the following manner.
verses.hindi: शोषितो धमेकामार्थ पतीक्ष्ोऽशे नरः समा; । भवत वख पहने मन, बाणी, शरीर से शुद्ध -उस कन्या के साथ उसका देवर  गमन फरे और सस्तान होने तक आतुर्काल में उक्करीति से पक एक वार गमन करे.) चतुर पुरुष पक .चार”

verses.sanskrit: एकाधिकं हरेज्ज्येष्ठः पुत्रोऽध्यर्धं ततोऽनुजः । अंशमंशं यवीयांस इति धर्मो व्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: ekAdhikaM harejjyeShThaH putro.adhyardhaM tato.anujaH | a.nshama.nshaM yavIyA.nsa iti dharmo vyavasthitaH
verses.translation: Let the eldest son take one share in excess, the (brother) born next after him one (share) and a half, the younger ones one share each; thus the law is settled.
verses.hindi: ' इती श्रति के अभिप्राय से, वाग्दान, के बाद मर जाने पर देवर फे साथ विवाह मठ ने लिला है । इतका धर्ग वियोग नहीं है । यह मत स्वदेशी है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वेभ्योंशेभ्यस्तु कन्याभ्यः प्रदद्युर्भ्रातरः पृथक् । स्वाभ्यः स्वाभ्यस्तु स्वात्स्वादंशाच्चतुर्भागं पतिताः स्युरदित्सवः
verses.transliteration: svebhyo.nshebhyastu kanyAbhyaH pradadyurbhrAtaraH pR^ithak | svAbhyaH svAbhyastu svAtsvAda.nshAchchaturbhAgaM patitAH syuraditsavaH
verses.translation: But to the maiden (sisters) the brothers shall severally give (portions) out of their shares, each out of his share one-fourth part; those who refuse to give (it), will become outcasts.
verses.hindi: जो खी अपने जुआरी, मद्यप और रोगातुर पति की सेवा न करे उसके भूपण आदि लेकर तीन महीने के लिए त्याग दे। पति की सेवा करें उसको न त्यागे; न कोई चीज़ छीने .। जो खी मद्यप, डुराचारिणी, उलटा बर्ताव करनेवाली, रोगिणी मार पीट

verses.sanskrit: अजाविकं सेकशफं न जातु विषमं भजेत् । अजाविकं चैकशफं अजाविकं तु विषमं ज्येष्ठस्यैव विधीयते
verses.transliteration: ajAvikaM sekashaphaM na jAtu viShamaM bhajet | ajAvikaM chaikashaphaM ajAvikaM tu viShamaM jyeShThasyaiva vidhIyate
verses.translation: Let him never divide (the value of) a single goat or sheep, or a (single beast) with uncloven hoofs; it is prescribed (that) a single goat or sheep (remaining after an equal division, belongs) to the eldest alone.
verses.hindi: उन खिया में जो अपनी जाति को हो थे पतिसधा और धर्मकर्म करें; दूसरे जाति की कभी न करें । पर जो मूखेता से अपनी जाति फी खी रहते दूसरी से कर्म कराता है उसको चाएडाल समान जाने-यह ऋषियों ने कदा है ॥ ८६-८७ ॥

verses.sanskrit: अरक्षिता गृहे रुद्धाः पुरुषैराप्तकारिभिः । आत्मानमात्मना यास्तु रक्षेयुस्ताः सुरक्षिताः
verses.transliteration: arakShitA gR^ihe ruddhAH puruShairAptakAribhiH | AtmAnamAtmanA yAstu rakSheyustAH surakShitAH
verses.translation: Women, confined in the house under trustworthy and obedient servants, are not (well) guarded; but those who of their own accord keep guard over themselves, are well guarded.
verses.hindi: कुलीन, सुंदर और समान जाति का वर मिले तो पिता विचाह- योग्य अवस्था न होने पर भी शाळारीति से कन्यादान फर दे। शुणहीन बर को कभी दान त करे । यदि पिता शुणी चर मिलने  पर विवाह न करे और कल्या ऋतुमती होतो हो तो चह तीनवषे

verses.sanskrit: यवीयान्ज्येष्ठभार्यायां पुत्रमुत्पादयेद्यदि । समस्तत्र विभागः स्यादिति धर्मो व्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: yavIyAnjyeShThabhAryAyAM putramutpAdayedyadi | samastatra vibhAgaH syAditi dharmo vyavasthitaH
verses.translation: If a younger brother begets a son on the wife of the elder, the division must then be made equally; this the law is settled.
verses.hindi: धस का नाश होता हो तो शीघ्रदी' करले! पति देवताओं फी दी हुई खो को पाता है अपनी इच्छा से नहीं « इसलिए देवताओं घारणार्थ ख्रियों को रचा और सन्तान पैदा करने को पुरुष रचा इसलिय खो-पुरुप साथ मे' धर्माचरण करें--यह घेव में कदा है -।

verses.sanskrit: उपसर्जनं प्रधानस्य धर्मतो नोपपद्यते । पिता प्रधानं प्रजने तस्माद्धर्मेण तं भजेत्
verses.transliteration: upasarjanaM pradhAnasya dharmato nopapadyate | pitA pradhAnaM prajane tasmAddharmeNa taM bhajet
verses.translation: The representative (the son begotten on the wife) is not invested with the right of the principal (the eldest brother to an additional share); the principal (became) a father on the procreation (of a son by his younger brother); hence one should give a share to the (son begotten on the wife of the elder brother) according to the rule (stated above).
verses.hindi: एप धर्मः समासेन हेयः ल्लीपुसयोः परः

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रः कनिष्ठो ज्येष्ठायां कनिष्ठायां च पूर्वजः । कथं तत्र विभागः स्यादिति चेत्संशयो भवेत्
