verses.translation: All those tribes in this world, which are excluded from (the community of) those born from the mouth, the arms, the thighs, and the feet (of Brahman), are called Dasyus, whether they speak the language of the Mlekkhas (barbarians) or that of the Aryans.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: ये द्विजानामपसदा ये चापध्वंसजाः स्मृताः । ते निन्दितैर्वर्तयेयुर्द्विजानामेव कर्मभिः
verses.transliteration: ye dvijAnAmapasadA ye chApadhva.nsajAH smR^itAH | te ninditairvartayeyurdvijAnAmeva karmabhiH
verses.translation: Those who have been mentioned as the base-born (offspring, apasada) of Aryans, or as produced in consequence of a violation (of the law, apadhvamsaga), shall subsist by occupations reprehended by the twice-born.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: सूतानामश्वसारथ्यमम्बष्ठानां चिकित्सनम् । वैदेहकानां स्त्रीकार्यं मागधानां वणिक्पथः
verses.transliteration: sUtAnAmashvasArathyamambaShThAnAM chikitsanam | vaidehakAnAM strIkAryaM mAgadhAnAM vaNikpathaH
verses.translation: To Sutas (belongs) the management of horses and of chariots; to Ambashthas, the art of healing; to Vaidehakas, the service of women; to Magadhas, trade;
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्यघातो निषादानां त्वष्टिस्त्वायोगवस्य च । मेदान्ध्रचुञ्चुमद्गूनामारण्यपशुहिंसनम्
verses.transliteration: matsyaghAto niShAdAnAM tvaShTistvAyogavasya cha | medAndhrachu~nchumadgUnAmAraNyapashuhi.nsanam
verses.translation: Killing fish to Nishadas; carpenters' work to the Ayogava; to Medas, Andhras, Kunkus, and Madgus, the slaughter of wild animals;
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्त्र्युग्रपुक्कसानां तु बिलौकोवधबन्धनम् । धिग्वणानां चर्मकार्यं वेणानां भाण्डवादनम्
verses.transliteration: kShattryugrapukkasAnAM tu bilaukovadhabandhanam | dhigvaNAnAM charmakAryaM veNAnAM bhANDavAdanam
verses.translation: To Kshattris, Ugras, and Pukkasas, catching and killing (animals) living in holes; to Dhigvanas, working in leather; to Venas, playing drums.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: सर्ववर्णेषु तुल्यासु पत्नीष्वक्षतयोनिषु । आनुलोम्येन सम्भूता जात्या ज्ञेयास्त एव ते
verses.transliteration: sarvavarNeShu tulyAsu patnIShvakShatayoniShu | Anulomyena sambhUtA jAtyA j~neyAsta eva te
verses.translation: In all castes (varna) those (children) only which are begotten in the direct order on wedded wives, equal (in caste and married as) virgins, are to be considered as belonging to the same caste (as their fathers)
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: चैत्यद्रुमश्मशानेषु शैलेषूपवनेषु च । वसेयुरेते विज्ञाता वर्तयन्तः स्वकर्मभिः
verses.transliteration: chaityadrumashmashAneShu shaileShUpavaneShu cha | vaseyurete vij~nAtA vartayantaH svakarmabhiH
verses.translation: Near well-known trees and burial-grounds, on mountains and in groves, let these (tribes) dwell, known (by certain marks), and subsisting by their peculiar occupations.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: चण्डालश्वपचानां तु बहिर्ग्रामात्प्रतिश्रयः । अपपात्राश्च कर्तव्या धनमेषां श्वगर्दभम्
verses.transliteration: chaNDAlashvapachAnAM tu bahirgrAmAtpratishrayaH | apapAtrAshcha kartavyA dhanameShAM shvagardabham
verses.translation: But the dwellings of Kandalas and Svapakas shall be outside the village, they must be made Apapatras, and their wealth (shall be) dogs and donkeys.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: वासांसि मृतचैलानि भिन्नभाण्डेषु भोजनम् । कार्ष्णायसमलङ्कारः परिव्रज्या च नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: vAsA.nsi mR^itachailAni bhinnabhANDeShu bhojanam | kArShNAyasamala~NkAraH parivrajyA cha nityashaH
verses.translation: Their dress (shall be) the garments of the dead, (they shall eat) their food from broken dishes, black iron (shall be) their ornaments, and they must always wander from place to place.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: न तैः समयमन्विच्छेत्पुरुषो धर्ममाचरन् । व्यवहारो मिथस्तेषां विवाहः सदृशैः सह
verses.transliteration: na taiH samayamanvichChetpuruSho dharmamAcharan | vyavahAro mithasteShAM vivAhaH sadR^ishaiH saha
verses.translation: A man who fulfils a religious duty, shall not seek intercourse with them; their transactions (shall be) among themselves, and their marriages with their equals.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: अन्नमेषां पराधीनं देयं स्याद्भिन्नभाजने । रात्रौ न विचरेयुस्ते ग्रामेषु नगरेषु च
verses.transliteration: annameShAM parAdhInaM deyaM syAdbhinnabhAjane | rAtrau na vichareyuste grAmeShu nagareShu cha
verses.translation: Their food shall be given to them by others (than an Aryan giver) in a broken dish; at night they shall not walk about in villages and in towns.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: दिवा चरेयुः कार्यार्थं चिह्निता राजशासनैः । अबान्धवं शवं चैव निर्हरेयुरिति स्थितिः
verses.transliteration: divA chareyuH kAryArthaM chihnitA rAjashAsanaiH | abAndhavaM shavaM chaiva nirhareyuriti sthitiH
verses.translation: By day they may go about for the purpose of their work, distinguished by marks at the king's command, and they shall carry out the corpses (of persons) who have no relatives; that is a settled rule.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: वध्यांश्च हन्युः सततं यथाशास्त्रं नृपाज्ञया । वध्यवासांसि गृह्णीयुः शय्याश्चाभरणानि च
verses.transliteration: vadhyA.nshcha hanyuH satataM yathAshAstraM nR^ipAj~nayA | vadhyavAsA.nsi gR^ihNIyuH shayyAshchAbharaNAni cha
verses.translation: By the king's order they shall always execute the criminals, in accordance with the law, and they shall take for themselves the clothes, the beds, and the ornaments of (such) criminals.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: वर्णापेतमविज्ञातं नरं कलुषयोनिजम् । आर्यरूपमिवानार्यं कर्मभिः स्वैर्विभावयेत्
verses.transliteration: varNApetamavij~nAtaM naraM kaluShayonijam | AryarUpamivAnAryaM karmabhiH svairvibhAvayet
verses.translation: A man of impure origin, who belongs not to any caste, (varna, but whose character is) not known, who, (though) not an Aryan, has the appearance of an Aryan, one may discover by his acts.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: अनार्यता निष्ठुरता क्रूरता निष्क्रियात्मता । पुरुषं व्यञ्जयन्तीह लोके कलुषयोनिजम्
verses.transliteration: anAryatA niShThuratA krUratA niShkriyAtmatA | puruShaM vya~njayantIha loke kaluShayonijam
verses.translation: Behaviour unworthy of an Aryan, harshness, cruelty, and habitual neglect of the prescribed duties betray in this world a man of impure origin.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: पित्र्यं वा भजते शीलं मातुर्वोभयमेव वा । न कथं चन दुर्योनिः प्रकृतिं स्वां नियच्छति
verses.transliteration: pitryaM vA bhajate shIlaM mAturvobhayameva vA | na kathaM chana duryoniH prakR^itiM svAM niyachChati
verses.translation: A base-born man either resembles in character his father, or his mother, or both; he can never conceal his real nature.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीष्वनन्तरजातासु द्विजैरुत्पादितान् सुतान् । सदृशानेव तानाहुर्मातृदोषविगर्हितान्
verses.transliteration: strIShvanantarajAtAsu dvijairutpAditAn sutAn | sadR^ishAneva tAnAhurmAtR^idoShavigarhitAn
verses.translation: Sons, begotten by twice-born man on wives of the next lower castes, they declare to be similar (to their fathers, but) blamed on account of the fault (inherent) in their mothers.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: कुले मुख्येऽपि जातस्य यस्य स्याद्योनिसङ्करः । संश्रयत्येव तत्शीलं नरोऽल्पमपि वा बहु
verses.transliteration: kule mukhye.api jAtasya yasya syAdyonisa~NkaraH | sa.nshrayatyeva tatshIlaM naro.alpamapi vA bahu
verses.translation: Even if a man, born in a great family, sprang from criminal intercourse, he will certainly possess the faults of his (father), be they small or great.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: यत्र त्वेते परिध्वंसाज्जायन्ते वर्णदूषकाः । राष्ट्रिकैः सह तद्राष्ट्रं क्षिप्रमेव विनश्यति
verses.transliteration: yatra tvete paridhva.nsAjjAyante varNadUShakAH | rAShTrikaiH saha tadrAShTraM kShiprameva vinashyati
verses.translation: But that kingdom in which such bastards, sullying (the purity of) the castes, are born, perishes quickly together with its inhabitants.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: राष्ट्रियैः ब्राह्मणार्थे गवार्थे वा देहत्यागोऽनुपस्कृतः । स्त्रीबालाभ्युपपत्तौ च बाह्यानां सिद्धिकारणम्
verses.transliteration: rAShTriyaiH brAhmaNArthe gavArthe vA dehatyAgo.anupaskR^itaH | strIbAlAbhyupapattau cha bAhyAnAM siddhikAraNam
verses.translation: Dying, without the expectation of a reward, for the sake of Brahmanas and of cows, or in the defence of women and children, secures beatitude to those excluded (from the Aryan community, vahya.)
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीबालाभ्यवपत्तौ च अहिंसा सत्यमस्तेयं शौचमिन्द्रियनिग्रहः । एतं सामासिकं धर्मं चातुर्वर्ण्येऽब्रवीन् मनुः
verses.transliteration: strIbAlAbhyavapattau cha ahi.nsA satyamasteyaM shauchamindriyanigrahaH | etaM sAmAsikaM dharmaM chAturvarNye.abravIn manuH
verses.translation: Abstention from injuring (creatures), veracity, abstention from unlawfully appropriating (the goods of others), purity, and control of the organs, Manu has declared to be the summary of the law for the four castes.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: शूद्रायां ब्राह्मणाज्जातः श्रेयसा चेत्प्रजायते । अश्रेयान् श्रेयसीं जातिं गच्छत्या सप्तमाद्युगात्
verses.transliteration: shUdrAyAM brAhmaNAjjAtaH shreyasA chetprajAyate | ashreyAn shreyasIM jAtiM gachChatyA saptamAdyugAt
verses.translation: If (a female of the caste), sprung from a Brahmana and a Sudra female, bear (children) to one of the highest caste, the inferior (tribe) attains the highest caste within the seventh generation.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: शूद्रो ब्राह्मणतामेति ब्राह्मणश्चैति शूद्रताम् । क्षत्रियाज्जातमेवं तु विद्याद्वैश्यात्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: shUdro brAhmaNatAmeti brAhmaNashchaiti shUdratAm | kShatriyAjjAtamevaM tu vidyAdvaishyAttathaiva cha
verses.translation: (Thus) a Sudra attains the rank of a Brahmana, and (in a similar manner) a Brahmana sinks to the level of a Sudra; but know that it is the same with the offspring of a Kshatriya or of a Vaisya.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: अनार्यायां समुत्पन्नो ब्राह्मणात्तु यदृच्छया । ब्राह्मण्यामप्यनार्यात्तु श्रेयस्त्वं क्वेति चेद्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: anAryAyAM samutpanno brAhmaNAttu yadR^ichChayA | brAhmaNyAmapyanAryAttu shreyastvaM kveti chedbhavet
verses.translation: If (a doubt) should arise, with whom the preeminence (is, whether) with him whom an Aryan by chance begot on a non-Aryan female, or (with the son) of a Brahmana woman by a non-Aryan,
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: कस्य चिद्भवेत् जातो नार्यामनार्यायामार्यादार्यो भवेद्गुणैः । जातोऽप्यनार्यादार्यायामनार्य इति निश्चयः
verses.transliteration: kasya chidbhavet jAto nAryAmanAryAyAmAryAdAryo bhavedguNaiH | jAto.apyanAryAdAryAyAmanArya iti nishchayaH
verses.translation: The decision is as follows: 'He who was begotten by an Aryan on a non-Aryan female, may become (like to) an Aryan by his virtues; he whom an Aryan (mother) bore to a non-Aryan father (is and remains) unlike to an Aryan.'
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: तावुभावप्यसंस्कार्याविति धर्मो व्यवस्थितः । वैगुण्याज्जन्मनः पूर्व उत्तरः प्रतिलोमतः
verses.transliteration: tAvubhAvapyasa.nskAryAviti dharmo vyavasthitaH | vaiguNyAjjanmanaH pUrva uttaraH pratilomataH
verses.translation: The law prescribes that neither of the two shall receive the sacraments, the first (being excluded) on account of the lowness of his origin, the second (because the union of his parents was) against the order of the castes.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: जन्मतः सुबीजं चैव सुक्षेत्रे जातं सम्पद्यते यथा । तथाऽर्याज्जात आर्यायां सर्वं संस्कारमर्हति
verses.transliteration: janmataH subIjaM chaiva sukShetre jAtaM sampadyate yathA | tathA.aryAjjAta AryAyAM sarvaM sa.nskAramarhati
verses.translation: As good seed, springing up in good soil, turns out perfectly well, even so the son of an Aryan by an Aryan woman is worthy of all the sacraments.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तरासु जातानां विधिरेष सनातनः । द्व्येकान्तरासु जातानां धर्म्यं विद्यादिमं विधिम्
verses.transliteration: anantarAsu jAtAnAM vidhireSha sanAtanaH | dvyekAntarAsu jAtAnAM dharmyaM vidyAdimaM vidhim
verses.translation: Such is the eternal law concerning (children) born of wives one degree lower (than their husbands); know (that) the following rule (is applicable) to those born of women two or three degrees lower.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: बीजमेके प्रशंसन्ति क्षेत्रमन्ये मनीषिणः । बीजक्षेत्रे तथैवान्ये तत्रैयं तु व्यवस्थितिः
verses.transliteration: bIjameke prasha.nsanti kShetramanye manIShiNaH | bIjakShetre tathaivAnye tatraiyaM tu vyavasthitiH
verses.translation: Some sages declare the seed to be more important, and others the field; again others (assert that) the seed and the field (are equally important); but the legal decision on this point is as follows:
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: अक्षेत्रे बीजमुत्सृष्टमन्तरैव विनश्यति । अबीजकमपि क्षेत्रं केवलं स्थण्डिलं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: akShetre bIjamutsR^iShTamantaraiva vinashyati | abIjakamapi kShetraM kevalaM sthaNDilaM bhavet
verses.translation: Seed, sown on barren ground, perishes in it; a (fertile) field also, in which no (good) seed (is sown), will remain barren.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: यस्माद्बीजप्रभावेण तिर्यग्जा ऋषयोऽभवन् । पूजिताश्च प्रशस्ताश्च तस्माद्बीजं प्रशस्यते
verses.transliteration: yasmAdbIjaprabhAveNa tiryagjA R^iShayo.abhavan | pUjitAshcha prashastAshcha tasmAdbIjaM prashasyate
verses.translation: As through the power of the seed (sons) born of animals became sages who are honoured and praised, hence the seed is declared to be more important.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: विशिष्यते) अनार्यमार्यकर्माणमार्यं चानार्यकर्मिणम् । सम्प्रधार्याब्रवीद्धाता न समौ नासमाविति
verses.transliteration: vishiShyate) anAryamAryakarmANamAryaM chAnAryakarmiNam | sampradhAryAbravIddhAtA na samau nAsamAviti
verses.translation: Having considered (the case of) a non-Aryan who acts like an Aryan, and (that of) an Aryan who acts like a non-Aryan, the creator declared, 'Those two are neither equal nor unequal.'
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणा ब्रह्मयोनिस्था ये स्वकर्मण्यवस्थिताः । ते सम्यगुपजीवेयुः षट् कर्माणि यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNA brahmayonisthA ye svakarmaNyavasthitAH | te samyagupajIveyuH ShaT karmANi yathAkramam
verses.translation: Brahmanas who are intent on the means (of gaining union with) Brahman and firm in (discharging) their duties, shall live by duly performing the following six acts, (which are enumerated) in their (proper) order.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: अध्यापनमध्ययनं यजनं याजनं तथा । दानं प्रतिग्रहश्चैव षट् कर्माण्यग्रजन्मनः
verses.transliteration: adhyApanamadhyayanaM yajanaM yAjanaM tathA | dAnaM pratigrahashchaiva ShaT karmANyagrajanmanaH
verses.translation: Teaching, studying, sacrificing for himself, sacrificing for others, making gifts and receiving them are the six acts (prescribed) for a Brahmana.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: षण्णां तु कर्मणामस्य त्रीणि कर्माणि जीविका । याजनाध्यापने चैव विशुद्धाच्च प्रतिग्रहः
verses.transliteration: ShaNNAM tu karmaNAmasya trINi karmANi jIvikA | yAjanAdhyApane chaiva vishuddhAchcha pratigrahaH
verses.translation: But among the six acts (ordained) for him three are his means of subsistence, (viz.) sacrificing for others, teaching, and accepting gifts from pure men.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: त्रयो धर्मा निवर्तन्ते ब्राह्मणात्क्षत्रियं प्रति । अध्यापनं याजनं च तृतीयश्च प्रतिग्रहः
verses.transliteration: trayo dharmA nivartante brAhmaNAtkShatriyaM prati | adhyApanaM yAjanaM cha tR^itIyashcha pratigrahaH
verses.translation: (Passing) from the Brahmana to the Kshatriya, three acts (incumbent on the former) are forbidden, (viz.) teaching, sacrificing for others, and, thirdly, the acceptance of gifts.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यं प्रति तथैवैते निवर्तेरन्निति स्थितिः । न तौ प्रति हि तान् धर्मान् मनुराह प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: vaishyaM prati tathaivaite nivarteranniti sthitiH | na tau prati hi tAn dharmAn manurAha prajApatiH
verses.translation: The same are likewise forbidden to a Vaisya, that is a settled rule; for Manu, the lord of creatures (Pragapati), has not prescribed them for (men of) those two (castes).
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: प्रति हितान् धर्मान् शस्त्रास्त्रभृत्त्वं क्षत्रस्य वणिक्पशुकृषिर्विषः । आजीवनार्थं धर्मस्तु दानमध्ययनं यजिः
verses.transliteration: prati hitAn dharmAn shastrAstrabhR^ittvaM kShatrasya vaNikpashukR^iShirviShaH | AjIvanArthaM dharmastu dAnamadhyayanaM yajiH
verses.translation: To carry arms for striking and for throwing (is prescribed) for Kshatriyas as a means of subsistence; to trade, (to rear) cattle, and agriculture for Vaisyas; but their duties are liberality, the study of the Veda, and the performance of sacrifices.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणाद्वैश्यकन्यायामम्बष्ठो नाम जायते । निषादः शूद्रकन्यायां यः पारशव उच्यते
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNAdvaishyakanyAyAmambaShTho nAma jAyate | niShAdaH shUdrakanyAyAM yaH pArashava uchyate
verses.translation: From a Brahmana a with the daughter of a Vaisya is born (a son) called an Ambashtha, with the daughter of a sudra a Nishada, who is also called Parasava.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: वेदाभ्यासो ब्राह्मणस्य क्षत्रियस्य च रक्षणम् । वार्ताकर्मैव वैश्यस्य विशिष्टानि स्वकर्मसु
verses.transliteration: vedAbhyAso brAhmaNasya kShatriyasya cha rakShaNam | vArtAkarmaiva vaishyasya vishiShTAni svakarmasu
verses.translation: Among the several occupations the most commendable are, teaching the Veda for a Brahmana, protecting (the people) for a Kshatriya, and trade for a Vaisya.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: अजीवंस्तु यथोक्तेन ब्राह्मणः स्वेन कर्मणा । जीवेत्क्षत्रियधर्मेण स ह्यस्य प्रत्यनन्तरः
verses.transliteration: ajIva.nstu yathoktena brAhmaNaH svena karmaNA | jIvetkShatriyadharmeNa sa hyasya pratyanantaraH
verses.translation: But a Brahmana, unable to subsist by his peculiar occupations just mentioned, may live according to the law applicable to Kshatriyas; for the latter is next to him in rank.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: उभाभ्यामप्यजीवंस्तु कथं स्यादिति चेद्भवेत् । कृषिगोरक्षमास्थाय जीवेद्वैश्यस्य जीविकाम्
verses.transliteration: ubhAbhyAmapyajIva.nstu kathaM syAditi chedbhavet | kR^iShigorakShamAsthAya jIvedvaishyasya jIvikAm
verses.translation: If it be asked, 'How shall it be, if he cannot maintain himself by either (of these occupations?' the answer is), he may adopt a Vaisya's mode of life, employing himself in agriculture and rearing cattle.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यवृत्त्याऽपि जीवंस्तु ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियोऽपि वा । हिंसाप्रायां पराधीनां कृषिं यत्नेन वर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: vaishyavR^ittyA.api jIva.nstu brAhmaNaH kShatriyo.api vA | hi.nsAprAyAM parAdhInAM kR^iShiM yatnena varjayet
verses.translation: But a Brahmana, or a Kshatriya, living by a Vaisya's mode of subsistence, shall carefully avoid (the pursuit of) agriculture, (which causes) injury to many beings and depends on others.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: कृषिं साधुइति मन्यन्ते सा वृत्तिः सद्विगर्हिताः । भूमिं भूमिशयांश्चैव हन्ति काष्ठमयोमुखम्
verses.transliteration: kR^iShiM sAdhuiti manyante sA vR^ittiH sadvigarhitAH | bhUmiM bhUmishayA.nshchaiva hanti kAShThamayomukham
verses.translation: (Some) declare that agriculture is something excellent, (but) that means of subsistence is blamed by the virtuous; (for) the wooden (implement) with iron point injuries the earth and (the beings) living in the earth.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: इदं तु वृत्तिवैकल्यात्त्यजतो धर्मनैपुणम् । विट्पण्यमुद्धृतोद्धारं विक्रेयं वित्तवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: idaM tu vR^ittivaikalyAttyajato dharmanaipuNam | viTpaNyamuddhR^itoddhAraM vikreyaM vittavardhanam
verses.translation: But he who, through a want of means of subsistence, gives up the strictness with respect to his duties, may sell, in order to increase his wealth, the commodities sold by Vaisyas, making (however) the (following) exceptions.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: सर्वान् रसानपोहेत कृतान्नं च तिलैः सह । अश्मनो लवणं चैव पशवो ये च मानुषाः
verses.transliteration: sarvAn rasAnapoheta kR^itAnnaM cha tilaiH saha | ashmano lavaNaM chaiva pashavo ye cha mAnuShAH
verses.translation: He must avoid (selling) condiments of all sorts, cooked food and sesamum, stones, salt, cattle, and human (beings),
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं च तान्तवं रक्तं शाणक्षौमाविकानि च । अपि चेत्स्युररक्तानि फलमूले तथौषधीः
verses.transliteration: sarvaM cha tAntavaM raktaM shANakShaumAvikAni cha | api chetsyuraraktAni phalamUle tathauShadhIH
verses.translation: All dyed cloth, as well as cloth made of hemp, or flax, or wool, even though they be not dyed, fruit, roots, and (medical) herbs
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: अपः शस्त्रं विषं मांसं सोमं गन्धांश्च सर्वशः । क्षीरं क्षौद्रं दधि घृतं तैलं मधु गुडं कुशान्
verses.transliteration: apaH shastraM viShaM mA.nsaM somaM gandhA.nshcha sarvashaH | kShIraM kShaudraM dadhi ghR^itaM tailaM madhu guDaM kushAn
verses.translation: Water, weapons, poison, meat, Soma, and perfumes of all kinds, fresh milk, honey, sour milk, clarified butter, oil, wax, sugar, Kusa-grass;
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: आरण्यांश्च पशून् सर्वान् दंष्ट्रिणश्च वयांसि च । मद्यं नीलिं च लाक्षां च सर्वांश्चैकशफांस्तथा
verses.transliteration: AraNyA.nshcha pashUn sarvAn da.nShTriNashcha vayA.nsi cha | madyaM nIliM cha lAkShAM cha sarvA.nshchaikashaphA.nstathA
verses.translation: All beasts of the forest, animals with fangs or tusks, birds, spirituous liquor, indigo, lac, and all one-hoofed beasts.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रियात्शूद्रकन्यायां क्रूराचारविहारवान् । क्षत्रशूद्रवपुर्जन्तुरुग्रो नाम प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: kShatriyAtshUdrakanyAyAM krUrAchAravihAravAn | kShatrashUdravapurjanturugro nAma prajAyate
verses.translation: From a Kshatriya and the daughter of a Sudra springs a being, called Ugra, resembling both a Kshatriya and a Sudra, ferocious in his manners, and delighting in cruelty.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: नीलीं काममुत्पाद्य कृष्यां तु स्वयमेव कृषीवलः । विक्रीणीत तिलांशूद्रान् धर्मार्थमचिरस्थितान्
verses.transliteration: nIlIM kAmamutpAdya kR^iShyAM tu svayameva kR^iShIvalaH | vikrINIta tilA.nshUdrAn dharmArthamachirasthitAn
verses.translation: But he who subsists by agriculture, may at pleasure sell unmixed sesamum grains for sacred purposes, provided he himself has grown them and has not kept them long.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: तिलांशुद्धान् भोजनाभ्यञ्जनाद्दानाद्यदन्यत्कुरुते तिलैः । कृमिभूतः श्वविष्ठायां पितृभिः सह मज्जति
verses.transliteration: tilA.nshuddhAn bhojanAbhya~njanAddAnAdyadanyatkurute tilaiH | kR^imibhUtaH shvaviShThAyAM pitR^ibhiH saha majjati
verses.translation: If he applies sesamum to any other purpose but food, anointing, and charitable gifts, he will be born (again) as a worm and, together with his ancestors, be plunged into the ordure of dogs.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: सद्यः पतति मांसेन लाक्षया लवणेन च । त्र्यहेण शूद्रो भवति ब्राह्मणः क्षीरविक्रयात्
verses.transliteration: sadyaH patati mA.nsena lAkShayA lavaNena cha | tryaheNa shUdro bhavati brAhmaNaH kShIravikrayAt
verses.translation: By (selling) flesh, salt, and lac a Brahmana at once becomes an outcast; by selling milk he becomes (equal to) a Sudra in three days.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: इतरेषां तु पण्यानां विक्रयादिह कामतः । ब्राह्मणः सप्तरात्रेण वैश्यभावं नियच्छति
verses.transliteration: itareShAM tu paNyAnAM vikrayAdiha kAmataH | brAhmaNaH saptarAtreNa vaishyabhAvaM niyachChati
verses.translation: But by willingly selling in this world other (forbidden) commodities, a Brahmana assumes after seven nights the character of a Vaisya.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: रसा रसैर्निमातव्या न त्वेव लवणं रसैः । कृतान्नं च कृतान्नेन तिला धान्येन तत्समाः
verses.transliteration: rasA rasairnimAtavyA na tveva lavaNaM rasaiH | kR^itAnnaM cha kR^itAnnena tilA dhAnyena tatsamAH
verses.translation: Condiments may be bartered for condiments, but by no means salt for (other) condiments; cooked food (may be exchanged) for (other kinds of) cooked food, and sesamum seeds for grain in equal quantities.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: जीवेदेतेन राजन्यः सर्वेणाप्यनयं गतः । न त्वेव ज्यायंसीं वृत्तिमभिमन्येत कर्हि चित्
verses.transliteration: jIvedetena rAjanyaH sarveNApyanayaM gataH | na tveva jyAya.nsIM vR^ittimabhimanyeta karhi chit
verses.translation: A Kshatriya who has fallen into distress, may subsist by all these (means); but he must never arrogantly adopt the mode of life (prescribed for his) betters.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: यो लोभादधमो जात्या जीवेदुत्कृष्टकर्मभिः । तं राजा निर्धनं कृत्वा क्षिप्रमेव प्रवासयेत्
verses.transliteration: yo lobhAdadhamo jAtyA jIvedutkR^iShTakarmabhiH | taM rAjA nirdhanaM kR^itvA kShiprameva pravAsayet
verses.translation: A man of low caste who through covetousness lives by the occupations of a higher one, the king shall deprive of his property and banish.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: वरं स्वधर्मो विगुणो न पारक्यः स्वनुष्ठितः । विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वधिष्ठितात् परधर्मेण जीवन् हि सद्यः पतति जातितः
verses.transliteration: varaM svadharmo viguNo na pArakyaH svanuShThitaH | viguNaH paradharmAtsvadhiShThitAt paradharmeNa jIvan hi sadyaH patati jAtitaH
verses.translation: It is better (to discharge) one's own (appointed) duty incompletely than to perform completely that of another; for he who lives according to the law of another (caste) is instantly excluded from his own.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: वैश्योऽजीवन् स्वधर्मेण शूद्रवृत्त्याऽपि वर्तयेत् । अनाचरन्नकार्याणि निवर्तेत च शक्तिमान्
verses.transliteration: vaishyo.ajIvan svadharmeNa shUdravR^ittyA.api vartayet | anAcharannakAryANi nivarteta cha shaktimAn
verses.translation: A Vaisya who is unable to subsist by his own duties, may even maintain himself by a Sudra's mode of life, avoiding (however) acts forbidden (to him), and he should give it up, when he is able (to do so).
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: अशक्नुवंस्तु शुश्रूषां शूद्रः कर्तुं द्विजन्मनाम् । पुत्रदारात्ययं प्राप्तो जीवेत्कारुककर्मभिः
verses.transliteration: ashaknuva.nstu shushrUShAM shUdraH kartuM dvijanmanAm | putradArAtyayaM prApto jIvetkArukakarmabhiH
verses.translation: But a Sudra, being unable to find service with the twice-born and threatened with the loss of his sons and wife (through hunger), may maintain himself by handicrafts.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को

verses.sanskrit: सान्तानिकं यक्ष्यमाणमध्वगं सार्ववेदसम् । गुर्वर्थं पितृमात्र्यर्थं स्वाध्यायार्थ्युपतापिनः
verses.transliteration: sAntAnikaM yakShyamANamadhvagaM sArvavedasam | gurvarthaM pitR^imAtryarthaM svAdhyAyArthyupatApinaH
verses.translation: Him who wishes (to marry for the sake of having) offspring, him who wishes to perform a sacrifice, a traveller, him who has given away all his property, him who begs for the sake of his teacher, his father, or his mother, a student of the Veda, and a sick man,
verses.hindi: यो वैश्यः स्थाइहुएशुहीनक्रतुरसोमपः ।

verses.sanskrit: भृत्यानामुपरोधेन यत्करोत्यौर्ध्वदेहिकम् । तद्भवत्यसुखौदर्कं जीवतश्च मृतस्य च
verses.transliteration: bhR^ityAnAmuparodhena yatkarotyaurdhvadehikam | tadbhavatyasukhaudarkaM jIvatashcha mR^itasya cha
verses.translation: If (a man) does anything for the sake of his happiness in another world, to the detriment of those whom he is bound to maintain, that produces evil results for him, both while he lives and when he is dead.
verses.hindi: इससे कम द्रव्य होने में जो द्विज सोमयाग करता है उसका पहला सोमयश सी नहीं पूरा पड़ता । इसलिए दूसरा कसी न करे! जो कुडुम्य को दुःखी होते दुसरो को घन देता है, बद पहले तो अच्छा लगता है, परन्तु परिणाम में विष के स्वाद छा भयानक

verses.sanskrit: गृहीत्वा मुसलं राजा सकृद्धन्यात्तु तं स्वयम् । वधेन शुध्यति स्तेनो ब्राह्मणस्तपसैव तु
verses.transliteration: gR^ihItvA musalaM rAjA sakR^iddhanyAttu taM svayam | vadhena shudhyati steno brAhmaNastapasaiva tu
verses.translation: A Brahmana who has stolen the gold (of a Brahmana) shall go to the king and, confessing his deed, say, 'Lord, punish me!'
verses.hindi: तथेव ससमे भक्के भक्तानि षडनक्षता। जो अस्तिहोत्री नही है ओर सौ १०० गौ का घन रखता है ओर जिसते यज्ञ न किया हो, पर हज़ार १००० गौ का धन हो, उन दोनों के घर से भी घन लेवा चादिण जो ब्राह्मण नित्य दान

verses.sanskrit: तपसापनुनुत्सुस्तु सुवर्णस्तेयजं मलम् । चीरवासा द्विजोऽरण्ये चरेद्ब्रह्महनो व्रतम्
verses.transliteration: tapasApanunutsustu suvarNasteyajaM malam | chIravAsA dvijo.araNye charedbrahmahano vratam
verses.translation: Taking (from him) the club (which he must carry), the king himself shall strike him once, by his death the thief becomes pure; or a Brahmana (may purify himself) by austerities.
verses.hindi: खल ( खरिहान ) खेत या घर से या कहीं से अन्न लावे और हाण फा धन कभी न छीनना चाहिए । यदि निर्वाह न होसके तो दूसरे कुकर्मियों से धन ले लेय । जो पुरुष यक्षादि धर्म न करने घालों से धन लेकर धर्माचारी सत्युषों को देता है बह अपने को

verses.sanskrit: एतैर्व्रतैरपोहेत पापं स्तेयकृतं द्विजः । गुरुस्त्रीगमनीयं तु व्रतैरेभिरपानुदेत्
verses.transliteration: etairvratairapoheta pApaM steyakR^itaM dvijaH | gurustrIgamanIyaM tu vratairebhirapAnudet
verses.translation: He who desires to remove by austerities the guilt of stealing the gold (of a Brahmana), shall perform the penance (prescribed) for the slayer of a Brahmana, (living) in a forest and dressed in (garments) made of bark.
verses.hindi: स पापात्मा परे लोके रभोच्छिष्टेन जीवति ॥ २६.॥ कानां पशुसोमानां निष्छृत्यथमसस्मवे

verses.sanskrit: गुरुतल्प्यभिभाष्यैनस्तप्ते स्वप्यादयोमये । तल्पे स्वप्याद् सूर्मीं ज्वलन्तीं स्वाश्लिष्येन् मृत्युना स विशुध्यति
verses.transliteration: gurutalpyabhibhAShyainastapte svapyAdayomaye | talpe svapyAd sUrmIM jvalantIM svAshliShyen mR^ityunA sa vishudhyati
verses.translation: By these penances a twice-born man may remove the guilt incurred by a theft (of gold); but he may atone for connexion with a Guru's wife by the following penances.
verses.hindi: जो आहण यज्ञ फे लिए घन सांगकर यज्ञ में -चहीं लगाता चह भरकर सौ वर्ष साख वा कौआ की योनि में रहता है । जो देवा- पण या अह्याप॑ण किये धन को लोभ से खाजाता है चह पापात्मा : परलोक में गीघ की जूंठन से-जीता है । पशुयाग या सोमयाग

verses.sanskrit: वाऽश्लिष्येन् स्वयं वा शिष्णवृषणावुत्कृत्याधाय चाञ्जलौ । नैर्{ऋ}तीं दिशमातिष्ठेदा निपातादजिह्मगः
verses.transliteration: vA.ashliShyen svayaM vA shiShNavR^iShaNAvutkR^ityAdhAya chA~njalau | nair{R^i}tIM dishamAtiShThedA nipAtAdajihmagaH
verses.translation: He who has violated his Guru's bed, shall, after confessing his crime, extend himself on a heated iron bed, or embrace the red-hot image (of a woman); by dying he becomes pure;
verses.hindi: करता है उस दुर्दुद्धि को उस धर्म का फल परलोक में नहीं मि- उन अ्पकारियों को अपने सामर्थ्यं सेही दरड देवे । तपशाकि द्विज को अपनी ही शक्ति से शत्रु दमन करना चाहिए॥ ३०-३२ ॥

verses.sanskrit: खट्वाङ्गी चीरवासा वा श्मश्रुलो विजने वने । प्राजापत्यं चरेत्कृच्छ्रमब्दमेकं समाहितः
verses.transliteration: khaTvA~NgI chIravAsA vA shmashrulo vijane vane | prAjApatyaM charetkR^ichChramabdamekaM samAhitaH
verses.translation: Or, having himself cut off his organ and his testicles and having taken them in his joined hands, he may walk straight towards the region of Nirriti (the south-west), until he falls down (dead);
verses.hindi: नाश करे । झनिय अपने शुजवल से, वैश्य और श्र अन से और उसको कोई बुरी वात या रूखी वात.न कहे  करवा, युवता, थोडा न करे । यदि ये-सव होता किये जायें तो खुद और जिसका अग्नि- होच हो बह दोनों नरकगामी होते हैं । इस कारण श्रौतकर्म में

verses.sanskrit: चान्द्रायणं वा त्रीन् मासानभ्यस्येन्नियतैन्द्रियः । हविष्येण यवाग्वा वा गुरुतल्पापनुत्तये
verses.transliteration: chAndrAyaNaM vA trIn mAsAnabhyasyenniyataindriyaH | haviShyeNa yavAgvA vA gurutalpApanuttaye
verses.translation: Or, carrying the foot of a bedstead, dressed in (garments of) bark and allowing his beard to grow, he may, with a concentrated mind, perform during a whole year the Krikkhra (or hard, penance), revealed by Pragapati, in a lonely forest;
verses.hindi: पति देवताचाले अश्व का दान नहीं करता चह अग्न्याधान फल नाश करता है। इस कारण थाइ धनवांला यज्ञ न करे ॥8८-छंव्यीं

verses.sanskrit: एतैर्व्रतैरपोहेयुर्महापातकिनो मलम् । उपपातकिनस्त्वेवमेभिर्नानाविधैर्व्रतैः
verses.transliteration: etairvratairapoheyurmahApAtakino malam | upapAtakinastvevamebhirnAnAvidhairvrataiH
verses.translation: Or, controlling his organs, he may during three months continuously perform the lunar penance, (subsisting) on sacrificial food or barley-gruel, in order to remove (the guilt of) violating a Guru's bed.
verses.hindi: पद् अन विहित कर दाता दुगा संतरेत्

verses.sanskrit: उपपातकसंयुक्तो गोघ्नो मासं यवान् पिबेत् । कृतवापो वसेद्गोष्ठे चर्मणा तेन संवृतः
verses.transliteration: upapAtakasa.nyukto goghno mAsaM yavAn pibet | kR^itavApo vasedgoShThe charmaNA tena sa.nvR^itaH
verses.translation: By means of these penances men who have committed mortal sins (Mahapataka) may remove their guilt, but those who committed minor offences, causing loss of caste, (Upapataka, can do it) by the various following penances.
verses.hindi: अकामतः कृते पापे प्रायश्चित्तं बिदुवुधाः ।  कामकारकृतेःप्याहुरेके श्रुतिनिदशनात्

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्थकालमश्नीयादक्षारलवणं मितम् । गोमूत्रेणाचरेत्स्नानं द्वौ मासौ नियतेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: chaturthakAlamashnIyAdakShAralavaNaM mitam | gomUtreNAcharetsnAnaM dvau mAsau niyatendriyaH
verses.translation: He who has committed a minor offence by slaying a cow (or bull) shall drink during (the first) month (a decoction of) barley-grains; having shaved all his hair, and covering himself with the hide (of the slain cow), he must live in a cow-house.
verses.hindi: अकामतः कृतं पापं वेदाभ्यासेन शुद्धति।   कामतस्तु छतं सोहाआयश्वितेः एथम्विधेः

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञश्चेत्प्रतिरुद्धः स्यादेकेनाङ्गेन यज्वनः । ब्राह्मणस्य विशेषेन धार्मिके सति राजनि
verses.transliteration: yaj~nashchetpratiruddhaH syAdekenA~Ngena yajvanaH | brAhmaNasya visheShena dhArmike sati rAjani
verses.translation: If a sacrifice, (offered) by (any twice-born) sacrificer, (and) especially by a Brahmana, must remain incomplete through (the want of) one requisite, while a righteous king rules,
verses.hindi: है श्रगिनिद्दोत्री राहण यदि जान-वूभकर दोनों काल हवन न करे फरना पुरत्या के समान है । जो आहण शूद्ध से धन लेकर दियो में विदित होते हैं । शद्रघन से अम्विउपासना करनेवाले मूख ब्राझणां के मस्तक पर घनदाता-शुद्ध पैर रखकर परलोक

verses.sanskrit: दिवाऽनुगच्छेद्गास्तास्तु तिष्ठन्नूर्ध्वं रजः पिबेत् । शुश्रूषित्वा नमस्कृत्य रात्रौ वीरासनं वसेत्
verses.transliteration: divA.anugachChedgAstAstu tiShThannUrdhvaM rajaH pibet | shushrUShitvA namaskR^itya rAtrau vIrAsanaM vaset
verses.translation: During the two (following) months he shall eat a small (quantity of food) without any factitious salt at every fourth meal-time, and shall bathe in the urine of cows, keeping his organs under control.
verses.hindi: इह दुश्चरिते-केवित्केवितूवैकृतेस्तथा ।

verses.sanskrit: वीरासनो तिष्ठन्तीष्वनुतिष्ठेत्तु व्रजन्तीष्वप्यनुव्रजेत् । आसीनासु तथाऽसीनो नियतो वीतमत्सरः
verses.transliteration: vIrAsano tiShThantIShvanutiShThettu vrajantIShvapyanuvrajet | AsInAsu tathA.asIno niyato vItamatsaraH
verses.translation: During the day he shall follow the cows and, standing upright, inhale the dust (raised by their hoofs); at night, after serving and worshipping them, he shall remain in the (posture, called) virasana.
verses.hindi: होकर चिना उसको किये सजना के साथ ससग न करे । कोई बिकारों को पाते है ॥ ४७--४८॥

verses.sanskrit: आतुरामभिशस्तां वा चौरव्याघ्रादिभिर्भयैः । पतितां पङ्कलग्नां वा सर्वौपायैर्विमोचयेत्
verses.transliteration: AturAmabhishastAM vA chauravyAghrAdibhirbhayaiH | patitAM pa~NkalagnAM vA sarvaupAyairvimochayet
verses.translation: Controlling himself and free from anger, he must stand when they stand, follow them when they walk, and seat himself when they lie down.
verses.hindi: दीपहती भवेदन्धः काणो निर्वापको भवेत् ।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वप्राणैर्विमोचयेत् उष्णे वर्षति शीते वा मारुते वाति वा भृशम् । न कुर्वीतात्मनस्त्राणं गोरकृत्वा तु शक्तितः
verses.transliteration: sarvaprANairvimochayet uShNe varShati shIte vA mArute vAti vA bhR^isham | na kurvItAtmanastrANaM gorakR^itvA tu shaktitaH
verses.translation: (When a cow is) sick, or is threatened by danger from thieves, tigers, and the like, or falls, or sticks in a morass, he must relieve her by all possible means:
verses.hindi: सोना का चोर बुरे नलोचाला, शराबी काले दातोबाला, बह्म- हत्यारा, क्षयरोगी ओर शुरु खी-गामी चर्मरोंगी होता है । चुगल को नाक खड़ती हे, झूठे निदक का सुख दुगन्घयुक्त होता है । श्वेतकुष्ठी ओर घोड़े का चोर लूला होता है । दाप चुरानेचाला

verses.sanskrit: आत्मनो यदि वाऽन्येषां गृहे क्षेत्रेऽथ वा खले । भक्षयन्तीं न कथयेत्पिबन्तं चैव वत्सकम्
verses.transliteration: Atmano yadi vA.anyeShAM gR^ihe kShetre.atha vA khale | bhakShayantIM na kathayetpibantaM chaiva vatsakam
verses.translation: In heat, in rain, or in cold, or when the wind blows violently, he must not seek to shelter himself, without (first) sheltering the cows according to his ability.
verses.hindi: मद्यपान, खुवशे की चोरी, शुरुत्री से व्यभिचार और इन सहा" पापों के करनेचाले का संसर्ग ये सब महापातक कहे हैं  अपनी बड़ाई मै झूँठ कहना, राजा से किली की चुगली करना और शुरू को भूंडा दोष लगाना--ये पाप ब्रह्महत्या के समाज है ॥९४--५६॥

verses.sanskrit: अनेन विधिना यस्तु गोघ्नो गामनुगच्छति । स गोहत्याकृतं पापं त्रिभिर्मासैर्व्यपोहति
verses.transliteration: anena vidhinA yastu goghno gAmanugachChati | sa gohatyAkR^itaM pApaM tribhirmAsairvyapohati
verses.translation: Let him not say (a word), if a cow eats (anything) in his own or another's house or field or on the threshing-floor, or if a calf drinks (milk).
verses.hindi: हिंसौषधीनां सत्र्याजीवोऽभिचारो सूलकर्स च

verses.sanskrit: वृषभैकादशा गाश्च दद्यात्सुचरितव्रतः । अविद्यमाने सर्वस्वं वेदविद्भ्यो निवेदयेत्
verses.transliteration: vR^iShabhaikAdashA gAshcha dadyAtsucharitavrataH | avidyamAne sarvasvaM vedavidbhyo nivedayet
verses.translation: The slayer of a cow who serves cows in this manner, removes after three months the guilt which he incurred by killing a cow.
verses.hindi: वेद को भूलज्ञाना, वेद की निंदा करता, सूँठी गचाही देना, समान हैं । धरोहर का मारना, मनुष्य, घोड़ा, चांदी, भूमि, हीरा अर मणि चुराना सुवर्णचोरी के माफिक है । सहोदर वहन, कुमारी कन्या, चाएडालिनी, मित्र और पुत्र की खी खे समागम

verses.sanskrit: एतदेव व्रतं कुर्युरुपपातकिनो द्विजाः । अवकीर्णिवर्ज्यं शुद्ध्यर्थं चान्द्रायणमथापि वा
verses.transliteration: etadeva vrataM kuryurupapAtakino dvijAH | avakIrNivarjyaM shuddhyarthaM chAndrAyaNamathApi vA
verses.translation: But after he has fully performed the penance, he must give to (Brahmanas) learned in the Veda ten cows and a bull, (or) if he does not possess (so much property) he must offer to them all he has.
verses.hindi: जेल च मेयुनं पुंसि जातिश्रंशुकर स्सृतस॒

verses.sanskrit: अवकीर्णिवर्जं अवकीर्णी तु काणेन गर्दभेन चतुष्पथे । पाकयज्ञविधानेन यजेत निर्{ऋ}तिं निशि
verses.transliteration: avakIrNivarjaM avakIrNI tu kANena gardabhena chatuShpathe | pAkayaj~navidhAnena yajeta nir{R^i}tiM nishi
verses.translation: Twice-born men who have committed (other) minor offences (Upapataka), except a student who has broken his vow (Avakirnin), may perform, in order to purify themselves, the same penance or also a lunar penance.
verses.hindi: संकरीकरशं सेयं सीनाहिसहिषस्य च

verses.sanskrit: हुत्वाऽग्नौ विधिवधोमानन्ततश्च समित्यृचा । वातेन्द्रगुरुवह्नीनां जुहुयात्सर्पिषाऽहुतीः
verses.transliteration: hutvA.agnau vidhivadhomAnantatashcha samityR^ichA | vAtendraguruvahnInAM juhuyAtsarpiShA.ahutIH
verses.translation: But a student who has broken his vow shall offer at night on a crossway to Nirriti a one-eyed ass, according to the rule of the Pakayagnas.
verses.hindi: कामिकीटवयोहत्या सद्यानुग तभोजनम् । फलेधःकुसुमस्तेयमपेर्यं च मलावहम्

verses.sanskrit: यो वैश्यः स्याद्बहुपशुर्हीनक्रतुरसोमपः । कुटुम्बात्तस्य तद्द्रव्यमाहरेद्यज्ञसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: yo vaishyaH syAdbahupashurhInakraturasomapaH | kuTumbAttasya taddravyamAharedyaj~nasiddhaye
verses.translation: That article (required) for the completion of the sacrifice, may be taken (forcibly) from the house of any Vaisya, who possesses a large number of cattle, (but) neither performs the (minor) sacrifices nor drinks the Soma-juice;
verses.hindi: ईधन के लिए हरे वृक्षा को कारना, अपने ही लिए भोजन चोरी करना, आणा को न झुकाना, असत् शासं का पढ़ना, नाच- शान में लगना, धान्य, कुप्य और पशुओं की चोरी, मयप खी को और मच को बंधना, कुटिलता ओर पुरुप से मैथुन, थे जात.

verses.sanskrit: कामतो रेतसः सेकं व्रतस्थस्य द्विजन्मनः । अतिक्रमं व्रतस्याहुर्धर्मज्ञा ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.transliteration: kAmato retasaH sekaM vratasthasya dvijanmanaH | atikramaM vratasyAhurdharmaj~nA brahmavAdinaH
verses.translation: Having offered according to the rule oblations in the fire, he shall finally offer (four) oblations of clarified butter to Vata, to Indra, to the teacher (of the gods, Brihaspati) and to Agni, reciting the Rik verse 'May the Maruts grant me,' &c.
verses.hindi: कुतावपनो निव्रसेद्र मान्ते गोबजेऽपि वा ।

verses.sanskrit: मारुतं पुरुहूतं च गुरुं पावकमेव च । चतुरो व्रतिनोऽभ्येति ब्राह्मं तेजोऽवकीर्णिनः
verses.transliteration: mArutaM puruhUtaM cha guruM pAvakameva cha | chaturo vratino.abhyeti brAhmaM tejo.avakIrNinaH
verses.translation: Those who know the Veda declare that a voluntary effusion of semen by a twice-born (youth) who fulfils the vow (of studentship constitutes) a breach of that vow.
verses.hindi: बनाकर रहे, भिक्षा मांगकर खाचे और झोपडी में सुरदे की खोपड़ी रांगे । अथवा शखघारिया की इच्छानुसार पातक ज्ञादिर होने का निशान करे, था जलती आश में नीचा शिर करके तीनबार हारी जितेन्द्रिय होकर, किसी वेद् का पाठ करता हुआ सो योजन

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेनसि प्राप्ते वसित्वा गर्दभाजिनम् । सप्तागारांश्चरेद्भैक्षं स्वकर्म परिकीर्तयन्
verses.transliteration: etasminnenasi prApte vasitvA gardabhAjinam | saptAgArA.nshcharedbhaikShaM svakarma parikIrtayan
verses.translation: The divine light which the Veda imparts to the student, enters, if he breaks his vow, the Maruts, Puruhuta (Indra), the teacher (of the gods, Brihaspati) and Pavaka (Fire).
verses.hindi: फोरे चोर प्राह्मण का घन चुराकर लियि जाता गो ठो उल पर तीन यार चढ़ाई करके धन को लोटालावे यान देतो मो बा हत्यां से छूट जाता है। अथवा जब अन क दह्र यु करके मरने को तैयार दो, वब उतना धन देकर का बा

verses.sanskrit: तेभ्यो लब्धेन भैक्षेण वर्तयन्नेककालिकम् । उपस्पृशंस्त्रिषवणं त्वब्देन स विशुध्यति
verses.transliteration: tebhyo labdhena bhaikSheNa vartayannekakAlikam | upaspR^isha.nstriShavaNaM tvabdena sa vishudhyati
verses.translation: When this sin has been committed, he shall go begging to seven houses, dressed in the hide of the (sacrificed) ass, proclaiming his deed.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मण जन्म से ही देवों का भी देव है, और उसका उपदेश बेदसूलक होने से लोक मे ममास माना जाता है। वेदज्ञो में तीन करवा है  क्योंकि, ब्राह्मणी की वाशीही पावन है । इस लिए सावधान होकर कहे भावयश्चित्तों से कोई भी करने से आरक्षण

verses.sanskrit: त्रिषवणं अब्देन जातिभ्रंशकरं कर्म कृत्वाऽन्यतममिच्छया । चरेत्सांतपनं कृच्छ्रं प्राजापत्यमनिच्छया
verses.transliteration: triShavaNaM abdena jAtibhra.nshakaraM karma kR^itvA.anyatamamichChayA | charetsA.ntapanaM kR^ichChraM prAjApatyamanichChayA
verses.translation: Subsisting on a single (daily meal that consists) of the alms obtained there and bathing at (the time of) the three savanas (morning, noon, and evening), he becomes pure after (the lapse of) one year.
verses.hindi: कामतो ब्राह्मणवधे निष्कृतिन विधीयते

verses.sanskrit: सङ्करापात्रकृत्यासु मासं शोधनमैन्दवम् । ऐन्दवः मलिनीकरणीयेषु तप्तः स्याद्यावकैस्त्र्यहम्
verses.transliteration: sa~NkarApAtrakR^ityAsu mAsaM shodhanamaindavam | aindavaH malinIkaraNIyeShu taptaH syAdyAvakaistryaham
verses.translation: For committing with intent any of the deeds which cause loss of caste (Gatibhramsakara), (the offender) shall perform a Samtapana Krikkhra; (for doing it) unintentionally, (the Krikkhra) revealed by Pragapati.
verses.hindi: साक्षी मे झूठ बोलकर, शुरुको भूंठा दोप लगाकर, धरोहर मार

verses.sanskrit: तुरीयो ब्रह्महत्यायाः क्षत्रियस्य वधे स्मृतः । वैश्येऽष्टमांशो वृत्तस्थे शूद्रे ज्ञेयस्तु षोडशः
verses.transliteration: turIyo brahmahatyAyAH kShatriyasya vadhe smR^itaH | vaishye.aShTamA.nsho vR^ittasthe shUdre j~neyastu ShoDashaH
verses.translation: As atonement for deeds which degrade to a mixed caste (Samkara), and for those which make a man unworthy to receive gifts (Apatra), (he shall perform) the lunar (penance) during a month; for (acts) which render impure (Malinikaraniya) he shall scald himself during three days with (hot) barley-gruel.
verses.hindi: पयो घृतं वा५मरणाद्वोशकृ्ठससेव वा

verses.sanskrit: अकामतस्तु राजन्यं विनिपात्य द्विजोत्तमः । वृषभैकसहस्रा गा दद्यात्सुचरितव्रतः
verses.transliteration: akAmatastu rAjanyaM vinipAtya dvijottamaH | vR^iShabhaikasahasrA gA dadyAtsucharitavrataH
verses.translation: One fourth (of the penance) for the murder of a Brahmana is prescribed (as expiation) for (intentionally) killing a Kshatriya, one-eighth for killing a Vaisya; know that it is one-sixteenth for killing a virtuous Sudra.
verses.hindi: यथेवेका तथा सर्वा न पातव्या शिजात्तमेः

verses.sanskrit: त्र्यब्दं चरेद्वा नियतो जटी ब्रह्महनो व्रतम् । वसन् दूरतरे ग्रामाद्वृक्षमूलनिकेतनः
verses.transliteration: tryabdaM charedvA niyato jaTI brahmahano vratam | vasan dUratare grAmAdvR^ikShamUlaniketanaH
verses.translation: But if a Brahmana unintentionally kills a Kshatriya, he shall give, in order to purify himself, one thousand cows and a bull;
verses.hindi: उसले शरीर जलजाने पर पाप से छुटता है अथवा गोमूज, जल, गौ का दूध, घी, गोवर का रख इनमें किसी पदार्थ को आग के झुवाक़िक् लाल करके मरणान्त पिया करे। या अन्नकण या तिलं की खली एक साल तक रात में एक वार खाय । कम्बल शोढकरा

verses.sanskrit: एतदेव चरेदब्दं प्रायश्चित्तं द्विजोत्तमः । प्रमाप्य वैश्यं वृत्तस्थं दद्याच्चैकशतं गवाम्
verses.transliteration: etadeva charedabdaM prAyashchittaM dvijottamaH | pramApya vaishyaM vR^ittasthaM dadyAchchaikashataM gavAm
verses.translation: Or he may perform the penance prescribed for the murderer of a Brahmana during three years, controlling himself, wearing his hair in braids, staying far away from the village, and dwelling at the root of a tree.
verses.hindi: क शरार मे रहनंबाला चंद््षान एकवार ही सच से गल जाताह सांता डच का परायाश्च कहा जायया ॥ ६५-६६ ॥

verses.sanskrit: आहरेत्त्रीणि वा द्वे वा कामं शूद्रस्य वेश्मनः । न हि शूद्रस्य यज्ञेषु कश्चिदस्ति परिग्रहः
verses.transliteration: AharettrINi vA dve vA kAmaM shUdrasya veshmanaH | na hi shUdrasya yaj~neShu kashchidasti parigrahaH
verses.translation: (Or) the (sacrificer) may take at his pleasure two or three (articles required for a sacrifice) from the house of a Sudra; for a Sudra has no business with sacrifices.
verses.hindi: सुवर्ण चोरी का प्रायरिचत्त । सुवर्णचोरी करनेवाला आहाण राजा के पास जाकर अपना फर्म प्रकट करे और कहे कि मेरे को थाप शिक्षा दे--तव राजा उसके कंधे पर से मूसल लेकर उसको एकवार मारे  चोर मारने

verses.sanskrit: दद्याद्वैकशतं गवाम् एतदेव व्रतं कृत्स्नं षण्मासांशूद्रहा चरेत्) । वृषभेकादशा वाऽपि दद्याद्विप्राय गाः सिताः
verses.transliteration: dadyAdvaikashataM gavAm etadeva vrataM kR^itsnaM ShaNmAsA.nshUdrahA charet) | vR^iShabhekAdashA vA.api dadyAdviprAya gAH sitAH
verses.translation: A Brahmana who has slain a virtuous Vaisya, shall perform the same penance during one year, or he may give one hundred cows and one (bull).
verses.hindi: उपपातकिनंस्लेवसेभिनोनाविधैमैतैः

verses.sanskrit: मार्जारनकुलौ हत्वा चाषं मण्डूकमेव च । श्वगोधौलूककाकांश्च शूद्रहत्याव्रतं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: mArjAranakulau hatvA chAShaM maNDUkameva cha | shvagodhaulUkakAkA.nshcha shUdrahatyAvrataM charet
verses.translation: He who has slain a Sudra, shall perform that whole penance during six months, or he may also give ten white cows and one bull to a Brahmana.
verses.hindi: शुरुपल्लीयामी अपने पाप को कहकर लोहे की जलती हुई शय्या पर सोचे! या लोह की चनी खी सूति जलती इदको रि पट कर भरने से पाप शुद्ध होता है। अथवा खुदी अपने" ग्रोर अणडकोशा को. काटकर. अज्ञलि में रखकर मरण -तक

verses.sanskrit: पयः पिबेत्त्रिरात्रं वा योजनं वाऽध्वनो व्रजेत् । उपस्पृशेत्स्रवन्त्यां वा सूक्तं वाऽब्।दैवतं जपेत्
verses.transliteration: payaH pibettrirAtraM vA yojanaM vA.adhvano vrajet | upaspR^ishetsravantyAM vA sUktaM vA.ab.daivataM japet
verses.translation: Having killed a cat, an ichneumon, a blue jay, a frog, a dog, an iguana, an owl, or a crow, he shall perform the penance for the murder of a Sudra;
verses.hindi: चतुथकालमश्नीयादक्षारखवणं मितम्!

verses.sanskrit: अभ्रिं कार्ष्णायसीं दद्यात्सर्पं हत्वा द्विजोत्तमः । पलालभारकं षण्ढे सैसकं चैकमाषकम्
verses.transliteration: abhriM kArShNAyasIM dadyAtsarpaM hatvA dvijottamaH | palAlabhArakaM ShaNDhe saisakaM chaikamAShakam
verses.translation: Or he may drink milk during three days, or walk one hundred yoganas, or bathe in a river, or mutter the hymn addressed to the Waters.
verses.hindi: उपपातकों का प्रायश्चित । गोवध करनेवाला मुण्डन कराकर, गोचर्म ओढ़कर -एक मास गोगोष्ठमे रहे और जॉकी लपसी चारे । दो मास तक गोसूच से ' स्नान करे, जितेन्द्रिय रहें, चोथे काल ( दुसरे दिन सायंकाल)

verses.sanskrit: घृतकुम्भं वराहे तु तिलद्रोणं तु तित्तिरौ । शुके द्विहायनं वत्सं क्रौञ्चं हत्वा त्रिहायनम्
verses.transliteration: ghR^itakumbhaM varAhe tu tiladroNaM tu tittirau | shuke dvihAyanaM vatsaM krau~nchaM hatvA trihAyanam
verses.translation: For killing a snake, a Brahmana shall give a spade of black iron, for a eunuch a load of straw and a masha of lead;
verses.hindi: अनेन विधिना यस्तु गोन्नो गामनुगच्छति । स गोहत्याकृतं पापं त्रिसिमासेव्यपोहति

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा हंसं बलाकां च बकं बर्हिणमेव च । वानरं श्येनभासौ च स्पर्शयेद्ब्राह्मणाय गाम्
verses.transliteration: hatvA ha.nsaM balAkAM cha bakaM barhiNameva cha | vAnaraM shyenabhAsau cha sparshayedbrAhmaNAya gAm
verses.translation: For a boar a pot of clarified butter, for a partridge a drona of sesamum-grains, for a parrot a calf two years old, for a crane (a calf) three years old.
verses.hindi: बृपभेकादशा गाशच दद्यात्सुचरितब्रतः ।

verses.sanskrit: वासो दद्याधयं हत्वा पञ्च नीलान् वृषान् गजम् । अजमेषावनड्वाहं खरं हत्वैकहायनम्
verses.transliteration: vAso dadyAdhayaM hatvA pa~ncha nIlAn vR^iShAn gajam | ajameShAvanaDvAhaM kharaM hatvaikahAyanam
verses.translation: If he has killed a Hamsa, a Balaka, a heron, a peacock, a monkey, a falcon, or a Bhasa, he shall give a cow to a Brahmana.
verses.hindi: रोगी, चोर, वाघ के भय से व्याकुल गिर्रीहुई कीचड़ में फेसी हुई गी को सब उपायों से मुक्त करे। धूप मै; धो में, शोत में और आंधी चलने पर यथाशक्कि गौ की रक्षा करे फिर अपनी रक्षा करे । अपने था दूसरे के घर में, खेत में, खीरिदान में चरती गौ

verses.sanskrit: क्रव्यादांस्तु मृगान् हत्वा धेनुं दद्यात्पयस्विनीम् । अक्रव्यादान् वत्सतरीमुष्ट्रं हत्वा तु कृष्णलम्
verses.transliteration: kravyAdA.nstu mR^igAn hatvA dhenuM dadyAtpayasvinIm | akravyAdAn vatsatarImuShTraM hatvA tu kR^iShNalam
verses.translation: For killing a horse, he shall give a garment, for (killing) an elephant, five black bulls, for (killing) a goat, or a sheep, a draught-ox, for killing a donkey, (a calf) one year old;
verses.hindi: अबकीयी को छोड़कर दूसरे उपपातकी द्विज अपनी शुद्धि के खण्डित करनेवाला अवकीर्णी होता है । बह रात को काने गंध पर चढ़कर चौराहा में जाकर पाकयज्ञ के विधान से मिऋति देवता का यज्ञ करे। अग्नि में बिधि से होम करके 'स मा सि-

verses.sanskrit: जीनकार्मुकबस्तावीन् पृथग्दद्याद्विशुद्धये । चतुर्णामपि वर्णानां नारीर्हत्वाऽनवस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: jInakArmukabastAvIn pR^ithagdadyAdvishuddhaye | chaturNAmapi varNAnAM nArIrhatvA.anavasthitAH
verses.translation: But for killing carnivorous wild beasts, he shall give a milch-cow, for (killing) wild beasts that are not carnivorous, a heifer, for killing a camel, one krishnala.
verses.hindi: मारुतं पुरुहूतं च गुरु पावकसेव च । चतुरो त्रतिनोऽभ्येति बाह्म तेजोऽवकीशिनः

verses.sanskrit: दानेन वधनिर्णेकं सर्पादीनामशक्नुवन् । एकैकशश्चरेत्कृच्छ्रं द्विजः पापापनुत्तये
verses.transliteration: dAnena vadhanirNekaM sarpAdInAmashaknuvan | ekaikashashcharetkR^ichChraM dvijaH pApApanuttaye
verses.translation: For killing adulterous women of the four castes, he must give, in order to purify himself, respectively a leathern bag, a bow, a goat, or a sheep.
verses.hindi: मलिनीकरणीयेषु तृतः स्याच्यावकेरूयहम्

verses.sanskrit: योऽनाहिताग्निः शतगुरयज्वा च सहस्रगुः । अयज्ञश् तयोरपि कुटुम्बाभ्यामाहरेदविचारयन्
verses.transliteration: yo.anAhitAgniH shatagurayajvA cha sahasraguH | ayaj~nash tayorapi kuTumbAbhyAmAharedavichArayan
verses.translation: If (a man) possessing one hundred cows, kindles not the sacred fire, or one possessing a thousand cows, drinks not the Soma-juice, a (sacrificer) may unhesitatingly take (what he requires) from the houses of those two, even (though they be Brahmanas or Kshatriyas);
verses.hindi: क सं मा सिखन्तु मरुतः सं पूषा सं बृहस्पतिः । से मायमग्निः तिञतु भजया च धनेन च दीरषमायुः कृणोतु में  ' अथर्वण ७ ३। ३३  १

verses.sanskrit: अस्थिमतां तु सत्त्वानां सहस्रस्य प्रमापणे । पूर्णे चानस्यनस्थ्नां तु शूद्रहत्याव्रतं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: asthimatAM tu sattvAnAM sahasrasya pramApaNe | pUrNe chAnasyanasthnAM tu shUdrahatyAvrataM charet
verses.translation: A twice-born man, who is unable to atone by gifts for the slaughter of a serpent and the other (creatures mentioned), shall perform for each of them, a Krikkhra (penance) in order to remove his guilt.
verses.hindi: यह पम्प रयादियों का मत है  बतभङ्ग से उसका तेज वायु, ६ । इस अतभङ् फा पाप लगे तो गधे का चमड़ा ओढ़कर अपना फर्म फर गोर सान घरा से भीख मांगे और उस भिक्षा से एक याय भे।अमलियाद फोर । ओर तीन वार स्वात करे! इस प्रकार

verses.sanskrit: किं चिदेव तु विप्राय दद्यादस्थिमतां वधे । अनस्थ्नां चैव हिंसायां प्राणायामेन शुध्यति
verses.transliteration: kiM chideva tu viprAya dadyAdasthimatAM vadhe | anasthnAM chaiva hi.nsAyAM prANAyAmena shudhyati
verses.translation: But for destroying one thousand (small) animals that have bones, or a whole cart-load of boneless (animals), he shall perform the penance (prescribed) for the murder of a Sudra.
verses.hindi: वपसैकादशा वापि दद्यादिप्राय गाः सिताः,

verses.sanskrit: फलदानां तु वृक्षाणां छेदने जप्यमृच्शतम् । गुल्मवल्लीलतानां च पुष्पितानां च वीरुधाम्
verses.transliteration: phaladAnAM tu vR^ikShANAM Chedane japyamR^ichshatam | gulmavallIlatAnAM cha puShpitAnAM cha vIrudhAm
verses.translation: But for killing (small) animals which have bones, he should give some trifle to a Brahmana; if he injures boneless (animals), he becomes pure by a suppressing his breath (pranayama).
verses.hindi: माजीरनकुलो हरवा चाषं सण्डकसेव च ।

verses.sanskrit: अन्नाद्यजानां सत्त्वानां रसजानां च सर्वशः । फलपुष्पोद्भवानां च घृतप्राशो विशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: annAdyajAnAM sattvAnAM rasajAnAM cha sarvashaH | phalapuShpodbhavAnAM cha ghR^itaprAsho vishodhanam
verses.translation: For cutting fruit-trees, shrubs, creepers, lianas, or flowering plants, one hundred Rikas must be muttered.
verses.hindi: पलालभारकं षण्डे सेसकश्चैकमावकम्

verses.sanskrit: कृष्तजानामोषधीनां जातानां च स्वयं वने । वृथालम्भेऽनुगच्छेद्गां दिनमेकं पयोव्रतः
verses.transliteration: kR^iShtajAnAmoShadhInAM jAtAnAM cha svayaM vane | vR^ithAlambhe.anugachChedgAM dinamekaM payovrataH
verses.translation: (For destroying) any kind of creature, bred in food, in condiments, in fruit, or in flowers, the expiation is to eat clarified butter.
verses.hindi: हत्वा हसँ वलाका च वर्क बर्हिणमेव च । अथवा चह पुरुष आम से दूर दक्ष के नौचे जटा रखकर एक जान म सदाचारी वेश्य के वध म॑ भी जानना चाहिए । और एकसौ गौ का दान करना चाहिए ।शद्धवध में भी यही सब घायड्चित्त

verses.sanskrit: एतैर्व्रतैरपोह्यं स्यादेनो हिंसासमुद्भवम् । ज्ञानाज्ञानकृतं कृत्स्नं शृणुतानाद्यभक्षणे
verses.transliteration: etairvratairapohyaM syAdeno hi.nsAsamudbhavam | j~nAnAj~nAnakR^itaM kR^itsnaM shR^iNutAnAdyabhakShaNe
verses.translation: If a man destroys for no good purpose plants produced by cultivation, or such as spontaneously spring up in the forest, he shall attend a cow during one day, subsisting on milk alone.
verses.hindi: घोडे की हत्या में वस, हाथी की हत्या मैं पांच नीले वैल, बकरा! ओर मेढ़ा के लिए सांड और गर्दभ के बघ मै एक वर्ष का बछुडा दान करे। मांसाहारी पशुओं की हत्या स दृध देनेवाली गौ, मांस न खामेवाले पशुओं की हिसा में बछुड़ी और ऊंट की हिंसा में

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञानाद्वारुणीं पीत्वा संस्कारेणैव शुध्यति । मतिपूर्वमनिर्देश्यं प्राणान्तिकमिति स्थितिः
verses.transliteration: aj~nAnAdvAruNIM pItvA sa.nskAreNaiva shudhyati | matipUrvamanirdeshyaM prANAntikamiti sthitiH
verses.translation: The guilt incurred intentionally or unintentionally by injuring (created beings) can be removed by means of these penances; hear (now, how) all (sins) committed by partaking of forbidden food (or drink, can be expiated).
verses.hindi: चारों वर्ण की व्यामिचारिणो खिया का हत्या होने पर कमसे मगचर्म, धनुष, वकरा ओर मेढे का दान करे ।.पूर्व कहे इए आदि के प्रायश्चितों को न करसके तो पक पक छच्छु बत करे हजार हड्डीबाले' जीघों की हत्या और विना हड्डीवाले गाड़ी भर

verses.sanskrit: अपः सुराभाजनस्था मद्यभाण्डस्थितास्तथा । पञ्चरात्रं पिबेत्पीत्वा शङ्खपुष्पीशृतं पयः
verses.transliteration: apaH surAbhAjanasthA madyabhANDasthitAstathA | pa~ncharAtraM pibetpItvA sha~NkhapuShpIshR^itaM payaH
verses.translation: He who drinks unintentionally (the spirituous liquor, called) Varuni, becomes pure by being initiated (again); (even for drinking it) intentionally (a penance) destructive to life must not be imposed; that is a settled rule.
verses.hindi: एक दिन दूध पीकर यो के पीछे फिरे  जान या अजान में हिसा का धायाश्चत्त खुनो ॥ १४५-१४६ ॥ ,  अज्ञानादारुणी पीला संस्कारेणेव शुध्यति।

verses.sanskrit: स्पृष्ट्वा दत्त्वा च मदिरां विधिवत्प्रतिगृह्य च । शूद्रोच्छिष्टाश्च पीत्वाऽपः कुशवारि पिबेत्त्र्यहम्
verses.transliteration: spR^iShTvA dattvA cha madirAM vidhivatpratigR^ihya cha | shUdrochChiShTAshcha pItvA.apaH kushavAri pibettryaham
verses.translation: He who has drunk water which has stood in a vessel used for keeping (the spirituous liquor, called) Sura, or other intoxicating drinks, shall drink during five (days and) nights (nothing but) milk in which the Sankhapushpi (plant) has been boiled.
verses.hindi: निवतेन्पे द्विजातीनां पुनः संस्कार कमीशि

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणस्तु सुरापस्य गन्धमाघ्राय सोमपः । प्राणानप्सु त्रिरायम्य घृतं प्राश्य विशुध्यति
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNastu surApasya gandhamAghrAya somapaH | prANAnapsu trirAyamya ghR^itaM prAshya vishudhyati
verses.translation: He who has touched spirituous liquor, has given it away, or received it in accordance with the rule, or has drunk water left by a Sudra, shall drink during three days water in which Kusa-grass has been boiled.
verses.hindi: धजान में मयपान से संस्कार से शुद्धि होती है । जानकर पीने मयादा है) जिसने खुण शरोर गय फे पात्र का जल पिया हो बह पाँच दिन डु फा फाढ़ा पिये । मद्य छूकर, देसर थोर विधि मे प्रहता करके और शूद्र का जूंठा जल पीकर, तीन दिन

verses.sanskrit: आदाननित्याच्चादातुराहरेदप्रयच्छतः । तथा यशोऽस्य प्रथते धर्मश्चैव प्रवर्धते
verses.transliteration: AdAnanityAchchAdAturAharedaprayachChataH | tathA yasho.asya prathate dharmashchaiva pravardhate
verses.translation: (Or) he may take (it by force or fraud) from one who always takes and never gives, and who refuses to give it; thus the fame (of the taker) will spread and his merit increase.
verses.hindi: विडवराहखरोष्ट्राणां गोमायोः कपिकाकयोः ।

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञानात्प्राश्य विण्मूत्रं सुरासंस्पृष्टमेव च । पुनः संस्कारमर्हन्ति त्रयो वर्णा द्विजातयः
verses.transliteration: aj~nAnAtprAshya viNmUtraM surAsa.nspR^iShTameva cha | punaH sa.nskAramarhanti trayo varNA dvijAtayaH
verses.translation: But when a Brahmana who has partaken of Soma-juice, has smelt the odour exhaled by a drinker of Sura, he becomes pure by thrice suppressing his breath in water, and eating clarified butter.
verses.hindi: शुप्काशि झुकता मा भौमानि निच

verses.sanskrit: वपनं मेखला दण्डो भैक्षचर्या व्रतानि च । भैक्ष्यचर्या निवर्तन्ते द्विजातीनां पुनःसंस्कारकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: vapanaM mekhalA daNDo bhaikShacharyA vratAni cha | bhaikShyacharyA nivartante dvijAtInAM punaHsa.nskArakarmaNi
verses.translation: (Men of) the three twice-born castes who have unintentionally swallowed ordure or urine, or anything that has touched Sura, must be initiated again.
verses.hindi: क्रव्यादसकरोहूएएं कुछुटानां च अक्षशे। नरकाकखशर्णा च तपतकझ्ृच्छ विशोधनभ

verses.sanskrit: अभोज्यानां तु भुक्त्वाऽन्नं स्त्रीशूद्रोच्छिष्टमेव च । जग्ध्वा मांसमभक्ष्यं च सप्तरात्रं यवान् पिबेत्
verses.transliteration: abhojyAnAM tu bhuktvA.annaM strIshUdrochChiShTameva cha | jagdhvA mA.nsamabhakShyaM cha saptarAtraM yavAn pibet
verses.translation: The tonsure, (wearing) the sacred girdle, (carrying) a staff, going to beg, and the vows (incumbent on a student), are omitted on the second initiation of twice-born men.
verses.hindi: मासिकान्न त योए्नीयादसमावतेकोी विजः । -स त्रीएयहान्युयवसेदेकाह चोदके वसेत्

verses.sanskrit: शुक्तानि च कषायांश्च पीत्वा मेध्यान्यपि द्विजः । तावद्भवत्यप्रयतो यावत्तन्न व्रजत्यधः
verses.transliteration: shuktAni cha kaShAyA.nshcha pItvA medhyAnyapi dvijaH | tAvadbhavatyaprayato yAvattanna vrajatyadhaH
verses.translation: But he who has eaten the food of men, whose food must not be eaten, or the leavings of women and Sudras, or forbidden flesh, shall drink barley (-gruel) during seven (days and) nights.
verses.hindi: मांख खाकर खात रात जब की लपसी खावे  सिरका आदि. नही होता। गाँव का सुत्र, गधा, ऊंट, सियार, चानर ओर  सांस जमीन के फूल, अज्ञात और कसाईख़ान का मांस खाकर ' सदुष्य,काआ और भधेःका मांस खाने से आजाय तो तत्तकच्छु

verses.sanskrit: विड्वराहखरोष्ट्राणां गोमायोः कपिकाकयोः । प्राश्य मूत्रपुरीषाणि द्विजश्चान्द्रायणं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: viDvarAhakharoShTrANAM gomAyoH kapikAkayoH | prAshya mUtrapurIShANi dvijashchAndrAyaNaM charet
verses.translation: A twice-born man who has drunk (fluids that have turned) sour, or astringent decoctions, becomes, though (these substances may) not (be specially) forbidden, impure until they have been digested.
verses.hindi: अयः कांस्योपलानां च द्वादशाहं कणान्नता

verses.sanskrit: शुष्काणि भुक्त्वा मांसानि भौमानि कवकानि च । अज्ञातं चैव सूनास्थमेतदेव व्रतं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: shuShkANi bhuktvA mA.nsAni bhaumAni kavakAni cha | aj~nAtaM chaiva sUnAsthametadeva vrataM charet
verses.translation: A twice-born man, who has swallowed the urine or ordure of a village pig, of a donkey, of a camel, of a jackal, of a monkey, or of a crow, shall perform a lunar penance.
verses.hindi: अपनी युद्धि चाहनेवाला पुरुष श्रमाउ्य अन्न न खाय और श्रतान से खाया हुआ घमन करदे। थह न करसके तो शीध प्रकार की विधि कही । अव चोरी कें पाप को नाश -करनेवाले अतो को सुनो । प्राह्मण यदि -जानकर अपने सजातीय के घर से

verses.sanskrit: क्रव्यादसूकरोष्ट्राणां कुक्कुटानां च भक्षणे । नरकाकखराणां च तप्तकृच्छ्रं विशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: kravyAdasUkaroShTrANAM kukkuTAnAM cha bhakShaNe | narakAkakharANAM cha taptakR^ichChraM vishodhanam
verses.translation: He who has eaten dried meat, mushrooms growing on the ground, or (meat, the nature of) which is unknown, (or) such as had been kept in a slaughter-house, shall perform the same penance.
verses.hindi: ' कपास, रेशस, ऊन दो. और एक खुर के पशु, पंक्षी; सुगन्ध ' द्रब्य, औषध, रस्ली की चोरी करने पर तीन दिन पानी पीकरं बितावे । द्विजो को इन जतों से.चोरी के पाप को.दूर करेना 'चां- हिए। अयस्या की के गमन. का पाप इन बतो से दुर करेः-सेंगी

verses.sanskrit: मासिकान्नं तु योऽश्नीयादसमावर्तको द्विजः । स त्रीण्यहान्युपवसेदेकाहं चोदके वसेत्
verses.transliteration: mAsikAnnaM tu yo.ashnIyAdasamAvartako dvijaH | sa trINyahAnyupavasedekAhaM chodake vaset
verses.translation: The atonement for partaking of (the meat of) carnivorous animals, of pigs, of camels, of cocks, of crows, of donkeys, and of human flesh, is a Tapta Krikkhra (penance).
verses.hindi: सडुच तु समासेव्य पुसे योषिति वा द्विजः । अमाजुपी योनि, रजस्वला और जल में चीयेपात करके सान्व- पन घत करे । दिज को पुरुष, खो, वैलयाड़ी में; जल में और दिन में, मैथुन करके चञ्ज सहित स्वान करना चाहिए । आहण

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचारी तु योऽश्नीयान् मधु मांसं कथं चन । व्रतचारी तु स कृत्वा प्राकृतं कृच्छ्रं व्रतशेषं समापयेत्
verses.transliteration: brahmachArI tu yo.ashnIyAn madhu mA.nsaM kathaM chana | vratachArI tu sa kR^itvA prAkR^itaM kR^ichChraM vratasheShaM samApayet
verses.translation: If a twice-born man, who has not returned (home from his teacher's house), eats food, given at a monthly (Sraddha,) he shall fast during three days and pass one day (standing) in water.
verses.hindi: को उसका पति पक घर में बन्द करे और जो गमन में प्रायक्षित्त है. वही उससे फरवाचे  के वहकाने पर फिर भी वह बिगड़ जावे तो कराचे । एक रात यांडाखी के साथ

verses.sanskrit: बिडालकाकाखूच्छिष्टं जग्ध्वा श्वनकुलस्य च । केशकीटावपन्नं च पिबेद्ब्रह्मसुवर्चलाम्
verses.transliteration: biDAlakAkAkhUchChiShTaM jagdhvA shvanakulasya cha | keshakITAvapannaM cha pibedbrahmasuvarchalAm
verses.translation: But a student who on any occasion eats honey or meat, shall perform an ordinary Krikkhra (penance), and afterwards complete his vow (of studentship).
verses.hindi: पक वपे तक पतितो के साथ एक सबारी वा आसन पर घेठने " से और पक पक्कि में. भोजन करने से उनको यज्ञकभ कराने, चेद पढ़ाने ओर चिवाददसस्वन्ध करने से पतित होजाता है। जो मनुष्य इन पतितों के साथ जो संस्थ करता है बह उस संसर्ग की. शु

verses.sanskrit: तथैव सप्तमे भक्ते भक्तानि षडनश्नता । अश्वस्तनविधानेन हर्तव्यं हीनकर्मणः
verses.transliteration: tathaiva saptame bhakte bhaktAni ShaDanashnatA | ashvastanavidhAnena hartavyaM hInakarmaNaH
verses.translation: Likewise he who has not eaten at (the time of) six meals, may take at (the time of) the seventh meal (food) from a man who neglects his sacred duties, without (however) making a provision for the morrow,
verses.hindi: सवा जञातिकायाणि यथापूर्व समाचरेत्

verses.sanskrit: अभोज्यमन्नं नात्तव्यमात्मनः शुद्धिमिच्छता । अज्ञानभुक्तं तूत्तार्यं शोध्यं वाऽप्याशु शोधनैः
verses.transliteration: abhojyamannaM nAttavyamAtmanaH shuddhimichChatA | aj~nAnabhuktaM tUttAryaM shodhyaM vA.apyAshu shodhanaiH
verses.translation: He who eats what is left by a cat, by a crow, by a mouse (or rat), by a dog, or by an ichneumon, or (food) into which a hair or an insect has fallen, shall drink (a decoction of) the Brahmasuvarkala (plant).
verses.hindi: सपिण्ड उनके साथ वोल-चाल उठना-वैठना छोड़ है । पिता फे धन में उसको साथ न दें ओर लौकिक व्यवहार भी न करे। पतित की ज्येष्ठता और उसके भाग का धव जाता रहता है। इसलिये यह भाग छोटों में जो शुणी हो उसको देना चाहिये ।

verses.sanskrit: एषोऽनाद्यादनस्योक्तो व्रतानां विविधो विधिः । स्तेयदोषापहर्तॄणां व्रतानां श्रूयतां विधिः
verses.transliteration: eSho.anAdyAdanasyokto vratAnAM vividho vidhiH | steyadoShApahartR^INAM vratAnAM shrUyatAM vidhiH
verses.translation: He who desires to be pure, must not eat forbidden food, and must vomit up such as he has eaten unintentionally, or quickly atone for it by (various) means of purification.
verses.hindi: प्रायश्वित्त न करनेदाले पातकिया के साथ दान आदि का निन्दा भी न करे । वालहत्यावाले, कूतघ, शरणागत को मारने तोसी उसका संसर्ग न करे । जिन द्विजं का शाखोक्क समय में यङ्ञापचात न इुआ हा उचका तान प्राजापत्य बत कराकर विधि

verses.sanskrit: धान्यान्नधनचौर्याणि कृत्वा कामाद्द्विजोत्तमः । स्वजातीयगृहादेव कृच्छ्राब्देन विशुध्यति
verses.transliteration: dhAnyAnnadhanachauryANi kR^itvA kAmAddvijottamaH | svajAtIyagR^ihAdeva kR^ichChrAbdena vishudhyati
verses.translation: The various rules respecting penances for eating forbidden food have been thus declared; hear now the law of those penances which remove the guilt of theft.
verses.hindi: -सासँ गोठे पयः पीत्वा मुच्यते,सखतियहात्

verses.sanskrit: मनुष्याणां तु हरणे स्त्रीणां क्षेत्रगृहस्य च । कूपवापीजलानां च शुद्धिश्चान्द्रायणं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: manuShyANAM tu haraNe strINAM kShetragR^ihasya cha | kUpavApIjalAnAM cha shuddhishchAndrAyaNaM smR^itam
verses.translation: The chief of the twice-born, having voluntarily stolen (valuable) property, grain, or cooked food, from the house of a caste-fellow, is purified by performing Krikkhra (penances) during a whole year.
verses.hindi: संवत्सरं यवीहारस्तत्पापमपसेधति

verses.sanskrit: द्रव्याणामल्पसाराणां स्तेयं कृत्वाऽन्यवेश्मतः । कृत्वाऽन्यवेश्मनि चरेत्सांतपनं कृच्छ्रं तन्निर्यात्यात्मशुद्धये
verses.transliteration: dravyANAmalpasArANAM steyaM kR^itvA.anyaveshmataH | kR^itvA.anyaveshmani charetsA.ntapanaM kR^ichChraM tanniryAtyAtmashuddhaye
verses.translation: The lunar penance has been declared to be the expiation for stealing men and women, and (for wrongfully appropriating) a field, a house, or the water of wells and cisterns.
verses.hindi: जो आहास निदित कमो से धन कमाते हैं वे उसको छोड़ने और जप करके एक महीना गोष्ठ में हुग्घाहार करके, बुरे दान लेने के पाप से छूरता है। उस 'उपचास से कृश, गो से श्राए विनीत ” माहाण से पूछे कि है सौम्य ! “ क्या तू हमारे समान रहने की

verses.sanskrit: भक्ष्यभोज्यापहरणे यानशय्याऽऽसनस्य च । पुष्पमूलफलानां च पञ्चगव्यं विशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: bhakShyabhojyApaharaNe yAnashayyA.a.asanasya cha | puShpamUlaphalAnAM cha pa~nchagavyaM vishodhanam
verses.translation: He who has stolen objects of small value from the house of another man, shall, after restoring the (stolen article), perform a Samtapana Krikkhra for his purification.
verses.hindi: उपटूयानं समार्य खरयानं तु कामतः ।

verses.sanskrit: तृणकाष्ठद्रुमाणां च शुष्कान्नस्य गुडस्य च । चेलचर्मामिषाणां च त्रिरात्रं स्यादभोजनम्
verses.transliteration: tR^iNakAShThadrumANAM cha shuShkAnnasya guDasya cha | chelacharmAmiShANAM cha trirAtraM syAdabhojanam
verses.translation: (To swallow) the five products of the cow (pankagavya) is the atonement for stealing eatables of various kinds, a vehicle, a bed, a seat, flowers, roots, or fruit.
verses.hindi: वेदोदितानां नित्यानां कर्मणां समतिक्रमे ।

verses.sanskrit: चैलचर्मामिक्षाणां मणिमुक्ताप्रवालानां ताम्रस्य रजतस्य च । अयः।कांस्यौपलानां च द्वादशाहं कणान्नता
verses.transliteration: chailacharmAmikShANAM maNimuktApravAlAnAM tAmrasya rajatasya cha | ayaH.kA.nsyaupalAnAM cha dvAdashAhaM kaNAnnatA
verses.translation: Fasting during three (days and) nights shall be (the penance for stealing) grass, wood, trees, dry food, molasses, clothes, leather, and meat.
verses.hindi: एक मास तक दो दिन के वाद तीसरे दिन सायंकाल--को भोजन, वेद्स॑हिता का पाठ और साकल मन्चौ से होम, पंक्लि- वाह्य.को शुद्ध करता है। घ्राण जानकर ऊंट या चथे की सवारी में बैठे या नंगा. होकर स्नान करे तो प्राणायाम से शुद्ध, होता .

verses.sanskrit: कार्पासकीटजोर्णानां द्विशफेकशफस्य च । द्वेशफेकखुरस्य च पक्षिगन्धौषधीनां च रज्ज्वाश्चैव त्र्यहं पयः
verses.transliteration: kArpAsakITajorNAnAM dvishaphekashaphasya cha | dveshaphekakhurasya cha pakShigandhauShadhInAM cha rajjvAshchaiva tryahaM payaH
verses.translation: To subsist during twelve days on (uncooked) grains (is the penance for stealing) gems, pearls, coral, copper, silver, iron, brass, or stone.
verses.hindi: चराको नास छृच्छोभ्ये सवपापापनोदनः

verses.sanskrit: एतैर्व्रतैरपोहेत पापं स्तेयकृतं द्विजः । अगम्यागमनीयं तु व्रतैरेभिरपानुदेत्
verses.transliteration: etairvratairapoheta pApaM steyakR^itaM dvijaH | agamyAgamanIyaM tu vratairebhirapAnudet
verses.translation: (For stealing) cotton, silk, wool, an animal with cloven hoofs, or one with uncloven hoofs, a bird, perfumes, medicinal herbs, or a rope (the penance is to subsist) during three days (on) milk.
verses.hindi: करे । जिन दोपों का आयश्चिच नहीं कदा है उनका शक्ति ओर पाप नष्ट करता है उन देवर्षि और पितरों के सेवित उपायों को तुम से कहता है. । माजापत्य-जत करनेचाला द्विज तान दिन प्रात काल और तीन दिन साथकाल और तीन दिन विना मांगा खन्न

verses.sanskrit: खलात्क्षेत्रादगाराद्वा यतो वाऽप्युपलभ्यते । आख्यातव्यं तु तत्तस्मै पृच्छते यदि पृच्छति
verses.transliteration: khalAtkShetrAdagArAdvA yato vA.apyupalabhyate | AkhyAtavyaM tu tattasmai pR^ichChate yadi pR^ichChati
verses.translation: Either from the threshing-floor, or from a field, or out of the house, or wherever he finds it; but if (the owner) asks him, he must confess to him that (deed and its cause).
verses.hindi: तीन, समय सनान करे, कृष शुक्केपक्ष म पक पक ग्रास वढ़ावे स यका यक बर घरावे, करता हुआ इरी सय विजियों को करे । ' यतिचान्दायसा ' आग नियमसे रदे। चार प्रास मातःकाल और चार आस खुयास्त

verses.sanskrit: गुरुतल्पव्रतं कुर्याद्रेतः सिक्त्वा स्वयोनिषु । सख्युः पुत्रस्य च स्त्रीषु कुमारीष्वन्त्यजासु च
verses.transliteration: gurutalpavrataM kuryAdretaH siktvA svayoniShu | sakhyuH putrasya cha strIShu kumArIShvantyajAsu cha
verses.translation: By means of these penances, a twice-born man may remove the guilt of theft; but the guilt of approaching women who ought not to be approached (agamya), he may expiate by (the following) penances.
verses.hindi: यथा यथा नरो धर्म स्वयं कल्वानुभाषते।  तथा तथा लचेवाहिस्तेवाधर्मेण मुच्यते

verses.sanskrit: पैतृस्वसेयीं भगिनीं स्वस्रीयां मातुरेव च । मातुश्च भ्रातुस्तनयां गत्वा चान्द्रायणं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: paitR^isvaseyIM bhaginIM svasrIyAM mAtureva cha | mAtushcha bhrAtustanayAM gatvA chAndrAyaNaM charet
verses.translation: He who has had sexual intercourse with sisters by the same mother, with the wives of a friend, or of a son, with unmarried maidens, and with females of the lowest castes, shall perform the penance, prescribed for the violation of a Guru's bed.
verses.hindi: मनोवाइसतिसिलित्य शुर्भ कसे समावरेत्

verses.sanskrit: भ्रातुराप्तस्य गत्वा एतास्तिस्रस्तु भार्यार्थे नोपयच्छेत्तु बुद्धिमान् । ज्ञातित्वेनानुपेयास्ताः पतति ह्युपयन्नधः
verses.transliteration: bhrAturAptasya gatvA etAstisrastu bhAryArthe nopayachChettu buddhimAn | j~nAtitvenAnupeyAstAH patati hyupayannadhaH
verses.translation: He who has approached the daughter of his father's sister, (who is almost equal to) a sister, (the daughter) of his mother's sister, or of his mother's full brother, shall perform a lunar penance.
verses.hindi: आसन पर उडा बैठा करे, अशकक हो तो भूमि पर सोवि और ब्रह्मचारी, अती, शुरु, देवता और डिजोका पूजक होखे । नित्य यथाशक्ति गायनी ओर अघमपेणादि पवित्र सच्चा का जप करे । जप आर होस कराकर शुद्ध करें । पाप करनेवाला पाप प्रकट

verses.sanskrit: अमानुषीषू पुरुष उदक्यायामयोनिषु । रेतः सिक्त्वा जले चैव कृच्छ्रं सांतपनं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: amAnuShIShU puruSha udakyAyAmayoniShu | retaH siktvA jale chaiva kR^ichChraM sA.ntapanaM charet
