verses.translation: A wise man should not take as his wife any of these three; they must not be wedded because they are (Sapinda-) relatives, he who marries (one of them), sinks low.
verses.hindi: महापाताकियश्चेव शेषाश्वाकार्यकारिशः । ज्ञानकर वा व ज्ञानकर निंदित कर्म करके उससे छुटकारा चाइनेचाला फिर दूसरा पापकर्म न करे; पापी के मन मै यदि आायखित्त से संतोष न हो तो अबतक सन्तोष हो तबतक तप

verses.sanskrit: मैथुनं तु समासेव्य पुंसि योषिति वा द्विजः । गोयानेऽप्सु दिवा चैव सवासाः स्नानमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: maithunaM tu samAsevya pu.nsi yoShiti vA dvijaH | goyAne.apsu divA chaiva savAsAH snAnamAcharet
verses.translation: A man who has committed a bestial crime, or an unnatural crime with a female, or has had intercourse in water, or with a menstruating woman, shall perform a Samtapana Krikkhra.
verses.hindi: से स्वर को जाते हैं। मझुष्य मन, वाणी और शारीर खे जो कुड पाप करते है उन सव को तपोधन ऋषि तप से शीघ्र ही भस्म हैं और कामनाओं को पूणे करते हैँ। तपोवल से ही प्रजापति ने - इस शाख को रचाथा और ऋषियों ने वेद भी तप से पाया था!

verses.sanskrit: चण्डालान्त्यस्त्रियो गत्वा भुक्त्वा च प्रतिगृह्य च । पतत्यज्ञानतो विप्रो ज्ञानात्साम्यं तु गच्छति
verses.transliteration: chaNDAlAntyastriyo gatvA bhuktvA cha pratigR^ihya cha | patatyaj~nAnato vipro j~nAnAtsAmyaM tu gachChati
verses.translation: A twice-born man who commits an unnatural offence with a male, or has intercourse with a female in a cart drawn by oxen, in water, or in the day-time, shall bathe, dressed in his clothes.
verses.hindi: अपि भ्रूणहणं मासासुनन्त्यहरहः कृता;

verses.sanskrit: विप्रदुष्टां स्त्रियं भर्ता निरुन्ध्यादेकवेश्मनि । यत्पुंसः परदारेषु तच्चैनां चारयेद्व्रतम्
verses.transliteration: vipraduShTAM striyaM bhartA nirundhyAdekaveshmani | yatpu.nsaH paradAreShu tachchainAM chArayedvratam
verses.translation: A Brahmana who unintentionally approaches a woman of the Kandala or of (any other) very low caste, who eats (the food of such persons) and accepts (presents from them) becomes an outcast; but (if he does it) intentionally, he becomes their equal.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार पापों का यथाविधि प्रायश्चितत कहा गया है. का पाठ करने से सुरापान दीष से मुक्त होजाता ९ । ॥ अस्या मस्य० ' इत्यादि ऋचा के सक और ' शिवसेकरुप० !: त्यां े सूकर के पाठ 'से, खुबरीचोरी फे पाप से तुरंत छ जाता है

verses.sanskrit: सा चेत्पुनः प्रदुष्येत्तु सदृशेनोपमन्त्रिता । सदृशेनोपयन्त्रिता कृच्छ्रं चान्द्रायणं चैव तदस्याः पावनं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: sA chetpunaH praduShyettu sadR^ishenopamantritA | sadR^ishenopayantritA kR^ichChraM chAndrAyaNaM chaiva tadasyAH pAvanaM smR^itam
verses.translation: An exceedingly corrupt wife let her husband confine to one apartment, and compel her to perform the penance which is prescribed for males in cases of adultery.
verses.hindi: सहापातकसंचुकोऽनुगच्छेद्गाः समाहितः ।

verses.sanskrit: यत्करोत्येकरात्रेण वृषलीसेवनाद्द्विजः । तद्भैक्षभुज्जपन्नित्यं त्रिभिर्वर्षैर्व्यपोहति
verses.transliteration: yatkarotyekarAtreNa vR^iShalIsevanAddvijaH | tadbhaikShabhujjapannityaM tribhirvarShairvyapohati
verses.translation: If, being solicited by a man (of) equal (caste), she (afterwards) is again unfaithful, then a Krikkhra and a lunar penance are prescribed as the means of purifying her.
verses.hindi: -सुच्यते पातकेः सवैः पराकैः शोविताश्चिभिः

verses.sanskrit: एषा पापकृतामुक्ता चतुर्णामपि निष्कृतिः । पतितैः सम्प्रयुक्तानामिमाः शृणुत निष्कृतीः
verses.transliteration: eShA pApakR^itAmuktA chaturNAmapi niShkR^itiH | patitaiH samprayuktAnAmimAH shR^iNuta niShkR^itIH
verses.translation: The sin which a twice-born man commits by dallying one night with a Vrishali, he removes in three years, by subsisting on alms and daily muttering (sacred texts).
verses.hindi: अधिक पाप करनेवाला नदी में स्वान करके ' सोमा रुद्रा ऋचाओंका एक मास तक नित्य पाउ करे तो शुद्ध होता है। “ऋचा का-नित्य पाठ करे ओर जल में सत्त-सूच डालनेवाला एक भास तक भोख मांगकर निर्वाह करे । द्विज, ' देवकतस्थ० ”

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणस्वं न हर्तव्यं क्षत्रियेण कदा चन । दस्युनिष्क्रिययोस्तु स्वमजीवन् हर्तुमर्हति
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNasvaM na hartavyaM kShatriyeNa kadA chana | dasyuniShkriyayostu svamajIvan hartumarhati
verses.translation: (On such occasions) a Kshatriya must never take the property of a (virtuous Brahmana; but he who is starving may appropriate the possessions of a Dasyu, or of one who neglects his sacred duties.
verses.hindi: इति मानवे धर्मशाखे भगुप्रणीताया सटती

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरेण पतति पतितेन सहाचरन् । याजनाध्यापनाद्यौनान्न तु यानासनाशनात्
verses.transliteration: sa.nvatsareNa patati patitena sahAcharan | yAjanAdhyApanAdyaunAnna tu yAnAsanAshanAt
verses.translation: The atonement (to be performed) by sinners (of) four (kinds) even, has been thus declared; hear now the penances for those who have intercourse with outcasts.
verses.hindi: जैले: यक्षा. का"राजाः अश्वमेध ,लब पापो:का 'नाशक्तःहे, चेस - भोजन. करे .तो;भी उसको' पातक नहीं लगता ।.जो  द्विज, सावः; . घावी; से, ऋफ्सहिता या यजुःसंहिता. अथवा; सामसंदितां-की .. ब्राह्मण-उपनिषदों  के सहित तीन बार (वृत्तिः करे तो! सब.

verses.sanskrit: यो येन पतितेनैषां संसर्गं याति मानवः । स तस्यैव व्रतं कुर्यात्तत्संसर्गविशुद्धये
verses.transliteration: yo yena patitenaiShAM sa.nsargaM yAti mAnavaH | sa tasyaiva vrataM kuryAttatsa.nsargavishuddhaye
verses.translation: He who associates with an outcast, himself becomes an outcast after a year, not by sacrificing for him, teaching him, or forming a matrimonial alliance with him, but by using the same carriage or seat, or by eating with him.
verses.hindi: स तानुवाच धर्मात्मा सहर्षीन सोनवो थृगुः। .

verses.sanskrit: पतितस्योदकं कार्यं सपिण्डैर्बान्धवैर्बहिः । निन्दितेऽहनि सायाह्ने ज्ञातिर्त्विग्गुरुसंनिधौ
verses.transliteration: patitasyodakaM kAryaM sapiNDairbAndhavairbahiH | nindite.ahani sAyAhne j~nAtirtviggurusa.nnidhau
verses.translation: He who associates with any one of those outcasts, must perform, in order to atone for (such) intercourse, the penance prescribed for that (sinner).
verses.hindi: कर्सजा गतयो नृणासुत्तमाधसमध्यमाः

verses.sanskrit: दासी घटमपां पूर्णं पर्यस्येत्प्रेतवत्पदा । अहोरात्रमुपासीरन्नशौचं बान्धवैः सह
verses.transliteration: dAsI ghaTamapAM pUrNaM paryasyetpretavatpadA | ahorAtramupAsIrannashauchaM bAndhavaiH saha
verses.translation: The Sapindas and Samanodakas of an outcast must offer (a libation of) water (to him, as if he were dead), outside (the village), on an inauspicious day, in the evening and in the presence of the relatives, officiating priests, and teachers.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: निवर्तेरंश्च तस्मात्तु सम्भाषणसहासने । दायाद्यस्य प्रदानं च यात्रा चैव हि लौकिकी
verses.transliteration: nivartera.nshcha tasmAttu sambhAShaNasahAsane | dAyAdyasya pradAnaM cha yAtrA chaiva hi laukikI
verses.translation: A female slave shall upset with her foot a pot filled with water, as if it were for a dead person; (his Sapindas) as well as the Samanodakas shall be impure for a day and a night;
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठता च निवर्तेत ज्येष्ठावाप्यं च यद्धनम् । यद्वसु ज्येष्ठांशं प्राप्नुयाच्चास्य यवीयान् गुणतोऽधिकः
verses.transliteration: jyeShThatA cha nivarteta jyeShThAvApyaM cha yaddhanam | yadvasu jyeShThA.nshaM prApnuyAchchAsya yavIyAn guNato.adhikaH
verses.translation: But thenceforward it shall be forbidden to converse with him, to sit with him, to give him a share of the inheritance, and to hold with him such intercourse as is usual among men;
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्ते तु चरिते पूर्णकुम्भमपां नवम् । तेनैव सार्धं प्रास्येयुः स्नात्वा पुण्ये जलाशये
verses.transliteration: prAyashchitte tu charite pUrNakumbhamapAM navam | tenaiva sArdhaM prAsyeyuH snAtvA puNye jalAshaye
verses.translation: And (if he be the eldest) his right of primogeniture shall be withheld and the additional share, due to the eldest son; and his stead a younger brother, excelling in virtue, shall obtain the share of the eldest.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: स त्वप्सु तं घटं प्रास्य प्रविश्य भवनं स्वकम् । सर्वाणि ज्ञातिकार्याणि यथापूर्वं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: sa tvapsu taM ghaTaM prAsya pravishya bhavanaM svakam | sarvANi j~nAtikAryANi yathApUrvaM samAcharet
verses.translation: But when he has performed his penance, they shall bathe with him in a holy pool and throw down a new pot, filled with water.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: एतदेव विधिं कुर्याद्योषित्सु पतितास्वपि । एतमेव विधिं वस्त्रान्नपानं देयं तु वसेयुश्च गृहान्तिके
verses.transliteration: etadeva vidhiM kuryAdyoShitsu patitAsvapi | etameva vidhiM vastrAnnapAnaM deyaM tu vaseyushcha gR^ihAntike
verses.translation: But he shall throw that pot into water, enter his house and perform, as before, all the duties incumbent on a relative.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: एनस्विभिरनिर्णिक्तैर्नार्थं किं चित्सहाचरेत् । कृतनिर्णेजनांश्चैव न जुगुप्सेत कर्हि चित्
verses.transliteration: enasvibhiranirNiktairnArthaM kiM chitsahAcharet | kR^itanirNejanA.nshchaiva na jugupseta karhi chit
verses.translation: Let him follow the same rule in the case of female outcasts; but clothes, food, and drink shall be given to them, and they shall live close to the (family-) house.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: योऽसाधुभ्योऽर्थमादाय साधुभ्यः सम्प्रयच्छति । स कृत्वा प्लवमात्मानं संतारयति तावुभौ
verses.transliteration: yo.asAdhubhyo.arthamAdAya sAdhubhyaH samprayachChati | sa kR^itvA plavamAtmAnaM sa.ntArayati tAvubhau
verses.translation: He who takes property from the wicked and bestows it on the virtuous, transforms himself into a boat, and carries both (over the sea of misfortune).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: कृतनिर्णेजनांश्चैतान् बालघ्नांश्च कृतघ्नांश्च विशुद्धानपि धर्मतः । शरणागतहन्तॄंश्च स्त्रीहन्तॄंश्च न संवसेत्
verses.transliteration: kR^itanirNejanA.nshchaitAn bAlaghnA.nshcha kR^itaghnA.nshcha vishuddhAnapi dharmataH | sharaNAgatahantR^I.nshcha strIhantR^I.nshcha na sa.nvaset
verses.translation: Let him not transact any business with unpurified sinners; but let him in no way reproach those who have made atonement.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: येषां द्विजानां सावित्री नानूच्येत यथाविधि । तांश्चारयित्वा त्रीन् कृच्छ्रान् यथाविध्योपनाययेत्
verses.transliteration: yeShAM dvijAnAM sAvitrI nAnUchyeta yathAvidhi | tA.nshchArayitvA trIn kR^ichChrAn yathAvidhyopanAyayet
verses.translation: Let him not dwell together with the murderers of children, with those who have returned evil for good, and with the slayers of suppliants for protection or of women, though they may have been purified according to the sacred law.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्तं चिकीर्षन्ति विकर्मस्थास्तु ये द्विजाः । ब्रह्मणा च परित्यक्तास्तेषामप्येतदादिशेत्
verses.transliteration: prAyashchittaM chikIrShanti vikarmasthAstu ye dvijAH | brahmaNA cha parityaktAsteShAmapyetadAdishet
verses.translation: Those twice-born men who may not have been taught the Savitri (at the time) prescribed by the rule, he shall cause to perform three Krikkhra (penances) and afterwards initiate them in accordance with the law.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: यद्गर्हितेनार्जयन्ति कर्मणा ब्राह्मणा धनम् । तस्योत्सर्गेण शुध्यन्ति जप्येन तपसैव च
verses.transliteration: yadgarhitenArjayanti karmaNA brAhmaNA dhanam | tasyotsargeNa shudhyanti japyena tapasaiva cha
verses.translation: Let him prescribe the same (expiation) when twice-born men, who follow forbidden occupations or have neglected (to learn) the Veda, desire to perform a penance.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: जपित्वा त्रीणि सावित्र्याः सहस्राणि समाहितः । मासं गोष्ठे पयः पीत्वा मुच्यतेऽसत्प्रतिग्रहात्
verses.transliteration: japitvA trINi sAvitryAH sahasrANi samAhitaH | mAsaM goShThe payaH pItvA muchyate.asatpratigrahAt
verses.translation: If Brahmanas acquire property by a reprehensible action, they become pure by relinquishing it, muttering prayers, and (performing) austerities.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: उपवासकृशं तं तु गोव्रजात्पुनरागतम् । प्रणतं प्रति पृच्छेयुः साम्यं सौम्यैच्छसीति किम्
verses.transliteration: upavAsakR^ishaM taM tu govrajAtpunarAgatam | praNataM prati pR^ichCheyuH sAmyaM saumyaichChasIti kim
verses.translation: By muttering with a concentrated mind the Savitri three thousand times, (dwelling) for a month in a cow-house, (and) subsisting on milk, (a man) is freed from (the guilt of) accepting presents from a wicked man.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: सत्यमुक्त्वा तु विप्रेषु विकिरेद्यवसं गवाम् । गोभिः प्रवर्तिते तीर्थे कुर्युस्तस्य परिग्रहम्
verses.transliteration: satyamuktvA tu vipreShu vikiredyavasaM gavAm | gobhiH pravartite tIrthe kuryustasya parigraham
verses.translation: But when he returns from the cow-house, emaciated with his fast, and reverently salutes, (the Brahmanas) shall ask him, 'Friend, dost thou desire to become our equal?'
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: व्रात्यानां याजनं कृत्वा परेषामन्त्यकर्म च । अभिचारमहीनं च त्रिभिः कृच्छ्रैर्व्यपोहति
verses.transliteration: vrAtyAnAM yAjanaM kR^itvA pareShAmantyakarma cha | abhichAramahInaM cha tribhiH kR^ichChrairvyapohati
verses.translation: If he answers to the Brahmanas, 'Forsooth, (I will not offend again), 'he shall scatter (some) grass for the cows; if the cows hallow that place (by eating the grass) the (Brahmana) shall re-admit him (into their community).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: शरणागतं परित्यज्य वेदं विप्लाव्य च द्विजः । संवत्सरं यवाहारस्तत्पापमपसेधति
verses.transliteration: sharaNAgataM parityajya vedaM viplAvya cha dvijaH | sa.nvatsaraM yavAhArastatpApamapasedhati
verses.translation: He who has sacrificed for Vratyas, or has performed the obsequies of strangers, or a magic sacrifice (intended to destroy life) or an Ahina sacrifice, removes (his guilt) by three Krikkhra (penances).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: श्वशृगालखरैर्दष्टो ग्राम्यैः क्रव्याद्भिरेव च । नराश्वोष्ट्रवराहैश्च प्राणायामेन शुध्यति
verses.transliteration: shvashR^igAlakharairdaShTo grAmyaiH kravyAdbhireva cha | narAshvoShTravarAhaishcha prANAyAmena shudhyati
verses.translation: A twice-born man who has cast off a suppliant for protection, or has (improperly) divulged the Veda, atones for his offence, if he subsists during a year on barley.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: न वै तान् स्नातकान् विद्याद्ब्राह्मणान् धर्मभिक्षुकान् । निःस्वेभ्यो देयमेतेभ्यो दानं विद्याविशेषतः
verses.transliteration: na vai tAn snAtakAn vidyAdbrAhmaNAn dharmabhikShukAn | niHsvebhyo deyametebhyo dAnaM vidyAvisheShataH
verses.translation: These nine Brahmanas one should consider as Snatakas, begging in order to fulfil the sacred law; to such poor men gifts must be given in proportion to their learning.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: यद्धनं यज्ञशीलानां देवस्वं तद्विदुर्बुधाः । अयज्वनां तु यद्वित्तमासुरस्वं तदुच्यते
verses.transliteration: yaddhanaM yaj~nashIlAnAM devasvaM tadvidurbudhAH | ayajvanAM tu yadvittamAsurasvaM taduchyate
verses.translation: The property of those who zealously offer sacrifices, the wise call the property of the gods; but the wealth of those who perform no sacrifices is called the property of the Asuras.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: षष्ठान्नकालता मासं संहिताजप एव वा । होमाश्च सकला नित्यमपाङ्क्त्यानां विशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: ShaShThAnnakAlatA mAsaM sa.nhitAjapa eva vA | homAshcha sakalA nityamapA~NktyAnAM vishodhanam
verses.translation: He who has been bitten by a dog, a jackal, or a donkey, by a tame carnivorous animal, by a man, a horse, a camel, or a (village-) pig, becomes pure by suppressing his breath (Pranayama).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: होमाश्च शाकला उष्ट्रयानं समारुह्य खरयानं तु कामतः । स्नात्वा तु विप्रो दिग्वासाः प्राणायामेन शुध्यति
verses.transliteration: homAshcha shAkalA uShTrayAnaM samAruhya kharayAnaM tu kAmataH | snAtvA tu vipro digvAsAH prANAyAmena shudhyati
verses.translation: To eat during a month at each sixth mealtime (only), to recite the Samhita (of a Veda), and (to perform) daily the Sakala oblations, are the means of purifying those excluded from society at repasts (Apanktya).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: विनाऽद्भिरप्सु वाऽप्यार्तः शारीरं संनिषेव्य च । सचैलो बहिराप्लुत्य गामालभ्य विशुध्यति
verses.transliteration: vinA.adbhirapsu vA.apyArtaH shArIraM sa.nniShevya cha | sachailo bahirAplutya gAmAlabhya vishudhyati
verses.translation: A Brahmana who voluntarily rode in a carriage drawn by camels or by asses, and he who bathed naked, become pure by suppressing his breath (Pranayama).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: वेदोदितानां नित्यानां कर्मणां समतिक्रमे । स्नातकव्रतलोपे च प्रायश्चित्तमभोजनम्
verses.transliteration: vedoditAnAM nityAnAM karmaNAM samatikrame | snAtakavratalope cha prAyashchittamabhojanam
verses.translation: He who has relieved the necessities of nature, being greatly pressed, either without (using) water or in water, becomes pure by bathing outside (the village) in his clothes and by touching a cow.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: हुङ्कारं ब्राह्मणस्योक्त्वा त्वङ्कारं च गरीयसः । स्नात्वाऽनश्नन्नहः शेषमभिवाद्य प्रसादयेत्
verses.transliteration: hu~NkAraM brAhmaNasyoktvA tva~NkAraM cha garIyasaH | snAtvA.anashnannahaH sheShamabhivAdya prasAdayet
verses.translation: Fasting is the penance for omitting the daily rites prescribed by the Veda and for neglecting the special duties of a Snataka.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: ताडयित्वा तृणेनापि कण्ठे वाऽबध्य वाससा । विवादे वा विनिर्जित्य प्रणिपत्य प्रसादयेत्
verses.transliteration: tADayitvA tR^iNenApi kaNThe vA.abadhya vAsasA | vivAde vA vinirjitya praNipatya prasAdayet
verses.translation: He who has said 'Hum' to a Brahmana, or has addressed one of his betters with 'Thou,' shall bathe, fast during the remaining part of the day, and appease (the person offended) by a reverential salutation.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: अवगूर्य त्वब्दशतं सहस्रमभिहत्य च । जिघांसया ब्राह्मणस्य नरकं प्रतिपद्यते
verses.transliteration: avagUrya tvabdashataM sahasramabhihatya cha | jighA.nsayA brAhmaNasya narakaM pratipadyate
verses.translation: He who has struck (a Brahmana) even with a blade of grass, tied him by the neck with a cloth, or conquered him in an altercation, shall appease him by a prostration.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: शोणितं यावतः पांसून् सङ्गृह्णाति महीतले । तावन्त्यब्दसहस्राणि तत्कर्ता नरके वसेत्
verses.transliteration: shoNitaM yAvataH pA.nsUn sa~NgR^ihNAti mahItale | tAvantyabdasahasrANi tatkartA narake vaset
verses.translation: But he who, intending to hurt a Brahmana, has threatened (him with a stick and the like) shall remain in hell during a hundred years; he who (actually) struck him, during one thousand years.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: नरके व्रजेत् अवगूर्य चरेत्कृच्छ्रमतिकृच्छ्रं निपातने । कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रौ कुर्वीत विप्रस्योत्पाद्य शोणितम्
verses.transliteration: narake vrajet avagUrya charetkR^ichChramatikR^ichChraM nipAtane | kR^ichChrAtikR^ichChrau kurvIta viprasyotpAdya shoNitam
verses.translation: As many particles of dust as the blood of a Brahmana causes to coagulate, for so many thousand years shall the shedder of that (blood) remain in hell.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: अनुक्तनिष्कृतीनां तु पापानामपनुत्तये । शक्तिं चावेक्ष्य पापं च प्रायश्चित्तं प्रकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: anuktaniShkR^itInAM tu pApAnAmapanuttaye | shaktiM chAvekShya pApaM cha prAyashchittaM prakalpayet
verses.translation: For threatening a Brahmana, (the offender) shall perform a Krikkhra, for striking him an Atikrikkhra, for shedding his blood a Krikkhra and an Atikrikkhra.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: न तस्मिन् धारयेद्दण्डं धार्मिकः पृथिवीपतिः । क्षत्रियस्य हि बालिश्याद्ब्राह्मणः सीदति क्षुधा
verses.transliteration: na tasmin dhArayeddaNDaM dhArmikaH pR^ithivIpatiH | kShatriyasya hi bAlishyAdbrAhmaNaH sIdati kShudhA
verses.translation: On him (who, for the reasons stated, appropriates another's possessions), a righteous king shall not inflict punishment; for (in that case) a Brahmana pines with hunger through the Kshatriya's want of care.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: यैरभ्युपायैरेनांसि मानवो व्यपकर्षति । तान् वोऽभ्युपायान् वक्ष्यामि देवर्षिपितृसेवितान्
verses.transliteration: yairabhyupAyairenA.nsi mAnavo vyapakarShati | tAn vo.abhyupAyAn vakShyAmi devarShipitR^isevitAn
verses.translation: For the expiation of offences for which no atonement has been prescribed, let him fix a penance after considering (the offender's) strength and the (nature of the) offence.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: त्र्यहं प्रातस्त्र्यहं सायं त्र्यहमद्यादयाचितम् । त्र्यहं परं च नाश्नीयात्प्राजापत्यं चरन् द्विजः
verses.transliteration: tryahaM prAtastryahaM sAyaM tryahamadyAdayAchitam | tryahaM paraM cha nAshnIyAtprAjApatyaM charan dvijaH
verses.translation: I will (now) describe to you those means, adopted by the gods, the sages, and the manes, through which a man may remove his sins.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं दधि सर्पिः कुशोदकम् । एकरात्रोपवासश्च कृच्छ्रं सांतपनं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: gomUtraM gomayaM kShIraM dadhi sarpiH kushodakam | ekarAtropavAsashcha kR^ichChraM sA.ntapanaM smR^itam
verses.translation: A twice-born man who performs (the Krikkhra penance), revealed by Pragapati, shall eat during three days in the morning (only), during (the next) three days in the evening (only), during the (following) three days (food given) unasked, and shall fast during another period of three days.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: एकैकं ग्रासमश्नीयात्त्र्यहाणि त्रीणि पूर्ववत् । त्र्यहं चोपवसेदन्त्यमतिकृच्छ्रं चरन् द्विजः
verses.transliteration: ekaikaM grAsamashnIyAttryahANi trINi pUrvavat | tryahaM chopavasedantyamatikR^ichChraM charan dvijaH
verses.translation: (Subsisting on) the urine of cows, cowdung, milk, sour milk, clarified butter, and a decoction of Kusa-grass, and fasting during one (day and) night, (that is) called a Samtapana Krikkhra.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: तप्तकृच्छ्रं चरन् विप्रो जलक्षीरघृतानिलान् । प्रतित्र्यहं पिबेदुष्णान् सकृत्स्नायी समाहितः
verses.transliteration: taptakR^ichChraM charan vipro jalakShIraghR^itAnilAn | pratitryahaM pibeduShNAn sakR^itsnAyI samAhitaH
verses.translation: A twice-born man who performs an Atikrikkhra (penance), must take his food during three periods of three days in the manner described above, (but) one mouthful only at each meal, and fast during the last three days.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: यतात्मनोऽप्रमत्तस्य द्वादशाहमभोजनम् । पराको नाम कृच्छ्रोऽयं सर्वपापापनोदनः
verses.transliteration: yatAtmano.apramattasya dvAdashAhamabhojanam | parAko nAma kR^ichChro.ayaM sarvapApApanodanaH
verses.translation: A Brahmana who performs a Taptakrikkhra (penance) must drink hot water, hot milk, hot clarified butter and (inhale) hot air, each during three days, and bathe once with a concentrated mind.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: एकैकं ह्रासयेत्पिण्डं कृष्णे शुक्ले च वर्धयेत् । उपस्पृशंस्त्रिषवणमेतत्चाण्ड्रायणं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: ekaikaM hrAsayetpiNDaM kR^iShNe shukle cha vardhayet | upaspR^isha.nstriShavaNametatchANDrAyaNaM smR^itam
verses.translation: A fast for twelve days by a man who controls himself and commits no mistakes, is called a Paraka Krikkhra, which removes all guilt.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: एतमेव विधिं कृत्स्नमाचरेद्यवमध्यमे । शुक्लपक्षादिनियतश्चरंश्चान्द्रायणं व्रतम्
verses.transliteration: etameva vidhiM kR^itsnamAcharedyavamadhyame | shuklapakShAdiniyatashchara.nshchAndrAyaNaM vratam
verses.translation: If one diminishes (one's food daily by) one mouthful during the dark (half of the month) and increases (it in the same manner) during the bright half, and bathes (daily) at the time of three libations (morning, noon, and evening), that is called a lunar penance (Kandrayana).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: अष्टावष्टौ समश्नीयात्पिण्डान् मध्यंदिने स्थिते । नियतात्मा हविष्याशी यतिचान्द्रायणं चरन्
verses.transliteration: aShTAvaShTau samashnIyAtpiNDAn madhya.ndine sthite | niyatAtmA haviShyAshI yatichAndrAyaNaM charan
verses.translation: Let him follow throughout the same rule at the (Kandrayana, called) yavamadhyama (shaped like a barley-corn), (but) let him (in that case) begin the lunar penance, (with a) controlled (mind), on the first day of the bright half (of the month).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: चतुरः प्रातरश्नीयात्पिण्डान् विप्रः समाहितः । चतुरोऽस्तमिते सूर्ये शिशुचान्द्रायणं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: chaturaH prAtarashnIyAtpiNDAn vipraH samAhitaH | chaturo.astamite sUrye shishuchAndrAyaNaM smR^itam
verses.translation: He who performs the lunar penance of ascetics, shall eat (during a month) daily at midday eight mouthfuls, controlling himself and consuming sacrificial food (only).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: तस्य भृत्यजनं ज्ञात्वा स्वकुटुम्बान् महीपतिः । श्रुतशीले च विज्ञाय वृत्तिं धर्म्यां प्रकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: tasya bhR^ityajanaM j~nAtvA svakuTumbAn mahIpatiH | shrutashIle cha vij~nAya vR^ittiM dharmyAM prakalpayet
verses.translation: Having ascertained the number of those dependent on such a man, and having fully considered his learning and his conduct, the king shall allow him, out of his own property, a maintenance whereon he may live according to the law;
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: यथा कथं चित्पिण्डानां तिस्रोऽशीतीः समाहितः । मासेनाश्नन् हविष्यस्य चन्द्रस्यैति सलोकताम्
verses.transliteration: yathA kathaM chitpiNDAnAM tisro.ashItIH samAhitaH | mAsenAshnan haviShyasya chandrasyaiti salokatAm
verses.translation: If a Brahmana, with concentrated mind, eats (during a month daily) four mouthfuls in a morning and four after sunset, (that is) called the lunar penance of children.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: एतद्रुद्रास्तथाऽदित्या वसवश्चाचरन् व्रतम् । सर्वाकुशलमोक्षाय मरुतश्च महर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: etadrudrAstathA.adityA vasavashchAcharan vratam | sarvAkushalamokShAya marutashcha maharShibhiH
verses.translation: He who, concentrating his mind, eats during a month in any way thrice eighty mouthfuls of sacrificial food, dwells (after death) in the world of the moon.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: महाव्याहृतिभिर्होमः कर्तव्यः स्वयमन्वहम् । अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधमार्जवं च समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: mahAvyAhR^itibhirhomaH kartavyaH svayamanvaham | ahi.nsA satyamakrodhamArjavaM cha samAcharet
verses.translation: The Rudras, likewise the Adityas, the Vasus and the Maruts, together with the great sages, practised this (rite) in order to remove all evil.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: त्रिरह्नस्त्रिर्निशायां च सवासा जलमाविशेत् । स्त्रीशूद्रपतितांश्चैव नाभिभाषेत कर्हि चित्
verses.transliteration: trirahnastrirnishAyAM cha savAsA jalamAvishet | strIshUdrapatitA.nshchaiva nAbhibhASheta karhi chit
verses.translation: Burnt oblations, accompanied by (the recitation of) the Mahavyahritis, must daily be made (by the penitent) himself, and he must abstain from injuring (sentient creatures), speak the truth, and keep himself free from anger and from dishonesty.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: स्थानासनाभ्यां विहरेदशक्तोऽधः शयीत वा । ब्रह्मचारी व्रती च स्याद्गुरुदेवद्विजार्चकः
verses.transliteration: sthAnAsanAbhyAM viharedashakto.adhaH shayIta vA | brahmachArI vratI cha syAdgurudevadvijArchakaH
verses.translation: Let him bathe three times each day and thrice each night, dressed in his clothes; let him on no account talk to women, Sudras, and outcasts.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: सावित्रीं च जपेन्नित्यं पवित्राणि च शक्तितः । सर्वेष्वेव व्रतेष्वेवं प्रायश्चित्तार्थमादृतः
verses.transliteration: sAvitrIM cha japennityaM pavitrANi cha shaktitaH | sarveShveva vrateShvevaM prAyashchittArthamAdR^itaH
verses.translation: Let him pass the time standing (during the day) and sitting (during the night), or if he is unable (to do that) let him lie on the (bare) ground; let him be chaste and observe the vows (of a student) and worship his Gurus, the gods, and Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: एतैर्द्विजातयः शोध्या व्रतैराविष्कृतेनसः । अनाविष्कृतपापांस्तु मन्त्रैर्होमैश्च शोधयेत्
verses.transliteration: etairdvijAtayaH shodhyA vratairAviShkR^itenasaH | anAviShkR^itapApA.nstu mantrairhomaishcha shodhayet
verses.translation: Let him constantly mutter the Savitri and (other) purificatory texts according to his ability; (let him) carefully (act thus) on (the occasion of) all (other) vows (performed) by way of penance.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: ख्यापनेनानुतापेन तपसाऽध्ययनेन च । पापकृत्मुच्यते पापात्तथा दानेन चापदि
verses.transliteration: khyApanenAnutApena tapasA.adhyayanena cha | pApakR^itmuchyate pApAttathA dAnena chApadi
verses.translation: By these expiations twice-born men must be purified whose sins are known, but let him purify those whose sins are not known by (the recitation of) sacred texts and by (the performance of) burnt oblations.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: यथा यथा नरोऽधर्मं स्वयं कृत्वाऽनुभाषते । तथा तथा त्वचैवाहिस्तेनाधर्मेण मुच्यते
verses.transliteration: yathA yathA naro.adharmaM svayaM kR^itvA.anubhAShate | tathA tathA tvachaivAhistenAdharmeNa muchyate
verses.translation: By confession, by repentance, by austerity, and by reciting (the Veda) a sinner is freed from guilt, and in case no other course is possible, by liberality.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: यथा यथा मनस्तस्य दुष्कृतं कर्म गर्हति । तथा तथा शरीरं तत्तेनाधर्मेण मुच्यते
verses.transliteration: yathA yathA manastasya duShkR^itaM karma garhati | tathA tathA sharIraM tattenAdharmeNa muchyate
verses.translation: In proportion as a man who has done wrong, himself confesses it, even so far he is freed from guilt, as a snake from its slough.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: कल्पयित्वाऽस्य वृत्तिं च रक्षेदेनं समन्ततः । राजा हि धर्मषड्भागं तस्मात्प्राप्नोति रक्षितात्
verses.transliteration: kalpayitvA.asya vR^ittiM cha rakShedenaM samantataH | rAjA hi dharmaShaDbhAgaM tasmAtprApnoti rakShitAt
verses.translation: And after allotting to him a maintenance, the king must protect him in every way; for he obtains from such (a man) whom he protects, the part of his spiritual merit.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा पापं हि संतप्य तस्मात्पापात्प्रमुच्यते । नैवं कुर्यां पुनरिति निवृत्त्या पूयते तु सः
verses.transliteration: kR^itvA pApaM hi sa.ntapya tasmAtpApAtpramuchyate | naivaM kuryAM punariti nivR^ittyA pUyate tu saH
verses.translation: In proportion as his heart loathes his evil deed, even so far is his body freed from that guilt.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: एवं सञ्चिन्त्य मनसा प्रेत्य कर्मफलोदयम् । मनोवाङ्मूर्तिभिर्नित्यं शुभं कर्म समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: evaM sa~nchintya manasA pretya karmaphalodayam | manovA~NmUrtibhirnityaM shubhaM karma samAcharet
verses.translation: He who has committed a sin and has repented, is freed from that sin, but he is purified only by (the resolution of) ceasing (to sin and thinking) 'I will do so no more.'
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञानाद्यदि वा ज्ञानात्कृत्वा कर्म विगर्हितम् । तस्माद्विमुक्तिमन्विच्छन् द्वितीयं न समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: aj~nAnAdyadi vA j~nAnAtkR^itvA karma vigarhitam | tasmAdvimuktimanvichChan dvitIyaM na samAcharet
verses.translation: Having thus considered in his mind what results will arise from his deeds after death, let him always be good in thoughts, speech, and actions.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्य कृते मनसः स्यादलाघवम् । तस्मिंस्तावत्तपः कुर्याद्यावत्तुष्टिकरं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yasmin karmaNyasya kR^ite manasaH syAdalAghavam | tasmi.nstAvattapaH kuryAdyAvattuShTikaraM bhavet
verses.translation: He who, having either unintentionally or intentionally committed a reprehensible deed, desires to be freed from (the guilt on it, must not commit it a second time.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: तपोमूलमिदं सर्वं दैवमानुषकं सुखम् । तपोमध्यं बुधैः प्रोक्तं तपोऽन्तं वेददर्शिभिः
verses.transliteration: tapomUlamidaM sarvaM daivamAnuShakaM sukham | tapomadhyaM budhaiH proktaM tapo.antaM vedadarshibhiH
verses.translation: If his mind be uneasy with respect to any act, let him repeat the austerities (prescribed as a penance) for it until they fully satisfy (his conscience).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणस्य तपो ज्ञानं तपः क्षत्रस्य रक्षणम् । वैश्यस्य तु तपो वार्ता तपः शूद्रस्य सेवनम्
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNasya tapo j~nAnaM tapaH kShatrasya rakShaNam | vaishyasya tu tapo vArtA tapaH shUdrasya sevanam
verses.translation: All the bliss of gods and men is declared by the sages to whom the Veda was revealed, to have austerity for its root, austerity for its middle, and austerity for its end.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयः संयतात्मानः फलमूलानिलाशनाः । तपसैव प्रपश्यन्ति त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्
verses.transliteration: R^iShayaH sa.nyatAtmAnaH phalamUlAnilAshanAH | tapasaiva prapashyanti trailokyaM sacharAcharam
verses.translation: (The pursuit of sacred) knowledge is the austerity of a Brahmana, protecting (the people) is the austerity of a Kshatriya, (the pursuit of) his daily business is the austerity of a Vaisya, and service the austerity of a Sudra.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: औषधान्यगदो विद्या दैवी च विविधा स्थितिः । तपसैव प्रसिध्यन्ति तपस्तेषां हि साधनम्
verses.transliteration: auShadhAnyagado vidyA daivI cha vividhA sthitiH | tapasaiva prasidhyanti tapasteShAM hi sAdhanam
verses.translation: The sages who control themselves and subsist on fruit, roots, and air, survey the three worlds together with their moving and immovable (creatures) through their austerities alone.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: यद्दुस्तरं यद्दुरापं यद्दुर्गं यच्च दुष्करम् । सर्वं तु तपसा साध्यं तपो हि दुरतिक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: yaddustaraM yaddurApaM yaddurgaM yachcha duShkaram | sarvaM tu tapasA sAdhyaM tapo hi duratikramam
verses.translation: Medicines, good health, learning, and the various divine stations are attained by austerities alone; for austerity is the means of gaining them.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं तत्तपसा महापातकिनश्चैव शेषाश्चाकार्यकारिणः । तपसैव सुतप्तेन मुच्यन्ते किल्बिषात्ततः
verses.transliteration: sarvaM tattapasA mahApAtakinashchaiva sheShAshchAkAryakAriNaH | tapasaiva sutaptena muchyante kilbiShAttataH
verses.translation: Whatever is hard to be traversed, whatever is hard to be attained, whatever is hard to be reached, whatever is hard to be performed, all (this) may be accomplished by austerities; for austerity (possesses a power) which it is difficult to surpass.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: न यज्ञार्थं धनं शूद्राद्विप्रो भिक्षेत कर्हि चित् । यजमानो हि भिक्षित्वा चण्डालः प्रेत्य जायते
verses.transliteration: na yaj~nArthaM dhanaM shUdrAdvipro bhikSheta karhi chit | yajamAno hi bhikShitvA chaNDAlaH pretya jAyate
verses.translation: A Brahmana shall never beg from a Sudra property for a sacrifice; for a sacrificer, having begged (it from such a man), after death is born (again) as a Kandala.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: कीटाश्चाहिपतङ्गाश्च पशवश्च वयांसि च । स्थावराणि च भूतानि दिवं यान्ति तपोबलात्
verses.transliteration: kITAshchAhipata~NgAshcha pashavashcha vayA.nsi cha | sthAvarANi cha bhUtAni divaM yAnti tapobalAt
verses.translation: Both those who have committed mortal sin (Mahapataka) and all other offenders are severally freed from their guilt by means of well-performed austerities.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: यत्किं चिदेनः कुर्वन्ति मनोवाङ्मूर्तिभिर्जनाः । मनोवाच्।कर्मभिर् तत्सर्वं निर्दहन्त्याशु तपसैव तपोधनाः
verses.transliteration: yatkiM chidenaH kurvanti manovA~NmUrtibhirjanAH | manovAch.karmabhir tatsarvaM nirdahantyAshu tapasaiva tapodhanAH
verses.translation: Insects, snakes, moths, bees, birds and beings, bereft of motion, reach heaven by the power of austerities.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: तपसैव विशुद्धस्य ब्राह्मणस्य दिवौकसः । इज्याश्च प्रतिगृह्णन्ति कामान् संवर्धयन्ति च
verses.transliteration: tapasaiva vishuddhasya brAhmaNasya divaukasaH | ijyAshcha pratigR^ihNanti kAmAn sa.nvardhayanti cha
verses.translation: Whatever sin men commit by thoughts, words, or deeds, that they speedily burn away by penance, if they keep penance as their only riches.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतिरिदं शास्त्रं तपसैवासृजत्प्रभुः । तथैव वेदान् ऋषयस्तपसा प्रतिपेदिरे
verses.transliteration: prajApatiridaM shAstraM tapasaivAsR^ijatprabhuH | tathaiva vedAn R^iShayastapasA pratipedire
verses.translation: The gods accept the offerings of that Brahmana alone who has purified himself by austerities, and grant to him all he desires.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतत्तपसो देवा महाभाग्यं प्रचक्षते । यदेतत्तपसो सर्वस्यास्य प्रपश्यन्तस्तपसः पुण्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: ityetattapaso devA mahAbhAgyaM prachakShate | yadetattapaso sarvasyAsya prapashyantastapasaH puNyamuttamam
verses.translation: The lord, Pragapati, created these Institutes (of the sacred law) by his austerities alone; the sages likewise obtained (the revelation of) the Vedas through their austerities.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यमुद्भवं वेदाभ्यासोऽन्वहं शक्त्या महायज्ञक्रिया क्षमा । नाशयन्त्याशु पापानि महापातकजान्यपि
verses.transliteration: puNyamudbhavaM vedAbhyAso.anvahaM shaktyA mahAyaj~nakriyA kShamA | nAshayantyAshu pApAni mahApAtakajAnyapi
verses.translation: The gods, discerning that the holy origin of this whole (world) is from austerity, have thus proclaimed the incomparable power of austerity.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: यथैधस्तेजसा वह्निः प्राप्तं निर्दहति क्षणात् । तथा ज्ञानाग्निना पापं सर्वं दहति वेदवित्
verses.transliteration: yathaidhastejasA vahniH prAptaM nirdahati kShaNAt | tathA j~nAnAgninA pApaM sarvaM dahati vedavit
verses.translation: The daily study of the Veda, the performance of the great sacrifices according to one's ability, (and) patience (in suffering) quickly destroy all guilt, even that caused by mortal sins.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतदेनसामुक्तं प्रायश्चित्तं यथाविधि । अत ऊर्ध्वं रहस्यानां प्रायश्चित्तं निबोधत
verses.transliteration: ityetadenasAmuktaM prAyashchittaM yathAvidhi | ata UrdhvaM rahasyAnAM prAyashchittaM nibodhata
verses.translation: As a fire in one moment consumes with its bright flame the fuel that has been placed on it, even so he who knows the Veda destroys all guilt by the fire of knowledge.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: सव्याहृतिप्रणवकाः प्राणायामास्तु षोडश । अपि भ्रूणहनं मासात्पुनन्त्यहरहः कृताः
verses.transliteration: savyAhR^itipraNavakAH prANAyAmAstu ShoDasha | api bhrUNahanaM mAsAtpunantyaharahaH kR^itAH
verses.translation: The penances for sins (made public) have been thus declared according to the law; learn next the penances for secret (sins).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: कौत्सं जप्त्वाऽप इत्येतद्वसिष्ठं च प्रतीत्यृचम् । माहित्रं शुद्धवत्यश्च सुरापोऽपि विशुध्यति
verses.transliteration: kautsaM japtvA.apa ityetadvasiShThaM cha pratItyR^icham | mAhitraM shuddhavatyashcha surApo.api vishudhyati
verses.translation: Sixteen suppressions of the breath (Pranayama) accompanied by (the recitation of) the Vyahritis and of the syllable Om, purify, if they are repeated daily, after a month even the murderer of a learned Brahmana.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञार्थमर्थं भिक्षित्वा यो न सर्वं प्रयच्छति । स याति भासतां विप्रः काकतां वा शतं समाः
verses.transliteration: yaj~nArthamarthaM bhikShitvA yo na sarvaM prayachChati | sa yAti bhAsatAM vipraH kAkatAM vA shataM samAH
verses.translation: A Brahmana who, having begged any property for a sacrifice, does not use the whole (for that purpose), becomes for a hundred years a (vulture of the kind called) Bhasa, or a crow.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: सकृत्जप्त्वाऽस्यवामीयं शिवसङ्कल्पमेव च । अपहृत्य सुवर्णं तु क्षणाद्भवति निर्मलः
verses.transliteration: sakR^itjaptvA.asyavAmIyaM shivasa~Nkalpameva cha | apahR^itya suvarNaM tu kShaNAdbhavati nirmalaH
verses.translation: Even a drinker of (the spirituous liquor called) Sura becomes pure, if he mutters the hymn (seen) by Kutsa, 'Removing by thy splendour our guilt, O Agni,' &c., (that seen) by Vasishtha, 'With their hymns the Vasishthas woke the Dawn,' &c., the Mahitra (hymn) and (the verses called) Suddhavatis.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: हविष्पान्तीयमभ्यस्य न तमं ह इतीति च । जपित्वा पौरुषं सूक्तं मुच्यते गुरुतल्पगः
verses.transliteration: haviShpAntIyamabhyasya na tamaM ha itIti cha | japitvA pauruShaM sUktaM muchyate gurutalpagaH
verses.translation: Even he who has stolen gold, instantly becomes free from guilt, if he once mutters (the hymn beginning with the words) 'The middlemost brother of this beautiful, ancient Hotri-priest' and the Sivasamkalpa.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: एनसां स्थूलसूक्ष्माणां चिकीर्षन्नपनोदनम् । अवेत्यृचं जपेदब्दं यत्किञ्चेदमितीति वा
verses.transliteration: enasAM sthUlasUkShmANAM chikIrShannapanodanam | avetyR^ichaM japedabdaM yatki~nchedamitIti vA
verses.translation: The violator of a Guru's bed is freed (from sin), if he repeatedly recites the Havishpantiya (hymn), (that beginning) 'Neither anxiety nor misfortune,' (and that beginning) 'Thus, verily, thus,' and mutters the hymn addressed to Purusha.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिगृह्याप्रतिग्राह्यं भुक्त्वा चान्नं विगर्हितम् । जपंस्तरत्समन्दीयं पूयते मानवस्त्र्यहात्
verses.transliteration: pratigR^ihyApratigrAhyaM bhuktvA chAnnaM vigarhitam | japa.nstaratsamandIyaM pUyate mAnavastryahAt
verses.translation: He who desires to expiate sins great or small, must mutter during a year the Rit-verse 'May we remove thy anger, O Varuna,' &c., or 'Whatever offence here, O Varuna,' &c.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: सोमारौद्रं तु बह्वेनाः मासमभ्यस्य शुध्यति । समामभ्यस्य) स्रवन्त्यामाचरन् स्नानमर्यम्णामिति च तृचम्
verses.transliteration: somAraudraM tu bahvenAH mAsamabhyasya shudhyati | samAmabhyasya) sravantyAmAcharan snAnamaryamNAmiti cha tR^icham
verses.translation: That man who, having accepted presents which ought not to be accepted, or having eaten forbidden food, mutters the Taratsamandiya (Rikas), becomes pure after three days.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: अब्दार्धमिन्द्रमित्येतदेनस्वी सप्तकं जपेत् । अप्रशस्तं तु कृत्वाऽप्सु मासमासीत भैक्षभुक्
verses.transliteration: abdArdhamindramityetadenasvI saptakaM japet | aprashastaM tu kR^itvA.apsu mAsamAsIta bhaikShabhuk
verses.translation: But he who has committed many sins, becomes pure, if he recites during a month the (four verses) addressed to Soma and Rudra, and the three verses (beginning) 'Aryaman, Varuna, and Mitra,' while he bathes in a river.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रैः शाकलहोमीयैरब्दं हुत्वा घृतं द्विजः । सुगुर्वप्यपहन्त्येनो जप्त्वा वा नम इत्यृचम्
verses.transliteration: mantraiH shAkalahomIyairabdaM hutvA ghR^itaM dvijaH | sugurvapyapahantyeno japtvA vA nama ityR^icham
verses.translation: A grievous offender shall mutter the seven verses (beginning with) 'Indra,' for half a year; but he who has committed any blamable act in water, shall subsist during a month on food obtained by begging.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: महापातकसंयुक्तोऽनुगच्छेद्गाः समाहितः । अभ्यस्याब्दं पावमानीर्भैक्षाहारो विशुध्यति
verses.transliteration: mahApAtakasa.nyukto.anugachChedgAH samAhitaH | abhyasyAbdaM pAvamAnIrbhaikShAhAro vishudhyati
verses.translation: A twice-born man removes even very great guilt by offering clarified butter with the sacred texts belonging to the Sakala-homas, or by muttering the Rik, (beginning) 'Adoration.'
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: अरण्ये वा त्रिरभ्यस्य प्रयतो वेदसंहिताम् । मुच्यते पातकैः सर्वैः पराकैः शोधितस्त्रिभिः
verses.transliteration: araNye vA trirabhyasya prayato vedasa.nhitAm | muchyate pAtakaiH sarvaiH parAkaiH shodhitastribhiH
verses.translation: He who is stained by mortal sin, becomes pure, if, with a concentrated mind, he attends cows for a year, reciting the Pavamani (hymns) and subsisting on alms.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: त्र्यहं तूपवसेद्युक्तस्त्रिरह्नोऽभ्युपयन्नपः । मुच्यते पातकैः सर्वैस्त्रिर्जपित्वाऽघमर्षणम्
verses.transliteration: tryahaM tUpavasedyuktastrirahno.abhyupayannapaH | muchyate pAtakaiH sarvaistrirjapitvA.aghamarShaNam
verses.translation: Or if, pure (in mind and in body), he thrice repeats the Samhita of the Veda in a forest, sanctified by three Paraka (penances), he is freed from all crimes causing loss of caste (pataka).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: देवस्वं ब्राह्मणस्वं वा लोभेनोपहिनस्ति यः । स पापात्मा परे लोके गृध्रौच्छिष्टेन जीवति
verses.transliteration: devasvaM brAhmaNasvaM vA lobhenopahinasti yaH | sa pApAtmA pare loke gR^idhrauchChiShTena jIvati
verses.translation: That sinful man, who, through covetousness, seizes the property of the gods, or the property of Brahmanas, feeds in another world on the leavings of vultures.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: यथाऽश्वमेधः क्रतुराट् सर्वपापापनोदनः । तथाऽघमर्षणं सूक्तं सर्वपापापनोदनम्
verses.transliteration: yathA.ashvamedhaH kraturAT sarvapApApanodanaH | tathA.aghamarShaNaM sUktaM sarvapApApanodanam
verses.translation: But if (a man) fasts during three days, bathing thrice a day, and muttering (in the water the hymn seen by) Aghamarshana, he is (likewise) freed from all sins causing loss of caste.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा लोकानपीमांस्त्रीनश्नन्नपि यतस्ततः । ऋग्वेदं धारयन् विप्रो नैनः प्राप्नोति किं चन
verses.transliteration: hatvA lokAnapImA.nstrInashnannapi yatastataH | R^igvedaM dhArayan vipro nainaH prApnoti kiM chana
verses.translation: As the horse-sacrifice, the king of sacrifices, removes all sin, even so the Aghamarshana hymn effaces all guilt.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: ऋक्संहितां त्रिरभ्यस्य यजुषां वा समाहितः । साम्नां वा सरहस्यानां सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: R^iksa.nhitAM trirabhyasya yajuShAM vA samAhitaH | sAmnAM vA sarahasyAnAM sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
verses.translation: A Brahmana who retains in his memory the Rig-veda is not stained by guilt, though he may have destroyed these three worlds, though he may eat the food of anybody.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: यथा महाह्रदं प्राप्य क्षिप्तं लोष्टं विनश्यति । तथा दुश्चरितं सर्वं वेदे त्रिवृति मज्जति
verses.transliteration: yathA mahAhradaM prApya kShiptaM loShTaM vinashyati | tathA dushcharitaM sarvaM vede trivR^iti majjati
verses.translation: He who, with a concentrated mind, thrice recites the Riksamhita, or (that of the) Yagur-veda; or (that of the) Sama-veda together with the secret (texts, the Upanishads), is completely freed from all sins.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: ऋचो यजूंषि चान्यानि सामानि विविधानि च । एष ज्ञेयस्त्रिवृद्वेदो यो वेदैनं स वेदवित्
verses.transliteration: R^icho yajU.nShi chAnyAni sAmAni vividhAni cha | eSha j~neyastrivR^idvedo yo vedainaM sa vedavit
verses.translation: As a clod of earth, falling into a great lake, is quickly dissolved, even so every sinful act is engulfed in the threefold Veda.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: आद्यं यत्त्र्यक्षरं ब्रह्म त्रयी यस्मिन् प्रतिष्ठिता । स गुह्योऽन्यस्त्रिवृद्वेदो यस्तं वेद स वेदवित्
verses.transliteration: AdyaM yattryakSharaM brahma trayI yasmin pratiShThitA | sa guhyo.anyastrivR^idvedo yastaM veda sa vedavit
verses.translation: The Rikas, the Yagus (-formulas) which differ (from the former), the manifold Saman (-songs), must be known (to form) the triple Veda; he who knows them, (is called) learned in the Veda.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: इष्टिं वैश्वानरीं नित्यं निर्वपेदब्दपर्यये । कॢप्तानां पशुसोमानां निष्कृत्यर्थमसम्भवे
verses.transliteration: iShTiM vaishvAnarIM nityaM nirvapedabdaparyaye | kL^iptAnAM pashusomAnAM niShkR^ityarthamasambhave
verses.translation: In case the prescribed animal and Soma-sacrifices cannot be performed, let him always offer at the change of the year a Vaisvanari Ishti as a penance (for the omission).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: आपत्कल्पेन यो धर्मं कुरुतेऽनापदि द्विजः । स नाप्नोति फलं तस्य परत्रेति विचारितम्
verses.transliteration: Apatkalpena yo dharmaM kurute.anApadi dvijaH | sa nApnoti phalaM tasya paratreti vichAritam
verses.translation: But a twice-born, who, without being in distress, performs his duties according to the law for times of distress, obtains no reward for them in the next world; that is the opinion (of the sages).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: विश्वैश्च देवैः साध्यैश्च ब्राह्मणैश्च महर्षिभिः । आपत्सु मरणाद्भीतैर्विधेः प्रतिनिधिः कृतः
verses.transliteration: vishvaishcha devaiH sAdhyaishcha brAhmaNaishcha maharShibhiH | Apatsu maraNAdbhItairvidheH pratinidhiH kR^itaH
verses.translation: By the Visve-devas, by the Sadhyas, and by the great sages (of the) Brahmana (caste), who were afraid of perishing in times of distress, a substitute was made for the (principal) rule.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: एतेभ्यो हि द्विजाग्र्येभ्यो देयमन्नं सदक्षिणम् । इतरेभ्यो बहिर्वेदि कृतान्नं देयमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: etebhyo hi dvijAgryebhyo deyamannaM sadakShiNam | itarebhyo bahirvedi kR^itAnnaM deyamuchyate
verses.translation: To these most excellent among the twice-born, food and presents (of money) must be given; it is declared that food must be given to others outside the sacrificial enclosure.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: प्रभुः प्रथमकल्पस्य योऽनुकल्पेन वर्तते । न साम्परायिकं तस्य दुर्मतेर्विद्यते फलम्
verses.transliteration: prabhuH prathamakalpasya yo.anukalpena vartate | na sAmparAyikaM tasya durmatervidyate phalam
verses.translation: That evil-minded man, who, being able (to fulfil) the original law, lives according to the secondary rule, reaps no reward for that after death.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: न ब्राह्मणो वेदयेत किञ्चिद्राजनि धर्मवित् । स्ववीर्येणैव तांशिष्यान् मानवानपकारिणः
verses.transliteration: na brAhmaNo vedayeta ki~nchidrAjani dharmavit | svavIryeNaiva tA.nshiShyAn mAnavAnapakAriNaH
verses.translation: A Brahmana who knows the law need not bring any (offence) to the notice of the king; by his own power alone be can punish those men who injure him.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: स्ववीर्याद्राजवीर्याच्च स्ववीर्यं बलवत्तरम् । तस्मात्स्वेनैव वीर्येण निगृह्णीयादरीन् द्विजः
verses.transliteration: svavIryAdrAjavIryAchcha svavIryaM balavattaram | tasmAtsvenaiva vIryeNa nigR^ihNIyAdarIn dvijaH
verses.translation: His own power is greater than the power of the king; the Brahmana therefore, may punish his foes by his own power alone.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतीरथर्वाङ्गिरसीः कुर्यादित्यविचारयन् । वाक्षस्त्रं वै ब्राह्मणस्य तेन हन्यादरीन् द्विजः
verses.transliteration: shrutIratharvA~NgirasIH kuryAdityavichArayan | vAkShastraM vai brAhmaNasya tena hanyAdarIn dvijaH
verses.translation: Let him use without hesitation the sacred texts, revealed by Atharvan and by Angiras; speech, indeed, is the weapon of the Brahmana, with that he may slay his enemies.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रियो बाहुवीर्येण तरेदापदमात्मनः । धनेन वैश्यशूद्रौ तु जपहोमैर्द्विजोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: kShatriyo bAhuvIryeNa taredApadamAtmanaH | dhanena vaishyashUdrau tu japahomairdvijottamaH
verses.translation: A Kshatriya shall pass through misfortunes which have befallen him by the strength of his arms, a Vaisya and a Sudra by their wealth, the chief of the twice-born by muttered prayers and burnt-oblations.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: विधाता शासिता वक्ता मैत्रो ब्राह्मण उच्यते । तस्मै नाकुशलं ब्रूयान्न शुष्कां गिरमीरयेत्
verses.transliteration: vidhAtA shAsitA vaktA maitro brAhmaNa uchyate | tasmai nAkushalaM brUyAnna shuShkAM giramIrayet
verses.translation: The Brahmana is declared (to be) the creator (of the world), the punisher, the teacher, (and hence) a benefactor (of all created beings); to him let no man say anything unpropitious, nor use any harsh words.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: न वै कन्या न युवतिर्नाल्पविद्यो न बालिशः । होता स्यादग्निहोत्रस्य नार्तो नासंस्कृतस्तथा
verses.transliteration: na vai kanyA na yuvatirnAlpavidyo na bAlishaH | hotA syAdagnihotrasya nArto nAsa.nskR^itastathA
verses.translation: Neither a girl, nor a (married) young woman, nor a man of little learning, nor a fool, nor a man in great suffering, nor one uninitiated, shall offer an Agnihotra.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: नरके हि पतन्त्येते जुह्वन्तः स च यस्य तत् । जुह्वतः तस्माद्वैतानकुशलो होता स्याद्वेदपारगः
verses.transliteration: narake hi patantyete juhvantaH sa cha yasya tat | juhvataH tasmAdvaitAnakushalo hotA syAdvedapAragaH
verses.translation: For such (persons) offering a burnt-oblation sink into hell, as well as he to whom that (Agnihotra) belongs; hence the person who sacrifices (for another) must be skilled in (the performance of) Vaitana (rites), and know the whole Veda.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: प्राजापत्यमदत्त्वाऽश्वमग्न्याधेयस्य दक्षिणाम् । अनाहिताग्निर्भवति ब्राह्मणो विभवे सति
verses.transliteration: prAjApatyamadattvA.ashvamagnyAdheyasya dakShiNAm | anAhitAgnirbhavati brAhmaNo vibhave sati
verses.translation: A Brahmana who, though wealthy, does not give, as fee for the performance of an Agnyadheya, a horse sacred to Pragapati, becomes (equal to one) who has not kindled the sacred fires.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यान्यन्यानि कुर्वीत श्रद्दधानो जितेन्द्रियः । न त्वल्पदक्षिणैर्यज्ञैर्यजेतेह कथं चन
verses.transliteration: puNyAnyanyAni kurvIta shraddadhAno jitendriyaH | na tvalpadakShiNairyaj~nairyajeteha kathaM chana
verses.translation: Let him who has faith and controls his senses perform other meritorious acts, but let him on no account offer sacrifices at which he gives smaller fees (than those prescribed).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: सर्वरत्नानि राजा तु यथार्हं प्रतिपादयेत् । ब्राह्मणान् वेदविदुषो यज्ञार्थं चैव दक्षिणाम्
verses.transliteration: sarvaratnAni rAjA tu yathArhaM pratipAdayet | brAhmaNAn vedaviduSho yaj~nArthaM chaiva dakShiNAm
verses.translation: But a king shall bestow, as is proper, jewels of all sorts, and presents for the sake of sacrifices on Brahmanas learned in the Vedas.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणि यशः स्वर्गमायुः कीर्तिं प्रजाः पशून् । हन्त्यल्पदक्षिणो यज्ञस्तस्मान्नाल्पधनो यजेत्
verses.transliteration: indriyANi yashaH svargamAyuH kIrtiM prajAH pashUn | hantyalpadakShiNo yaj~nastasmAnnAlpadhano yajet
verses.translation: The organs (of sense and action), honour, (bliss in) heaven, longevity, fame, offspring, and cattle are destroyed by a sacrifice at which (too) small sacrificial fees are given; hence a man of small means should not offer a (Srauta) sacrifice.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: अग्निहोत्र्यपविद्याग्नीन् ब्राह्मणः कामकारतः । चान्द्रायणं चरेन् मासं वीरहत्यासमं हि तत्
verses.transliteration: agnihotryapavidyAgnIn brAhmaNaH kAmakArataH | chAndrAyaNaM charen mAsaM vIrahatyAsamaM hi tat
verses.translation: A Brahmana who, being an Agnihotrin, voluntarily neglects the sacred fires, shall perform a lunar penance during one month; for that (offence) is equal to the slaughter of a son.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: ये शूद्रादधिगम्यार्थमग्निहोत्रमुपासते । ऋत्विजस्ते हि शूद्राणां ब्रह्मवादिषु गर्हिताः
verses.transliteration: ye shUdrAdadhigamyArthamagnihotramupAsate | R^itvijaste hi shUdrANAM brahmavAdiShu garhitAH
verses.translation: Those who, obtaining wealth from Sudras, (and using that) offer an Agnihotra, are priests officiating for Sudras, (and hence) censured among those who recite the Veda.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: तेषां सततमज्ञानां वृषलाग्न्युपसेविनाम् । पदा मस्तकमाक्रम्य दाता दुर्गाणि संतरेत्
verses.transliteration: teShAM satatamaj~nAnAM vR^iShalAgnyupasevinAm | padA mastakamAkramya dAtA durgANi sa.ntaret
verses.translation: Treading with his foot on the heads of those fools who worship a fire (kindled at the expense) of a Sudra, the giver (of the wealth) shall always pass over his miseries (in the next world).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: अकुर्वन् विहितं कर्म निन्दितं च समाचरन् । प्रसक्तश्चैन्द्रियार्थेषु प्रायश्चित्तीयते नरः
verses.transliteration: akurvan vihitaM karma ninditaM cha samAcharan | prasaktashchaindriyArtheShu prAyashchittIyate naraH
verses.translation: A man who omits a prescribed act, or performs a blamable act, or cleaves to sensual enjoyments, must perform a penance.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: प्रसज्जनिन्द्रियार्थेषु अकामतः कृते पापे प्रायश्चित्तं विदुर्बुधाः । कामकारकृतेऽप्याहुरेके श्रुतिनिदर्शनात्
verses.transliteration: prasajjanindriyArtheShu akAmataH kR^ite pApe prAyashchittaM vidurbudhAH | kAmakArakR^ite.apyAhureke shrutinidarshanAt
verses.translation: (All) sages prescribe a penance for a sin unintentionally committed; some declare, on the evidence of the revealed texts, (that it may be performed) even for an intentional (offence).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: अकामतः कृतं पापं वेदाभ्यासेन शुध्यति । कामतस्तु कृतं मोहात्प्रायश्चित्तैः पृथग्विधैः
verses.transliteration: akAmataH kR^itaM pApaM vedAbhyAsena shudhyati | kAmatastu kR^itaM mohAtprAyashchittaiH pR^ithagvidhaiH
verses.translation: A sin unintentionally committed is expiated by the recitation of Vedic texts, but that which (men) in their folly commit intentionally, by various (special) penances.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्तीयतां प्राप्य दैवात्पूर्वकृतेन वा । न संसर्गं व्रजेत्सद्भिः प्रायश्चित्तेऽकृते द्विजः
verses.transliteration: prAyashchittIyatAM prApya daivAtpUrvakR^itena vA | na sa.nsargaM vrajetsadbhiH prAyashchitte.akR^ite dvijaH
verses.translation: A twice-born man, having become liable to perform a penance, be it by (the decree of) fate or by (an act) committed in a former life, must not, before the penance has been performed, have intercourse with virtuous men.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: इह दुश्चरितैः के चित्के चित्पूर्वकृतैस्तथा । प्राप्नुवन्ति दुरात्मानो नरा रूपविपर्ययम्
verses.transliteration: iha dushcharitaiH ke chitke chitpUrvakR^itaistathA | prApnuvanti durAtmAno narA rUpaviparyayam
verses.translation: Some wicked men suffer a change of their (natural) appearance in consequence of crimes committed in this life, and some in consequence of those committed in a former (existence).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णचौरः कौनख्यं सुरापः श्यावदन्तताम् । ब्रह्महा क्षयरोगित्वं दौश्चर्म्यं गुरुतल्पगः
verses.transliteration: suvarNachauraH kaunakhyaM surApaH shyAvadantatAm | brahmahA kShayarogitvaM daushcharmyaM gurutalpagaH
verses.translation: He who steals the gold (of a Brahmana) has diseased nails; a drinker of (the spirituous liquor called) Sura, black teeth; the slayer of a Brahmana, consumption; the violator of a Guru's bed, a diseased skin;
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: कृतदारोऽपरान् दारान् भिक्षित्वा योऽधिगच्छति । रतिमात्रं फलं तस्य द्रव्यदातुस्तु संततिः
verses.transliteration: kR^itadAro.aparAn dArAn bhikShitvA yo.adhigachChati | ratimAtraM phalaM tasya dravyadAtustu sa.ntatiH
verses.translation: If a man who has a wife weds a second wife, having begged money (to defray the marriage expenses, he obtains) no advantage but sensual enjoyment; but the issue (of his second marriage belongs) to the giver of the money.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: पिशुनः पौतिनासिक्यं सूचकः पूतिवक्त्रताम् । धान्यचौरोऽङ्गहीनत्वमातिरैक्यं तु मिश्रकः
verses.transliteration: pishunaH pautinAsikyaM sUchakaH pUtivaktratAm | dhAnyachauro.a~NgahInatvamAtiraikyaM tu mishrakaH
verses.translation: An informer, a foul-smelling nose; a calumniator, a stinking breath; a stealer of grain, deficiency in limbs; he who adulterates (grain), redundant limbs;
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: अन्नहर्ताऽमयावित्वं मौक्यं वागपहारकः । वस्त्रापहारकः श्वैत्र्यं पङ्गुतामश्वहारकः
verses.transliteration: annahartA.amayAvitvaM maukyaM vAgapahArakaH | vastrApahArakaH shvaitryaM pa~NgutAmashvahArakaH
verses.translation: A stealer of (cooked) food, dyspepsia; a stealer of the words (of the Veda), dumbness a stealer of clothes, white leprosy; a horse-stealer, lameness.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: एवं कर्मविशेषेण जायन्ते सद्विगर्हिताः । जडमूकान्धबधिरा विकृताकृतयस्तथा
verses.transliteration: evaM karmavisheSheNa jAyante sadvigarhitAH | jaDamUkAndhabadhirA vikR^itAkR^itayastathA
verses.translation: The stealer of a lamp will become blind; he who extinguishes it will become one-eyed; injury (to sentient beings) is punished by general sickliness; an adulterer (will have) swellings (in his limbs).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: चरितव्यमतो नित्यं प्रायश्चित्तं विशुद्धये । निन्द्यैर्हि लक्षणैर्युक्ता जायन्तेऽनिष्कृतेनसः
verses.transliteration: charitavyamato nityaM prAyashchittaM vishuddhaye | nindyairhi lakShaNairyuktA jAyante.aniShkR^itenasaH
verses.translation: Thus in consequence of a remnant of (the guilt of former) crimes, are born idiots, dumb, blind, deaf, and deformed men, who are (all) despised by the virtuous.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्या सुरापानं स्तेयं गुर्वङ्गनागमः । महान्ति पातकान्याहुः संसर्गश्चापि तैः सह
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyA surApAnaM steyaM gurva~NganAgamaH | mahAnti pAtakAnyAhuH sa.nsargashchApi taiH saha
verses.translation: Penances, therefore, must always be performed for the sake of purification, because those whose sins have not been expiated, are born (again) with disgraceful marks.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: अनृतं च समुत्कर्षे राजगामि च पैशुनम् । गुरोश्चालीकनिर्बन्धः समानि ब्रह्महत्यया
verses.transliteration: anR^itaM cha samutkarShe rAjagAmi cha paishunam | guroshchAlIkanirbandhaH samAni brahmahatyayA
verses.translation: Killing a Brahmana, drinking (the spirituous liquor called) Sura, stealing (the gold of a Brahmana), adultery with a Guru's wife, and associating with such (offenders), they declare (to be) mortal sins (mahapataka).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोज्झता वेदनिन्दा कौटसाक्ष्यं सुहृद्वधः । गर्हितानाद्ययोर्जग्धिः सुरापानसमानि षट्
verses.transliteration: brahmojjhatA vedanindA kauTasAkShyaM suhR^idvadhaH | garhitAnAdyayorjagdhiH surApAnasamAni ShaT
verses.translation: Falsely attributing to oneself high birth, giving information to the king (regarding a crime), and falsely accusing one's teacher, (are offences) equal to slaying a Brahmana.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: निक्षेपस्यापहरणं नराश्वरजतस्य च । भूमिवज्रमणीनां च रुक्मस्तेयसमं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: nikShepasyApaharaNaM narAshvarajatasya cha | bhUmivajramaNInAM cha rukmasteyasamaM smR^itam
verses.translation: Forgetting the Veda, reviling the Vedas, giving false evidence, slaying a friend, eating forbidden food, or (swallowing substances) unfit for food, are six (offences) equal to drinking Sura.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: रेतःसेकः स्वयोनीषु कुमारीष्वन्त्यजासु च । सख्युः पुत्रस्य च स्त्रीषु गुरुतल्पसमं विदुः
verses.transliteration: retaHsekaH svayonIShu kumArIShvantyajAsu cha | sakhyuH putrasya cha strIShu gurutalpasamaM viduH
verses.translation: Stealing a deposit, or men, a horse, and silver, land, diamonds and (other) gems, is declared to be equal to stealing the gold (of a Brahmana).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: गोवधोऽयाज्यसंयाज्यं पारदार्यात्मविक्रयः । गुरुमातृपितृत्यागः स्वाध्यायाग्न्योः सुतस्य च
verses.transliteration: govadho.ayAjyasa.nyAjyaM pAradAryAtmavikrayaH | gurumAtR^ipitR^ityAgaH svAdhyAyAgnyoH sutasya cha
verses.translation: Carnal intercourse with sisters by the same mother, with (unmarried) maidens, with females of the lowest castes, with the wives of a friend, or of a son, they declare to be equal to the violation of a Guru's bed.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: धनानि तु यथाशक्ति विप्रेषु प्रतिपादयेत् । वेदवित्सु विविक्तेषु प्रेत्य स्वर्गं समश्नुते
verses.transliteration: dhanAni tu yathAshakti vipreShu pratipAdayet | vedavitsu vivikteShu pretya svargaM samashnute
verses.translation: One should give, according to one's ability, wealth to Brahmanas learned in the Veda and living alone; (thus) one obtains after death heavenly bliss.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: परिवित्तिताऽनुजेऽनूढे परिवेदनमेव च । तयोर्दानं च कन्यायास्तयोरेव च याजनम्
verses.transliteration: parivittitA.anuje.anUDhe parivedanameva cha | tayordAnaM cha kanyAyAstayoreva cha yAjanam
verses.translation: Slaying kine, sacrificing for those who are unworthy to sacrifice, adultery, selling oneself, casting off one's teacher, mother, father, or son, giving up the (daily) study of the Veda, and neglecting the (sacred domestic) fire,
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: कन्याया दूषणं चैव वार्धुष्यं व्रतलोपनम् । तडागारामदाराणामपत्यस्य च विक्रयः
verses.transliteration: kanyAyA dUShaNaM chaiva vArdhuShyaM vratalopanam | taDAgArAmadArANAmapatyasya cha vikrayaH
verses.translation: Allowing one's younger brother to marry first, marrying before one's elder brother, giving a daughter to, or sacrificing for, (either brother),
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: व्रात्यता बान्धवत्यागो भृत्याध्यापनमेव च । भृत्या चाध्ययनादानमपण्यानां च विक्रयः
verses.transliteration: vrAtyatA bAndhavatyAgo bhR^ityAdhyApanameva cha | bhR^ityA chAdhyayanAdAnamapaNyAnAM cha vikrayaH
verses.translation: Defiling a damsel, usury, breaking a vow, selling a tank, a garden, one's wife, or child,
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: भृताच्चाध्ययनादानम् सर्वाकारेष्वधीकारो महायन्त्रप्रवर्तनम् । हिंसौषधीनां स्त्र्याजीवोऽभिचारो मूलकर्म च
verses.transliteration: bhR^itAchchAdhyayanAdAnam sarvAkAreShvadhIkAro mahAyantrapravartanam | hi.nsauShadhInAM stryAjIvo.abhichAro mUlakarma cha
verses.translation: Living as a Vratya, casting off a relative, teaching (the Veda) for wages, learning (the Veda) from a paid teacher, and selling goods which one ought not to sell,
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: इन्धनार्थमशुष्काणां द्रुमाणामवपातनम् । आत्मार्थं च क्रियारम्भो निन्दितान्नादनं तथा
verses.transliteration: indhanArthamashuShkANAM drumANAmavapAtanam | AtmArthaM cha kriyArambho ninditAnnAdanaM tathA
verses.translation: Superintending mines (or factories) of any sort, executing great mechanical works, injuring (living) plants, subsisting on (the earnings of) one's wife, sorcery (by means of sacrifices), and working (magic by means of) roots, (and so forth),
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: अनाहिताग्निता स्तेयं ऋणानामनपक्रिया । असत्शास्त्राधिगमनं कौशीलव्यस्य च क्रिया
verses.transliteration: anAhitAgnitA steyaM R^iNAnAmanapakriyA | asatshAstrAdhigamanaM kaushIlavyasya cha kriyA
verses.translation: Cutting down green trees for firewood, doing acts for one's own advantage only, eating prohibited food,
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: धान्यकुप्यपशुस्तेयं मद्यपस्त्रीनिषेवणम् । स्त्रीशूद्रविट्क्षत्रवधो नास्तिक्यं चोपपातकम्
verses.transliteration: dhAnyakupyapashusteyaM madyapastrIniShevaNam | strIshUdraviTkShatravadho nAstikyaM chopapAtakam
verses.translation: Neglecting to kindle the sacred fires, theft, non-payment of (the three) debts, studying bad books, and practising (the arts of) dancing and singing,
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणस्य रुजः कृत्वा घ्रातिरघ्रेयमद्ययोः । जैह्म्यं च मैथुनं पुंसि जातिभ्रंशकरं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNasya rujaH kR^itvA ghrAtiraghreyamadyayoH | jaihmyaM cha maithunaM pu.nsi jAtibhra.nshakaraM smR^itam
verses.translation: Stealing grain, base metals, or cattle, intercourse with women who drink spirituous liquor, slaying women, Sudras, Vaisyas, or Kshatriyas, and atheism, (are all) minor offences, causing loss of caste (Upapataka).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: खराश्वोष्ट्रमृगैभानामजाविकवधस्तथा । सङ्करीकरणं ज्ञेयं मीनाहिमहिषस्य च
verses.transliteration: kharAshvoShTramR^igaibhAnAmajAvikavadhastathA | sa~NkarIkaraNaM j~neyaM mInAhimahiShasya cha
verses.translation: Giving pain to a Brahmana (by a blow), smelling at things which ought not to be smelt at, or at spirituous liquor, cheating, and an unnatural offence with a man, are declared to cause the loss of caste (Gatibhramsa)
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: निन्दितेभ्यो धनादानं वाणिज्यं शूद्रसेवनम् । अपात्रीकरणं ज्ञेयमसत्यस्य च भाषणम्
verses.transliteration: ninditebhyo dhanAdAnaM vANijyaM shUdrasevanam | apAtrIkaraNaM j~neyamasatyasya cha bhAShaNam
verses.translation: Killing a donkey, a horse, a camel, a deer, an elephant, a goat, a sheep, a fish, a snake, or a buffalo, must be known to degrade (the offender) to a mixed caste (Samkarikarana).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: यस्य त्रैवार्षिकं भक्तं पर्याप्तं भृत्यवृत्तये । अधिकं वाऽपि विद्येत स सोमं पातुमर्हति
verses.transliteration: yasya traivArShikaM bhaktaM paryAptaM bhR^ityavR^ittaye | adhikaM vA.api vidyeta sa somaM pAtumarhati
verses.translation: He who may possess (a supply of) food sufficient to maintain those dependant on him during three years or more than that, is worthy to drink the Soma-juice.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: कृमिकीटवयोहत्या मद्यानुगतभोजनम् । फलेधः।कुसुमस्तेयमधैर्यं च मलावहम्
verses.transliteration: kR^imikITavayohatyA madyAnugatabhojanam | phaledhaH.kusumasteyamadhairyaM cha malAvaham
verses.translation: Accepting presents from blamed men, trading, serving Sudras, and speaking a falsehood, make (the offender) unworthy to receive gifts (Apatra).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: एतान्येनांसि सर्वाणि यथोक्तानि पृथक्पृथक् । यैर्यैर्व्रतैरपोह्यन्ते तानि सम्यग्निबोधत
verses.transliteration: etAnyenA.nsi sarvANi yathoktAni pR^ithakpR^ithak | yairyairvratairapohyante tAni samyagnibodhata
verses.translation: Killing insects, small or large, or birds, eating anything kept close to spirituous liquors, stealing fruit, firewood, or flowers, (are offences) which make impure (Malavaha).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महा द्वादश समाः कुटीं कृत्वा वने वसेत् । भैक्षाश्यात्मविशुद्ध्यर्थं कृत्वा शवशिरो ध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: brahmahA dvAdasha samAH kuTIM kR^itvA vane vaset | bhaikShAshyAtmavishuddhyarthaM kR^itvA shavashiro dhvajam
verses.translation: Learn (now) completely those penances, by means of which all the several offences mentioned (can) be expiated.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: लक्ष्यं शस्त्रभृतां वा स्याद्विदुषामिच्छयाऽत्मनः । प्रास्येदात्मानमग्नौ वा समिद्धे त्रिरवाक्षिराः
verses.transliteration: lakShyaM shastrabhR^itAM vA syAdviduShAmichChayA.atmanaH | prAsyedAtmAnamagnau vA samiddhe triravAkShirAH
verses.translation: For his purification the slayer of a Brahmana shall make a hut in the forest and dwell (in it) during twelve years, subsisting on alms and making the skull of a dead man his flag.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: यजेत वाऽश्वमेधेन स्वर्जिता गोसवेन वा । अभिजिद्विश्वजिद्भ्यां वा त्रिवृताऽग्निष्टुताऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: yajeta vA.ashvamedhena svarjitA gosavena vA | abhijidvishvajid.hbhyAM vA trivR^itA.agniShTutA.api vA
verses.translation: Or let him, of his own free will, become (in a battle) the target of archers who know (his purpose); or he may thrice throw himself headlong into a blazing fire;
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: जपन् वाऽन्यतमं वेदं योजनानां शतं व्रजेत् । ब्रह्महत्यापनोदाय मितभुज्ञियतेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: japan vA.anyatamaM vedaM yojanAnAM shataM vrajet | brahmahatyApanodAya mitabhuj~niyatendriyaH
verses.translation: Or he may offer a horse-sacrifice, a Svargit, a Gosava, an Abhigit, a Visvagit, a Trivrit, or an Agnishtut;
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्वं वेदविदुषे ब्राह्मणायोपपादयेत् । धनं हि जीवनायालं गृहं वा सपरिच्छदम्
verses.transliteration: sarvasvaM vedaviduShe brAhmaNAyopapAdayet | dhanaM hi jIvanAyAlaM gR^ihaM vA saparichChadam
verses.translation: Or, in order to remove (the guilt of) slaying a Brahmana, he may walk one hundred yoganas, reciting one of the Vedas, eating little, and controlling his organs;
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: हविष्यभुग्वाऽनुसरेत्प्रतिस्रोतः सरस्वतीम् । जपेद्वा नियताहारस्त्रिर्वै वेदस्य संहिताम्
verses.transliteration: haviShyabhugvA.anusaretpratisrotaH sarasvatIm | japedvA niyatAhArastrirvai vedasya sa.nhitAm
verses.translation: Or he may present to a Brahmana, learned in the Vedas, whole property, as much wealth as suffices for the maintenance (of the recipient), or a house together with the furniture;
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: कृतवापनो निवसेद्ग्रामान्ते गोव्रजेऽपि वा । आश्रमे वृक्षमूले वा गोब्राह्मणहिते रतः
verses.transliteration: kR^itavApano nivasedgrAmAnte govraje.api vA | Ashrame vR^ikShamUle vA gobrAhmaNahite rataH
verses.translation: Or, subsisting on sacrificial food, he may walk against the stream along (the whole course of the river) Sarasvati; or, restricting his food (very much), he may mutter thrice the Samhita of a Veda.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणार्थे गवार्थे वा सद्यः प्राणान् परित्यजेत् । संयक्प्राणान् मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्याया गोप्ता गोर्ब्राह्मणस्य च
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNArthe gavArthe vA sadyaH prANAn parityajet | sa.nyakprANAn muchyate brahmahatyAyA goptA gorbrAhmaNasya cha
verses.translation: Having shaved off (all his hair), he may dwell at the extremity of the village, or in a cow-pen, or in a hermitage, or at the root of a tree, taking pleasure in doing good to cows and Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: अतः स्वल्पीयसि द्रव्ये यः सोमं पिबति द्विजः । स पीतसोमपूर्वोऽपि न तस्याप्नोति तत्फलम्
verses.transliteration: ataH svalpIyasi dravye yaH somaM pibati dvijaH | sa pItasomapUrvo.api na tasyApnoti tatphalam
verses.translation: But a twice-born man, who, though possessing less than that amount of property, nevertheless drinks the Soma-juice, does not derive any benefit from that (act), though he may have formerly drunk the Soma-juice.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: त्रिवारं प्रतिरोद्धा वा सर्वस्वमवजित्य वा । त्र्यवरं विप्रस्य तन्निमित्ते वा प्राणालाभे विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: trivAraM pratiroddhA vA sarvasvamavajitya vA | tryavaraM viprasya tannimitte vA prANAlAbhe vimuchyate
verses.translation: He who unhesitatingly abandons life for the sake of Brahmanas or of cows, is freed from (the guilt of) the murder of a Brahmana, and (so is he) who saves (the life of) a cow, or of a Brahmana.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: प्राणालाभेऽपि मुच्यते एवं दृढव्रतो नित्यं ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः । समाप्ते द्वादशे वर्षे ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति
verses.transliteration: prANAlAbhe.api muchyate evaM dR^iDhavrato nityaM brahmachArI samAhitaH | samApte dvAdashe varShe brahmahatyAM vyapohati
verses.translation: If either he fights at least three times (against robbers in defence of) a Brahmana's (property), or reconquers the whole property of a Brahmana, or if he loses his life for such a cause, he is freed (from his guilt).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: शिष्ट्वा वा भूमिदेवानां नरदेवसमागमे । स्वमेनोऽवभृथस्नातो हयमेधे विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: shiShTvA vA bhUmidevAnAM naradevasamAgame | svameno.avabhR^ithasnAto hayamedhe vimuchyate
verses.translation: He who thus (remains) always firm in his vow, chaste, and of concentrated mind, removes after the lapse of twelve years (the guilt of) slaying a Brahmana.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: धर्मस्य ब्राह्मणो मूलमग्रं राजन्य उच्यते । तस्मात्समागमे तेषामेनो विख्याप्य शुध्यति
verses.transliteration: dharmasya brAhmaNo mUlamagraM rAjanya uchyate | tasmAtsamAgame teShAmeno vikhyApya shudhyati
verses.translation: Or he who, after confessing his crime in an assembly of the gods of the earth (Brahnanas), and the gods of men (Kshatriyas), bathes (with the priests) at the close of a horse-sacrifice, is (also) freed (from guilt).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणः सम्भवेनैव देवानामपि दैवतम् । प्रमाणं चैव लोकस्य ब्रह्मात्रैव हि कारणम्
verses.transliteration: brahmaNaH sambhavenaiva devAnAmapi daivatam | pramANaM chaiva lokasya brahmAtraiva hi kAraNam
